article.articleHeadline: Projeção da Fiocruz não vê epidemia como a de 2024, mas dengue segue em alerta para 2027
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz projection does not foresee an epidemic like the one in 2024, but dengue remains on alert for 2027.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces a dengue season in 2027 with an estimated 860,000 probable cases, according to projections by Fiocruz, FGV, and InfoDengue, with uncertainty from about 560,000 to 1.6 million. The projection, presented in early November 2026 at a virtual event, indicates no epidemic like 2024 but ongoing vigilance similar to 2025–2026. The key preventive measure is eliminating standing water to curb Aedes aegypti reproduction, which could ease pressures on health services. El Niño is acknowledged as a contingency factor with an uncertain multiplier effect. October–November are identified as critical for training health teams and informing the public. Health systems in higher-risk areas must be ready for rapid diagnosis and treatment. Primary barrier remains removing breeding sites before summer; recommended actions include clearing water-holding containers, closing reservoirs, cleaning gutters/drains, adding sand to plant saucers, and using screens and repellents in transmission zones.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルスの予測では2024年のような流行は見込まれないが、デング熱は2027年も引き続き警戒対象
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける季節性デング熱の年次予測記事であり、2024年のような大規模流行は見込まれていない。異常事態ではなくルーティンの公衆衛生予測・準備情報であるため見送りとする。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年発生する季節性疾患で、本記事は2027年に向けた予測と予防策の呼びかけであり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではない。Fiocruz等の研究機関による予測公表であり政府機関の関心はあるが、国際的な異常事態や渡航制限等には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 11 mil infetados e 5.400 mortes: porque é tão difícil travar o Ébola no Congo?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 11,000 infected and 5,400 deaths: why is it so difficult to stop Ebola in the Congo?
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, has killed more than 5,400 and infected over 11,000, with new cases running at 400–500 per week six months after the outbreak was declared. The epidemic has spread across 67 health zones in eight provinces. Children are disproportionately affected, accounting for more than a quarter of confirmed cases and about one third of deaths; mortality among children under five reaches roughly 70%. Late detection and weak contact tracing hamper responses. Insecurity and armed conflict impede access; the WHO notes more than 80 attacks on health facilities since the outbreak began, while population displacement and movement restrictions complicate control measures. Laboratory capacity has expanded, with about 2,000 beds available in treatment and transit facilities. The WHO stresses strengthening security and response capacity to mitigate the crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 感染者1万1千人以上、死者5400人超:コンゴのエボラ流行がなぜ止められないのか
triage.triage_reason: 致死率が高く大規模な感染拡大が続き、武装紛争や保健施設への攻撃により対応が困難であるため、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威としてフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 武装紛争・治安悪化・保健施設への攻撃が対応を妨げており、WHOは安全保障強化と対応能力強化を強調している。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en la RDC: advierten riesgo de brote continental y esto se sabe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Warning of the risk of a continental outbreak and what is known.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains one of the gravest in recent memory, with 11,254 confirmed cases and 5,505 deaths (case fatality 48.9%) as of 15 November 2026, spanning 67 health zones in eight provinces. The Bundibugyo strain poses additional challenges, with no vaccines or therapies as effective as those for the Zaire variant. Declared six months ago, the outbreak threatens regional and continental spread amid insecurity, population displacement, and resource shortfalls. Across the region, 80% of new cases are detected outside formal health systems, and about 65% of victims die without specialized care. Cross-border transmission has occurred: Kenya reports 9 cases and 2 deaths; Nigeria is also cited. Response includes surveillance, case isolation, and risk communication, but financing gaps (~$60 million) and security barriers impede control. The United States has imposed entry suspensions for travelers from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：大陸規模の流行リスクを警告、現在分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,254例・死亡5,505例（CFR48.9%）に達する大規模エボラ流行であり、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境感染や米国の入国制限措置など国際的拡大・渡航制限が既に発生しているため、IHR4基準すべてに該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・米国・スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyo株はZaire株用のワクチン・治療薬の有効性が低く、対応能力に重大な懸念あり。資金ギャップ約6000万ドルも指摘されている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 검역본부, 고병원성 조류인플루엔자(AI) 위험주의보 발령
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quarantine Headquarters issues a risk advisory for highly pathogenic avian influenza (AI)
article.articleSummary: Nov 13, 2026: Korea's Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency (APQA) issued a High-Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) risk advisory as domestic poultry outbreaks rise and wild birds test positive for H5N1 and H5N9. Since Oct 12, HPAI antigens were detected in wild birds at Suncheon Bay, with a total of 10 detections to date, and six poultry-farm outbreaks: Yeoncheon and Yeoju (Gyeonggi Province) layer farms; Jangheung (Jeollanam-do) fattening duck farm; Ganghwa (Incheon) layer farm; Jincheon (Chungcheongbuk-do) breeding duck farm; and Paju (Gyeonggi) quail farm. Migratory-bird tracking shows a mallard moving south from Baicheng, Jilin, China, arriving in Uljin, North Gyeongsang, by Nov 7. In Japan, HP AI antigens were detected in wild birds/environments in Akita, Hokkaido, Kagoshima, with suspected cases in Kyoto (200,000-layer) and Chiba (40,000-layer) farms. Measures include two-stage farm-vehicle disinfection, PPE and dedicated footwear, closing back doors without anterooms, entry disinfection, hand hygiene, and intensified central inspections.

triage.headline_ja: 検疫本部、高病原性�local インフルエンザ(AI)危険注意報発令
triage.triage_reason: 韓国・日本で家禽・野鳥のHPAI(H5N1/H5N9)検出が増加し渡り鳥による越境拡散が確認されているが、人への感染報告はなく情報が限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽・野鳥でのHPAI検出事例であり、人への感染事例は報告されていない。中国（吉林省）は渡り鳥の移動経路として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。対象国（韓国・日本）はリスト対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Sikar Viral Fever News: सीकर में वायरल का वार, 11 दिन में 80 हजार मरीज पहुंचे अस्पताल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sikar Viral Fever News: Viral fever strikes in Sikar; 80,000 patients reached hospitals in 11 days.
article.articleSummary: In Sikar district, a seasonal viral fever surge following weather changes has overwhelmed public health facilities. In the last 11 days, OPDs at CHCs and PHCs logged over 80,000 patients, about twice the normal 40–44k. Patients report high fever, joint pain, muscle aches, profound weakness, and fatigue, with gastrointestinal symptoms such as vomiting and diarrhea. Some patients show reduced platelet counts, and 36 dengue and chikungunya cases have been recorded, triggering an anti-vector response. Health authorities have initiated larval control around homes, fogging, and the deployment of MLO oil in stagnant water, while blood tests for fever patients are being intensified. Hospitals have been instructed to maintain essential medicines stock and to restrict nonessential staff leaves to ensure care. CMHO Dr. Ashok Maharia emphasized mandatory blood investigations for fever cases.

triage.headline_ja: シーカル季節性ウイルス熱アウトブレイク情報:シーカルでウイルス熱が猛威、11日間で8万人が病院を受診
triage.triage_reason: インドのシーカル県で季節性ウイルス熱（デング熱・チクングニア熱36例含む）の患者数が通常の約2倍に急増しているが、重症度や国際的拡大の情報はなく、地元当局が既に対応を開始しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性ウイルス熱の急増を主題とし、デング熱・チクングニア熱は36例確認されたのみ。地元保健当局（CHC/PHC）がベクター対策（防蚊、燻蒸、幼虫駆除）と血液検査強化を実施中。重症例・死亡例の報告はなく、国際的な拡大リスクも記載なし。季節性パターンとされているが、通常比約2倍の患者数増加は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand's Dengue Cases and Deaths Put Prevention in Focus
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 34,875 dengue infections and 47 deaths nationwide through Nov 7, 2026, with southern Health Region 11 recording transmission at 1.7 times the national average amid flood-driven mosquito breeding. Floodwaters in the Gulf of Thailand monsoon fuel late-season outbreaks; national infections peaked in August at about 1,450, versus 2,700 in August 2025. School-age children and working-age adults account for most cases, while older adults experience deadlier outcomes due to underlying conditions; officials have mobilized village health volunteers to clear larval habitats before floodwaters recede. Early dengue mimics flu; symptoms include fever 39–40 C, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle aches, and nausea. Red-flag signs—vomiting, abdominal pain, skin bleeding, nosebleeds, dark stools—require emergency care. Prevention centers on eliminating standing water weekly, repairing screens, sleeping under nets, and using DEET/picaridin. Travelers should monitor weekly provincial advisories.

triage.headline_ja: タイのデング熱感染者数・死亡者数増加、予防対策に注目
triage.triage_reason: タイの季節性デング熱流行で、洪水による蚊媒介感染の継続が懸念されるが、症例数は前年より少なく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 例年発生する季節性デング熱であり、2026年の症例数は2025年同時期より少ない。洪水による蚊媒介感染リスクの継続が主な懸念点。タイ政府は自国内対応（村落保健ボランティアの動員等）で対処中であり、外部支援の必要性は低いと見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox ultrapassa mil casos no Brasil e registra primeira morte em 2026 - Três Passos News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox surpasses 1,000 cases in Brazil and records first death in 2026 - Três Passos News
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) infections in Brazil exceed 1,000 cases in 2026, with Rio de Janeiro recording the year's first death. A 48-year-old man with HIV-related immunosuppression died; the death was confirmed by the state health secretariat. As of Nov 12, Brazil had 1,023 confirmed cases, 46 probable, and 581 suspected, with one fatality; over half of confirmations occurred in October–November. In Rio de Janeiro, 382 confirmed cases were reported by Nov 13, with about two-thirds since Sep 13. The city accounts for roughly 70% of cases, and 55 patients were hospitalized. Mpox is caused by a virus related to smallpox and transmits mainly through close contact with infected lesions, with symptoms including fever, muscle pains, lymphadenopathy, and skin rash. Vaccination efforts include more than 2,000 doses allocated to Rio de Janeiro for priority groups, including people with HIV/AIDS; authorities urge avoidance of contact with suspected cases and prompt medical care.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでMpoxが1,000例を超え、2026年初の死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpox症例が1,000例超・死亡例発生という重大な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、HIV感染者への拡大や入院例の多さからWPRO基準・IHR基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: リオデジャネイロ州が症例の約70%を占め、免疫不全（HIV陽性）患者での死亡例が確認されている。ワクチン配布など対応が進行中だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限への言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Use available Ebola vaccine without delay: Médecins Sans Frontières
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts Médecins Sans Frontières to urge rapid use of ERVEBO, the only Ebola vaccine deployed at scale. With Bundibugyo-specific vaccines still under development and not licensed, MSF notes that results are months away, and for children under 12 the timeline extends further. ERVEBO is licensed for people aged one year and older and has a well-established safety profile with extensive operational use in previous DRC Ebola responses. MSF argues that the absence of a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine should not block immediate protection for healthcare workers, frontline responders, contacts of confirmed cases, and affected communities. It calls for lifting restrictions that tie ERVEBO vaccination to research protocols to enable rapid deployment and reduce severe disease and deaths while vaccine candidates are studied. Published November 16, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチンの速やかな使用を：国境なき医師団が訴え
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクが発生しており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大のリスクがあるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株エボラはDRCで発生しており、既存のERVEBOワクチンの使用拡大をMSFが要請している。株特異的ワクチンは未承認で、研究プロトコルに縛られた使用制限の解除が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: DBD Tak Kenal Musim, Jumantik Pun Tak Berhenti Berantas Jentik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Knows No Season, Jumantik Also Continues to Eradicate Larvae
article.articleSummary: Dengue Fever (DBD) remains a year-round threat in Jakarta as Aedes aegypti larvae (jentik) are found beyond the rainy season. On 13 November 2026 at 08:30 WIB in Slipi, West Jakarta, Jumantik volunteers from RT 002 RW 002 Palmerah conducted a house-to-house larval source reduction (PSN) drive, forming two groups (~15 houses each) to inspect 35 residences. Three homes harbored larvae. Larvae were commonly found in outdoor plant pots and discarded items, with interior breeding in bathtubs or unsealed water containers. Muhammad Agus Setiawan of Puskesmas Palmerah urged immediate larval disposal and resident education; checks occur at least twice weekly. Volunteers like Nurhikmah (48) in Kemanggisan and Dina (27) in Grogol Utara monitor over 50 homes, focusing on exterior areas and hidden spaces, and intensify efforts if a Dengue case is confirmed. Abate larvicide is used to prevent further growth.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱に季節なし、ジュマンティックも幼虫駆除を止めない
triage.triage_reason: ジャカルタにおける恒常的なデング熱対策・幼虫駆除活動に関する一般的な報道であり、異常な増加や重症例、新規アウトブレイクの情報はない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアで流行性があり通年対策が行われているが、本記事は地域コミュニティの日常的な予防活動（PSN/幼虫駆除）に関する内容であり、症例数の急増や異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya Masih Mengancam, Masyarakat Diimbau Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya Still Threatens, Public Urged to Be Vigilant.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya remains a public health threat in West Kalimantan, Indonesia, with transmission by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. Despite less media attention, risk persists as mosquitoes continue to breed, especially during the rainy season when standing water increases. Symptoms include sudden fever up to about 39°C, joint and muscle pain, headache, skin rash, and fatigue; onset typically 3–7 days after a bite, though it can range 2–12 days. Preventive measures focus on the 3M Plus program: drain standing water weekly, tightly seal water storage, and dispose or reuse items that collect rainwater; also use mosquito repellent, install screens, and wear long sleeves. Individuals with sudden fever and joint pain should seek medical care promptly since chikungunya resembles dengue fever, necessitating medical testing for confirmation. Continued environmental hygiene and routine prevention help reduce mosquito breeding and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱は依然として脅威、住民に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 西カリマンタンにおけるチクングニア熱の注意喚起・予防啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数増加や異常な流行拡大の報告はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的な蚊媒介感染症への一般的な警戒喚起であり、具体的な感染者数や急増の記述なし。続報があれば注視する程度。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情持续六个月 已致5400余人死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has persisted for six months, killing more than 5,400 people.
article.articleSummary: As of November 16, 2026, a Bundibugyo-type Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has persisted for six months, with over 11,000 confirmed cases and more than 5,400 deaths. Weekly cases continue at 400–500. Children account for >25% of cases and ~33% of deaths; among under-5s, the fatality rate is around 70%. Imported cases have been reported in Kenya and Nigeria, signaling cross-border transmission risk. Around 100 health and humanitarian organizations are delivering relief. Diagnostics labs have expanded from 2 to >20; 104 treatment/evacuation centers provide nearly 2,000 beds. About 3,000 patients have recovered, with roughly one-quarter joining survivor support programs. Training reached >17,000 community health workers and >46,000 community workers. Nearly 90% of registered deaths have been buried safely and with dignity. Attacks on health services exceed 80 since the outbreak began.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が6か月継続、死者5400人超
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱の継続的流行で死者5400人超、国境を越えた伝播（ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入例）も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。主たる発生地はDRC。医療従事者への攻撃が80件超など、対応能力への懸念も高い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola deaths cross 5,500 as violence hampers response
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 5,500 deaths with 11,254 confirmed cases as of November 12, six months into the crisis. Weekly new infections remain 400–500, with transmission reaching remote rural areas. Children account for more than a quarter of confirmed cases and about one-third of deaths (CFR 48.9%). Violence in Ituri and North Kivu disrupts surveillance: a Cantine-Aloya attack killed 66 civilians (including three health workers) and looted three facilities, leaving over 1,000 contacts lost to follow-up; another assault reported November 11. Testing capacity expanded from two laboratories to more than two dozen; nearly 2,000 treatment beds across 104 treatment and transit centers; around 3,000 patients recovered. Imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria highlight cross-border risk. The outbreak is the world’s second-largest Ebola epidemic; vaccine/treatment candidates remain under evaluation. Government plans total 1.3 billion USD; a 2.2-billion-dollar appeal (launched in June) is ~54% funded, with emphasis on reaching conflict-affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、死者5,500人超え、暴力が対応を阻害
triage.triage_reason: 死者5,500人超・CFR約49%の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大や武装勢力による対応阻害など、公衆衛生上・国際的に重大な懸念があるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。世界第2位の規模のエボラ流行であり、資金不足（アピールの54%のみ充足）と武装勢力による対応妨害が継続的な拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola en Congo alcanza cifras alarmantes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo reaches alarming levels.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached alarming levels. As of November 15, the World Health Organization reports 11,254 confirmed cases and 5,505 deaths, with a national case-fatality rate of 48.9% and 400–500 new weekly infections. Children are highly affected, comprising over a quarter of cases and about a third of deaths, including a 70% mortality rate among those under five. Africa CDC reports 80% of cases outside medical surveillance and 65% of patients dying without specialized care. The risk of cross-border spread is underscored by imported infections detected in Kenya and Nigeria. Since the outbreak began, more than 80 attacks on facilities and health workers have occurred, with 74 healthcare workers killed. On November 6, an attack in Cantine-Aloya, North Kivu, killed 66 civilians, including three doctors.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、深刻な水準に到達
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.9%、死者5,505人という深刻な公衆衛生への影響があり、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡散も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは輸入症例の検出国であり、対象国リストにDRCのみ含まれるためverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。医療従事者への攻撃や保健インフラの崩壊が流行制御を著しく困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ministry steps up Ebola awareness, surveillance in Busia
article.articleSummary: Ebola awareness and surveillance have intensified in Busia, Kenya, focusing on Teso North during the 42-day mandatory monitoring toward Ebola-free status, due to end December 23, 2026. Led by the Ministry of Health and the Kenya Red Cross Society, the programme strengthens community awareness, early detection, and prevention along the Northern Corridor border. Target groups include sex workers, long-distance truck drivers, persons with disabilities, women’s groups, youth, the elderly, and religious leaders; chiefs and ward leaders will mobilize residents and facilitate referrals, with herbalists and traditional healers directing danger-sign patients to facilities. No community transmission has been reported; Kenyan cases are linked to infections from the Democratic Republic of Congo. A 30-day action roadmap, 'Together for a Healthy and Safe Teso North,' guides activities, and officials warn against misconceptions such as chang'aa immunity.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、ブシア県でエボラ出血熱に関する啓発・サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ感染がケニア国境地域で確認され、国境を越えた感染拡大・監視体制強化が行われているため、IHR基準複数該当とみなしフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニア（ブシア県）における国境サーベイランス強化であるが、感染源はDRCであり、ケニア国内での市中感染は報告されていない。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、感染源であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Sebut 3.000 Orang Pulih dari Ebola di Republik Demokratik Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Says 3,000 People Recovered from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Approximately 3,000 people have recovered from Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) amid the largest recorded outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of 16 November 2026, more than 11,000 confirmed cases and 5,400 deaths have been reported across 67 health zones in eight provinces. The WHO notes progression toward containment, with transmission slowing at initial outbreak centers and ongoing results from clinical trials, including the Tumaini study and several candidate vaccines. Six months after WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, Tedros Ghebreyesus urged safe humanitarian access, ending hostilities, and community engagement to encourage early treatment. He also called on donors to increase funding; Africa CDC reports about two-thirds of the $2.9 billion raised for Ebola response has not yet been disbursed. WHO remains committed to supporting Congo until zero cases."

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラから3,000人が回復したと発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言した史上最大規模のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行であり、11,000人超の感染者、5,400人の死亡者が8州67保健地域に及んでいるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長によるPHEIC宣言から6か月が経過し、資金調達（29億ドルの2/3が未拠出）や人道的アクセス確保が課題として挙げられている。既にWHO管理下での大規模対応が進行中の既知の継続イベントであるため、フルRRAによる最新状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dulu Dianggap Kasus "Impor", Kini Malaria Muncul di Dataran Tinggi Papua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Once Thought to Be an 'Imported' Case, Malaria Now Emerges in the Papua Highlands.
article.articleSummary: Malaria, once considered an imported disease in the Papua Highlands, now shows evidence of local transmission in Wamena, Jayawijaya Regency. While most cases historically traced to travel to endemic districts, reports from Wamena indicate infections occurring without leaving the town, including multiple family cases in Kampung Tulem and Wita Waya. In January–October 2026, Jayawijaya recorded 1,144 malaria positives from 8,091 tests; Yahukimo 10,112/18,555; Nduga 9,589/10,463. Across Papua Highlands, malaria deaths reached 20, with four in Jayawijaya. Local health workers say malaria cases are usually linked to mobility to endemic areas, but rising exposure within highland communities is emerging. Climate warming, greater land connectivity to Jayapura and other endemic regions may facilitate a local vector (Anopheles). Public health measures urged include education at airports and continued bed net use; diagnosis remains common in clinics.

triage.headline_ja: かつては「輸入」症例とされていたマラリアが、今やパプア高地で発生
triage.triage_reason: パプア高地ワメナ地域で従来は輸入症例とされていたマラリアの現地感染が確認され、死亡者も出ており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Papua New Guineaは地域データに含まれるが記事の主題はインドネシア・パプア高地（ワメナ、ジャヤウィジャヤ、ヤフキモ）であり、PNGでの発生については言及がないため除外した。高地での媒介蚊（Anopheles）の定着と気候変動の影響による新たな伝播拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: நாமக்கல்லில் பறவைக் காய்ச்சல் பாதிப்புக்கு 100% வாய்ப்பு இல்லை: முட்டைக் கோழி பண்ணையாளர்கள் உறுதி
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Namakkal: Egg-laying chicken farmers say there is no 100% chance of an avian influenza outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, Namakkal district in Tamil Nadu hosts over 1,000 poultry farms with about 100 million egg-laying hens, producing roughly 80 million eggs daily. These eggs supply Tamil Nadu’s public distribution system and reach Kerala and international markets. Earlier, in Cuddalore district, thousands of broiler chickens died due to avian influenza. Namakkal Poultry Farmers Association secretary Sundararajan told reporters that strict biosecurity is in place and the risk of a bird-flu outbreak is not 100% likely in Namakkal. Guidance from Tamil Nadu Veterinary and Animal Sciences University and Namakkal Veterinary College Hospital supports continued rearing of laying hens. At farm entry points, vehicles are disinfected with potassium permanganate solution, restricting access. There has been no avian influenza impact on Namakkal poultry, and there is no need for alarm among farmers or the public.

triage.headline_ja: ナマッカルで鳥インフルエンザ発生の可能性は100%ない：採卵鶏農家が断言
triage.triage_reason: 記事はタミルナードゥ州ナマッカル地区で鳥インフルエンザの影響がないことを強調する内容であり、クダロール地区でのブロイラー死亡は過去の局所的事例として言及されるのみ。人への感染報告はなく、バイオセキュリティ対策も機能しており社会的懸念・国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 記事はナマッカル地区での鳥インフルエンザ非発生と安全性を強調する内容。クダロール地区での家禽死亡事例はタミルナードゥ州内の既知の動物衛生イベントであり、人への感染や国際的拡大の兆候はない。ケララは卵の流通先として言及されているのみで発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal Penyakit Pes Peran Tikus, Pinjal, dan Cara Pencegahannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understanding the Plague: The Role of Rats and Fleas, and How to Prevent It
article.articleSummary: Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, remains a public health concern. Transmission in humans involves a three-trophic cycle: rats, rat fleas (Xenopsylla cheopis), and the bacterium. Infected fleas bite humans after their rat hosts die, enabling spillover. House rats (Rattus rattus) and Norway rats (Rattus norvegicus) are of particular concern due to proximity to people. Historically, the Black Death (1347–1351) demonstrated the disease’s deadly potential. In Russia, flea vectors are pivotal to human risk, but transmission remains unlikely without infected fleas. In Indonesia, plague activity is limited to several districts on Java, with ongoing Ministry of Health surveillance. The most effective prevention is rodent control in residential areas, including sanitation and securing waste to remove food sources. The report also notes other rat-borne diseases, such as leptospirosis and hantavirus, highlighting the need for general environmental hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: ペストを理解する:ネズミ、ノミの役割、そして予防方法
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な啓発・教育記事であり、具体的な新規発生や症例急増の報告はない。既知の限定的な流行地域に関する記述のみ。
triage.notes: 記事はペストの基礎知識と予防法に関する一般啓発記事。インドネシアのジャワ島の一部地域で限定的なペスト活動があり保健省が監視中との記述があるが、新規の集団発生や異常事態の報告ではない。ロシアに関する記述は一般的な媒介生物の説明であり、具体的な発生報告ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 대응에 9억 달러 풀었지만...현장은 '빈 손'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Poured $900 million into the Ebola response, but the field is empty-handed.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province, ongoing since May. As of Nov 13, 2026 (six months after declaration), about 11,000+ confirmed cases and 5,000+ deaths. No approved vaccine or therapy exists for Bundibugyo virus. Despite roughly $900 million in international donations, about $700 million of funds’ use is unaccounted or unverified at the field level, with frontline staff often unpaid or unaided and fuel shortages crippling vehicles and ambulances. Surveillance is weak: only around 9% of treated patients had previously identified contacts; some areas lack mobile data or reporting capabilities. MSF warns the response is not reaching many communities and urges stronger governance and prioritization of resources to high-need districts, including clinics, pharmacies, and community actors. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba has asked donors to disclose funding sources and uses to improve accountability.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応に9億ドルを投入したが、現場は『手ぶら』
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行が6か月継続し、1万人超の感染・5千人超の死亡という重大な公衆衛生影響があり、サーベイランス不備・資金不透明性からヒト-ヒト感染拡大や国際支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株による大規模流行で、資金・ガバナンス不全が現場対応を阻害していることがMSFにより指摘されている。続報で国際的拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果（金）伊波拉疫情持續　6個月病例逾萬宗逾5400死　肯尼亞尼日利亞現輸入個案 (10:15) - 20261116 - 國際
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues; over 10,000 cases and more than 5,400 deaths in six months; Kenya and Nigeria report imported cases (10:15) - 2026-11-16 - International.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists into its sixth month, with cumulative cases exceeding 11,000 and deaths surpassing 5,400, according to Africa CDC on Sunday, November 15. The epidemic remains active, with roughly 400–500 new cases each week. Children account for more than a quarter of diagnosed cases and about one-third of deaths; case fatality among under-five children is approximately 70%. Imported cases have been reported in Kenya and Nigeria, highlighting cross-border transmission risk. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus. Public health authorities warn that continued spread remains likely without enhanced surveillance and cross-border cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（金）でエボラ疫情が継続、6か月で症例1万件超・死者5400人超、ケニア・ナイジェリアで輸入症例確認
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%の大規模エボラ流行が6か月継続し、国境を越えた輸入症例（ケニア・ナイジェリア）が確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは輸入症例として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo株による流行で、小児の致死率が非常に高い点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Patricia Gouw Pilih Rawat Sendiri Putranya yang Kena Flu Singapura, Ini Alasannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patricia Gouw Chooses to Take Care of Her Son Who Caught Singapore Flu, Here's the Reason.
article.articleSummary: Singapore flu, or hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD), affected Zoe, two-year-old son of Patricia Gouw, in Indonesia. Patricia, speaking in Jakarta’s Tanah Abang area, described bumps on Zoe’s hands, palms, tongue, and feet. Early awareness allowed prompt home care in Bali, avoiding hospitalization to reduce transmission. Zoe recovered in four to five days; she did not develop severe mouth ulcers and maintained her appetite. Patricia suspects exposure came from interactions with many people through her child’s school attendance and frequent air travel together. During home care, strict hygiene protocols were observed, including wearing a mask at night to prevent spreading the virus and meticulous hand and skin care. The article notes no laboratory confirmation details. Date: 2026-11-16; locations: Bali and Jakarta (Tanah Abang).

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Penularan Kusta, Sulsel Beri Obat ke 13 Ribu Orang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To Prevent Leprosy Transmission, South Sulawesi Provides Medicine to 13,000 People
article.articleSummary: South Sulawesi, Indonesia, conducted the country’s first leprosy chemoprophylaxis program using single-dose rifampicin for close contacts of newly diagnosed patients. By Oct 28, 2026, the initiative enrolled 13,959 participants, exceeding the initial target of 10,000 (139.59%). The eight-day campaign ran Oct 21–28, 2026, across 24 regencies/cities and 257 puskesmas (community health centers), targeting 611 individuals as part of contact tracing and transmission prevention. Success attributed to coordinated efforts among the provincial and district health offices, health workers, and professional bodies including PERDOSKI Sulsel. South Sulawesi becomes the first Indonesian province to implement leprosy chemoprophylaxis on this scale. Health official Evi Mustikawati Arifin announced the outcome in Jakarta on Nov 15, 2026, with praise from Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin.

triage.headline_ja: ハンセン病感染予防のため、南スラウェシ州が1万3000人に投薬
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病であるハンセン病に対する予防的な公衆衛生プログラムの成功報告であり、新規性・異常性・緊急性のあるアウトブレイクではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防的化学予防（リファンピシン単回投与）プログラムの成功事例報告であり、アウトブレイクやシグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。保健当局の積極的な取り組みとして評価される内容。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia TB Fight: Over 700,000 Cases Found as Treatment Success Falls Short - Best Breaking News and Beyond: Singapore, Batam and some say JB
article.articleSummary: Indonesia identifies more than 700,000 tuberculosis cases in 2026, with about 90% of detected patients starting treatment. Through October, 666,985 cases were recorded, 599,425 of whom began therapy, while the Health Ministry estimates roughly 1.08 million new TB cases for the year. The ministry targets 972,000 detected cases in 2026 and is expanding screening through the Free Health Check program, workplaces, Islamic boarding schools, and other community settings; two village health workers per village (Rp500,000 monthly) support contact tracing and adherence. In Sumedang, West Java, local teams have screened 30,000 toward a 65,000 target. The Free Health Check is integrated with the national TB information system to improve follow-up and confirmatory testing. Treatment success remains below targets: about 80% for drug-sensitive TB (target 90%) and 58% for drug-resistant TB (target 80%), with some figures dating to 2025. Regional implications stress improving completion to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの結核対策:症例70万件超、治療成功率は目標に届かず
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアで常在化した疾患であり、本記事は年次の症例数・治療成功率に関する定例的な保健行政報告であって、急性の異常事象や国際的拡大リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核は長年の風土病であり、本記事は保健省の年次プログラム進捗報告（スクリーニング拡大・治療成功率の目標未達）を扱っており、突発的な公衆衛生危機を示すものではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Iklim Berubah, Ancaman DBD Meluas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As Climate Changes, the Dengue Fever Threat Expands.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia bears the highest dengue fever burden in Southeast Asia, with 488 of 514 districts reporting cases annually, despite prevention programs since the 1970s. Climate change is a key driver, as warmer temperatures, altered rainfall, and humidity accelerate Aedes aegypti breeding and shorten viral incubation. National dengue cases fluctuated from 65,602 in 2018 to 257,271 in 2024, then fell 33.6% to 170,798 in 2025, still above many years. Among the top 10 provinces in 2025, seven exceed 2015 levels; Lampung and Riau rise since 2023, with Lampung up 205% to 9,603, and Banten up 132% to 6,999. The three most populous provinces—West Java, East Java, Central Java—record the most cases, with West Java and Jakarta more than doubling. Bali has the highest national incidence in 2025 at 233.97 per 100,000, though the national rate is 60.32. Regional variations reflect climate, density, mobility, and vector-control effectiveness.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動により、デング熱の脅威が拡大
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで毎年流行しているデング熱の統計・傾向に関する記事であり、地域的な増加は見られるが突発的な異常事態や新規アウトブレイクではなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも明記されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は気候変動との関連性と地域別統計の分析記事。突発的なアウトブレイクではないためPICKUPには該当しないが、一部地域での顕著な増加率（Lampung+205%等）から継続的な監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue do El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño-linked dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Brazil is seen as El Niño-driven, with elevated risk as Pacific Ocean warming creates conditions favorable to Aedes aegypti proliferation (heavy rains and heat). After a global dengue surge of over 14 million cases two years ago, Brazil accounted for nearly half; in 2025 Brazil reported fewer than 2 million cases, with continued decline through the first half of that year. Projections indicate a potential rise to more than 800,000 notifications next year due to current El Niño dynamics. Preventive actions should start now: public campaigns and household measures to eliminate standing water (daily yard checks, drilling under plant pots, ensuring plant saucers aren’t waterlogged). Government guidance includes window screens, sealing water tanks, and clearing drains. Vaccination for 10–14-year-olds requires two doses, but about 3 million received only the first dose. Structural challenges—urban disorder, complacency, and variable political commitment—impair dengue prevention in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョに関連するデング熱
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱は既知の季節性・周期性疾患であり、現時点では予測・論評記事であって急性の異常事態ではないが、エルニーニョによる来シーズンの流行拡大予測があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は社説・論評であり、来年のデング熱流行拡大予測とワクチン接種率の課題、予防対策の必要性について述べている。既知の季節性感染症であり、現時点で新たな異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 泰南水灾 蚊虫滋生 拉响登革热警报|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Southern Thailand floods; mosquitoes proliferate; dengue fever alert sounded | Guanghua Net
article.articleSummary: Southern Thailand faces a dengue fever surge as floods and persistent rains increase mosquito breeding sites. Thailand's government issued a dengue warning on Nov 15 for residents in flood-affected areas. Nationwide, as of Nov 7, 34,875 dengue cases and 47 deaths have been reported. Data from the Department of Disease Control show dengue is particularly severe in the southern Health Regions 11 and 12. Region 11 covers Surat Thani, Ranong, Phuket, Phang Nga, Chumphon, and Krabi; Region 12 covers Trang, Narathiwat, Pattani, Yala, Songkhla, Satun, and Betong (in Yala). Due to ongoing rainfall, Region 11's dengue level is about 1.7 times the national average. The article emphasizes climate-driven transmission and the need for public health measures; it does not detail clinical symptoms or laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: タイ南部で洪水被害、蚊の大量発生でデング熱警報
triage.triage_reason: タイ南部で洪水に伴う蚊媒介性デング熱の季節的増加が報告されているが、既知の風土病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、政府が国内対応として警報を発出している段階であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 洪水による蚊の繁殖増加で南部（健康区域11・12）のデング熱症例が全国平均の約1.7倍に達しているが、全国累計34,875例・死亡47例は季節性の範囲内と考えられ、国際的な懸念拡大の兆候は記事から確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai sees highest malaria cases in five years, BMC data reveals
article.articleSummary: Mumbai recorded 12,574 malaria cases Jan–Oct 2026, the highest in at least five years, with September at 2,937. Dengue ELISA cases were 4,457 (Jan–Oct 2026), the lowest for the period since 2022; chikungunya 113 cases (Jan–Oct 2026), a four-year low; leptospirosis 430 cases (Jan–Oct 2026), also a four-year low. For comparison, 2022–2025 malaria totals were 3,564; 5,824; 6,491; 8,521 respectively, showing a rising malaria trend into 2025 before the 2026 spike. Data from the BMC Public Health Department in response to an RTI filed by activist Chetan Kothari; concerns raised about confirmatory testing access and declines in ELISA testing amid staff shortages and lack of rapid kits for chikungunya. Experts urge digitizing HMIS dashboards; officials maintain figures are accurate and doctors can treat with rapid tests despite testing gaps.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイのマラリア症例、過去5年で最多に ― BMCデータが明らかに
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイでマラリア症例が5年ぶりの最高値を記録し、報道・行政（RTI開示）双方で関心が高まっており、媒介生物感染症としての流行しやすさも懸念されるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事はムンバイ市（BMC）の年間データ開示（RTI請求への回答）に基づく定点報告であり、急性アウトブレイク事例ではない。ただしマラリア症例の5年来の急増、デング・チクングニア検査体制の縮小という懸念が報告されており、媒介生物感染症の流行動向として継続的な監視が望ましい。重症度（入院・死亡数）に関する情報は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 生吞新鮮蛇膽！陸5旬男「癱倒抽搐」　醫一看驚：滿腦寄生蟲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swallowing fresh snake gallbladder raw! Mainland man in his 50s collapses and convulses; doctor stunned: brain full of parasites.
article.articleSummary: In Taizhou, Zhejiang Province, China, a 50-year-old man swallowed fresh snake gallbladder after his father believed the folk remedy would clear heat and improve vision. Two to three months later he suffered abrupt left-sided weakness, collapsed, and had convulsions. Head imaging revealed brain lesions with numerous nodules and a peanut-sized cyst; laboratory assessment diagnosed neurocysticercosis due to pork tapeworm (Taenia solium). Doctors warn snakes can harbor parasites; ingesting snake gallbladder can introduce parasite eggs that hatch, larvae migrate to the brain, and form cysts causing seizures, hemiparesis, vision impairment, and incontinence, with potential for death. The case underscores that snake bile has no proven health benefits and carries high infection risk; seek proper medical care rather than relying on unproven folk remedies to avoid delays in treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 生のヘビの胆嚢を丸呑み！中国本土の50代男性が「倒れてけいれん」　医師が驚愕：脳が寄生虫だらけ
triage.triage_reason: 個人の民間療法による単発の有鉤嚢虫症（神経嚢虫症）症例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や公衆衛生上の拡大リスクはなく、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 単一症例の報告であり、民間療法（生のヘビの胆嚢摂取）による個人的な感染事例。ヒト-ヒト感染性はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急対応は不要。食習慣に関する啓発目的の記事と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Negacionismo contribui para volta do sarampo e aumenta risco de Covid
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Denialism contributes to the resurgence of measles and increases the risk of COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in New York State (Jan 1–Oct 3, 2026) totaled 108 cases, with 92 in rural areas of low vaccination coverage; the governor declared a state of emergency and boosted vaccination efforts. By November, the state reported its first measles-associated pediatric death in more than 30 years. Across the United States, 5,412 confirmed measles cases were reported by Nov 12, 2026, up from 2,289 in 2025 and 285 in 2024. The surge reflects rising denialism and anti-vaccine movements linked to far-right networks, including permissive vaccine-exemption laws (e.g., Texas). The article also notes a poliomyelitis case after 20 years, and cites Brazil’s COVID-19 era policies that reduced vaccination coverage, later reversed in 2024 to restore a measles-free status; São Paulo saw imported cases controlled via vaccination. Global coordination and the WHO remain essential for vaccine-led protection.

article.articleHeadline: Saat Soekarno Proaktif Berantas Malaria dari Kalasan, Sleman, DIY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When Soekarno Proactively Eradicated Malaria in Kalasan, Sleman, Yogyakarta Special Region.
article.articleSummary: Malaria eradication began in Kalasan, Sleman, Yogyakarta on 12 November 1959 when President Soekarno ordered DDT spraying on house walls, launching malaria control. The Malaria Eradication Service (KOPEM) worked with WHO/USAID toward elimination by 1970. Although the deadline was missed, by 1964 about 63 million people were protected, and Indonesia’s first National Health Day was observed in 1964. As of 2026, 414 districts have eliminated malaria, with Yogyakarta Special Region earning an elimination certificate alongside South Sumatra. Malaria now concentrates in Papua, where 2025 cases reached 706,297—about 95% from six Papua provinces, with Mimika as the largest contributor. Papua’s surveillance rose 337% from 2021–2025. The TOKEN strategy targets 800k new cases in 2026. Free first 15 days of treatment for CKG-detected patients; JKN covers the rest; 284 million people (~98%) insured. PKG screened 114 million by Nov 1, 2026; TB active case finding exceeded 700k with 90% on treatment.

article.articleHeadline: Ketika Nyamuk DBD "Naik" ke Dataran Tinggi Batu dan Malang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When the Dengue Mosquito Reaches the Batu and Malang Highlands.
article.articleSummary: DBD (dengue fever) persists in Batu and Malang highlands, East Java, with transmission despite cooler temperatures. In Batu, 96 dengue and dengue shock syndrome cases were recorded January–October 2026, with no deaths; 2024 saw 444 cases and five deaths, while 2023 and 2025 had 128 and 164 cases with one death each. Aedes aegypti remains capable due to vector adaptation; Batu’s climate averages 15–19°C with 75–98% humidity and substantial rainfall, sustaining breeding sites. High mobility and tourism—Batu attracted about 9.7 million visitors in 2025—increase the risk of viremic travelers introducing the virus. A local case, HF (15), was diagnosed in mid-October 2026 after fever and dizziness; epistaxis developed, platelet count fell to 190,000/µL and later rose to >200,000/µL after treatment, with discharge a week later. Health authorities attribute declines to intensified prevention, vector control, and improved early detection and management. In Malang Regency, highland districts such as Pujon and Poncokusumo face similar transmission, though data are incomplete.

article.articleSummary: Karyamekar Village in Cariu District, Bogor Regency, Indonesia, conducted a tuberculosis (TB) health awareness socialization on 16 November 2026 as part of the Bogor Regency Government’s Bankeu Akselerasi program. The event aimed to increase community knowledge of TB’s transmissibility and the importance of early detection, promote healthy living at home, and encourage proactive screening. Participants included village officials, representatives from TNI and Satpol PP, Puskesmas health workers, BPD, dusun heads, RW and RT leaders, Linmas, Posyandu cadres, and local residents. Village Head Jaji noted that funds support non-physical health activities beyond infrastructure. Babinsa Adim urged everyday hygiene and sharing acquired knowledge with families and neighbors, and reiterated that TB should not be stigmatized. The campaign highlighted the role of seven Posyandu in delivering community health services.

article.articleHeadline: Multinational study tests interventions to prevent tuberculosis - Society - The Jakarta Post
article.articleSummary: PHOTON (Prevention of Household Tuberculosis with Optimal Nutrition) is a multinational five-year trial launched Oct 2026, testing targeted nutritional supplements to prevent tuberculosis among household contacts of TB patients in Indonesia and Tanzania. The study enrolls 78,400 individuals—more than 42,000 from Indonesia and the remainder from Tanzania—to determine whether specific nutrition can interrupt the cycle between undernutrition and active TB. Results were presented on Nov 11 at the State of TB Innovation briefing by the Gates Foundation ahead of the World Conference on Lung Health in Rio de Janeiro. The WHO Global TB Report 2026, released Nov 12, notes TB as the deadliest infectious disease in 2025, with about 1.13 million deaths and 10.6 million cases; ~2.2 million cases were undiagnosed. Indonesia accounts for ~10% of global TB, with 1.08 million cases in 2024 (382/100,000), underscoring the goal to reduce incidence to 65/100,000 by 2030.

article.articleHeadline: डीआरसी के ग्रामीण इलाकों तक फैला इबोला, हिंसा की वजह से राहत कार्यों में बाधा | DR Congo Ebola outbreak spreads to remote areas as violence hampers response
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads to DR Congo's rural areas, relief efforts hampered by violence.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to spread from the eastern outbreak epicenters of Ituri and North Kivu into DR Congo’s rural areas. As of 12 November, 5,505 deaths and 11,254 confirmed infections have been reported. Despite progress at some hotspots, weekly new cases persist at 400–500. Bunia and Butembo show declines, but transmission remains in other rural zones; Bunia’s rate has halved. Testing capacity has risen from two labs to over two dozen; 104 treatment and transit centers now offer about 2,000 beds, with roughly 3,000 patients recovered. Contact tracing remains below target; cross-border cases have appeared in Kenya and Nigeria. Violence disrupts response, including a Kantine-Aloya attack in North Kivu killing 66 civilians and 3 health workers and looting three facilities. Over 80 attacks on health centers have been logged. WHO and partners urge sustained funding through 2027, and deployment of vaccines, backed by a $1.3 billion Ebola response plan.

article.articleSummary: China's sexually transmitted disease (STD) burden rose from 152 million cases in 1990 to 235 million in 2021, a gain of more than 50%, with genital herpes the most common (about 168 million) and Trichomonas infection responsible for the largest number of new cases (about 65 million). Frontiers in Public Health data (1990–2021) exclude HIV. The 30–34 age group has the highest incidence. Deaths declined significantly (4,893 to 2,235, −54%), while age‑adjusted incidence/prevalence remained stable. New STD cases reached about 148 million, with China leading; population growth drives totals, reaching about 252 million in 2027 and 248 million by 2035. Additional trends: gonorrhea rising among under‑20s; HIV infections in older adults increasing—60+ accounted for 32.3% of syphilis in 2019, and HIV infections in 60+ rose from 5,946 to 31,541 (2010–2018). A SW China city study notes 50+ HIV+ men who pay for sex often do not use condoms (84.7% and 87.7%).

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study: Sexually transmitted diseases in China have risen by more than 50% over the past 30 years, with cases reaching 235 million
article.articleSummary: From 1990 to 2021, China’s sexually transmitted infections (excluding HIV) rose by over 50%, total 235 million cases in 2021 (up from 152 million); annual new cases climbed from 124 million to 148 million. Genital herpes remains the largest disease burden (about 168 million cases in 2021), while trichomoniasis accounts for the most new infections (about 65 million in 2021). Incidence is highest among 30–34-year-olds (roughly 25,858 per 100,000). Globally, China led in 2021 for new STD cases, ahead of India and Indonesia; population growth is the main driver, with age-adjusted rates relatively stable and deaths down from 4,893 to 2,235 (−54%). Projections suggest a 2027 peak near 252 million, easing to about 248 million by 2035. Other findings show gonorrhea decreasing overall (−3.5%/year 2006–2020) but rising in under-20s; HIV infections in older adults are rising, with a Southwest China city noting high-risk behaviors and low condom use among men 50+.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sakon Nakhon warns to stay vigilant for Mpox; advises monitoring fever and abnormal rashes/lesions to prevent transmission.
article.articleSummary: As of November 16, 2026, Sakon Nakhon Province, Thailand, warns residents to be vigilant for mpox (monkeypox). Transmission occurs via close contact with an infected person, especially touching lesions, bodily fluids, or items contaminated with the virus (clothing, towels), and prolonged close proximity. Authorities urge self-care and protecting others to prevent community spread, noting mpox does not spread easily through everyday activities. Symptoms to monitor include fever, headache, muscle aches, and swollen lymph nodes, followed by abnormal rashes or lesions that may start as red spots and progress to vesicles, pustules, and crusts. Lesions may appear on the face, palms, soles, genitals, or anus. If symptoms develop or there is a history of exposure, avoid close contact, seek medical evaluation promptly, and provide accurate exposure details. Do not panic, but take appropriate precautions.

article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control six months after official declaration, with more than 11,200 infections and about 5,500 deaths, Africa CDC reported (via Reuters). The epidemic is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, making it the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak on record after West Africa's 2014–2016 epidemic. More than 80% of new cases are detected outside contact-tracing lists, and over 65% of deaths occur in the community away from health facilities. Ongoing response challenges include lethal attacks on health workers, delays in paying staff, and resource shortages, with persistent coordination problems between the Congolese government and international donors. The warning from experts emphasizes that unless transmission is stopped now, this could become the worst Ebola outbreak the world has suffered.

article.articleSummary: RSV, commonly discussed as a pediatric respiratory virus, also threatens adults over 70 in Indonesia. Dr. Ulul Albab, Sp.O.G., Subsp.Obginsos, highlighted that aging alters the respiratory system: alveoli and airways lose strength and elasticity, increasing susceptibility to respiratory syncytial virus infection. Cumulative exposure to cigarette smoke and environmental factors over years compounds risk in seniors. The physician used motorbike-commuting and lifelong smoke exposure as examples of prolonged environmental contact contributing to airway plaque and reduced airway function, likening the lungs to a worn hose with accumulated debris. The remarks were made at an event in Jakarta on November 11, 2026 (Sahabat Peduli Journalist Club Edisi 4). As of 16 November 2026, the article emphasizes that RSV risk in older adults stems from both physiological aging and long-term environmental exposure, not just age.

Weekly new cases total 400–500, with a national case fatality rate near 49%. Since May 15, more than 11,200 infections with the rare Bundibugyo strain and about 5,500 deaths have been recorded. Security in Ituri and North Kivu, including the November 6 Kantin-Aloya attack, has disrupted containment and contact tracing; cross-border cases reached Kenya and Nigeria.

article.articleHeadline: Tamil Nadu Culls 40,000 Chickens in Cuddalore Bird Flu
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza confirmed in Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore district near Kurinjipadi, triggering culling of about 40,000 chickens and a three-month ban on broiler farming in the affected area. Samples tested positive at the national laboratory in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. Public Health Director Dr. Somasundaram says no human cases have been detected in the state and has ordered strengthened statewide surveillance. Namakkal, a major egg-producing district, is prioritized for precautions. The outbreak follows a recent closure of Chennai’s Vandalur Zoo after bird infections. Officials urge the public to avoid handling dead birds with bare hands and to seek medical care promptly if fever, headache, muscle pain, cough or breathing difficulties appear, especially after contact with birds. Consumers should ensure chicken is thoroughly cooked to prevent infection.

triage.headline_ja: タミルナドゥ州、クダロールの鳥インフルエンザ発生で鶏4万羽を殺処分
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザがタミルナドゥ州で確認され、大規模な殺処分と養鶏禁止措置が取られており、WPRO基準で複数該当し社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 人間への感染例は報告されていないが、動物園での鳥感染に続く家禽アウトブレイクであり、卵生産地域への拡大懸念もあるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC warns of immense challenges over fragile Ebola gains
article.articleSummary: Six months since the May 15 declaration of the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), cumulative confirmed cases exceed 11,100 with over 5,400 deaths. Insecurity persists, with more than 80 attacks on health care in the past six months. Ongoing conflict, displacement and movement restrictions have continued to complicate containment efforts. Despite progress, an average of 400 to 500 new cases weekly in the DRC, with the virus expanding from three health zones in a single province to about 67 health zones across eight provinces. Children account for more than a quarter of confirmed cases and one-third of deaths; seven out of ten children under five with Ebola have died. Recent imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria underscore cross-border risk. Positive signs include control of early epicenters and halted rapid transmission; around 3,000 recoveries. Diagnostics have grown from 2 labs to >24; nearly 2,000 treatment beds across 104 treatment and transit centres. Cross-border collaboration improved; absence of licensed vaccines; research ongoing. Calls for sustained funding through 2027, political commitment, safe access, protection of health workers, and meaningful community participation.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、脆弱なエボラ対策の成果に対する重大な課題を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが8州67保健地区に拡大し、累計1万1千人超の感染・5400人超の死亡、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境事例も発生しており、IHR基準の複数に該当する深刻な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。治安悪化・医療従事者への攻撃・ワクチン未承認など継続的リスクが顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Laguna declared free from bird flu
article.articleSummary: Laguna, Philippines, is declared free from avian influenza (HPAI H5N1) by the Department of Agriculture after meeting animal health requirements per a circular issued on 2026-11-16. The province previously recorded 19 confirmed HPAI H5N1 cases, mostly in backyard duck farms: 13 cases in 2022 across San Pedro (8), Victoria (2), Los Baños (2), Pangil (1); and 6 cases in 2023 in Santa Cruz (4) and Lumban (2). In response, the provincial and local governments, DA Regional Field Office IV-A, and the Bureau of Animal Industry implemented control measures under the Avian Influenza Protection Program, including stamping out, cleaning and disinfection, biosecurity, and quarantine activities to prevent further spread. These coordinated efforts addressed infection risk from affected premises, enabling Laguna to regain bird flu-free status.

triage.headline_ja: ラグナ州、鳥インフルエンザ清浄化を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はフィリピン・ラグナ州が過去（2022-2023年）のHPAI H5N1発生から清浄化を宣言したという内容であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではなく、ヒトへの感染報告もない。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽（アヒル農場）における過去のH5N1発生事例の清浄化達成を報じるポジティブなニュースであり、新規感染や拡大の兆候はない。影響カテゴリも動物のみ。

article.articleHeadline: 民主刚果伊波拉疫情持续6个月 已致5400余人死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has lasted six months, killing more than 5,400 people.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-type Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has lasted six months, with over 11,000 cases and more than 5,400 deaths; weekly cases are about 400–500. Children account for more than a quarter of infections and roughly one third of deaths, with a 70% fatality rate among under-5s. Kenya and Nigeria have reported imported cases, signaling cross-border transmission risk. About 100 health and humanitarian partners are delivering aid. Diagnostics capacity has grown from 2 to over 20 laboratories; 104 treatment and transport centers provide nearly 2,000 beds. Around 3,000 patients have recovered, with a quarter in rehabilitation programs. Training has reached over 17,000 community health workers and 46,000 staff, and about 90% of registered deaths have been buried safely and with dignity. Ongoing challenges include armed conflict, displacement, and movement restrictions; over 80 attacks on health services have occurred since the outbreak began.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ流行が6カ月継続、死者5400人超

article.articleHeadline: エボラ流行、宣言から半年経ってもなお収束せず＝アフリカＣＤＣ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak remains uncontrolled even six months after the declaration — Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: As of November 16, 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains uncontrolled six months after declaration, according to Africa CDC chief Jean-Kaseya. Contributing factors include attacks on health workers, unpaid salaries, and resource shortages. Since May 15, there have been over 11,200 infections and about 5,500 deaths. More than 80% of new cases involve people not on contact lists, and over 65% of deaths occur in communities outside health facilities. Despite large funding promises, aid groups warn support has not reached hotspots, with untrained staff, fuelless ambulances, and shortages of surveillance teams hampering response. The outbreak is the rare Bundibugyo strain, the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record after 2014–2016 West Africa (approximately 28,600 infections and 11,000 deaths). Pledged funding totals about $2.9 billion; donors are urged to contribute $1.6 billion and coordinate with the government to minimize duplication.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、宣言から半年経ってもなお収束せず＝アフリカＣＤＣ
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が宣言から半年経過しても制御できておらず、感染者1万人超・死者5500人規模で国際的対応の必要性が高いためIHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるブンディブギョ株エボラ流行が主題。ウガンダ・アンゴラは地理的近接性による参考地域と思われ、記事本文で明確な発生報告はないため除外。既に史上2番目の規模の流行であり、資金・人員不足が継続的拡大リスクを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Số ca mắc sốt xuất huyết tại Hà Nội vẫn tăng cao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of dengue fever cases in Hanoi continues to rise
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, Hanoi records 619 dengue fever cases in the week of 6–13 November across 101 wards/communes, with 20 new outbreaks; 31 active outbreaks remain in the capital, indicating peak season. Hanoi CDC coordinates surveillance and containment, with focused monitoring in Kim Liên, Hòa Xá, Kiều Phú, and Ô Chợ Dừa. Household water containers are key larval habitats, prompting measures: rinse and cover water tanks, release fish in decorative tanks to eat larvae, refresh vase water regularly, add salt or safe chemicals to bowls or planters, and flip over unused containers. Authorities will continue vector-control campaigns and environmental sanitation; health facilities strengthen case detection and community surveillance. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and can affect all ages; danger rises during days 3–7 (defervescence), with warning signs such as severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, lethargy, mucosal bleeding, reduced urine. Seek prompt medical care and avoid NSAIDs.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイのデング熱患者数、依然として増加続く
triage.triage_reason: ハノイでデング熱の季節的流行が続いているが、ベトナムでは毎年見られる風土病的事象であり、IHR基準・社会的関心の高まりは確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ハノイCDCが監視・媒介蚊対策を主導しており、現地対応内で管理可能とみられる。死亡例や重症例の具体的数値は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Vụ nhiều người nhập viện ở Quảng Ngãi: Phát hiện vi khuẩn Salmonella trong các mẫu bánh mì
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Incident in Quang Ngai where many people were hospitalized: Salmonella bacteria detected in bread samples.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, Quảng Ngãi Province health authorities report a foodborne illness cluster linked to baguette bread sold at four outlets in Tịnh Khê and Đông Sơn communes. From 3–7 November, 22 patients were admitted to three hospitals with abdominal cramps, repeated diarrhea, vomiting and fever after consuming the bread. Investigations collected 13 food samples and 3 clinical specimens, sent to the Pasteur Institute Nha Trang for testing. Laboratory results showed Salmonella spp. in two-thirds of clinical samples; Salmonella spp. were also detected in foods including chả bò (minced beef), butter, dipping sauce, chà bông (pork floss) and sauce. Notably, bread and butter samples contained Staphylococcus aureus, with Staphylococcal enterotoxin detected. Other findings included Bacillus cereus and Escherichia coli in some samples. Inspections found the Ông Bảy baguette stand lacked separation from a restroom; some vendors lacked ingredient provenance records, food safety knowledge, and worker health documentation. Authorities urged stronger inspections and enforcement of food safety regulations to prevent recurrence.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ省での入院多発事案：バインミーのサンプルからサルモネラ菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 特定のパン屋の食品が原因と特定された局所的な食中毒クラスター（サルモネラ、黄色ブドウ球菌等）であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 感染源（パン・バター等）が特定され、保健当局により調査・是正措置が進行中。22名入院だが死亡報告なし。食品衛生管理の問題であり、感染症の国際的脅威には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak Defies Control as Conflict, Hunger Fuel Crisis Six Months In
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-16, six months into the largest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's history, containment remains elusive as it is entangled with hunger, armed conflict, mistrust, and a health system stretched to the limit. More than 11,000 people have been affected. The crisis underscores that public health response depends not only on medical measures but also on addressing severe food insecurity, ongoing conflict, and erosion of trust in health services. The situation illustrates how social and operational challenges—access to communities, security for responders, and resource constraints—shape the trajectory of this Ebola outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・エボラ流行、発生から6カ月紛争と飢餓が危機を悪化させ封じ込め困難に
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行（1万1千人超が影響）が6カ月続き、紛争・飢餓・不信感により封じ込めが困難化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける史上最大規模のエボラ流行を報じており、紛争・飢餓・医療システムの逼迫が制御を困難にしている。国境を越えた拡大の明示的記載はないが、規模と地域不安定性からリスクは高いと推定。続報でのケース増加・国際的対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: School in Cebu suspends face-to-face classes due to dengue cases
article.articleSummary: Tabunok Central Elementary School in Talisay City, Cebu, reports a clustering of dengue cases among students, prompting a one-week suspension of face-to-face classes with modular distance learning. The City Health Office, Dengue Task Force, and school personnel will conduct intensive cleaning, larval control, inspections, and removal of mosquito breeding sites within the campus, aided by misting activities. Mayor Samsam Gullas announced the preventive measure and said the city will reassess after one week and may extend the suspension if the cluster persists. The order applies only to in-person classes; learning continues through alternative arrangements. City authorities will maintain dengue surveillance in other schools in Talisay. No dengue case count is provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: セブの学校、デング熱症例により対面授業を停止
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・セブ州タリサイ市の小学校でデング熱クラスターが発生し対面授業を一時停止したが、感染者数や重症度等の詳細情報が不足しており、地域限定の対応で現時点では国際的な懸念は低い。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで毎年流行する風土病であり、学校単位でのクラスター対応は地方自治体レベルで管理可能。症例数や死亡者数の情報がなく、重症度の評価は不可。

article.articleHeadline: Nhiều người ngộ độc sau ăn bánh mì nhiễm khuẩn tại Quảng Ngãi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people poisoned after eating bacteria-contaminated bread in Quảng Ngãi
article.articleSummary: Twenty-two people in Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam, were hospitalized after eating bread contaminated with Salmonella and other bacteria from four vendors: Ông Bảy and bà Đô in Tịnh Khê commune; Thu and Hà in Đông Sơn commune. Illness onset occurred 3–7 November; patients presented with abdominal cramps, diarrhea, vomiting, and fever. All four outlets were suspended; authorities urged stricter sourcing, post-market surveillance, and training for street-food handlers. This follows a second bread-related outbreak in October (Bà Được) with Salmonella-positive samples.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ省で細菌汚染パンによる食中毒多発

article.articleHeadline: Six Months On, Accessing Hard-to-Reach Communities Key to Halting Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Six months into a Bundibugyo-virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, there are over 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths. Children account for more than a quarter of confirmed infections and about one third of deaths; seven in ten under-fives with confirmed Ebola have died. Transmission slowed, but 400–500 new weekly cases persist, with the outbreak expanding to 67 health zones. Contact follow-up remains below target, and many deaths occur in communities, signaling late detection. Imported cases have been reported in Kenya and Nigeria, underscoring cross-border risk. Diagnostics expanded from 2 to more than 24 labs; about 2,000 beds in 104 centres; roughly 3,000 recovered, a quarter in the survivor programme. Training includes 17,000 health workers and 46,000 actors; 1 million meals delivered to 180,000 people; ~90% of deaths received safe burials. Cantine-Aloya attacks killed 66; over 80 attacks on health workers. Halt hostilities and sustain funding through 2027.

article.articleHeadline: Afrique: Tuberculose - Plus d'un million de morts en 2025, la riposte mondiale piétine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Tuberculosis — More than one million deaths in 2025, the global response stalls.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, tuberculosis killed 1.13 million people globally in 2025 and caused 10.6 million new infections (54% men, 35% women, 11% children). The disease is airborne, primarily affecting the lungs. New-case reductions since 2015 reached only 14%, while deaths fell 35%—but the 2025 target of a 50% reduction in new cases and the 2030 goal of 90% mortality reduction remain out of reach. Thirty high-burden countries accounted for 88% of cases, led by India (~25% of new cases), with Indonesia (10%), the Philippines (6.8%), China (6.5%), Pakistan (6.4%), and Nigeria (4.9%). Financing for prevention/diagnosis/treatment in low- and middle-income countries rose to $6.6B in 2025, still far from the $22B/year target by 2027. TB killed 137,000 people living with HIV last year; 8.4M were newly diagnosed in 2025 (79% of 10.6M). Treatments (2000–2025) reportedly prevented 86M deaths; calls for expanded access and funding.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：結核 — 2025年に100万人以上が死亡、世界的対応は停滞
triage.triage_reason: 世界の結核に関する年次統計report（既知の慢性的流行病の進捗報告）であり、急性の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではないため、シグナルとして取り上げない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の慢性感染症であり、本記事はWHO等による世界的な年次統計・進捗報告に基づくもの。急性のアウトブレイクやクラスター事例ではないため、EBSシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。パキスタン・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。
