Thorough cooking of chicken and safe handling to prevent contamination are advised. Ongoing containment efforts aim to limit exposure and quickly identify infections; no imported/exported case details reported.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州、クダロールの養鶏場でH5N1検出後、鳥インフルエンザ監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 家禽でのH5N1感染が確認され防疫措置が取られているが、ヒト感染例は報告されておらず、公衆衛生への直接的影響は現時点で限定的。動物での発生として今後の人への感染拡大がないか経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ヒト感染例は未確認。家禽での発生に対する行政対応（殺処分・ブロイラー養殖禁止・監視強化）が主な内容。今後ヒトへの感染が報告されないか継続的な監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Cơn sốt nhẹ cũng có thể đẩy con vào vòng sinh tử trong 24 giờ do não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even a mild fever can push a child into a life-or-death ordeal within 24 hours due to meningococcal disease.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis) in Vietnam can progress to meningitis and septicemia within hours, with fulminant sepsis causing death in under 24 hours. In Ho Chi Minh City, 5 children have contracted meningococcal disease recently, including a 12-year-old who died from fulminant septic shock and multi-organ failure. Since the start of the year, the Southern region reported 45 cases and 9 deaths. Tay Ninh Province reported two positive cases on Nov 9: a 53-year-old factory worker and a 7-year-old student. Four serogroups—A, C, Y, W—are circulating in Vietnam; groups W and C are particularly virulent. Globally, serogroup W has the highest fatality. A tetravalent vaccine covering A, C, Y, W is available in Vietnam, with evidence of up to 90% risk reduction in adolescents and reduced transmission; it can be given in the first year of life. Prevention also includes hygiene and consulting a physician about vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 軽い発熱でも24時間以内に生死を分ける事態に陥ることがある髄膜炎菌感染症
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム南部（ホーチミン市・タイニン省）で髄膜炎菌感染症による小児死亡例を含むクラスターが報告され、重症度・流行しやすさの観点でWPRO基準に該当し、報道による社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: ベトナム南部で年初から45例・9死亡が報告されており、血清群W・Cの病原性が高いことが懸念点。4価ワクチンが利用可能であり、現時点で国外支援が必要との記述はないが、クラスター発生の継続性に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲疾控中心：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情仍处失控状态
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control.
article.articleSummary: As of November 12, 2026, six months after the May 15 declaration, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control, per Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kaseya. Cumulative confirmed cases: 11,254; deaths: 5,505. New infections include over 80% not previously identified as contacts; more than 65% of deaths occurred in the community, not health facilities. Healthcare workers have been attacked and killed, and staff have been unpaid for months. Donors pledged about $2.9 billion, but coordination with the government remains challenging; a release of roughly $1.6 billion is urged. WHO notes progress is hard-won: labs increased from 2 to 20+, about 3,000 patients recovered, and over 17,000 community health workers and 46,000 community members have been trained. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no approved vaccine or specific therapy; WHO calls it the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は依然として制御不能な状態
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大・最悪規模のエボラ流行が6か月経過しても制御不能であり、致死率・地域拡散・国際支援の必要性からIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHO・Africa CDCがDRC史上最大最悪のエボラ流行と明言。承認済みワクチン・治療薬なし、医療従事者への攻撃や未払い給与など対応能力に深刻な課題あり。資金拠出の遅延も懸念材料。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Laguna and Manila Declared Bird Flu-Free After Successful Containment Efforts
article.articleSummary: Laguna and Manila have been declared avian influenza-free after successful containment. Under Memorandum Circular Nos. 57 and 58, series 2026, Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr. formally lifted status for Laguna and Manila following depopulation, cleaning and disinfection, movement restrictions, and surveillance that confirmed absence of infection. Laguna recorded 19 confirmed H5N1 cases from 2022–2023, including eight in San Pedro and two each in Victoria, Los Baños, and Pangil (2022), plus four in Santa Cruz and two in Lumban (2023). Manila had a confirmed H5N1 case in January 2023 involving gamefowl chickens. Ongoing monitoring within one- and seven-kilometer surveillance zones around affected farms yielded negative results for influenza A. The World Organisation for Animal Health's Terrestrial Animal Health Code allows restoration of disease-free status at least 28 days after stamping-out with confirmed absence of infection; any new case would revoke the declaration.

triage.headline_ja: ラグナ州とマニラ、封じ込め成功により鳥インフルエンザ清浄地域に認定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は家禽の鳥インフルエンザ清浄化（終息宣言）を報じるものであり、新規感染拡大やヒト感染事例はなく、過去事例の収束報告であるため対応不要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は2022-2023年のH5N1家禽感染事例に関する清浄化宣言であり、現在進行中の感染拡大事例ではない。ヒトへの感染報告もなし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO ALERT: भारत में मेडिकल इमरजेंसी की चेतावनी, मच्छरों के कारण हजारों लोगों की मौत की संभावना
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO ALERT: Warning of a medical emergency in India, thousands could die due to mosquitoes.
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, 16 November 2026: WHO warns of a medical emergency in India as mosquito-borne diseases such as dengue fever, chikungunya, and Zika could spread in unprecedented severity due to El Niño-driven climate risks. Aedes aegypti thrive in heat and humidity, accelerating transmission as temperatures rise and the incubation period shortens. India is named high-risk for simultaneous heatwaves and vector-borne outbreaks in coming months, with December 2026 surface temperatures potentially 3.7°C above normal. The alert also cautions that 2027 could see heat-induced deaths. Authorities are urged to bolster district health infrastructure, maintain ample stocks of ORS, IV fluids, and anti-dengue medicines, and deploy larvicides in water containers. Public campaigns should stress testing for platelets and blood; avoid standing water; wear long sleeves; use nets and repellents. Emergency numbers: 112; 104; 1070/1077; Tele-MANAS 14416/1800-891-4416; 1915 for price gouging.

triage.headline_ja: WHOアラート：インドで医療緊急事態の警告、蚊媒介感染症により数千人が死亡する可能性
triage.triage_reason: エルニーニョによる気候変動を背景とした将来予測的な警告記事であり、実際の症例数・死者数等の具体的発生データが示されていない。デング熱等は毎年インドで流行する既知の疾患であり、現時点では続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事は地方メディア（Bhopal Samachar、ヒンディー語）による将来予測的な警告であり、WHOの公式発表かどうか真偽が不明。デング熱・チクングニア・ジカはインドで毎年発生する既知の蚊媒介感染症であり、気候変動による悪化予測が主題。実際の症例数・死亡者数等の実データが記載されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻度や異常性の判断材料が不足している。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: तमिलनाडु में बर्ड फ्लू की दस्तक, 40 हजार मुर्गियों को मारा गया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu hits Tamil Nadu; 40,000 chickens culled.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza H5N1 confirmed at a poultry farm in Kurinjipadi, Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, prompting intensified surveillance. About 40,000 chickens have been culled in the affected area, and a three-month pause on broiler farming has been imposed there. Samples sent to the National Lab in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, tested positive for H5N1. Chennai’s Vandalur Zoo reported bird infections and was temporarily closed for weeks; Namakkal, a major egg-production hub, is under heightened monitoring. Health Director Dr. Somu Sundaram ordered strengthened surveillance and containment, noting no human cases in Tamil Nadu so far and urging residents to stay vigilant without panic. Advice includes avoiding contact with dead birds and seeking immediate medical care if fever, headache, muscle pain, cough, or breathing difficulties arise, especially after poultry exposure. Emphasize fully cooked poultry and safe handling to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州で鳥インフルエンザ発生、4万羽の鶏が殺処分
triage.triage_reason: H5N1による家禽感染が確認され、動物園での感染拡大や養鶏場の操業停止など監視強化が行われており、パンデミックポテンシャルのあるH5N1である点から当局・メディアの関心も高いためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 現時点でヒト感染例は報告されていないが、H5N1は人獣共通感染症としてパンデミックポテンシャルを有するため、続報（ヒト症例の有無、他地域拡大）の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: भोपाल के 4 हजार घरों में मिला 'डेंगू का लार्वा', जानलेवा हो सकती लापरवाही, इन 7 लक्षणों को करें इग्नोर | Do Not Ignore These 7 Symptoms Of Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue larvae found in 4,000 homes in Bhopal; negligence could be deadly; ignore these 7 dengue symptoms
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is rising in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, where 4,208 of 89,702 homes surveyed (Sep 1–Nov 10) harbored dengue larvae—about one in 21 homes. VIP and posh colonies are affected; 10,000+ vacant plots with rainwater act as breeding grounds. So far this year, 206 people in Bhopal have been infected. Larvae were found in cooler water, plant-saucer containers, and bird-baths; clear water can also sustain larvae. Twelve localities at higher risk include Lalghat, Kohefiza, GMC, Shaheed Nagar, Eidgah Hills, Saket Nagar, AIIMS, Piplia Pende Khan, Barkheda, Ayodhya Nagar, Ashoka Garden, and Katara Hills. Key symptoms to watch: sudden high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, intense joint/muscle pain, nausea/vomiting, extreme fatigue, and red rash. Rapid tests signal dengue; ELISA confirms infection; hospital counts may differ from government figures due to testing practices.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールの4,000軒でデング熱の幼虫発見、油断は命取りに。見逃してはいけない7つの症状
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域（ボパール）における季節性デング熱の発生状況報告であり、季節的・局地的な流行拡大の兆候だが、重症度や国際的拡大の情報は不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地域的な蚊媒介性疾患の季節的増加報告。ボパール市内の特定地区で感染リスクが高いとされるが、重症例や死亡者数の情報はなし。地方自治体レベルでの対応（幼虫駆除調査）が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose: meta global chega 5 anos atrasada em meio a 10,6 milhões de casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis: Global Target Five Years Behind Schedule Amid 10.6 Million Cases.
article.articleSummary: TB remains the globe’s deadliest infectious disease, with 10.6 million cases and 1.13 million deaths in 2025, per the WHO Global TB Report 2026. Despite a downward trend, End TB targets are five years late; incidence declined slightly and mortality fell 4%. In lusophone countries, Angola and Mozambique remain among the top 30 burdened, together accounting for most cases; Africa Region contributes a quarter of new infections and has achieved a 30% incidence reduction since 2015. Cabo Verde progresses toward low incidence; Guinea-Bissau and São Tomé and Príncipe face HIV coinfection and diagnostic constraints; Timor-Leste is a priority in Southeast Asia; Portugal and Brazil illustrate leadership in Europe and the Americas. Funding fell to $940 million in 2025, while $6.6B invested still trails the $22B annual target for 2027; almost half of affected families pay >20% of income. Calls for stronger South-South collaboration and universal access to vaccines and therapies.

triage.headline_ja: 結核：2025年に1,060万人の症例、世界目標は5年遅れ
triage.triage_reason: WHO Global TB Report 2026に基づく年次世界統計の報告であり、特定国における新規・異常な発生事象ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHO Global TB Report 2026に基づく世界全体のTB統計・資金状況に関する定例報告。ブラジル、アンゴラ、モザンビーク等は既知の慢性的な結核流行国として言及されているが、新規のアウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。特定の対象国における突発的な事象ではないため、対象国リストへの該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Полторы тысячи погибших в месяц: крупнейшая вспышка Эболы в Конго выходит из-под контроля
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fifteen hundred killed per month: The largest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control.
article.articleSummary: Fifteen hundred killed per month: The largest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to worsen six months after the May 15 start. More than 11,000 people infected and over 5,500 deaths have been reported, with the case fatality near 49%. As of November 14, the outbreak spans 68 health zones in eight provinces. In recent months, about 240 people die weekly, roughly the equivalent of losing 1.5 Boeing 737 jets each week. Experts note a troubling shift: two-thirds of recent fatalities occur in communities rather than in specialized treatment centers, indicating late detection, limited access to care, and safety and surveillance gaps. The crisis is compounded by armed conflict, severe hunger, broken infrastructure, and deep distrust of the health system. The UN warned in August that Ebola is outpacing response and urged faster action.

triage.headline_ja: 月間1500人死亡：コンゴ最大のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、感染者1万1千人超、死者5500人超と公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、国際的拡大・支援の必要性も示唆されるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: UNが8月に対応の遅れを警告しており、国際的な支援拡大が急務とされている。武力紛争・飢餓・医療システムへの不信が流行拡大の背景要因として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Спалах Еболи в Конго майже вийшов з-під контролю - понад 5500 загиблих за 6 місяців
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo nearly out of control — more than 5,500 deaths in six months.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 11,376 Ebola cases and 5,568 deaths (case fatality ~49%), with the outbreak spanning 68 health zones in 8 provinces. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain drives the current surge, for which there is no vaccine or treatment with proven efficacy. About two-thirds of recent deaths occur outside specialized treatment centers, indicating late presentation and limited access to care. Conflict, distrust, and severe health-system disruption—including unreliable electricity and water and inadequate isolation facilities—hinder containment. Acute food insecurity affects roughly 29 million Congolese, forcing some individuals to seek food rather than observe isolation. UN officials warn that armed violence in some areas claims more lives than Ebola, further complicating outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行がほぼ制御不能に ― 6か月間で5,500人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo株によるエボラ流行が11,376症例・5,568死亡（致死率約49%）に達し、68保健区・8州に拡大。ワクチン・治療薬なし、武力紛争・食料不安により封じ込めが困難化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する深刻な公衆衛生危機。
triage.notes: 致死率約49%、治療薬・ワクチン未確立のBundibugyo株による大規模流行。武力紛争と食料不安が封じ込めを著しく阻害しており、国際支援の必要性が極めて高い事例。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Конго почти вышла из-под контроля -- более 5500 погибших за 6 месяцев
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo nearly out of control — more than 5,500 have died in six months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains difficult to control six months into the crisis. As of 14 November, 11,376 suspected/confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths have been reported (about 49% lethality), with the outbreak spanning 68 health zones across 8 provinces. MSF notes roughly two-thirds of recent fatalities occur outside dedicated treatment centers, implying late diagnosis or lack of access to care. Contributing factors include armed conflict, community mistrust, and chronic shortages of essential hospital resources, including electricity, water, and isolation capacity. For the Bundibugyo strain driving this surge, there is no vaccine or treatment with proven efficacy. Widespread hunger—nearly 29 million Congolese facing acute food insecurity—further complicates isolation efforts. UN warnings emphasize that in some areas armed violence kills more people than Ebola, hindering containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがほぼ制御不能に ― 6か月間で5,500人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、11,376症例・5,568人死亡という大規模アウトブレイクであり、ワクチン・治療法未確立のブンディブギョ株、武装紛争や食料危機による制御困難という複合的要因から、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的懸念が高い事案と判断。
triage.notes: 致死率約49%は極めて高く、ワクチン・有効治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行。武装紛争・食料不安・医療資源不足が制御を阻んでおり、国際支援の必要性が高い。フルリスク評価（RRA）への移行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 5,5 тыс.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in DR Congo exceeds 5,500.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has surpassed 11,900 confirmed cases and 5,500 deaths since May 2026. The National Institute of Public Health reports 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths (case fatality 48.9%). The epicenter is Ituri province, accounting for 69.1% of confirmed infections, with spread across 68 of 178 medical zones in eight provinces. The current outbreak began in May 2026 in the DRC and Uganda, with Bundibugyo ebolavirus for which WHO has no licensed vaccines or therapeutics. Uganda declared its outbreak over on July 28; WHO confirmed by August 25. In October, Kenya reported its first Ebola case; on October 20 Nigeria announced Ebola on its national territory. The report notes ongoing cross-border transmission linked to the DRC–Uganda outbreak, as of November 16, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでのエボラ死者数が5,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、1万人超の確定症例、複数国への越境伝播が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（特にイツリ州）を主軸としたエボラ流行を報じている。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播にも言及があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス株であり、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Çiftleri balayında bekleyen Dang Ateşi riskine KTÜ'lü uzmandan uyarı geldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KTÜ expert warns of dengue fever risk awaiting couples on their honeymoon.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-16, KTÜ expert warns of dengue fever risk for couples honeymooning abroad. A dengue virus infection was detected in a person returning from Africa last week. The KTÜ Farabi Hospital infectious diseases head notes that dengue and West Nile encephalitis are seen in Turkey's western regions, Greece, and North Africa; although they come from different virus families, both can cause viral hemorrhagic fever–like illness. Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever (CCHF) is also part of this group. Travelers should protect against vectors and consider pre-travel vaccination and preventive measures. Regions cited include Burkina Faso, Nepal, India, Indonesia, and Maldives (honeymooners) where dengue has occurred. Dengue is vector-borne, not transmitted person-to-person; imported cases occur after travel. Common dengue symptoms: sudden high fever up to 40°C, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgias, nausea/vomiting, rash; severe disease can cause hemorrhage and shock. Seasonal influenza and COVID-19 are also present in the population.

triage.headline_ja: KTÜ専門家、新婚旅行中のカップルを待ち受けるデング熱リスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: 特定国での新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、トルコの専門家による新婚旅行者向け一般的な健康啓発・注意喚起記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はトルコの専門家が新婚旅行者に対し、海外渡航時のデング熱等の感染症リスクについて一般的な注意喚起を行う内容。インド・インドネシア等は『デング熱が流行している渡航先』として例示されているのみで、具体的なアウトブレイク発生状況の報告はないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ഡെ​ങ്കി​പ്പ​നി വ്യാ​പ​ന​ത്തി​നെ​തി​രെ ജാ​ഗ്ര​ത വേ​ണ​മെ​ന്ന്​ ആ​രോ​ഗ്യ വ​കു​പ്പ് | Health Department urges vigilance against spread of dengue fever
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever spread requires vigilance, says Health Department.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is spreading in Idukki district, Kerala, with local transmission confirmed in the Santhanpara area and isolated cases reported in Devikulam, Ilamadesam, Vellathooval, Karunapuram, and Irrattayar. As of 16 November 2026, the Health Department urges public vigilance to prevent further spread. Principal symptoms include abrupt high fever, severe headaches, retro-orbital pain, muscle and joint pains, red skin rashes, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, and extreme fatigue. Severe signs—persistent abdominal pain, ongoing vomiting, bleeding from nose or mouth, dark stools, or dizziness—require urgent hospital care. Dengue control emphasizes mosquito breeding site elimination; weekly checks inside and around homes are advised. Educational institutions should observe a Dry Day on Fridays, offices/workplaces on Saturdays, and homes on Sundays, with ten-minute weekly inspections to eradicate breeding grounds and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の流行阻止に向け警戒を呼びかけ　保健局
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケララ州の一地域（イドゥッキ県）での地域流行であり、公衆衛生対策の呼びかけ記事であるため、通常の季節性デング熱対応の範囲内と考えられるが、感染拡大の継続性を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの対象地域で季節性・風土病的に発生しており、本記事は特定県内の局地的流行に対する注意喚起。重症度や症例数などの詳細データは記事内に不明。

article.articleHeadline: Balayı için yurt dışına giden çiftlere Dang Ateşi uyarısı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever warning for couples traveling abroad for their honeymoon
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever warning for honeymoon travelers: As of 16 November 2026, Turkish clinicians warn that dengue fever (Dang Ateşi), transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, is increasingly seen in travelers returning from abroad. A recent case involved a traveller who returned from Africa with dengue infection. West Nile encephalitis is also reported in Türkiye’s western regions, Greece, and North Africa; though from a different virus family, these infections can cause viral hemorrhagic fever. Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever (KKKA) is likewise categorized among fever-and-bleeding illnesses. Travelers should protect against vectors and pursue pre-travel vaccination: influenza, pneumonia, RSV, and shingles if risk factors exist. Regions cited include Burkina Faso, Nepal, India, Indonesia, and Maldives, where dengue exposure occurred—tourists, including honeymooners, have contracted dengue after trips. Current hospital cases include one COVID-19 and one influenza patient; awareness of vectorborne risks remains crucial for safe travels and early recognition of symptoms such as high fever, headache, myalgias, and rash.

triage.headline_ja: 新婚旅行で海外に行くカップルへのデング熱警告
triage.triage_reason: 特定国における新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、トルコの医師による渡航者向け一般的なデング熱・感染症注意喚起記事であるため、シグナルとして取り上げる根拠に乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事はトルコの医療従事者による渡航者向け一般的な感染症注意喚起であり、インド・インドネシア等は過去に観光客が感染した例として言及されているのみで、現在進行中の発生事象の主題国ではないためverified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Смертность от Эболы в ДР Конго превысила 5,5 тыс. человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpassed 5,500 people.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has more than 11,900 confirmed cases and over 5,500 deaths. The National Institute of Public Health under the Ministry of Health reports Ituri province as the epicenter, accounting for 69.1% of cases. The outbreak spans 68 of 178 health zones across eight provinces. Begun in May in the DRC and Uganda, the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with no WHO-licensed vaccines or therapeutics. Earlier counts hovered around 10,990 confirmed cases, with daily reports near 10,900. At the start of the month, the case fatality rate was about 51.6%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱による死者数が5,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)はワクチン未承認で致死率51.6%、11,900例以上・死者5,500人超、8州68保健区域に拡大し国境を越えてウガンダにも及んでおり、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Ituri州はDRC国内のADM1地域であり、DRCに包含される。

article.articleHeadline: Dang Ateşi uyarısı: Balayı dönüşü vakalar görüldü
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Warning: Cases Reported on Returning from Honeymoons.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (Dang Ateşi) cases linked to international travel have appeared in Turkey. Prof. Dr. Gürdal Yılmaz of Karadeniz Technical University Farabi Hospital reported a lab-confirmed dengue infection in a traveler returning from Africa last week, with additional dengue cases in a patient from Indonesia and in honeymoon travelers returning from the Maldives. Dengue is mosquito-borne and not transmitted person-to-person; Turkey is non-endemic. Classic symptoms include abrupt high fever up to 40 C, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia, nausea/vomiting, and rash; a minority may progress to dengue hemorrhagic fever or dengue shock syndrome. Travelers should protect against vectors and assess region-specific infection risks. Vaccination considerations are advised, including influenza, pneumonia, RSV, and shingles if risk factors exist. As of 2026-11-16, the hospital reports one COVID-19 and one influenza patient; autumn–winter viral activity remains ongoing. Regarded as imported/exported cases with travel-related infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱警報：新婚旅行帰りに症例が確認される
triage.triage_reason: トルコ国内での輸入症例報告であり、対象国（インドネシア等）での発生拡大やアウトブレイクを示す情報ではないため、見送りと判定。
triage.notes: 記事はトルコにおける輸入症例（アフリカ・インドネシア・モルディブ帰りの旅行者）に関する報告であり、対象国（インドネシア）自体でのデング熱アウトブレイク発生を示す記述はない。発生地域リストのIndonesiaは患者の渡航歴に基づくもので、現地での発生拡大を示す情報ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spread in DRC's ​‌‌⁠‌‍⁠⁠‍‍‌⁠‍⁠‌‌​‌​epicentres under control as 3,000 people recovered - WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is largely under control six months into the outbreak, with more than 11,000 cases and about 5,400 deaths. Transmission has slowed in key epicentres Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Nizi, Rwampara and Butembo; Bunia remains challenging but with halved new cases. Diagnostic capacity rose from two laboratories to over 24; close to 2,000 treatment beds are available across 104 treatment and transit centres. About 3,000 patients have recovered, with roughly a quarter enrolled in the survivor programme. Over 17,000 community health workers and 46,000 community actors have been trained; nearly 1,000,000 hot meals have been delivered to more than 180,000 people across 59 facilities. The outbreak spans 67 health zones in eight provinces, with 400–500 new weekly cases. Insecurity has caused more than 80 attacks on health care, including a Cantine-Aloya siege; Kenya and Nigeria have reported imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ拡大、震源地では制御下に3,000人が回復-WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（症例11,000超、死亡5,400人超）が継続中で、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境感染例も報告されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の全項目該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラアウトブレイクに関する続報で、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入症例も言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。治安悪化（医療施設への80件以上の攻撃）がアウトブレイク対応の障害となっている点は重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak defies control as conflict, hunger fuel crisis six months in
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Democratic Republic of Congo’s largest Ebola outbreak, the Bundibugyo strain continues to defy containment as hunger, armed conflict and mistrust cripple the response. Since declared May 15, more than 11,000 infections and about 5,500 deaths have been reported; as of November 14, Congo’s official tally stood at 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths (case fatality ~49%), with transmission in 68 health zones across eight provinces. In North Kivu, 153 patients and suspects were treated outside designated centres, risking further spread. About two-thirds of deaths occurred in communities rather than treatment facilities, signaling late detection and barriers to care amid insecurity. No proven therapy exists for Bundibugyo; Merck’s Ervebo is used but may offer limited cross-protection. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines—Oxford/Serum Institute and Moderna—are entering late-stage trials in Congo, with results expected early 2027. Over 3,300 people have been vaccinated in North Kivu; only 247 doses remain, underscoring urgency.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・エボラ流行、発生6か月で紛争と飢餓が危機を悪化させ制御困難に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続し、1万1千人超の感染・5500人超の死亡（致死率約49%）を記録。紛争・飢餓により封じ込めが困難で、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当し国際支援の必要性も高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には有効な治療法がなく、既存ワクチン（Ervebo）の交差防御効果も限定的。新規ワクチンの治験結果は2027年初頭予定であり、現時点でのワクチン在庫が逼迫（残247回分）している点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Vụ 22 người ngộ độc sau ăn bánh mì ở Quảng Ngãi: Nhiều mẫu nhiễm khuẩn, có cả Salmonella
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Incident of 22 people poisoned after eating bread in Quảng Ngãi: Many samples contaminated with bacteria, including Salmonella.
article.articleSummary: Twenty-two people in Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam, are suspected of food poisoning after eating bread from four vendors in the Tịnh Khê and Đông Sơn communes between November 2–4. By November 16, the provincial Health Department reported testing 13 food samples and 3 patient samples; 2 of the 3 patient samples were positive for Salmonella spp. Salmonella was detected in items including chả bò, butter, sauce, meat floss, and sauce. Additionally, bread samples (bánh mì xíu) and butter contained Staphylococcus aureus with Staphylococcal enterotoxin; other samples contained Bacillus cereus and Escherichia coli. Investigations found the food preparation area at the Ông Bảy baguette point not separated from a toilet; some stalls lacked adequate origin documentation and food-safety knowledge. Several outlets were suspended pending investigation. Since December 2025, Quảng Ngãi has experienced multiple bread-related outbreaks totaling at least 419 affected.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ省でのバインミー食中毒事件:22人発症、複数検体から細菌検出、サルモネラ菌も確認
triage.triage_reason: 単一地域での食中毒事例でヒト-ヒト感染の懸念は低いが、同地域で過去にも複数回同様の集団食中毒が発生しており、食品衛生管理体制の問題として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 食品(バインミー)の衛生管理不備による集団食中毒事例。サルモネラ、黄色ブドウ球菌、セレウス菌、大腸菌など複数病原体検出。2025年12月以降同地域で累計419人が同様の被害に遭っており、食品安全管理体制の構造的問題が示唆される。国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: DRC's Ebola epicentres under control as 3,000 people recovered: WHO
article.articleSummary: 3,000 people recovered six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with most early epicentres now under control and rapid transmission halted. Transmission fronts at Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Nizi, Rwampara and Butembo have been contained; Bunia shows halved new cases and low treatment-centre occupancy, though transmission remains significant. WHO directs the technical health response while the humanitarian system enables access, logistics, protection, and continuity of essential services. Nearly 100 health and humanitarian partners operate across affected areas, delivering essential health services including treatment for acute malnutrition. Africa CDC and WHO co-lead the joint continental Incident Management Support Team coordinating health partners across affected and at-risk countries in response, preparedness and readiness. Nonetheless, ongoing conflict and displacement continue to drive outbreak expansion in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、流行の中心地は制御下に：WHOが3,000人の回復を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的流行であり、重篤な公衆衛生影響と人道的対応の必要性が確認され、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）における既知のエボラ流行（6ヶ月目）の進捗報告。ルワンダ（キガリ州）は発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では『at-riskな国』としての言及に留まり、実際の症例発生国として明示されていないため除外。紛争・避難民の影響により流行拡大が継続している点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in R.D. del Congo, Unicef: oltre 1.700 bambini morti in 6 mesi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, UNICEF: more than 1,700 children have died in six months.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, UNICEF reports significant progress in expanding and strengthening the response, but transmission continues and the outbreak is spreading to new areas. More than 1,700 children have died over this period. Beyond infection risk, many children have lost parents and caregivers and have been unable to access essential protection, health services, and basic psychosocial support; they have also faced interruptions to schooling. All of this is unfolding in communities already strained by conflict and displacement. The ongoing transmission and geographic spread underscore the need for sustained, child-focused interventions, safe access to care, and protection measures to mitigate the impact on children in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、ユニセフ：過去6か月で1,700人以上の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続・拡大しており、多数の死者（子ども1,700人以上）が報告され、紛争・避難民により状況下で管理が困難なためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ユニセフの報告に基づく記事で、エボラの継続的な伝播と地理的拡大、及び子どもへの深刻な影響（死亡・保護サービスの欠如・教育の中断）が強調されている。紛争・避難民状況が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: 反滲透淨水器出來的水能直飲嗎？20戶家庭實測：多戶樣本菌落總數超標
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is water from a reverse osmosis purifier drinkable? Field test in 20 households: multiple samples exceed the standard for total bacterial colony counts.
article.articleSummary: Beijing-based field test of 20 households with under-sink reverse osmosis (RO) purifiers found drinking water often exceeds microbial standards. The study, covering brands including AO Smith, Angel, and Midea, collected two sample sets per household: A (daily-use water after typical flushing) and B (after disinfection with a 5-minute flush). Among 20 A samples, 14 exceeded the GB 5749 2022 limit for total bacterial colonies (100 CFU/mL), with a maximum of 3000 CFU/mL; 1 sample showed total coliforms (2 MPN/100 mL) and no E. coli was detected. In 20 B samples, 6 exceeded the limit, up to 310 CFU/mL; no E. coli detected, and the one A sample with total coliforms did not recur in B. New machines and filters, lower daily usage, longer standing times, and humid environments correlated with higher exceedance. Disinfection/flush improved some samples but did not eliminate risk; experts advocate boiling water for direct drinking and suggest possible UV sterilization after the post-filter, noting no unified direct-drinking standard exists.

triage.headline_ja: 逆浸透浄水器から出る水は直接飲めるか？20世帯の実測：多数のサンプルで細菌コロニー総数が基準超過
triage.triage_reason: 家庭用浄水器の水質調査に関する記事であり、E.coli自体は検出されておらず、疾病の発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: E. coliは検出されず、一般細菌数の基準超過が主な内容。疾病アウトブレイクではなく製品・水質に関する消費者向け調査記事。

article.articleHeadline: Người đàn ông 54 tuổi nguy kịch vì vi khuẩn Whitmore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 54-year-old man in critical condition due to Whitmore's bacterium.
article.articleSummary: 54-year-old man from Loc Ninh, Tay Ninh, Vietnam, developed severe pneumonia caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei (Whitmore’s disease) with septic shock, multi-organ failure, and acute kidney injury. He was admitted in respiratory distress, intubated, and placed on mechanical ventilation in the ICU. After nearly three weeks of intensive care, his condition improved enough to transfer to the Respiratory Department and discharge. A GI complication emerged as melena; urgent esophagogastroduodenoscopy revealed a Forrest IIa gastric ulcer at the cardia with moderate duodenal erosions, and endoscopic hemostasis was performed. A multidisciplinary team—ICU, pulmonology, and gastroenterology—coordinated care to control infection, support respiration, and manage GI bleeding. Dr. Nguyen Thi Kieu Oanh notes Burkholderia pseudomallei infections are severe with high mortality if not detected early, especially in older adults or those with chronic lung disease; early medical evaluation for respiratory symptoms is advised.

triage.headline_ja: 54歳男性、ウィットモア菌感染により重体
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の個別臨床報告であり、類鼻疽は環境由来の非伝染性感染症で人-人感染リスクも低いため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: ベトナム・タイニン省での単発の類鼻疽（ウィットモア病）重症例報告。地域的流行拡大の兆候なし。環境中のBurkholderia pseudomallei曝露による散発例と見られ、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Bangla News: পানীয় জল না কি ফুচকায় বিপদ? বসিরহাটে হু হু করে ছড়াচ্ছে জন্ডিস, চরম আতঙ্ক এলাকায়
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangla News: Is it the drinking water or danger in the fuchkas? Jaundice is spreading rapidly in Basirhat, causing extreme panic in the area.
article.articleSummary: Jaundice outbreak in Basirhat Municipality, Ward 18, North 24 Parganas, India, with 17 confirmed cases and 11 more showing symptoms as of 16 November 2026. Authorities closed several drinking-water taps and fuchka stalls amid suspected contamination of potable water as the outbreak source. Health officials are conducting inspections to identify transmission pathways; laboratory results for the 11 symptomatic individuals are expected by Monday. Basirhat Municipality has ensured daily drinking-water supply and organized a two-day health camp, with public-health teams visiting homes to monitor residents and identify new cases, especially among close contacts of patients. Several residents report illness after eating at local fuchka vendors, suggesting possible food-linked exposure alongside water. The case count could rise as testing continues and further samples are analyzed by health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: バングラニュース：飲料水か、それともフチュカ（軽食）が原因か？バシルハットで黄疸が急速に拡大し、地域で大きな不安が広がる
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地区（バシルハット）で黄疸（原因病原体不明、疑わしい水系感染）が17例確認され11例が症状を呈しているが、死亡例や重症例の報告はなく、地元自治体が既に水道・屋台閉鎖や健康キャンプ等の対応を行っている。検査結果待ちで情報が不十分なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 原因病原体（肝炎ウイルス等）は未特定で、検査結果待ち。飲料水汚染とフチュカ屋台での食品媒介感染の両方が疑われている。地元自治体は水道供給確保・健康キャンプ実施等で対応中であり、現時点で国際的な支援要請の兆候はない。続報（検査結果・症例数推移）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Apa Itu Super Flu? Kenali Gejala dan Cara Mencegah Penularannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Super Flu? Learn the symptoms and how to prevent its transmission.
article.articleSummary: Super flu is an informal term for influenza with heavier symptoms; it is not a distinct medical diagnosis. In Indonesia, it has been linked to Influenza A(H3N2) subclade K, though this subclade is not a WHO/CDC official nomenclature. Indonesian surveillance shows 166 subclade K cases in 2025, and 22 cases through week 38 of 2026; the dominant circulating influenza overall is Influenza A(H1N1)pdm09. Symptoms resemble seasonal flu but can be abrupt and severe: fever with chills, cough, runny nose or congestion, sore throat, headache, muscle and joint aches, fatigue; nausea or diarrhea are more common in children. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets, direct contact, and contaminated surfaces, with higher risk indoors in crowded, poorly ventilated spaces. Prevention includes handwashing, masking when ill or in crowds, cough etiquette, avoiding close contact with the sick, annual influenza vaccination, cleaning high touch surfaces, ensuring ventilation, rest when sick, and avoiding travel while symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: 「スーパーフル」とは何か？症状と感染予防法を知る
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでインフルエンザA(H3N2)サブクレードKを含む季節性インフルエンザに関する啓発記事であり、症例数は限定的で重症化や異常拡大の明確な証拠は乏しいが、新型様サブクレードの流行可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は一般向け啓発・解説記事であり、公式サーベイランスデータに基づく数値は限定的（2025年166例、2026年第38週までに22例）。重症度や拡大リスクに関する具体的情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: سهم بالای کودکان از ابولا در کنگو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High share of Ebola cases among children in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-16, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues, affecting eight provinces. Official counts since May exceed 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths. Children bear a heavy burden, accounting for more than a quarter of confirmed infections and about one-third of fatalities; seven in ten under-five cases die. Ongoing violence, displacement, and humanitarian needs drive transmission in damaged regions, with WHO noting a weekly 400–500 new cases despite some slowdown in hotspots. There is no approved vaccine for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain identified in mid-May in the DRC. Four African countries are affected overall—DRC, Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria—with recent imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria signaling cross-border risk. The high community mortality rate suggests continued delays in case detection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ感染者の中で子どもの割合が高い
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が8州に拡大し1万人超の症例・5400人超の死亡、複数国への越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内の流行状況を主題としており、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境症例は言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ボンディブギョ株に対するワクチン未承認、致死率の高さ、子どもへの重い負担が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Yale'li Epidemiyolog Colin Carlson: "El Niño Domuz Gribinden Ölümcül Olacak, DSÖ Acil Durum İlan Etmeli"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Colin Carlson, Yale Epidemiologist: "El Niño Will Be Deadly From Swine Flu, WHO Should Declare a State of Emergency"
article.articleSummary: El Niño 2026–27 could cause up to 857,000 heat-related deaths globally, with about 451,000 between June 2026 and February 2027 and roughly 373,000 in October–March, per the Chicago Climate Impact Lab. Regional fatalities include Sahel 66,800 (Nigeria 31,400; Sudan 17,500; Niger 10,000; Chad 8,000); Indonesia 19,300; Philippines/Vietnam/Thailand/Cambodia combined 19,400; India 15,800; Brazil 13,300. The projection centers on heat deaths, but dengue, cholera and other infections could rise concurrently. Yale epidemiologist Colin Carlson and Indiana climate scientist Christopher Callahan urge the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, akin to Ebola in the DRC and polio spread; they note the 2009 H1N1 swine flu pandemic killed about 284,000. August was record-hot; COP31 reports suggest 2027 will bring more extreme heat, intensifying the global health crisis.

triage.headline_ja: イェール大学の疫学者コリン・カールソン：「エルニーニョは豚インフルエンザ並みに致命的になる、WHOは緊急事態を宣言すべきだ」
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではなく、気候変動（エルニーニョ）による熱関連死亡者数の予測と、それに便乗した専門家の意見・提言記事であり、具体的な疾患発生情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はエルニーニョによる熱関連死亡予測を主題とする意見記事であり、デング熱・コレラ・エボラ・ポリオ・豚インフルエンザ等への言及は過去事例との比較や将来リスクへの言及に留まり、各対象国での実際の感染症発生事実を報告するものではないため、いずれの国もverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Vụ 22 người ngộ độc bánh mì ở Quảng Ngãi: Phát hiện vi khuẩn trong bơ, chả bò, nước chan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bread poisoning case in Quảng Ngãi: Bacteria detected in butter, beef sausage, and dipping sauce.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, 22 people in Quảng Ngãi were hospitalized after eating bread at four outlets in the communes of Tịnh Khê and Đông Sơn during 2–4 November. Outlets: Bánh mì que Ông Bảy; Bánh mì bà Đô (Tịnh Khê); Bánh mì bà Thu and Bánh mì bà Hà (Đông Sơn). Thirteen food samples and three patient specimens were tested at Pasteur Institute Nha Trang. Results: Salmonella spp detected in 2 of 3 patient samples; Salmonella also found in foods including chả bò (minced beef), butter, dipping sauce, chà bông, and nước sốt. Notably, Staphylococcus aureus was found in a bánh mì xíu and butter, with Staphylococcal enterotoxin detected. Bacillus cereus and Escherichia coli were also reported in some samples. Investigations noted an inadequate separation of the prep area from a restroom and incomplete records on ingredients and safety practices. Outlets were suspended; authorities urged stricter inspections. Since Dec 2025, Quảng Ngãi has recorded four bread-related outbreaks affecting at least 419 people.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイのパン食中毒事件22人：バターや牛肉チャーシュー、タレから細菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 局地的な食中毒事件で22人が入院したが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。ただし同地域で繰り返し発生している食品衛生問題として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 2025年12月以降、クアンガイ省で少なくとも4件のパン関連食中毒事件（計419人以上）が発生しており、反復的な食品安全問題として注視が必要。サルモネラ、黄色ブドウ球菌、セレウス菌、大腸菌が検出され、衛生管理の不備が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Эксперт Касейя: вспышку Эболы на востоке ДР Конго не удается взять под контроль
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaseya Expert: An Ebola Outbreak in Eastern DR Congo Cannot Be Brought Under Control.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains uncontrolled six months after it began on May 15 in the DRC and neighboring Uganda, according to Jean Kaseya, head of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention. He warned the outbreak could become the worst ever if not stopped and highlighted that up to 80% of new cases are identified outside contact lists and over 65% of deaths occur outside health facilities. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus is responsible; this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the second largest by scale in Africa’s history. Eight Congolese provinces have reported cases. The National Institute of Public Health, under the Ministry of Health, reported a total of 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths (case fatality 48.9%) since the epidemic began. There is no WHO-approved vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: カセヤ専門家:コンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ流行は制御不能な状態が続く
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が6か月以上続き、1万人超の感染・致死率約49%、国際的拡大の可能性が指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダへの波及にも言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。承認ワクチンがないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による史上2番目規模の流行であり、致死率48.9%と極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: 上海龙华寺附近疑有人放生鹦鹉 志愿者：已救助上百只，有的鸟体内检出传染性致病病毒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected release of parrots near Shanghai's Longhua Temple; volunteers say they've rescued over a hundred birds, with some birds testing positive for infectious pathogenic viruses.
article.articleSummary: Suspected release of pet parrots near Shanghai's Longhua Temple prompts rescue of over 100 birds. Volunteers report saving more than one hundred birds, with many juveniles and wings clipped; several died along roadsides. Species include budgerigars (虎皮鹦鹉), pearl birds, and finches; these are domestic birds and are unlikely to survive outdoors in the current environment. The Longhua Temple area is also known for stray cats that prey on birds, contributing to fatalities. The temple said the release was not organized by the temple and that the perpetrators are unknown. Importantly, some rescued birds tested positive for infectious pathogenic viruses; the report provides no details on specific pathogens or laboratory confirmation. No further information on infection source or outbreak scope is given.

triage.headline_ja: 上海龍華寺付近でインコが放生された疑い;ボランティアが100羽以上を救助、一部の鳥から感染性病原ウイルスを検出
triage.triage_reason: 鳥類における感染性病原ウイルス検出が報告されているが、病原体の種類やヒトへの感染リスクに関する情報が全くなく、現時点では公衆衛生への影響を評価できないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: ペットのインコ（愛玩鳥）が放生され野外で死亡する事例が報告され、一部の鳥から「感染性病原ウイルス」が検出されたとされるが、病原体名・ヒトへの感染性・検査方法等の詳細情報が記事に全く記載されていない。人獣共通感染症（鳥インフルエンザ等）の可能性は否定できないが現時点では推測の域を出ないため、続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 22 người nhập viện sau khi ăn bánh mì: Nhiều mẫu thực phẩm nhiễm vi sinh vật
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 22 People Hospitalized After Eating Bread: Many Food Samples Contaminated with Microorganisms
article.articleSummary: 22 people were hospitalized in Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam after eating bread from four vendors during 2–4 November. By 16 November, laboratory testing at Pasteur Institute Nha Trang confirmed contamination with Salmonella spp in patient samples; 13 food samples and 3 patient samples were tested. Contaminated items included chả bò (minced beef), butter, dipping sauce, chà bông (shredded pork), and sauce, all with Salmonella spp. Bánh mì xíu and butter samples also contained Staphylococcus aureus, with Staphylococcal enterotoxin detected. Additional findings included Bacillus cereus and Escherichia coli in other samples. Investigations found the food-preparation area at the Ông Bảy baguette stall not separated from a restroom; some vendors lacked ingredient records, food-safety knowledge, and worker health documentation. Authorities ordered temporary business stoppages and urged intensified inspections to prevent similar outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: パンを食べた後22人が入院：多数の食品サンプルから微生物汚染が検出
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・クアンガイ省における単発の食中毒事例で、原因（サルモネラ・黄色ブドウ球菌等）と汚染源（特定のパン屋）が既に特定され、当局により営業停止・衛生指導が行われている。国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクはなく、通常の食品衛生事案の範疇。
triage.notes: 地元当局が原因究明・営業停止・衛生強化指導済みで、既に収束に向けた対応が取られている典型的な食中毒事例。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue deve avançar com El Niño; médicos recomendam vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue is set to rise with El Niño; doctors recommend vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Brazil anticipates a dengue surge linked to El Niño-driven warmer temperatures and altered rainfall, with health authorities forecasting a 20%-40% rise in cases next year. By 31 October 2026, Brazil reported 372,945 dengue cases and 368 deaths; for the same period in 2025, 1,423,675 cases and 1,810 deaths were recorded. Vaccination is urged: the SUS offers Takeda’s Qdenga for children and adolescents 10–14 in two doses (3 months apart); the rest of the population (4–60) can access it privately. The Butantan-DV dengue vaccine remains suspended in SUS pending safety investigations after 42 severe adverse reactions (including two deaths); Anvisa is reviewing data. Experts advise vaccination before peak transmission, noting protection develops after the first dose and does not replace vector control. LIRAa shows most breeding sites around homes, with 49.2% of evaluated municipalities at alert or risk; plant containers and water storage are prominent sources.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョの影響でデング熱増加の見通し、医師らがワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルではデング熱は毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事はエルニーニョによる今後の増加予測とワクチン接種推奨に関する内容。2026年の症例数は前年同期より減少しており、突発的な異常事態ではないが、ワクチン安全性問題や媒介生物対策の課題から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は来年のデング熱増加予測とワクチン接種の推奨に関する内容。実際の2026年症例数（37万件超、368人死亡）は前年同期（142万件超、1,810人死亡）より少なく、現時点で急激な異常発生ではない。ただし、Butantan-DVワクチンの安全性問題（重篤な副反応42件、死亡2件）でAnvisaが審査中であり、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Salmonella found in 'banh mi' samples linked to 22 suspected poisoning cases in central Vietnam
article.articleSummary: Salmonella detected in banh mi–linked outbreak in Quang Ngai Province, Vietnam, after 22 hospitalizations from eating banh mi sold at Ong Bay, Ba Do (Tinh Khe) and Ba Thu, Ba Ha (Dong Son) shops. Exposure: Nov 2–4; admissions Nov 3–7. Thirteen food samples and three clinical specimens tested at the Pasteur Institute in Nha Trang yielded Salmonella spp in two of three clinical samples; Salmonella also detected in beef sausage, butter, gravy, pork floss, and sauces. Staphylococcus aureus, including enterotoxin-producing strains, found in banh mi xiu and butter; Bacillus cereus and Escherichia coli detected in other samples. Violations included prep areas not separated from restrooms and missing documentation on ingredients, training, and health records; vendors suspended. Fourth banh mi outbreak in Quang Ngai since Dec 2025, at least 419 affected; prior outbreaks: Oct 2025 Ba Duoc (175 hospitalized), Mar 2026 Tinh Khe (19 hospitalized), Dec 2025 Hong Van (203).

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム中部でバインミー試料からサルモネラ検出、疑い食中毒22例と関連
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・クアンガイ省で食品媒介性サルモネラ食中毒（22例入院）が発生したが、死亡報告なし・ヒトヒト感染の可能性もなく国際拡大リスクは低い。ただし同地域で過去1年に4回目の類似発生であり、食品衛生管理の構造的問題として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: クアンガイ省では2025年12月以降4回目のバインミー関連食中毒事例（累計419人影響）。食品取扱施設の衛生管理不備（調理場とトイレの未分離、記録不備等）が繰り返し原因となっており、地域の食品安全体制の構造的問題として継続的な監視が望ましい。国際的な公衆衛生緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Sirohi News: बुखार से दो बच्चों की मौत, स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने की लोगों से अपील | Rajasthan Two Children Die After Fever Health Department Issues Appeal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sirohi News: Two children die of fever, Health Department appeals to the public | Rajasthan
article.articleSummary: Two children died after fever in Chhitariya Phali, Kala Mahadev Kheda, Bhula PHC, Pindwara block, Sirohi district, Rajasthan. A 12-year-old boy, Manish, developed fever, cough and abdominal pain on 8 November and was taken to private clinics in Sirohi area before dying on the way home on 14 November. A 4.5-year-old girl, Jamna Kumari, developed mild fever on 10 November, was treated at a Rohida private clinic and died around 12:00 am on 14 November. Health authorities deployed teams; 13 households, 108 people tested. Findings included 4 with fever, 2 with cold, 2 with cough, 16 with boils, and 11 with body aches. An 8-year-old with abdominal pain and weakness was referred to PHC Bhula; malaria tests in 19 people were negative. Water samples collected; anti-larval measures implemented. Officials urge patients to seek care at government hospitals via 108 ambulance rather than faith healing, as investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: Sirohiニュース：発熱により2人の子供が死亡、保健局が住民に呼びかけ｜ラジャスタン州
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の発熱で2人の子供が死亡したが、マラリア検査は陰性で病因が特定されておらず、規模も小村レベルに限定されているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疾患名はMalariaとされているが、記事内では19人のマラリア検査は陰性。死因は特定されておらず、原因不明の発熱クラスターとして地元保健当局が調査中。局所的な事例であり、国際的な懸念材料は現時点で見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Đồng Nai xử phạt 157 triệu đồng, tiêu hủy 1,6 tấn thịt heo nhiễm khuẩn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dong Nai fines 157 million dong, destroys 1.6 metric tons of bacteria-contaminated pork.
article.articleSummary: Dong Nai authorities fined a resident 157 million VND and destroyed 1.6 metric tons of bacterially contaminated pork after an inspection on 16 November 2026. The offender, identified as B.A.T. of Long Bình Ward, slaughtered animals at an unapproved site, and sold meat without official slaughterhouse marks and veterinary hygiene seals. He also marketed raw foods of animal origin contaminated beyond permissible microbial limits. The 1.6 tons of pork pieces were destroyed under supervision due to high microbial counts, including total viable counts, E. coli, and Salmonella. In addition to the fine, he must heat-treat or repurpose 20 kg of pork and conduct veterinary hygiene checks on 100 kg of pork bones. The intervention was conducted by the Dong Nai Department of Agriculture and Rural Development’s Livestock and Fisheries Sub-Department with an inter-agency city team.

triage.headline_ja: ドンナイ省、1億5700万ドンの罰金を科し、細菌汚染豚肉1.6トンを廃棄処分
triage.triage_reason: 無許可食肉処理と衛生基準違反に対する行政処分の事例であり、ヒト感染症の発生報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は食品安全規制違反に対する行政処分（罰金・廃棄処分）の報告であり、実際のヒト感染症発生例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。疾患名（チフス、E.coli等）は汚染指標として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: E. coli found in BMC's water supply; 200 families forced to buy bottled water
article.articleSummary: E. coli detected in BMC's Vaishali Nagar water supply in Madhya Pradesh. About 200 families have stopped using tap water, relying on bottled water. Independent testing arranged by resident Vivek Rai at the State Research Laboratory of the MP Pollution Control Board confirmed contamination: Oct 28 result 60 MPN/100 ml; Nov 12 result 350 MPN/100 ml, with the report dated Nov 13. The measured levels exceed zero, signaling persistent contamination. The article does not report any illnesses or symptoms among residents, nor does it identify a contamination source. No information on imported/exported cases is provided. This laboratory-confirmed water contamination raises immediate public health concerns for residents in Vaishali Nagar and underscores the need for remediation and verification of the municipal water supply.

triage.headline_ja: BMCの水道供給からE.coli検出、200世帯がボトル水の購入を余儀なくされる
triage.triage_reason: 水道水からE.coliが検出され住民が飲用を控えているが、実際の患者発生や症状報告はなく、汚染源も特定されていないため情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は水道水の汚染検査結果（MPN値上昇）を報告しているが、住民の健康被害（疾病・症状）については言及がなく、公衆衛生上の実害は未確認。自治体（BMC）による対応状況や汚染源特定の続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Balayı rotası yanıltmasın: Dang Ateşi riski ve alınacak önlemler | Haberport
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't let the honeymoon itinerary mislead you: Dengue fever risk and precautions to be taken
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, dengue fever cases linked to international travel have been reported, with emphasis on honeymooners. Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral infection; it is not transmitted person-to-person, and Turkey is not endemic. Reported cases involve travelers returning from Africa, Indonesia, and the Maldives, with others linked to Burkina Faso, Nepal, India, Indonesia, and the Maldives. Most infections are mild, but symptomatic patients may experience sudden high fever (up to 40°C), severe headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, nausea, vomiting, and rash; rare cases progress to dengue hemorrhagic fever or dengue shock syndrome with bleeding, hypotension, and organ failure. West Nile encephalitis can be seen in western Turkey, Greece, and North Africa. Preventive measures include vaccination for influenza, pneumonia, and RSV; zoster vaccine only if risk factors. Travelers should pre-travel risk assessments and vector precautions.

triage.headline_ja: 新婚旅行のルートに惑わされないで：デング熱のリスクと取るべき対策
triage.triage_reason: 特定の国における具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、トルコからの旅行者向けにデング熱・蚊媒介感染症に関する一般的な渡航医学アドバイザリー記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・西ナイル熱に関する一般的な渡航医学の予防啓発記事であり、インドネシアやインドなどは旅行者の感染地として言及されているのみで、特定の国での新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Bacterial Pneumonia Linked to Worse Outcomes in Hospitalized Influenza A
article.articleSummary: In Xi’an, a retrospective cohort at a tertiary hospital evaluated adults hospitalized with influenza A(H1N1) from March 2023–February 2025. Of 453 patients, 290 underwent culture testing (sputum, BALF, or blood). Culture-positive bacterial pneumonia occurred in 41 (14.1%) of the tested group, with Klebsiella pneumoniae and Pseudomonas aeruginosa each accounting for 21.95% of culture-positive cases; Gram-negative organisms predominated. Compared with culture-negative patients, those with bacterial pneumonia had more severe pneumonia, higher ventilation needs, and longer hospital stays. Exploratory analyses within 48 hours of admission showed higher WBC counts, CRP, and procalcitonin in culture-positive cases. Adjusted analyses indicated discharge hypoalbuminemia strongly associated with culture positivity (OR ~3.0; p=0.003 in standard, ~2.98; p=0.003 in Firth). Associations with chronic respiratory disease were uncertain (p≈0.06). The study notes limitations of retrospective design and non-universal culture testing, urging cautious interpretation.

triage.headline_ja: 入院したインフルエンザA患者における細菌性肺炎と予後不良の関連
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去2年間（2023-2025）の後方視的臨床研究であり、新規の公衆衛生イベントや異常な感染症発生を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)入院患者における細菌性肺炎合併症についての臨床研究レポートであり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではない。中国・西安が舞台だが、これは研究実施施設の所在地であり、発生イベントではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲疾控中心：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情仍处失控状态
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control.
article.articleSummary: Five months after the Democratic Republic of the Congo declared an Ebola outbreak, Africa CDC Director Kasaye said the Bundibugyo-type epidemic remains out of control. As of November 12, the DR Congo outbreak totals 11,254 confirmed cases and 5,505 deaths. Over 80% of newly detected infections were not previously listed in contact tracing, and more than 65% of fatalities occurred in the community rather than healthcare facilities. Attacks on healthcare workers and months-long salary arrears highlight fragile response conditions. Donors pledged about US$2.9 billion, with a call to release roughly US$1.6 billion to bolster coordination with the government. WHO notes progress: Ebola labs increased from two to more than 20, about 3,000 patients recovered; more than 17,000 community health workers and 46,000 community personnel trained; cross-border surveillance and information-sharing strengthened. There is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola, and this is the largest, deadliest outbreak in DR Congo’s history.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は依然として制御不能な状態にある
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模・最多死亡者数のエボラ流行が発生し、アフリカCDCが「制御不能」と公式表明しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域の『Africa』は大陸区分であり対象国リストに非該当のため除外。DRCのみを検証済み地域とした。国境を越えた監視強化の記述はあるが、具体的な渡航・貿易制限措置の言及はないため travel_trade_restriction は不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: 浙江汉听信偏方生吞蛇胆｢清火｣突抽搐偏瘫　医揭大脑遭寄生虫安家
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zhejiang man swallows a snake gallbladder to 'clear heat,' suddenly experiences convulsions and hemiplegia as doctors reveal parasites have taken up residence in his brain
article.articleSummary: In Taizhou, Zhejiang Province, a 50-year-old man ingested a peanut-sized wild snake gallbladder as a folk remedy to 'clear heat and improve eyesight.' About two to three months later, he suddenly developed left hemiparesis and convulsions. Brain imaging revealed widespread punctate lesions and a peanut-sized intracranial cyst. He was diagnosed with neurocysticercosis, caused by Taenia solium (pork tapeworm). Physicians explained that snakes can host parasites, and raw snake gallbladder effectively introduces parasite eggs into the gut; after hatching, larvae travel via the bloodstream and can lodge in the brain, causing epilepsy, unilateral weakness, vision problems, and incontinence; severe cases can be fatal. The report warns that raw snake gallbladder does not cure disease and carries high parasitic risk. Avoid such folk remedies; wild-snake products and raw animal foods pose serious infection risks.

triage.headline_ja: 浙江の男性、｢清火｣目的で生の蛇胆を飲み込み、突然のけいれんと片麻痺に　医師が脳内に寄生虫が寄生していることを発見
triage.triage_reason: 個人の民間療法による単発の有鉤嚢虫症例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性や公衆衛生上の広範な影響はなく、国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 個人の民間療法に起因する単発症例報告であり、感染症アウトブレイクではない。有鉤条虫（Taenia solium）はヒト-ヒト感染せず、食習慣由来の孤発例のため公衆衛生シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Madiun skrining 10.115 orang terduga TBC hingga Oktober 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Madiun Regency Government screens 10,115 people suspected of TB through October 2026.
article.articleSummary: Madiun Regency, Indonesia, screened 10,115 people suspected of tuberculosis from January–October 2026, reaching 100% of the Minimal Service Standard target. Of those screened, 1,234 tested positive for TB, with 96% of patients initiating treatment. TB cases span all ages, from children to the elderly. Major challenges include loss to follow-up when patients move away and persistent social stigma. Officials note patients become non-infectious after two months of intensive therapy and urge continued masking and full treatment completion. Contact screening is prioritized to curb transmission, aligned with central government goals to eliminate TB by 2030. Outreach covers pesantren, students (SD–SMA), and prospective couples, and is integrated with Free Health Check programs at puskesmas and posyandu ILP, aided by mobile X-ray units. To reduce deaths, the regency provides supplementary food and tight treatment monitoring; TB mortality is 9 per 100,000, above the <6 per 100,000 target.

triage.headline_ja: マディウン県、2026年10月までに結核疑いの10,115人をスクリーニング
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策プログラムに関する定期報告であり、異常な発生や急激な増加を示す情報はない。既存の公衆衛生活動の進捗報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 結核は地域で地方病性（endemic）であり、本記事は通常のスクリーニング・治療プログラムの実績報告。死亡率が目標値を上回っている点は地域保健当局の継続的課題だが、新規の異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Reaching Remote Communities Key to Ending Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists, with over 11,000 cases and more than 5,400 deaths. Children comprise more than a quarter of confirmed infections and about a third of deaths; seven in ten infected children under five die. Transmission has slowed in several initial hotspots, yet 400–500 new cases are recorded weekly across 67 health zones in eight provinces. The response has intensified with expanded testing, more treatment facilities, and strengthened community health efforts. Nearly 3,000 people have recovered, and about 90% of registered deaths are managed through safe and dignified burials. Ongoing challenges include insecurity, attacks on health workers, funding delays, and weak contact tracing. Health agencies urge continued international funding and improved humanitarian access to help end the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行終息の鍵は遠隔地域への対応
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で11,000例超・5,400人超の死者を伴う大規模なエボラ流行が継続中であり、複数州にまたがる拡大と国際支援の必要性からIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く特に5歳未満児で深刻（感染児の7割が死亡）。8州67保健区にまたがり、週400〜500例の新規発生が継続。治安悪化・資金不足・接触者追跡の弱さが対応の障害となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia eboli w Kongu zbiera żniwo. Lekarze alarmują o brakach
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo claims lives. Doctors warn of shortages.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies as Dr. Jean Kaseya reports that over 80% of infections involve people not in contact registries, indicating gaps in transmission tracing. Attacks on health workers, equipment shortages, and months of unpaid salaries hinder response; Doctors Without Borders notes ambulances lack fuel and regions lack surveillance teams. By September, $2.9 billion in pledges from Africa CDC, the U.S., the EU, and World Bank had been promised, but relief has not reached the affected areas, says Dr. Kaseya. Ebola hemorrhagic fever has about 50% mortality. WHO notes natural reservoirs are fruit bats; infection occurs via contact with blood or secretions of infected wildlife and spreads through bodily fluids of the sick. The current wave is linked to the rare Bundibugyo variant and is the second-largest Ebola outbreak, surpassed only by 2014-2016 West Africa with over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が深刻化、医師らが物資不足を警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%のエボラ出血熱がDRCで拡大し、接触者追跡の失敗や医療資源不足が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、米国・アンゴラは資金拠出等の文脈のみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 7 in 10 Confirmed Under-Five Ebola Cases Die
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists six months after onset. Africa CDC reports more than 11,000 confirmed Ebola cases and about 5,400 deaths across 67 health zones in eight provinces, with 400–500 new cases weekly. Children under five constitute about 14% of confirmed cases but around 21% of deaths; seven in ten confirmed under‑five cases have died, with UNICEF putting under‑five mortality at nearly 72% among confirmed cases. One in three admitted under-fives dies within 24 hours of hospital intake. No Africa-external cases are confirmed, though imported cases have been reported in Kenya and Nigeria. Health‑care attacks exceed 80 since the outbreak began, including Cantine-Aloya where 66 civilians, including 3 health workers, were killed. Response led by WHO and Africa CDC; no clear end yet.

triage.headline_ja: 確認された5歳未満のエボラ症例の10人に7人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）アウトブレイクが6ヶ月間継続し、11,000例超・5,400人超の死亡、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入例も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアでの輸入症例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。医療従事者への攻撃（80件超）や医療アクセス不全が流行拡大・長期化の要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: WHO Declares Major Success As 3,000 Recover In DRC, Early Outbreak Hotspots Contained
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) shows progress as of 16 November 2026: WHO says transmission has been halted in epicentres, with 3,000 recovered since onset six months ago; however, armed attacks, displacement and gaps in contact tracing and frontline pay threaten containment. The outbreak has surpassed 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths, with 400–500 new infections across eight provinces. Hotspots Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Nizi, Rwampara and Butembo improved; Bunia shows reduced infections. Diagnostic capacity rose from two labs to over 24; 2,000 beds in 104 centres. Children are disproportionately affected (over 25% of cases, about one-third of deaths; under-fives ~70% of confirmed deaths). About 3,000 recovered, a quarter in survivor programmes. Meals delivered to >180,000 people; 17,000 health workers and 46,000 actors trained. Cross-border imports to Kenya and Nigeria highlight regional risk. Urges end to hostilities and sustained funding through 2027; ~100 partners; Africa CDC/WHO coordinate response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOがDRCで3,000人回復と大きな成功を宣言、初期の流行拠点は封じ込め
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,000例・5,400人死亡の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境輸入例も確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境輸入例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。流行は6か月継続中で、資金・治安の制約が封じ込めの課題となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Warning for Australia as highly contagious disease makes comeback in US
article.articleSummary: United States loses measles elimination status for the first time in 26 years, recording more than 5,400 measles cases in 2026, according to the Pan American Health Organisation/World Health Organisation. Elimination status means no native or ongoing local transmission for at least 12 months. Canada lost elimination status last year. Australia has seen measles outbreaks in Sydney, the Gold Coast and Adelaide, though not at US scale; about 200 cases in Australia over the past few years. Many infections trace to travellers returning from overseas, often Asia. A National Centre for Immunisation Research and Surveillance study says about 6.7% of Australians—roughly 1.7 million—are at risk due to incomplete immunisation. Experts warn Australia is heading in the wrong direction; Professor Brendan Crabb notes measles is appearing more frequently. Some fear other diseases like congenital rubella and pertussis could follow if trends continue.

triage.headline_ja: 米国での麻疹流行拡大を受け、オーストラリアに警告
triage.triage_reason: 米国が26年ぶりに麻疹排除状態を失い、カナダも排除状態を喪失するなど複数国で予想外の拡大が見られ、国際的拡大リスクが高いためIHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は米国・カナダ・オーストラリアにおける麻疹（および風疹・百日咳への波及懸念）に関するもので、対象国（ガーナ含む）はいずれも主題として言及されていないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": أكثر من 10 ملايين إصابة بمرض السل و1.1 مليون وفاة في 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: More than 10 million tuberculosis cases and 1.1 million deaths in 2025.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports 10.6 million tuberculosis (TB) cases and 1.1 million TB deaths in 2025, with progress slower than targets. The global TB incidence rate fell 14% since 2015, far short of the 50% reduction target for 2025; TB deaths declined 35% over the same period, achieving the first mortality milestone of the End TB Strategy about five years late. About 88% of cases are concentrated in 30 countries. Regional trends show Europe with a 42% reduction in incidence, Africa 30%, Southeast Asia 18%, and the Eastern Mediterranean 6.6% decline; the Americas region experienced increases for a fifth straight year. Global TB funding and research remain inadequate, with 2023 funding at ~$1.2 billion vs the $5 billion annual target for 2027. India is highlighted for major strides toward elimination; TB treatment has saved ~86 million lives since 2000. Source: WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：2025年に結核患者1000万人超、死亡者110万人
triage.triage_reason: WHOの世界結核報告書に基づく年次統計データであり、特定の国での異常なアウトブレイクを示すものではないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026の統計概要であり、インドは結核撲滅に向けた進展の事例として言及されているのみで、インド国内での異常な流行や新規アウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。地域データはグローバル・地域レベルの傾向報告であり、特定国の突発的事象ではないため対象国として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC says Congo's Ebola outbreak remains out of control
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains uncontrolled six months after it was declared on May 15, with Africa CDC reporting more than 11,200 infections and 5,500 deaths. Jean Kaseya warned the outbreak is not under control; over 80% of new cases are among people outside existing contact-tracing lists, and more than 65% of deaths occur in communities outside health facilities, highlighting surveillance gaps and transmission in later illness when contagion is highest. The response faces attacks on health workers, unpaid wages, and shortages of basic supplies; the government is digitizing payroll to address delays. About $2.9 billion has been pledged; roughly $1.6 billion remains to be released amid coordination concerns. In Nigeria, an imported Bundibugyo Ebola case was recorded in Abuja in October; by Nov 11, 34 of 62 contacts completed 21-day monitoring, 28 remained under surveillance, no new case.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、コンゴのエボラ流行は依然として制御不能と発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は11,200例・5,500死亡と深刻で制御不能、ナイジェリアへの越境輸入例も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア（アブジャ）での輸入例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。資金不足（約16億ドル未拠出）や医療従事者への攻撃など対応の課題が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan: CA बनने का सपना अधूरा छोड़ गई प्राची, इंजेक्शन के बाद बिगड़ी तबीयत; ऑपरेशन से पहले थम गई सांसें | Bhilwara Ca Student Prachi Mehta Death Injection Infection
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rajasthan: Prachi, whose dream of becoming a CA remained unfulfilled, deteriorated after an injection; breathing stopped before the operation | Bhilwara CA student Prachi Mehta death injection infection
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan, Bhilwara: Prachi Mehta, a Chartered Accountant aspirant from a family running a small artificial jewelry shop, died after an injection administered at a local medical store. On 11 November she developed fever and visited a nearby dispensary that was closed; at Lovkush Medical Store, Ram Prasad Sharma gave an injection. Subsequently she developed severe leg pain and fever, with swelling by 12 November. She was taken to Ramsnehi Hospital and referred to Geetanjali Hospital in Udaipur, where doctors noted a rapidly spreading leg infection and indicated amputation to save her life. On 13 November, as surgery was to begin, Prachi stopped breathing and her leg turned blue; she died. A postmortem by a medical board in Udaipur is pending to determine the cause. Police registered a case of alleged non-intentional homicide under section 105 against Sharma; locals allege negligence. No outbreak; single fatality.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州：公認会計士を夢見たプラチが注射後に死亡、手術前に息を引き取る | ビルワラ CA学生プラチ・メータ死亡 注射 感染
triage.triage_reason: 単発の医療過誤疑いによる死亡事例であり、感染症のアウトブレイクではなく公衆衛生上の脅威や拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は無資格の医薬品店での注射後に感染症が急速に進行し死亡した単発事例を報じており、警察が過失致死の疑いで捜査中。アウトブレイクではなく対象国の公衆衛生イベントとしての該当性はないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: สสจ.โคราช แจงปีนี้พบผู้ป่วยไข้หูดับมากถึง 76 ราย เสียชีวิตแล้ว 9 ราย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nakhon Ratchasima Provincial Public Health Office says this year there have been as many as 76 cases of fever with deafness, with 9 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis infection presenting as fever with deafness is rising in Nakhon Ratchasima Province, Thailand, with 76 cases and 9 deaths reported in 2026 as of November 11; four new cases were recorded in early November. Among Isan Health Region 9 provinces, Korat has the highest case and mortality burden. The distribution is concentrated in Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima District, followed by Phimai, Khams Tha Le Sao, Kam Sakaeng, and Dan Khun Thot. The at‑risk groups are older adults, especially 70+, and individuals 50+ with comorbidities such as diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, heart disease, or immunosuppression; heavy alcohol use also increases risk. Transmission occurs via consumption of undercooked/raw pork products (e.g., larb, raw pork, blood, nem) and through wounds from handling raw pork. Preventive measures include fully cooked pork, separate utensils, safe sourcing, and protective gear for handlers; seek urgent medical care for fever, severe headache, dizziness, or hearing loss after raw pork exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ナコンラチャシマ県公衆衛生事務所、今年の「聞こえなくなる熱」患者76例、死亡9例と発表
triage.triage_reason: Streptococcus suis感染によるタイ・ナコンラチャシマ県での死亡例を含む症例報告だが、本病は同地域で毎年報告される既知の人獣共通感染症（豚肉関連）であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは低い。重症度・継続曝露の観点からWPRO基準には該当するが、IHR基準は満たさず、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: Streptococcus suis（豚連鎖球菌症）はタイで毎年季節的に報告される既知の人獣共通感染症で、生豚肉・生血料理（ラープ等）の摂取や豚肉取扱時の創傷感染が主な感染経路。ヒト-ヒト感染は報告されておらず、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は限定的。県公衆衛生事務所による予防啓発の一環としての発表であり、現時点ではフルリスク評価の対象というより継続監視が妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: বসিরহাট পুরসভা এলাকায় জন্ডিস, নলবাহী জলে সংক্রমণ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jaundice, infection in piped water in Basirhat Municipality area.
article.articleSummary: Jaundice and hepatitis infections in Bagati, Ward 18 of Basirhat Municipality, are linked to the piped drinking water. Over the past three weeks, about 20 jaundice cases have been reported, with one death. Health authorities suspect contamination in the municipal water supply, as residents describe foul-smelling pipes. In response, piped water use has been suspended and water tankers are delivering safe drinking water. Basirhat Health District medical teams conducted health checks, treated patients, and issued medicines, while water samples were collected for testing and ongoing surveillance is in place. A patient, Shakib Gazi, reported fever for a week followed by jaundice and vomiting, aligning with the outbreak. No information on imported or exported cases is provided. (As of 2026-11-16.)

triage.headline_ja: バシルハット市当局地域で黄疸・パイプ水道汚染による感染
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州バシルハット市の特定地区における水道汚染に起因する黄疸・肝炎アウトブレイク（3週間で約20例、死亡1例）で、地元保健当局が対応中だが、水質汚染の原因究明や感染拡大の可能性について続報を要する。
triage.notes: 地域の飲料水汚染が原因とみられる局地的なアウトブレイクであり、地元保健当局（Basirhat Health District）が水道使用停止・給水車手配・患者治療・水質検査など対応を実施中。国際的な拡大リスクは低いが、汚染原因の特定と感染拡大の有無について続報の確認が必要。
