article.articleHeadline: Is It Safe To Eat Chicken & Eggs Amid Bird Flu Outbreak In Tamil Nadu? What You Should Know
article.articleSummary: Bird flu confirmed in Tamil Nadu as Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) H5N1 at a poultry farm in Kattiyankuppam, Cuddalore district, on 13 November 2026, with initial unusual deaths reported 30 October in Thamanampatti. The outbreak has claimed 35,647 birds in the affected zone. Containment includes culling at the index farm and within a one-km radius, deployment of nine rapid response teams, movement restrictions on poultry, and a three-month prohibition on introducing new birds to affected farms. For consumers, properly cooked poultry products are considered safe to eat; WHO urges cooking to at least 70°C internal temperature and avoiding raw or undercooked poultry/eggs. Human infection risk remains mainly from close, unprotected contact with infected birds or contaminated environments, emphasizing caution for poultry workers who should avoid touching dead birds with bare hands and report unusual deaths. No need to avoid chicken and eggs if sourced responsibly and cooked thoroughly.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州での鳥インフルエンザ流行下、鶏肉や卵を食べても安全か？知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州の養鶏場でH5N1が確認され防疫措置が取られているが、人への感染報告はなく、記事も消費者向けの安全性情報が主旨であるため、現時点ではフルRRAの必要性は低いが継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 人間感染の報告はなく、家禽（35,647羽）における発生に限定。地元当局による殺処分・移動制限・迅速対応チーム展開などの防疫措置が進行中。記事は消費者向けの食品安全情報（加熱調理の推奨等）が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Sorotipo 3 da dengue avança no Brasil e acende alerta às vésperas do verão; entenda por que uma nova infecção pode ser mais perigosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue serotype 3 advances in Brazil and raises alarm as summer approaches; understand why a new infection can be more dangerous.
article.articleSummary: Dengue serotype 3 is advancing in Brazil, heightening risk as summer approaches and the November 21 National Dengue Combat Day nears. The antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) explains why a secondary infection with a different serotype can be more severe, though outcomes depend on serotype and patient. Brazil recorded over 374,000 dengue cases and 371 deaths from January to October 2026; 2025 saw 1,841 deaths (70.6% fewer than 2024’s 6,270). DENV-3, once uncommon, rose from at least 14% of cases in 2025 to about 30% in 2026. Qdenga vaccination is approved for 4–60-year-olds, with two doses 3 months apart, available in private networks and SUS; priority vaccination targets 10–14-year-olds, with contraindications including pregnancy, breastfeeding, and immunosuppression. Dengue grave signs include severe abdominal pain, bleeding, hypotension, vomiting, reduced urine, and altered consciousness; 2025 reported 35,749 severe or warning cases. No antiviral; emphasis on early diagnosis and fluid/organ-supportive care. Avoid self-medication, including aspirin and NSAIDs.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱血清型3がブラジルで拡大、夏を前に警戒感が高まる――新たな感染がより危険な理由とは
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで毎年発生する季節性デング熱の流行報告であり、血清型3の増加や重症例数は注視すべきだが、IHR基準上の異常性・国際拡大リスクは低く、現時点ではフルRRAに進めるほどの新規性・緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年季節的に流行する既知の疾患であり、血清型3の増加は注目点だが、IHR通報基準（異常性・国際拡大）には該当しにくい。ワクチン接種（Qdenga）や国内対策が進行中であり、外部支援の必要性は低いと見られる。

article.articleHeadline: DPRD Palangka Raya minta warga segera periksa kesehatan jika alami gejala DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Palangka Raya DPRD urges residents to promptly seek a medical check-up if they experience dengue fever symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Palangka Raya, Kalimantan Tengah, Indonesia, officials urge residents to seek medical check-ups promptly if dengue fever symptoms appear, as the rainy season heightens dengue transmission risk. Deputy Speaker Nenie Adriati Lambung of the Palangka Raya City DPRD emphasizes early medical evaluation enables timely treatment and may prevent complications. The message highlights standing water around homes as potential Aedes aegypti breeding sites, underscoring the need for vigilant environmental hygiene. Authorities advocate regular removal or draining of water containers and general cleanliness to reduce mosquito habitats. While no case counts are disclosed, the emphasis is on heightened vigilance during the monsoon season to curb transmission and protect family health by seeking care promptly for suspected dengue.

triage.headline_ja: パランカラヤ市議会、デング熱の症状があれば速やかな健康診断を住民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例数や異常な増加の報告はなく、雨季に伴う通常の注意喚起・予防啓発の内容であるため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 症例数の開示がなく、季節性の注意喚起記事。デング熱は毎年雨季に流行しやすいため、流行しやすさ(epidemic_prone)と長期曝露の基準には該当するが、異常性や社会的関心の高まりは確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Desa Siaga TB: Cirebon Perluas Penemuan Kasus Aktif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB-Ready Village: Cirebon Expands Active Case Finding.
article.articleSummary: 60 Desa Siaga TB (TB Ready Villages) in Cirebon Regency, West Java, Indonesia, aim to expand active TB case finding and accelerate community-level management. The program mobilizes village governments, puskesmas, and community health volunteers to identify residents with TB symptoms, facilitate screening, and ensure patients complete treatment. Bupati Imron Rosyadi stresses that TB control requires community involvement beyond health facilities; TB screening is integrated into the Free Health Check program (CKG) to address upstream-to-downstream processes. Emphasis on reducing stigma, improving housing ventilation, sanitation, and healthy lifestyles to curb transmission. A key challenge is low TB preventive therapy (TPT) coverage among close contacts—17% in West Java—highlighted by Wiyagus, who urges involving Babinsa, Bhabinkamtibmas, and village heads to support screening and preventive therapy. He calls for TB to be included in regional planning documents (RPJMD, RKPD, APBD) to secure cross-sector support, given TB’s health and socioeconomic impact.

triage.headline_ja: TB警戒村:チルボンが活動的症例発見を拡大
triage.triage_reason: 既知の地域流行疾患（結核）に対する通常の公衆衛生プログラムの報道であり、突発的・異常な流行や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による結核対策プログラム（症例発見強化・予防療法拡大）の通常の取り組みであり、新規発生や異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Setelah Diperiksa, Ternyata 1.234 Orang Warga Madiun Positif TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After being examined, 1,234 Madiun residents tested positive for tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) in Madiun Regency, East Java, Indonesia, spans all ages, including children and the elderly. As of October 2026, 10,115 people suspected of TB were screened, with 1,234 TB cases detected. Screening reached 100% of its Standard Service Minimal target, and 96% of diagnosed individuals started treatment. Challenges include patients interrupting therapy after moving and ongoing stigma. Health authorities urge not to shun TB patients, noting that after two months of intensive treatment most are non-infectious. Screening now prioritizes close contacts, residents of pesantren, students from SD–SMA, and prospective brides/grooms, integrated with the Free Health Check program at puskesmas/posyandu ILP. A mobile chest X-ray unit is deployed to accelerate case finding as Indonesia pursues a 2030 TB-free goal.

triage.headline_ja: 検査の結果、マディウン住民1,234人が結核陽性と判明
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアの地方における既知の風土病であり、スクリーニング事業の成果報告であって異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病で、本記事は地域保健当局によるスクリーニング・治療プログラムの進捗報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Xử phạt 157 triệu đồng, tiêu hủy 1,6 tấn thịt heo nhiễm khuẩn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fined 157 million dong; 1.6 tons of bacteria-contaminated pork destroyed.
article.articleSummary: On 16 November 2026, Đồng Nai City authorities, led by the Livestock and Fisheries Sub-Department under the Department of Agriculture and Environment, fined a local individual (B.A.T.) 157 million VND for multiple veterinary and food-safety violations. Violations included slaughtering animals at an unapproved site, selling livestock meat without a slaughter-control stamp and veterinary hygiene seal, and marketing fresh products of animal origin with microbial contamination beyond permissible limits. In response, 1.6 tonnes of contaminated pork containing Escherichia coli and Salmonella were destroyed under supervision. Additionally, 20 kg of pork must be thermally treated or repurposed, and 100 kg of pork bones require veterinary hygiene checks. This enforcement underscores ongoing vigilance against unsafe meat handling and microbial contamination in Đồng Nai. Published date: 2026-11-16.

triage.headline_ja: 157百万ドンの罰金処分、細菌汚染豚肉1.6トンを廃棄処分

triage.notes: 本件は動物衛生・食品安全当局による規制違反に対する罰金・廃棄処分の記事であり、ヒト感染症の発生事例ではないため対象国リストへの該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 防止埃博拉病毒病疫情传入我国，海关总署发布公告
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: General Administration of Customs issues an announcement to prevent Ebola virus disease outbreak from entering China.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak data from WHO show Congo (Kinshasa) with 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths (CFR 48.8%) between May 15 and Nov 9, 2026; Kenya reports 9 cases and 2 deaths (Oct 6–Nov 10, 2026); Nigeria records one imported EVD case on Oct 20, 2026. To prevent cross-border transmission, China’s General Administration of Customs issues Announcement No. 156, effective Nov 18, 2026 for one year, covering anyone who has visited EVD-affected countries within 21 days and who has had exposure to EVD patients or exhibits symptoms (fever, fatigue, headache, myalgia, sore throat, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, rash, or bleeding). Such travelers must declare on entry and undergo prescribed medical measures; goods, containers, luggage, and packaging from affected areas should be disinfected. The policy also applies to newly WHO-listed countries during the effective period.

triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）に指定したエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（DRCで11,042症例・致死率48.8%）が、ケニア・ナイジェリアへ拡大し、中国が検疫措置を講じるなど国際的対応が進んでいるためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Alarm na priljubljenih turističnih destinacijah: Okužba se hitro širi, v eni državi že 427 mrtvih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm at popular tourist destinations: The infection is spreading rapidly, and in one country there are already 427 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreaks are spreading at popular tourist destinations, with Vietnam, Mexico and the Dominican Republic seeing sharp case increases. In a four‑week window, Mexico, Bolivia, Peru and Colombia reported a 53% rise in infections. The Dominican Republic had 415 cases up to week 40, including La Romana and Puerto Plata; Honduras had over 12,000 cases by end‑October. Asia shows especially worrying activity: Bangladesh has about 136,930 cases this year with 427 deaths, and Vietnam around 131,205 infections, a 37% rise year on year. Dengue is transmitted mainly by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, daytime‑active mosquitoes; protection measures include long sleeves, repellents, and bed nets. Symptoms include sudden high fever, severe headache and muscle pain 4–10 days after a bite. There is debate on vaccination: STIKO recommends vaccination for those previously infected; BCRT advocates vaccinating also those never infected, with two doses at least three months apart. Local transmission in Europe is possible if infected travelers seed local cases.

triage.headline_ja: 人気観光地で警報：感染が急速に拡大、ある国ではすでに427人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング熱がベトナムを含む複数国で急増しており（ベトナムは前年比37%増、約13万人感染）、WPRO基準の複数（異常性・重症度・曝露継続・流行しやすさ）に該当し、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国（メキシコ、ドミニカ共和国、ホンジュラス、バングラデシュ、ペルー、ボリビア、コロンビア等）のデング熱急増を扱っているが、対象国リストに該当するのはベトナムのみ。ベトナムは前年比37%増・約13万人感染と報告されており、地域的な注視が必要。他地域（中南米・南アジア）は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Urban Expansion Across Sub-Saharan Africa Fuels Complex Malaria
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Sub-Saharan Africa is increasingly driven by urban expansion, with the urban‑peri‑urban interface forming a distinct, persistent transmission zone. A narrative review of 2000–2026 literature (Covenant University, Nigeria) across PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science and Google Scholar identifies three environments—dense urban cores, dynamic peri‑urban interfaces, and semi‑urban/rural transitions—where peri‑urban areas sustain high transmission despite lower core incidence. In Libreville, Gabon, Plasmodium falciparum prevalence reached 50.9% in semi‑rural and 46.5% in semi‑urban communities in 2023; Bamako, Yaoundé, Lagos, and Accra show similar peripheral burdens due to informal settlements and poor drainage. Bioko Island risk is shaped by travel history to high‑transmission mainland and household wealth. Anopheles gambiae complex adapts to polluted waters; An. coluzzii pupates at 90% in contaminated field water (Cotonou) vs 78.67% lab, and accounts for 54.79% of An. gambiae s.l. in Accra, where 65.34% of breeding sites harbor larvae (drainage ditches 48.21%; urban agriculture 27.24%).

triage.headline_ja: サハラ以南アフリカにおける都市拡大が複雑なマラリア感染リスクを助長
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2000–2026年の文献レビューに基づく学術的総説であり、急性の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではないため、シグナルとして取り上げる必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はナイジェリアCovenant大学による文献レビューであり、ガボン・マリ・カメルーン・ナイジェリア・ベナン・赤道ギニアなど複数国のマラリア媒介蚊生態系と都市化の関連を分析した学術研究。対象国リストの中ではガーナ（アクラ）のみが具体的な研究対象地として言及されているが、急性アウトブレイクではなく既知のマラリア流行パターンに関する長期的疫学分析のためトリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 防止埃博拉病毒病疫情传入我国 海关总署发布公告
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: General Administration of Customs issues notice to prevent Ebola virus disease outbreak from entering China
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) per the World Health Organization. From May 15 to November 9, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 11,042 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,387 deaths (crude fatality rate 48.8%). Kenya recorded 9 confirmed cases and 2 deaths during October 6–November 10, 2026, and Nigeria reported 1 imported case on October 20, 2026. To prevent entry into China, the General Administration of Customs issues a one-year notice effective November 18, 2026: (1) travelers who have been in Ebola-affected countries in the past 21 days, or who have contact with Ebola cases or exhibit symptoms, must declare to customs for medical Measures; (2) potentially contaminated transport vehicles, containers, goods, luggage, packages, and outer packaging should undergo sanitation; (3) travelers may consult customs or the International Travel Health Center before departure or check the customs website for updates.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の流入防止のため、中国税関総署が通知を発出

article.articleHeadline: Bayi Ditemukan dalam Karung Beras di Taipa Dirawat Intensif, Alami Infeksi dan Sesak Napas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Baby Found in a Rice Sack in Taipa Admitted to Intensive Care with Infection and Shortness of Breath.
article.articleSummary: Newborn girl found alive inside a rice sack in the Taipa Complex, Palu City, Central Sulawesi, Indonesia, is admitted to RSUD Madani Palu in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit with infection and respiratory distress. She arrived at the emergency department around 11:00 WITA and was placed in an incubator with intravenous access and oxygen support. NICU head Ni Made Puni Rastiti said the infant showed respiratory distress with mild chest retractions at arrival, but improved after initial stabilization and transfer to NICU at about 15:15 WITA. Initial assessments indicated infection, triggering antibiotic therapy and supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula. Nutrition is provided through an orogastric tube delivering 4–7 ml of milk every three hours. The baby weighs about 2,030 grams, classed as low birth weight. As of 16 November 2026, she remains under intensive care.

triage.headline_ja: タイパで米袋の中から発見された赤ちゃん、感染症と呼吸困難で集中治療室へ
triage.triage_reason: これは個別の乳児遺棄事件に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の感染症アウトブレイクやヒト-ヒト感染のリスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: この記事は単一の新生児症例（遺棄された乳児の感染症と低体重）に関する地域ニュースであり、感染症危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: മാസ്കും ലോക്ഡൗണും തിരിച്ചുവരുന്നോ? തലപൊക്കി പുതിയ കോവിഡ് വകഭേദം; ഇന്ത്യ ആശങ്കയുടെ നിഴലിലോ? ഇക്കാര്യങ്ങൾ അറിയണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Are masks and lockdowns returning? A new COVID variant with head covering; is India under a cloud of concern? Here’s what you need to know.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1 is a SARS-CoV-2 variant with 25+ mutations in the spike protein, nicknamed the 'Saltation' or 'Jump' variant. First detected in Ontario, Canada on May 2, 2026, it has since been reported in the United States, Spain, France, Israel, Singapore, Australia, and New Zealand. Mutations enhance binding to the ACE2 receptor, aiding cell entry and spread, but lab data do not indicate higher transmissibility or significant immune escape. There are no distinct symptoms beyond usual COVID-19 manifestations; some patients may experience shortness of breath or altered sense of smell/taste. Overall severity is unclear, though older adults (70+) may be more frequently affected. India has not confirmed PJ.2.1; genomic surveillance by INSACOG and WHO monitoring continue to track arrivals and changes in the variant.

triage.headline_ja: マスクとロックダウンが再来するのか？新たなコロナ変異株が頭をもたげる――インドは懸念の影に？知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 25以上のスパイク変異を持つ新変異株PJ.2.1が複数国で検出され国際的拡散が確認されているため、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡散）を2つ満たしピックアップ対象とする。ただしインドでは未確認で重症度・伝播性増加の根拠もなく、情報不足が多い。
triage.notes: 記事はインドにおける懸念を扱っているが、インド国内での確認症例はなく、INSACOGおよびWHOによる監視が継続中との記載のみ。対象国リストのうちインドは『未確認』であるため verified_locations からは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Grippe in Berlin: Neuer Impfstoff trifft auf Schweinegrippe-Virus - was das für den Winter bedeutet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza in Berlin: A new vaccine meets the swine flu virus — what this means for the winter.
article.articleSummary: Influenza has arrived in Berlin with 38 lab-confirmed cases reported in the latest week by Berlin’s health authorities (Lageso); three weeks earlier, 32 cases. Wastewater monitoring shows influenza A virus concentrations rising about 8% per week, signaling early activity. Within Berlin, incidence by district varies: Pankow highest at 8.9/100,000, followed by Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg (4.9), Mitte (4.7), and Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf (4.6); Reinickendorf (1.7) and Marzahn-Hellersdorf (1.8) lowest. Nationally, rhino- and enteroviruses predominate in respiratory infections; RKI reports moderate community activity and low hospital activity as of 12 November. Sentinel testing shows rhino/enteroviruses ~33% of samples, influenza ~10%, SARS-CoV-2 ~3%; RSV is currently limited. The A(H1N1)pdm09 subtype dominates so far. Vaccination season is advised: STIKO recommends autumn immunization, with protection developing in ~two weeks; peak activity usually after New Year. About 18.8 million vaccine doses were released by PEI by mid-October. The season’s vaccine includes updated components for A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and Victoria-line B; H1N1 component is based on a 2025 strain, relevant as it is currently prevalent. Vaccination reduces severe illness and doctor visits, even with imperfect matches (per a Suzhou study).

triage.headline_ja: ベルリンのインフルエンザ：新ワクチンが豚インフルエンザウイルスに対抗 ― 冬への影響とは
triage.triage_reason: ドイツ・ベルリンにおける季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行状況を報告する記事であり、対象国に該当せず、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツ・ベルリンでの季節性インフルエンザ（A(H1N1)pdm09優勢）の定例的なサーベイランス報告であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。Suzhou（中国）への言及は過去の研究論文の引用であり、現地での発生事例ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго число погибших при вспышке Эболы превысило 5,5 тысячи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the death toll from the Ebola outbreak has surpassed 5,500.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has infected over 11,000 people and caused more than 5,500 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. As of November 14, 2026, the outbreak has spread to 68 health zones across eight provinces. In recent months, about 240 people die each week from Ebola. About two-thirds of recent deaths occur in towns rather than in specialized treatment centers, suggesting late case detection and limited access to care. Contributing factors hindering control include armed conflict, famine, damaged infrastructure, distrust of the medical system, poor roads, and geographic isolation, which complicate response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の死者数が5,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（感染者1万人超、死者5,500人超）で、複数州に拡大し、武力紛争や医療不信などで対応が困難化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 死亡率が高く、治療施設外での死亡が多いことから検知・医療アクセスの遅れが深刻。武力紛争・飢饉・インフラ破壊などが対応を一層困難にしており、国際的な支援が必要な状況と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: La peur d'Ebola fait chuter la fréquentation des hôpitaux
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: The fear of Ebola leads to a drop in hospital attendance.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus, Bundibugyo strain, in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri) triggers a sharp drop in hospital attendance as fear grows. In Bukavu and Sud-Kivu, clinics report declines since April 2026—from around 20 consultations per day at Kalunga health center to about 5, with some days no patients. Residents increasingly self-medicate, citing fear of isolation, stigma, and dying alone in treatment centers, followed by bereavement without family rites. Experts stress this is a social protection response to a polycrisis that includes ongoing conflict, COVID-19 trauma, extreme poverty, eroding trust in institutions, and infodemic. Two Ebola cases have been confirmed in the Miti-Murhesa health zone (Kabare, South Kivu). The outbreak reframes hospitals as spaces of danger rather than refuge during this crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラへの恐怖が病院受診数の急減を招く
triage.triage_reason: 東部コンゴ（北キブ・南キブ・イトゥリ）でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の確認症例が報告され、恐怖による受診回避という二次的な公衆衛生危機も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものよりも、恐怖・不信による受診回避という社会的影響に焦点を当てているが、Miti-Murhesa保健区（南キブ州カバレ）で2例のエボラ確定症例が明記されており、紛争・貧困・COVID-19トラウマ等が絡む複合的危機（polycrisis）としてフルリスク評価が妥当。COVID-19タグは心理的背景要因としての言及であり、現行の流行ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Thiếu niên tiêu cơ vân kèm cúm A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rhabdomyolysis in an adolescent with influenza A.
article.articleSummary: 16-year-old Khang in Hanoi presented with high fever after gym and widespread muscle aches, diagnosed with acute rhabdomyolysis related to influenza A and overexertion. At Tam Anh General Hospital Hanoi, creatine kinase was 33,749 U/L (normal 200–300), indicating severe muscle damage. Dr. Nguyen Thi Kieu Linh explained that exercising beyond the muscle’s capacity causes fiber breakdown and myoglobin release, which can injure the kidneys, especially with dehydration. If untreated, rhabdomyolysis can lead to acute kidney injury and electrolyte disturbances, potentially life-threatening. Treatment addressed both muscle injury and influenza A. After one week, pain resolved, mobility returned, CK normalized, and the patient was discharged to rest and resume training gradually. Early rhabdomyolysis can resemble normal post-exercise soreness; symptoms include severe muscle pain, weakness, swelling, and dark urine, though not all patients have dark urine. Advice: gradually increase loads, stay hydrated, avoid heavy workouts during fever or acute illness, and seek prompt evaluation for worsening symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAに伴う横紋筋融解症を発症した青年
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の個別臨床報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 40,000 கோழிகள் அழிப்பு.. தமிழகத்தை அதிர விடும் பறவை காய்ச்சல்... சிக்கன், முட்டை சாப்பிடலாமா?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 40,000 Chickens Culled: Avian Influenza to Shake Tamil Nadu — Should We Eat Chicken and Eggs?
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) detected in poultry in Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, has led to enhanced statewide surveillance. About 40,000 chickens have been culled and a temporary ban on broiler farming is imposed in the affected area. Tamil Nadu Public Health Department Director Dr. Somasundaram ordered intensified monitoring and preventive measures. There have been no human infections detected in Tamil Nadu. Guidance from the World Health Organization emphasizes that chicken meat and eggs should be cooked to at least 70°C internal temperature to inactivate the virus; undercooked or raw poultry poses risk. Citizens are advised to avoid visiting affected zones and handling dead birds. As protein sources, eggs (about 6–7 g protein per egg) and chicken (about 30 g per 100 g) remain safe when thoroughly cooked.

triage.headline_ja: 4万羽の鶏を殺処分…タミルナードゥ州を揺るがす鳥インフルエンザ、鶏肉や卵は食べても大丈夫？
triage.triage_reason: タミルナードゥ州の家禽でH5N1が確認され大規模殺処分と監視強化が行われているが、ヒトへの感染は報告されておらず現時点で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は限定的。今後のヒト感染発生の有無を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ヒト感染例は報告されていないが、H5N1は人獣共通感染症としての潜在的リスクがあるため、州の監視状況や今後のヒト症例報告の有無を継続的に確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Especialista alerta para necessidade de reforçar prevenção contra a dengue diante de previsão de 860 mil casos em 2027
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expert Warns of the Need to Strengthen Dengue Prevention in View of a Forecast of 860,000 Cases in 2027.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces a dengue surge as conditions could yield up to 860,000 cases in 2027, according to infectious disease specialist Marion Burger of PUCPR. The forecast hinges on a 'super El Niño' that heats Pacific waters and combines heavy rainfall with high temperatures, speeding Aedes aegypti development from two weeks to five–seven days. Prevention must intensify, especially in November, to curb transmission before it peaks. The Health Ministry urges vigilance: inspect yards, eliminate standing water, seal water tanks, fill plant saucers with sand or perforate pots for drainage, and unclog gutters, roofs, and drains; where transmission exists, install window screens and use repellents. Recognize dengue symptoms—high fever (39–40°C), headache behind the eyes, myalgias/arthralgias, malaise, nausea, and a red rash—and seek care if signs appear. Vaccination is nationwide for ages 10–14; two doses three months apart; over 3,000,000 have started and await second dose to ensure protection.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱予防強化の必要性を専門家が警告、2027年には86万件の症例予測
triage.triage_reason: 2027年の症例増加予測に基づく予防啓発記事であり、現時点での急激な異常発生や深刻な公衆衛生危機を示すものではないが、気候要因によるデング熱媒介蚊の増殖加速という継続的なリスク要因があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は将来予測(2027年)に基づく予防啓発記事であり、現在進行中の急性アウトブレイクではない。発生地域に含まれるUnited States, Missouri, Pacificは記事の主題と無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: חולי אבולה נמלטו ממיטותיהם: האיום שחוזר לקונגו - והמלכוד הקטלני
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patients fled from their beds: the threat returning to Congo — and the deadly trap.
article.articleSummary: Six months into a deadly Ebola outbreak (Ebola virus disease, EVD) in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the epidemic has killed more than 5,000 people across eight provinces. Initiated in May 2026, the outbreak now runs along a forest corridor linking Beni and Mambasa (about 136 km), with Biakato accounting for roughly a quarter of new cases. Attacks by an ISIS-linked faction, the Allied Democratic Forces, have intensified the crisis: 106 people were killed in recent raids, and gunmen burned homes, shops and health facilities near Biakato, forcing Ebola patients to flee beds and triggering mass displacement. MSF operates a treatment centre in Beni, about 64 km from Biakato, but expansion into infected areas is hampered by threats against aid workers. Deep-seated distrust and decades of conflict hinder response; Dr. Jean-Jacques Muyumba urges negotiations with rebels to allow medical access, arguing containment depends on it.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者がベッドから逃げ出した：コンゴに戻ってきた脅威と致死的な罠
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で5000人超の死者を出す大規模エボラ流行が8州に拡大し、武装勢力の攻撃により患者の逃走・大量避難が発生するなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態でIHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 武装勢力ADFによる攻撃が感染対策の障害となっており、医療アクセスの確保には交渉が必要との専門家指摘あり。渡航・貿易制限に関する言及は記事中になし。

article.articleHeadline: Sốc tim, suy hô hấp... vì sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cardiogenic shock, respiratory failure... due to dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Two dengue fever cases in southern Vietnam progressed to severe complications requiring ECMO. Case 1: N.K.L., 24, from Ward Vung Tau, Ho Chi Minh City, developed high fever, chest pain, vomiting and diarrhea, then cardiogenic shock from fulminant dengue-related myocarditis with multi-organ failure. He received VA-ECMO to support heart and lungs, improved after a week, vasopressors and ECMO were stopped, and he was discharged. Case 2: L.M.T., born 1991, from Hong Thai Commune, Lam Dong Province, had about a week of fever and cough followed by escalating dyspnea and respiratory failure. He received VV-ECMO at Binh Thuan General Hospital before transfer to Ho Chi Minh City; after four days his lungs recovered, he was extubated, and ECMO was discontinued two days later. ECMO provides temporary life support, not a dengue cure; early evaluation for warning signs is urged.

triage.headline_ja: 心原性ショック、呼吸不全…デング熱による重症化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで流行性疾患であるデング熱の重症例2件（ECMO使用）の個別症例報告であり、異常な集団発生や新規性を示す情報はなく、公衆衛生上の新たな懸念は低い。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの風土病であり、本記事は個別重症症例（ECMO治療）の医学的事例報告。集団発生や感染拡大を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Contipharma presenteert eerste alles-in-één-speekseltest voor malariadiagnose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Contipharma presents the first all-in-one saliva test for malaria diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Liège-based Contipharma unveils Smart, the first all-in-one saliva test to screen for malaria, to be presented on Monday at Medica in Düsseldorf, Germany. The device combines sampling, analysis, and result interpretation in a single unit, replacing finger-prick blood collection, sample transfer, and laboratory analysis. By simplifying the process and reducing error risk, it targets children and communities in remote, malaria-endemic areas. The test is currently being validated by the Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo, a country severely affected by malaria. CEO Bernard Delhez notes Kinshasa was chosen because policy decisions on malaria are made there, and eradicating malaria requires identifying the invisible reservoir on the ground, where people live, not only the sick.

triage.headline_ja: Contipharma社、マラリア診断用の世界初オールインワン唾液検査を発表
triage.triage_reason: 疾病発生事例ではなく、新規診断デバイス（唾液検査キット）に関する製品発表記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な流行とは無関係。
triage.notes: 本記事はベルギー企業Contipharmaによるマラリア診断用唾液検査デバイス『Smart』のドイツMedica展示会での発表、およびコンゴ民主共和国キンシャサでの検証実施に関する製品ニュースであり、アウトブレイクや感染拡大の報告ではない。DRCでの検証言及はあるが、新規マラリア流行の報告ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: हरियाणा में टीबी उन्मूलन अभियान को मिली बड़ी सफलता, 2,157 ग्राम पंचायतें घोषित हुईं टीबी मुक्त; 25.6 लाख लोगों की हुई जांच
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Major success for the TB elimination campaign in Haryana: 2,157 gram panchayats declared TB-free; 2.56 million people were tested.
article.articleSummary: TB in Haryana, India: In 2025, 2,157 of 6,237 gram panchayats were declared TB-free (about 35%) as part of a state elimination drive. A total of 2.56 million people have been tested. The program uses AI-based digital chest X-rays and rapid molecular diagnostics for early detection. Since starting on 7 December 2024, the campaign has conducted over 900,000 chest X-rays and about 550,000 molecular tests. By October 2026, roughly 167,000 TB cases were identified during the drive (not current patients). The TB-free certificate is issued after verification against government standards and does not imply permanent eradication. The strategy emphasizes active community-based screening, modern diagnostic facilities, treatment monitoring, and public participation to curb transmission across the state.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州の結核撲滅キャンペーンが大成功、2,157のグラム・パンチャヤトが結核フリーを宣言；256万人が検査を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 結核撲滅キャンペーンの成果報告であり、異常な公衆衛生事象ではなく、既存の疾病対策プログラムの進捗報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の疾患であり、本記事は州政府の撲滅プログラムの成功事例報告。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではないためシグナルとして扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DR Congo tops 5,500 -- Health Ministry
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reported 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths (case fatality 48.9%) per the National Institute of Public Health, with Ituri Province the epicenter (69.1% of cases) and 68 of 178 health zones across eight provinces affected. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus for which there are no WHO-approved drugs or vaccines, began in May 2026 in the DRC and Uganda. Since May, the tally has exceeded 5,500 deaths and 11,900 total cases. Kenya reported its first Ebola case on Oct 6, and Nigeria reported an infection on Oct 20, indicating cross-border concerns. Uganda’s outbreak was declared over on July 28, with WHO confirmation on Aug 25. The dynamic spread stresses surveillance across multiple nations despite regional containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数が5,500人を突破――保健省発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は死者5,500人超・致死率約49%と深刻で、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準複数・WPRO基準複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、Kenya、Nigeriaも含まれるが、これらは対象国リスト（GeoNames ID指定）に含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。記事の主題であるDRCのみを計上した。ウガンダの流行は既に終息宣言済み（7/28）。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola ¿siempre tarde?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Is it always late?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri's Mongbwalu, has reached about 11,000 infections and 5,300 deaths. Africa-CDC in Addis Ababa monitors outbreaks and informs ambassadors, but is criticized for arriving after crises. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant lacks approved vaccines or treatments, while Zaire ebolavirus vaccines exist; first Bundibugyo trials began in October with results not expected until 2027. International aid promises around $2.9 billion, but only roughly $220 million has been disbursed with justification; root problems include under-trained local entities, with only 19 of 92 organizations responding to the Ministry of Health’s call for resource management clarity. Health workers face unpaid salaries amid violence in Ituri, hampering response. Safe burials and community engagement are crucial; sustained funding, ongoing research, and local capacity are essential to prevent repeating such tragedies.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、常に後手に回るのか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行は感染者・死者数が非常に多く、ワクチン未承認かつ資金・人員不足が深刻で、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルリスク評価へ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ムォングバルを中心としたエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行に関するオピニオン記事。エチオピア（アディスアベバ）はアフリカCDCの監視拠点として言及されているのみで発生地域ではないため除外。感染者・死者数（約11,000人・5,300人）は記事記載の数値であり、公的発表と異なる可能性がある点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 上周多3人染退伍軍人症　2宗為社區感染1宗為輸入個案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three more people contracted Veterans' disease last week; two cases were community-acquired and one was an imported case.
article.articleSummary: Legionnaires’ disease cases in Hong Kong rose to three infections from November 8–14: two community-acquired and one imported. Aged 62–67; two men (63 in Tuen Mun, 67 in Wong Tai Sin) and a 62-year-old woman who had traveled to mainland China during incubation. All had underlying conditions. The Centre for Health Protection is conducting epidemiological investigations to identify infection sources and high-risk exposures; as of November 14, these cases appear sporadic with no link to earlier local cases. Total Legionnaires’ disease cases in 2026 reached 178; compared with 167 in 2025 and 135 in 2024. Risk factors include male sex, age over 50, smoking, alcohol use, and immunocompromise. Environmental risks involve poorly maintained or old water systems, cooling towers, fountains, spas, electric water heaters, hotels or ships. Legionella grows in warm water (20–45°C) and inhalation of aerosolized water causes infection; gardening soil, compost, and potting mix can also be sources.

triage.headline_ja: 先週さらに3人がレジオネラ症に感染　2件は地域感染、1件は輸入症例
triage.triage_reason: 香港で散発的なレジオネラ症症例が報告されているが、関連性は確認されておらず、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大のリスクは低い。年間累計は増加傾向にあり経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: レジオネラ症は環境中の水系から散発的に発生する疾患で、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。香港のCHPが疫学調査を実施中だが、症例間の関連は確認されていない。年間症例数は増加傾向（2024年135件→2025年167件→2026年178件）にあり、環境要因の監視強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: La société civile de Butembo alerte sur les risques liés à la grève des prestataires de soins engagés dans la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Butembo civil society warns of the risks associated with the strike by healthcare providers involved in the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, civil society in Butembo, North Kivu, Congo-Kinshasa warns that a strike by healthcare providers involved in the Ebola response is disrupting care at Ebola treatment and transit centers in Butembo and Katwa health zones. The workers are demanding two months of back salaries, a revision of the salary scale, and improvements to working conditions and equipment. The civil society calls on authorities to intervene swiftly to resolve the dispute, fearing consequences for patient management and ongoing Ebola outbreak control. They warn that care gaps could lead to deterioration of patients admitted in facilities and could complicate outbreak control, especially as some contacts remain untraceable and the epidemic remains not fully controlled. At the time of reporting, authorities' response had not been obtained.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ブテンボ市民社会、エボラ対応に従事する医療従事者のストライキに伴うリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応において、医療従事者のストライキにより治療・感染経路追跡が阻害される恐れがあり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応中にヘルスケア提供者のストライキが発生し、接触者追跡や患者管理に支障が出る可能性がある。アウトブレイクは完全には制御されていないとされ、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DH announces latest situation regarding Legionnaires' disease cases
article.articleSummary: Legionnaires’ disease (LD) in Hong Kong: from November 8–14, CHP reported three cases (two community-acquired, one imported), ages 62–67, with underlying illnesses; two men (63 in Tuen Mun, 67 in Wong Tai Sin) and a 62-year-old woman who travelled to the Mainland during incubation. Investigations describe these as sporadic with no links to prior confirmed cases. As of November 14, 178 LD cases have been recorded this year, compared with 167 in 2025 and 135 in 2024. Susceptible groups include men, people over 50, smokers, alcohol users, and the immunocompromised. Transmission occurs via aerosols from contaminated water systems; risk factors include poor maintenance, old water systems, cooling towers, fountains, whirlpool spas, and hot-water devices. Preventive guidance emphasizes sterile or boiled water for drinking/oral care, regular cleaning and maintenance of water systems, purging infrequently used outlets, careful humidifier use, and garden-soil precautions. Public health resources and smoking-cessation information are available through CHP and DH channels.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生署、レジオネラ症症例に関する最新状況を発表
triage.triage_reason: 香港における散発的なレジオネラ症症例の定例報告であり、過去事例との関連もなく、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な拡大傾向は認められない。
triage.notes: 症例は散発的で環境中のレジオネラ菌による感染であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はない。年間報告数は過去数年と比較してやや増加傾向だが、通常の公衆衛生監視の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Tanzania: Malaria Fight Gains New Tools, but Elimination Remains Distant
article.articleSummary: Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, and Africa-wide, malaria remains a major public health challenge, with 2024 estimates of 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths, mostly among children under five. A New England Journal of Medicine review describes a prevention transition: combining tools to local transmission, strengthening surveillance, and securing financing are essential to move toward elimination. Insecticide-treated nets, once dominant, face pyrethroid resistance, prompting the 2023 rollout of dual-ingredient nets. Seasonal malaria chemoprevention protected 54 million children in 19 sub-Saharan countries in 2024, reducing illness and deaths by 59% at about $4 per child annually. Two vaccines, RTS,S/AS01 and R21/Matrix-M, have WHO prequalification, with 25 African countries introducing vaccination by April 2026 and 62–66% uptake among 3-dose recipients in Ghana, Kenya and Malawi, linked to a 32% drop in hospital admissions for severe malaria. Success hinges on tailored strategies, reliable surveillance, and sustainable financing, since vaccines and new tools complement, not replace, vector control and preventive medicines.

triage.headline_ja: タンザニア：マラリア対策に新たな手段も、根絶にはなお遠く
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア対策の進捗を総括する解説記事であり、特定の異常な発生や急性のアウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はタンザニア発だが、アフリカ全体のマラリア対策（予防薬、ワクチン、蚊帳等）の進捗を報告する総説的内容であり、特定の急性感染拡大イベントではない。ガーナ・ケニア・マラウイも言及されるが、ワクチン導入実績の文脈であり主題国ではないため除外した。対象国リストのいずれも主題としての発生国に該当しないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Older Age Correlates With Late HIV Diagnoses in Island Transmission
article.articleSummary: Zhoushan City, an island municipality in eastern China, reports 32.3% late HIV/AIDS diagnoses among 275 cases from 2020–2024. In molecular transmission networks (128 patients in 32 clusters), late-diagnosis rate is 31.3%, not significantly different from non-network cases (33.3%; p=0.713). Among networked cases, age 50 years or older independently predicts late diagnosis (adjusted odds ratio 2.703; 95% CI 1.095–6.672; p=0.031), while transmission among men who have sex with men is linked to lower odds (OR 0.222; 95% CI 0.060–0.821; p=0.024). Seven larger active networks (≥5 nodes) show 26.8% late diagnosis (18/67), lower than overall and non-network rates with overlapping CIs. Longitudinal tracking shows 2020–2023 rates below 2024’s 45.5%. Overall, late diagnoses remain moderate-to-low nationally; ongoing molecular surveillance may better target key populations and optimize detection.

triage.headline_ja: 島嶼部の伝播ネットワークにおけるHIV後期診断と高齢の相関
triage.triage_reason: 学術的な疫学研究論文であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示すものではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国舟山市におけるHIV後期診断率に関する研究論文の紹介であり、感染症の急性発生イベントではない。疾患名にCoccidioidomycosisが含まれているが記事内容とは無関係と思われる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : la riposte freinée par l'insécurité et la méfiance
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the response hampered by insecurity and mistrust.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo strain persists six months after its May declaration, with more than 11,200 confirmed cases and 5,500 deaths. The epidemic has spread to eight provinces and 67 health zones, concentrated mainly in Ituri and North Kivu, where about 90% of cases remain. Originating in Mongwalu, about 50 km north of Bunia, the virus has extended to Fataki, Kilo, Drodro, and Mahagi in Ituri, and to Beni, Butembo, Oicha in North Kivu. Africa CDC notes new resurgences. Field response is hampered by contact-tracing difficulties and community mistrust, while about 64% of deaths occur in communities due to limited access and early detection. Security degradation causes attacks on health workers and facilities, mobility of populations, and obstacles to surveillance; Uganda reports no new Bundibugyo cases since July. Containment hinges on surveillance, community engagement, and safe operations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱:治安悪化と不信感により対応が停滞
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)が6ヶ月以上継続し、11,200例以上・死亡5,500例に達する大規模アウトブレイクであり、治安悪化や住民の不信感により対応が困難となっているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境リスクが言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。既に大規模かつ長期化したアウトブレイクであり、治安情勢の悪化が対応を阻害している点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Cứu sống người đàn ông nhiễm 'vi khuẩn ăn thịt người' suy đa tạng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man Saved from Flesh-Eating Bacteria Infection Causing Multi-Organ Failure
article.articleSummary: On 16 November, a 54-year-old man from Loc Ninh, Tay Ninh Province, Vietnam, was treated for melioidosis caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, presenting with severe pneumonia, septic shock, acute respiratory failure, and acute kidney injury. At Xuyên Á Tay Ninh General Hospital, he arrived in respiratory distress (RR 32/min, SpO2 90%) and required ICU care, endotracheal intubation, and mechanical ventilation. Burkholderia pseudomallei, the agent of Whitmore (melioidosis), is soil- and water-borne and can enter via skin breaks, inhalation, or ingestion, with a course ranging from pneumonia to multi-organ abscesses and septicemia and high mortality if untreated. After three days, his condition improved and he was moved to Pulmonology. He later developed upper GI bleeding; endoscopy revealed a Forrest IIa gastric ulcer with mild duodenal erosion, treated endoscopically. After nearly three weeks, he was discharged. Clinicians warn of melioidosis’ severity, especially in older or comorbid patients, and urge prompt evaluation for pneumonia and adherence to COPD therapy.

triage.headline_ja: 人食いバクテリア感染で多臓器不全となった男性、救命される
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発症例報告であり、土壌・水由来の非接触感染症（類鼻疽）であるためヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは低く、社会的関心や政府関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 類鼻疽（メリオイドーシス）は東南アジアの土壌・水環境に常在する細菌による風土病で、単発の重症例報告。ヒト-ヒト感染は起こらないためアウトブレイクのリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak: 11,000 Infected as Hunger, Violence Hamper Response
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak has reached 11,376 confirmed infections and 5,568 deaths as of November 14, across 68 health zones in eight provinces, with a fatality rate near 49–50%. Since May 15, 11,000 infections have occurred, 240 deaths weekly. Armed violence, hunger and mistrust hinder contact tracing and patient isolation, with two-thirds of recent deaths in communities rather than treatment centers, signaling late detection or care gaps. Rumors fuel resistance; 84 have been documented, including beliefs that patients at centers never return home. For Bundibugyo Ebola, there is no proven vaccine or treatment yet; Merck’s Ervebo vaccine may offer some cross-protection. North Kivu has vaccinated over 3,300 people, leaving 247 doses and an urgent request for 10,000 more. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines from Oxford/Serum Institute of India and Moderna are in late-stage trials, results expected early 2027. Health measures—case finding, contact tracing, isolation, and building community trust—remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：飢餓と暴力が対応を阻害する中、感染者11,000人に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例11,376人、死亡5,568人、致死率約50%の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、武力紛争・飢餓・不信感が対応を阻害し国際的な支援要請も出ているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラで既存ワクチン（Ervebo）の有効性不明、専用ワクチンは2027年初頭まで結果待ち。武力紛争地域での対応困難、ワクチン供給不足（10,000回分の追加要請）あり、地域拡大・国際的影響への懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 장갑도 안 끼고 맨손으로 덥석"... 황도 통조림 속 '세균' 어쩌나
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bare-handed, with no gloves on, grabbing it... what about the bacteria in canned peaches?
article.articleSummary: Video from a Chinese food processing plant shows workers packing peach segments by hand, without gloves, into plastic cups. The video's authenticity and the plant's identity, manufacturer, product distribution, and domestic import status are unconfirmed. The incident highlights contamination risk from poor hand hygiene in processed foods, especially sugar- or moisture-rich products that support microbial growth. Two pathogens of concern are Staphylococcus aureus, common on skin, which can transfer to food and cause vomiting, abdominal cramps, diarrhea, and nausea within 1–5 hours, and norovirus, which can spread via contaminated hands or water and trigger acute gastroenteritis with dehydration, hazardous for infants and the elderly. Practical advice includes strict hand and tool cleanliness, avoiding bare-handed contact; if illness occurs, drink boiled water or electrolyte solutions, eat bland foods during recovery, and avoid laxatives. Seek medical care for high fever or bloody stools. Domestic/import status remains unconfirmed.

triage.headline_ja: 手袋もせず素手でわしづかみ...黄桃缶詰の中の『細菌』どうする?
triage.triage_reason: 未確認の動画を基にした衛生リスクの一般的注意喚起であり、実際の感染事例や発生報告がなく、真正性・工場特定・流通状況も未確認のため基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、未確認動画に基づく食品衛生への注意喚起記事。工場の特定や製品の流通状況も未確認であり、具体的な健康被害の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : près de 3 000 guérisons enregistrées en six mois, selon l'OMS | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: Nearly 3,000 recoveries recorded in six months, according to the WHO | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is six months in with nearly 3,000 recoveries reported by the WHO. Transmission is slowing in some affected zones, but ongoing insecurity, population displacement, and limited access hinder response efforts, complicating contact tracing, rapid case finding, and patient care. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus commended frontline teams and urged continued community engagement, listening to affected populations, respecting communities, and improving care quality to boost survival and reduce transmission. The UN agency calls for secure humanitarian access and increased funding to sustain interventions necessary to interrupt virus circulation. Tedros reaffirmed commitment to support Congolese authorities and partners, and urged persistent actions until there are no new cases. Published date: 2026-11-16.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOによると過去6カ月で約3,000人の回復者が記録される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクであり、治安悪化・人口移動・アクセス制限により対応が困難化しており、WPRO基準で複数該当かつ社会的関心・国際支援の必要性が明確であるため。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイクに関する進捗報告記事だが、治安・アクセス問題により対応継続が困難なため経過観察からフルRRAへの移行が適当。

article.articleHeadline: 1918 - Gripe espanhola: governo responde críticas de inspetor de saúde de Corumbá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1918 - Spanish flu: government responds to criticisms by Corumbá's health inspector.
article.articleSummary: Spanish flu drives a sanitary barrier decision in Mato Grosso, Brazil. In a 16 November 1918 letter, Governor Dom Aquino Corrêa responds to Corumbá port health inspector Gastão de Oliveira, justifying a sanitary barrier at Amolar to isolate Cuiabá from contagion detected in the city. The government emphasizes urgent sanitary measures for the south while protecting the less-developed north, orders a medical post at Amolar, and mandates five-day observation of all vessels from that port, with arrivals showing illness to return due to lack of hospital facilities. Acknowledging the absence of a federal sanitary service in Cuiabá, the policy aims to reassure the populace, prevent infected individuals from entering immune populations, and maintain morale during the epidemic. Source: A Cruz (Cuiabá), 24/11/1918.

triage.headline_ja: 1918年 - スペイン風邪：政府がコルンバ港健康検査官の批判に反論
triage.triage_reason: 1918年のスペイン風邪に関する歴史的コラム記事であり、現代の公衆衛生上の脅威ではないため、トリアージ対象外とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は1918年のスペイン風邪流行時のブラジル・マトグロッソ州における歴史的出来事を振り返るコラムであり、現代の感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di RD Kongo Semakin Ganas, 5.500 Orang Tewas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo grows more deadly, 5,500 people dead.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak, more than 5,500 people have died and about 11,200 have been infected. Africa CDC warns the outbreak remains uncontrolled and could become the worst in history if not halted. Declared May 15, it has spread to eight of Congo’s 26 provinces, reaching parts of East, Central, and West Africa. Over 80% of new cases are among people not previously listed in contact tracing, and more than 65% of deaths occur in communities rather than health facilities. The Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant causing hemorrhagic fever, is implicated with an estimated 50% fatality rate. This is the second-largest and second-deadliest Ebola outbreak, behind 2014-2016 West Africa. Donor funding gaps persist; $2.9 billion pledged, only $1.3 billion disbursed. There is no Bundibugyo-specific vaccine or treatment yet, but WHO has approved two vaccine trials (including Tumaini) with results expected early 2027; about 3,000 patients have recovered.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行がさらに深刻化、死者5,500人に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%のエボラ出血熱が複数州・複数国に拡大し、制御不能で史上最悪化の恐れがあるとAfrica CDCが警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: モザンビーク・アンゴラはBluedotの地域タグに含まれるが記事サマリー上は言及がないため除外。コンゴ国内の東部・中部・西部地域への拡大が述べられている。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola: 15 nouvelles guérisons, mais la létalité reste élevée | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: 15 new recoveries, but the case-fatality rate remains high | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues across eight provinces of the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, Sud-Ubangi, Nord-Ubangi). An INSP report published 14 November shows 11,316 cumulative confirmed cases, 5,532 deaths (case fatality rate 48.9%). 1,055 patients are in isolation or hospital care; 3,069 have recovered (including 15 new recoveries). Surveillance logged 4,384 alerts across seven provinces; 28,356 contacts are followed daily, with 83.8% follow-up, still below the 95% target. Prevention activities include decontaminating 24 households, 11 health facilities, and one school in Ituri; Bas-Uélé reports four resumed control points in Viadana. Community outreach reaches: 2,156 students educated in Bunia; home visits in Nord-Kivu reached 41,741 people with prevention messages.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：新たに15人が回復、ただし致死率は依然高い水準
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で複数州にまたがるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続中で、累計11,316例・死亡5,532例（致死率48.9%）と深刻。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国国内8州（Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, Sud-Ubangi, Nord-Ubangi）にまたがる既知のエボラ流行の継続状況報告であり、他国への拡大は明示されていないが、接触者追跡率が目標値（95%）を下回るなど管理上の課題が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm A diễn biến khó lường, người khỏe mạnh cũng có thể nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A can have an unpredictable course; even healthy people can become gravely ill.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is an acute respiratory virus affecting all ages, with higher risk for children under 5, adults over 65, those with chronic conditions, and pregnant women; cases are rising in northern Vietnam. At Phu Tho General Hospital, a 55-year-old man with no prior conditions developed influenza A with fulminant pneumonia and acute respiratory failure, requiring intubation and VV-ECMO. After seven days, lung function improved, ECMO was stopped, and by day ten he was extubated and recovering. In Hanoi, a 26-year-old Bat Trang resident was diagnosed after fever up to 40°C and improved after about a week. The Thanh Nhan Hospital Infectious Diseases unit treats about 50 influenza A patients, including elderly, immunocompromised, and cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy or radiotherapy. Transmission is via droplets and close contact; warning signs include shortness of breath, cyanosis, altered consciousness, and chest pain; early care is essential to prevent ARDS.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAは予測不可能な経過をたどることがあり、健康な人でも重篤化する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム北部でインフルエンザA症例が増加し重症例も報告されているが、季節性インフルエンザの枠を超えた異常性や国際的拡大の根拠は乏しく、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの重症例報告であり、新型株や異常な病原性を示す根拠は記事中にない。国内医療機関での対応事例として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: بعد أول وفاة فى البرازيل .. تعرف علي أبرز المعلومات عن جدرى القرود وطرق الوقاية - صوت الأمة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the first death in Brazil, learn the key information about monkeypox and prevention methods - Voice of the Nation
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) is a viral infection caused by an Orthopoxvirus. It commonly causes a painful skin rash and flu-like symptoms (fever, headache, muscle pains, fatigue), though presentations vary: rash may be predominant, or flu-like symptoms can precede or occur without rash. The disease is endemic in parts of Africa but has caused outbreaks outside Africa, including the 2022 global outbreak; a first death in Brazil was reported. Complications include secondary bacterial skin infections leading to sepsis, eye infection with possible vision loss, myocarditis or pericarditis, encephalitis, pneumonia, severe breathing difficulties, and scarring. Most cases are managed with supportive care; no antiviral is routinely approved for all cases, though antivirals may be used for severe or high-risk patients. Seek medical evaluation for unusual rash with fever or swollen lymph nodes, especially after exposure; severe symptoms require urgent care. Avoid contact and sharing personal items until guidance is provided.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで初の死亡例確認後、サル痘（Mpox）に関する重要情報と予防法について
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのMpox初死亡例が言及されているが、記事は一般的なMpox解説が主体で、症例数・発生時期・感染経路など具体的な疫学情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は一般的なMpoxの疾患解説記事であり、ブラジルでの『初の死亡例』は見出しで言及されているのみで本文に詳細な症例情報がない。発生地域に含まれる'Africa'は大陸区分のため対象国リストに該当せず除外した。

article.articleHeadline: بعد أول وفاة فى البرازيل كل ما تريد معرفته عن جدرى القرود وطرق الوقاية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After Brazil's first death, everything you need to know about monkeypox and prevention methods.
article.articleSummary: As of November 16, 2026, Brazil reports its first mpox death amid a notable rise in cases. The report outlines mpox symptoms, transmission, and treatment options, underscoring the need for early recognition to prevent spread. Mpox is a viral infection that can cause a painful skin rash and flu-like symptoms such as fever, headache, muscle pains, and fatigue. The rash may include ulcers or blisters, though presentations vary; in some people, the rash is the sole symptom, or general symptoms precede skin findings. Understanding transmission routes and early signs is key to avoiding spread. Mpox is caused by a virus in the orthopoxvirus family and was formerly known as Monkeypox before adopting the name Mpox. The article highlights prevention measures alongside treatment approaches.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで初のエムポックス死亡例、サル痘(エムポックス)と予防法について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpoxによる初の死亡例が報告され、症例増加も伴うため公衆衛生上の重篤性とIHR基準の複数該当が疑われる。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおけるMpox死亡例増加を主題としており、対象国リストに含まれるブラジルのみを検証対象とした。詳細な死亡者数や感染経路は本文に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 增3宗退伍軍人病個案　包括兩宗社區感染及一宗輸入個案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three more veteran's disease cases, including two community-transmission cases and one imported case.
article.articleSummary: Three more Veteran's Disease cases were reported in Hong Kong for November 8–14, 2026, by the Centre for Health Protection. Two are locally transmitted through community spread; one is an imported case with incubation after travel to Mainland China. The local cases occurred in the Tuen Mun District and Wong Tai Sin District. The three patients are two men and one woman, aged 62–67, all with underlying chronic illnesses. Preliminary investigations indicate all cases are sporadic with no epidemiological links to previously identified Hong Kong cases. As of November 14, 2026, the year-to-date total stands at 178 Veteran's Disease cases. The report highlights ongoing sporadic activity, including an imported case, based on CHP surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 退役軍人病（レジオネラ症）新たに3件、うち地域感染2件と輸入例1件
triage.triage_reason: レジオネラ症（環境由来感染症）の散発例で、香港当局の定期サーベイランス報告の一環。疫学的関連なし、人-人感染リスクなく、異常性も低い。
triage.notes: レジオネラ症は環境（給水設備等）由来の非接触感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染は起こらない。年間178例は香港における通常の発生水準と考えられ、特段のシグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, l'Ebola ha ucciso 5.500 persone e l'agenzia sanitaria africana avverte: "È fuori controllo"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo, Ebola has killed 5,500 people, and the African health agency warns: "It's out of control".
article.articleSummary: Eastern DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) has surpassed 11,200 cases and 5,500 deaths since May 15, making it the second-largest Ebola epidemic after 2014–16 West Africa. WHO reports ongoing transmission, adding about 400–500 cases weekly; over 80% of new infections are outside contact lists and roughly 65% of deaths occur in communities far from treatment centers. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya calls it 'out of control,' citing unfulfilled donor pledges, attacks on health workers, and a government-dunderfunded response; only about 1.3 of $2.9 billion pledged has been disbursed, with ~1.6 billion yet to release. Notable violence includes the Cantine-Aloya attack in North Kivu, where 66 civilians and 3 health workers were killed, and three health facilities looted. Over 1,000 contacts have been lost; >3,000 recovered. Cases have been reported in Kenya, Uganda, and Nigeria; WHO approved two Bundibugyo vaccine trials, with results expected early 2027.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱で5,500人死亡——アフリカ保健機関「制御不能」と警告
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で11,200症例・5,500人死亡という大規模エボラ流行が継続し、週400〜500例増加、近隣国への拡散や資金不足による対応困難が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアでの症例も言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Angolaも同様に対象国外。主たる流行地はDRC東部（北キブ州）。

article.articleHeadline: Especialistas alertam para risco de reinfecção da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts warn of the risk of dengue reinfection.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces rising dengue reinfection risk as summer and Aedes aegypti activity intensify transmission. Dengue has four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4); prior infection provides lasting protection only against the same type. Antibody-Dependent Enhancement (ADE) can accelerate second infections and elevate severe dengue risk when the serotype differs. ITpS reports 374,000+ dengue cases and 371 deaths in Jan–Oct 2026; 2025 saw 35,749 severe cases or dengue with warning signs. Serotype DENV-3, once rare, rose from at least 14% of cases in 2025 to 30% in 2026, heightening concern. Qdenga vaccine is approved for 4–60-year-olds, two doses 3 months apart, available in private clinics and SUS; vaccination prioritized for 10–14-year-olds. Contraindications include pregnancy, lactation, immunosuppression. Severe dengue includes hemorrhage, plasma leakage, hypotension, organ injury; risk of death from shock. Treatment is supportive with IV fluids and hospitalization as needed; no specific antiviral.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、デング熱再感染のリスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年にデング熱の重症例・死亡者数が高水準（37万例超、371名死亡）であり、従来稀であったDENV-3血清型の急増（14%→30%）により再感染による重症化（ADE）リスクが高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル国内の保健当局（ITpS）報告に基づく季節的デング熱流行の分析記事。血清型構成の変化（DENV-3増加）が重症化リスクを高めている点が注目される。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: Grippe aviaire aux Pays-Bas : quels marchés africains dépendent le plus de la volaille néerlandaise
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza in the Netherlands: Which African markets depend most on Dutch poultry.
article.articleSummary: Morocco notified the WTO on 11 November of a suspension of imports of poultry and poultry products from the Netherlands, as highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) cases rise in the Netherlands. Outbreaks occurred in Hierden (Gelderland) on 9–11 November, a third site in Hierden on 13 November (19,000 birds), and a 60,000-bird laying farm at Oosterwolde on 15 November. The measure underscores risks to African poultry supply, though Morocco is not a major Dutch destination. Africa’s reliance is shown by five markets—Ghana, Zambia, Mozambique, DRC, and Benin—which imported about 97,000 tonnes (US$80m) in 2025; these five accounted for roughly 80,200 tonnes (≈83%). Zambia was most exposed: 14,000 of 26,000 tonnes imported from the Netherlands (≈54%). Mozambique: 11,000 of 80,000; Ghana: 43,000 of 321,000; DRC: 8,700 of 245,000; Benin: 3,500 of 114,000. Import share, not total dependence, governs exposure; substitution speed and Dutch outbreak dynamics will drive risk.

triage.headline_ja: オランダの鳥インフルエンザ：アフリカのどの市場がオランダ産鶏肉に最も依存しているか
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はオランダにおける家禽の高病原性鳥インフルエンザ発生とそれに伴うアフリカ向け鶏肉輸出・貿易制限への影響を扱う経済・貿易記事であり、ヒトへの健康被害や対象国内での疫病発生は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 実際のHPAI発生地はオランダ（対象国外）。記事はアフリカ諸国（ガーナ、ザンビア、モザンビーク、DRC、ベナン）のオランダ産鶏肉への輸入依存度を論じる貿易分析であり、これらの国での疾病発生自体は報告されていない。ヒト感染事例の言及もなし。

article.articleHeadline: Michelle Arantes alerta: demora na identificação do sarampo pode favorecer surtos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Michelle Arantes warns: Delay in identifying measles can fuel outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Measles (sarampo) outbreaks intensify in the Americas with 55,792 confirmed cases and 77 deaths from Jan 4 to Oct 3, 2026, according to OPAS. The region faces very high risk of spread in October due to ongoing outbreaks and vaccination gaps. In Brazil, through Oct 19, 61 measles cases reported across São Paulo, Amazonas, Rio de Janeiro and Acre, despite Brazil having eliminated endemic transmission as of 2024. Michelle de Oliveira Guimarães Arantes emphasizes that measles spreads where vaccination is incomplete and rapid identification is crucial; delays in detection and notification increase exposure risk and transmission chains. Challenges include reaching unvaccinated groups, accessing communities with lower coverage, and logistical barriers to complete multi-dose schedules. Digital tools (integrated notifications, lab results, immunization data) and AI can aid risk identification, but require interoperability within SUS and professional decision-making. Nurses play a central role in vaccination, surveillance, and case finding.

triage.headline_ja: ミシェル・アランテス氏の警告：麻疹の発見の遅れがアウトブレイクを助長する可能性
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルを含む米州で麻疹の症例・死亡が継続的に報告されており、地域的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への影響（死者77名）からIHR基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は主にブラジル国内（サンパウロ、アマゾナス、リオデジャネイロ、アクレ州）の麻疹症例と、米州全体（OPASデータ）の流行状況を扱う。スペイン・カナリア諸島は地名リストに含まれるが記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện Salmonella trong nhiều mẫu bánh mì gây ngộ độc ở Quảng Ngãi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Salmonella detected in multiple bread samples causing food poisoning in Quảng Ngãi.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, Salmonella spp. were detected in bread and related foods linked to a food-poisoning outbreak in Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam. The Pasteur Institute Nha Trang tested 13 food samples and 3 patient samples from 24 suspected cases in Tịnh Khê and Đông Sơn; Salmonella was found in 2 of 3 patient samples and in foods including chả bò (minced beef sausage), nước chấm, butter, sauce, and chà bông (pork floss). Bread samples (bánh mì xíu) and butter also contained Staphylococcus aureus with Staphylococcal enterotoxin; Bacillus cereus and E. coli were detected in other samples. From 3–7 November at four outlets—Mr. Bảy’s baguette stall; Mrs. Đô’s; and Mrs. Thu’s and Mrs. Hà’s shops—over 20 people were hospitalized. This year marks the third bread-related suspected poisoning in Quảng Ngãi; October saw 175 illnesses at Bà Được. Fines totaled 85.75 million VND: 750,000 for uncovered food and 85 million for poisoning.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ省で食中毒を引き起こしたパンの複数サンプルからサルモネラ菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム国内の地域的な食品由来食中毒（サルモネラ、黄色ブドウ球菌等）であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性や国際的拡大リスクはなく、既知の病原体による限定的事案のため。
triage.notes: 今年3回目のパン関連食中毒事案。地域当局による罰金措置あり。複数病原体（サルモネラ、黄色ブドウ球菌、バチルス・セレウス、大腸菌）が検出されているが、いずれも食品衛生管理の問題であり国際的な公衆衛生危機には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Dutch Bird Flu Raises Supply Risks for Five Major African Poultry Importers
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-16, Morocco suspended poultry imports from the Netherlands on Nov 11 after outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza, covering birds of all species, live birds, meat and products. Dutch outbreaks were detected in Hierden, Gelderland (Nov 9 and 11), including a 19,000-bird infection at a duck and laying-hen farm (Nov 13) and a 60,000-bird laying-hen farm in Oosterwolde (Nov 15). Five African markets—Ghana, Zambia, Mozambique, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Benin—accounted for about 97,000 tonnes of Dutch poultry meat and offal in 2025 (roughly $80 million), representing about 83% of Africa-bound Dutch shipments. Relative exposure varies: Zambia imported about 54% of its poultry from the Netherlands (14,000 of 26,000 t); Mozambique 13.8% (11,000 of 80,000 t); Ghana 13.4% (43,000 of 321,500 t); DRC 3.6% (8,700 of 245,000 t); Benin 3.1% (3,500 of 114,000 t). Ongoing outbreaks and any new trade restrictions will shape risks to these importers.

triage.headline_ja: オランダの鳥インフルエンザがアフリカの主要家禽輸入5カ国に供給リスクをもたらす
triage.triage_reason: オランダでのHPAI家禽アウトブレイクによる貿易制限が複数対象国の家禽輸入に影響しているが、ヒトへの感染や健康被害は報告されておらず、人の公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては情報不足。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽貿易・経済的影響に焦点を当てており、ヒト感染症例の報告はない。オランダの鳥インフルエンザ発生自体は対象国リストに含まれないため、記事主題国としては除外。ザンビア・ガーナ・DRCはオランダからの家禽輸入依存度が高く、貿易制限による経済的・食料供給リスクの観点から動向注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội ghi nhận 619 ca sốt xuất huyết và 20 ổ dịch mới trong 1 tuần
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi records 619 dengue cases and 20 new outbreaks in one week.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains heavy in Hanoi: 619 new cases across 101 wards/communes in the 6–13 November week, with 20 new outbreaks. Since 2026 began, Hanoi has 7,026 dengue cases in 122 wards/communes and no deaths; 279 outbreaks, 31 active. Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) recorded 118 cases in 61 wards, down 35 week-on-week; no new outbreaks. Cumulatively, HFMD stands at 6,843 cases in 126 wards, with no deaths and all 105 outbreaks ended. Other infections include four pertussis cases in four wards, two measles cases in Đại Mỗ and Yên Nghĩa (418 total in 113 wards), and two new COVID-19 cases (1,676 total in 122 wards). Hanoi CDC intensified targeted surveillance in Kim Liên, Hoà Xá, Kiều Phú and Ô Chợ Dừa, with next-week focus on several districts. Public health actions emphasize environmental sanitation, larval control, insecticide spraying, early detection, school hygiene, vaccination, and collaboration with animal health sectors.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、1週間でデング熱619例・新規流行地20カ所を記録
triage.triage_reason: ハノイにおけるデング熱の季節的流行の定期報告であり、死亡例なし・既存の対応体制内で管理されているが、症例数（週619例、累計7,026例）が多く新規流行地も発生しているため継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はハノイにおけるデング熱・HFMD・麻疹・百日咳・COVID-19の定期的なサーベイランス報告。デング熱は死亡例なしで、ベトナムの季節的流行パターンの範囲内と考えられる。Hanoi CDCによる環境衛生・幼虫駆除・殺虫剤散布などの対応が継続中で、外部支援の必要性は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Rio de Janeiro confirma primeira morte por mpox no Brasil em 2026; estado registra 382 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro confirms Brazil's first mpox death in 2026; state records 382 cases.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) outbreak in Brazil: Rio de Janeiro state reported 382 confirmed mpox cases in 2026 as of November 13, including the year's first death, a Rio de Janeiro city resident; at least 55 hospitalizations and 71.2% of state cases in the capital. Of the 382, 124 occurred January–September, with 258 identified in the following two months. Transmission is mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, secretions, bodily fluids, and contaminated objects. Symptoms include skin lesions (face, hands, feet, genitals, anus, mouth), fever, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, and lymphadenopathy. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with lesions, not sharing personal items, hand hygiene, seeking care for suspected infection, and isolation after confirmation. Brazil’s mpox vaccination exists, targeted to high‑risk groups, with two doses 28 days apart and 25,000 additional doses; national cases exceed 1,000 by November. Minas Gerais reports 45 cases; authorities urge vigilance, early diagnosis, and prevention, not panic.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州、2026年ブラジル初のmpox死亡例を確認。州内症例382件に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州でmpoxの急増（124件→258件/2ヶ月）と2026年初の死亡例が確認され、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常な増加傾向がみられるため、IHR基準を2つ以上満たしフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 全国では既に1,000例を超え、ミナスジェライス州でも45例報告があり、リオデジャネイロ州以外にも拡大している可能性がある。ワクチン接種は高リスク群に限定的に実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Kongo Belum Terkendali Menurut Africa CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo ebolavirus outbreak has not yet been contained, according to Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EBOV) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues six months after first declaration, driven by Bundibugyo lineage causing hemorrhagic fever. As of 16 November 2026, more than 11,200 cases and 5,500 deaths have been reported, with transmission in eight of 26 provinces and export cases in Nigeria, Kenya, and Uganda—the widest geographic spread. About 80% of new infections involve people not previously listed in contact tracing or health surveillance; more than 65% of deaths occur outside medical facilities. WHO has approved clinical trials of two Ebola vaccines, including Tumaini and another candidate; results expected in early 2027. UNICEF reports that children account for 35% of Ebola deaths, with under-five deaths at 21% and roughly 72% case fatality among infected children. MSF notes resource gaps, healthcare worker strikes over pay, and attacks on facilities amid conflict with rebel groups such as M23 and Allied Democratic Forces.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、コンゴのエボラ流行は依然として制御できていないと発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが6ヶ月以上継続し、11,200人以上の感染、5,500人以上の死亡、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへの越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへの越境症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでの流行が記事の主題であり継続的な注視が必要。
