article.articleHeadline: Positividade da Covid-19 chega a 21,9% no ES; veja como se proteger - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 positivity rate reaches 21.9% in Espírito Santo; see how to protect yourself - Folha Vitória
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 positivity in Espírito Santo, Brazil, rose to 21.9% in weeks 40–44 (Oct 4–Nov 7) from Lacen-ES data; 393 samples in week 44, with 86 positives. Influenza was 4.1% and RSV 1.8%. COVID-19 now dominates the trio of monitored respiratory viruses, though influenza, metapneumovirus, and rhinovirus can surge at different times. Symptoms overlap, so clinician assessment and testing are important for accurate diagnosis. The flu vaccine does not protect against COVID-19 but reduces influenza-related complications. Influenza virus mutates yearly, so vaccine composition is updated. For 2027, Anvisa approved a new Southern Hemisphere formulation: a trivalent vaccine against A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and B/Victoria; two strains were changed from the prior season. Egg-based production takes about six months. Vaccination mainly prevents severe disease, hospitalizations and deaths; emphasize timing, high-risk groups, and complementary measures (hand hygiene, masking around vulnerable individuals). Antiviral prophylaxis may be considered with prescription.

triage.headline_ja: エスピリトサント州でCOVID-19陽性率が21.9%に到達;予防方法について
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器ウイルス（COVID-19、インフルエンザ、RSV）の通常のサーベイランス報告であり、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大リスクを示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 地域の呼吸器系ウイルスサーベイランスデータに基づく一般的な健康啓発記事であり、通常の季節変動の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: variante ligada a surto na África avança no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Africa-linked outbreak variant advances in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports 1,099 confirmed mpox cases as of November 13, 2026, and its first mpox-related death of the year in Rio de Janeiro, where the patient had a preexisting condition. Health authorities intensified surveillance of Africa-linked mpox clade Ib, tied to the Democratic Republic of Congo's 2024 outbreak, now circulating in Brazil. São Paulo’s Instituto Adolfo Lutz identified clade Ib in 103 cases through November 13. While the overall rise in mpox diagnoses is not yet definitively caused by this lineage, experts urge cautious interpretation and continued monitoring. mpox symptoms include skin or mucosal lesions (potentially with blisters and crusts), fever, headache, myalgia, lymphadenopathy, chills, and fatigue; lesions may appear on face, hands, feet, genitals, or the anal region, and some cases lack fever. Transmission occurs via close contact with lesions, secretions, or contaminated objects; isolation and vaccination for defined groups (25,000 doses secured) are part of response.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox:アフリカ由来の流行株がブラジルで拡大
triage.triage_reason: クレードIbというアフリカ由来の国際的懸念株がブラジルで103例確認され、死亡例も発生していることから、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の重大性が認められる。
triage.notes: DRCはクレードIbの由来として言及されているが、記事の主題はブラジルでの流行拡大であるためverified_locationsには含めない。1,099例確認、死亡1例、クレードIbが103例で検出されている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Was Urlauber über Denguefieber wissen sollten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What tourists should know about dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus (Asian tiger mosquito), with daytime biting. Four dengue virus serotypes exist; many infections are asymptomatic, but illness typically begins 4–10 days after a bite with fever, severe headache, muscle and joint pains, nausea, and rash; most recover in 1–2 weeks, though rare cases cause bleeding or shock; reinfection increases risk of severe disease. The WHO estimates 100–400 million infections annually, and risk is highest in tropical and subtropical regions, including Southeast Asia (Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam, Philippines) and the Americas (Brazil, Mexico, Dominican Republic). Europe has had sporadic autochthonous cases; in Germany, infections are imported and local transmission is not established, though vectors are present and risk could rise with warmer months. Prevention centers on avoiding bites (DEET/picaridin/IR3535, protective clothing, nets, reducing standing water). Vaccination (Qdenga) is advised only for travelers aged 4+ with prior lab-confirmed dengue who will visit areas; two doses, 3 months apart.

triage.headline_ja: 旅行者がデング熱について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な旅行医学・デング熱の基礎知識を解説する啓発記事であり、特定の国での異常発生やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の一般的な医学情報（病原体、症状、予防、ワクチン）を旅行者向けに解説したもので、特定地域での流行急増や異常事態を報じていない。タイ・インドネシア・ベトナム・フィリピン・ブラジル等はリスク地域の例示として挙げられているに過ぎず、具体的な発生状況の記述がないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: "Es fällt im Moment allen schwer, die Lage einzuschätzen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: "Right now, it's difficult for everyone to gauge the situation."
article.articleSummary: An interview on the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak centers on Ituri and North Kivu, with Goma at the epicenter. In about five and a half months the outbreak has cost over 5,000 lives. Transmission is driven by mild early symptoms that mimic malaria, keeping patients infectious as they interact with teachers, drivers, traders, and clergy. Traditional caregiving and funerals—where the deceased are washed, combed, and touched—fuel spread, despite knowledge of protective measures. A colleague recounts 46 relatives dying in his family; his daughter survived but his brother did not. The response is criticized as “Ebola business,” with rapid foreign teams and booming isolation centers seeding distrust in a region ravaged by conflict, displacement, and poverty. Rwanda shut and then reopened its border; strict contact tracing and quarantines are emphasized to curb cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：「今は誰もが状況を把握するのが難しい」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部（イトゥリ・北キブ）で5か月半に5,000人超が死亡する大規模エボラ流行であり、マラリアに似た軽症期の存在やヒト-ヒト感染、国境を越えた拡大懸念（ルワンダの国境閉鎖）があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツ語メディアのインタビュー形式で、ルワンダの国境閉鎖・再開にも言及があるが、ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。発生の主体はDRC東部（イトゥリ・北キブ、ゴマ）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 5 471 décès, le bilan le plus lourd des 17 épidémies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 5,471 deaths, the heaviest toll among the 17 outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the 17th and deadliest in the country, with 5,471 deaths among 11,197 cases since it was declared on May 15, 2026. As of 16 November 2026, authorities report a record toll surpassing earlier outbreaks; a prior August 1 flare reached 1,117 cases and 702 deaths by April 4, with 295 suspects still under investigation. Symptoms include sudden fever, extreme weakness, and muscle pains, potentially followed by internal or external bleeding; case fatality can reach 90% depending on the strain. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected or deceased individuals. The response is pressured in a country of over 100 million people, with medical teams and international partners intensifying field efforts. Africa CDC had placed ten neighboring or nearby countries on alert, including South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Congo, Burundi, Angola, Central African Republic, and Zambia.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：死者5,471人、17回の流行史上最悪の被害
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模（死者5,471人、致死率約49%）のエボラ流行が継続中であり、Africa CDCが近隣10カ国に警戒を発令するなど国際的拡大リスクが高く、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内の第17次エボラ流行が過去最多の死者数（5,471人/11,197症例）に達したことを報告。Africa CDCが南スーダン、ルワンダ、ケニア、タンザニア、エチオピア、コンゴ共和国、ブルンジ、アンゴラ、中央アフリカ共和国、ザンビアの10カ国に警戒を発令しているが、これらは『発生国』ではなく『警戒対象国』であるため verified_locations には含めていない。ザンビア等での実際の症例発生は記事中で確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola toujours hors de contrôle après six mois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the Ebola outbreak still out of control after six months.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, remains out of control six months after the May 15, 2026 declaration. As of November 15, 2026, authorities report over 11,200 cases and more than 5,500 deaths. More than 80% of new infections occur outside known contact lists, and over 65% of deaths happen in communities, underscoring weak surveillance and early care. The eastern provinces are hardest hit, with armed violence hindering access; a Cantine-Aloya attack in North Kivu killed 66 civilians, including three health workers, and more than 1,000 contacts have been lost to follow-up. MSF cites staff shortages, ambulances lacking fuel, and insufficient epidemiological teams; funding commitments have not fully materialized. International pledges total about $2.9 billion, but about $1.6 billion remains unallocated. The outbreak has spread to eight provinces and to Kenya and Nigeria, raising regional concerns. WHO notes vaccine/therapy trials with results expected in 2027; no approved options yet for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ出血熱の流行、発生から6カ月経っても制御不能な状態が続く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大）に該当し、死亡者5,500人超・8州拡大・国境を越えた波及が確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大にも言及しているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。資金不足（約16億ドル未配分）、武装勢力による医療アクセス阻害、承認済みワクチン・治療薬の不在など、制御困難な要因が多数報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: ठाण्यात रविवारी पल्स पोलिओ मोहीम
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pulse Polio Campaign in Thane on Sunday
article.articleSummary: Polio immunization campaign under the Pulse Polio program is being conducted in Thane, Maharashtra, by the Thane Municipal Corporation's Public Health Department. On Sunday, 22 November 2026, free Pulse Polio vaccine doses will be offered at vaccination centers across the Thane Municipal Corporation area to ensure no child under five is left unvaccinated. From 23 to 27 November, health workers and volunteers will conduct door-to-door visits to immunize children who did not attend centers. The initiative, in operation in India since 1995, aims to maintain protection against poliovirus even as the country has largely controlled the disease; importation risk persists from other countries. Mayor Sharmila Pimolkar and Commissioner Saurabh Rao urged parents to vaccinate their children. Dr. Prasad Patil, Medical Health Officer, emphasized free vaccination at municipal health centers and active public participation.

triage.headline_ja: ターネーで日曜日にパルスポリオキャンペーン実施
triage.triage_reason: これは通常の予防接種キャンペーンの告知記事であり、新規症例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的なポリオ予防接種プログラム（Pulse Polio）の実施案内であり、実際の感染症例の発生を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : survivant du virus, ce médecin a repris son activité auprès des patients
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: a virus survivor, this doctor has resumed his practice with patients.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak persists in Butembo, North Kivu, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; about 11,000 infections and 5,400 deaths, making it the second-deadliest on record, with 3,031 survivors. Dr. Raymond Kasereka Kamwanga, a 30-year-old physician at Katwa Hospital in Butembo, survived after a 13-day inpatient course of supportive care for dehydration and organ stress. He likely contracted the virus from a patient where protective measures were inadequate. Early symptoms included a bitter taste, headaches, and malaise, progressing to vomiting and diarrhea; diagnosis was delayed because Butembo lacks rapid testing, with samples sent 54 km to Beni, taking 48–72 hours. After recovery, stigma persisted; his family kept distance for 21 days (the incubation period). He has written a book and returned to work, hoping to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ウイルス生存者であるこの医師は、患者の診療を再開した
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ブテンボで継続中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）流行は約11,000人感染・5,400人死亡と史上2番目の規模で、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクを伴うためIHR基準に複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は生存した医師の個人的体験を中心に描いているが、背景として大規模かつ継続中のエボラ流行（死者5,400人、史上2番目の規模）が言及されており、公衆衛生上のインパクトは非常に大きい。診断検査能力不足（検体を54km離れたベニへ送付、48-72時間要する）など対応能力の課題も示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil tem primeira morte por Mpox confirmada no Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil has its first Mpox death confirmed in Rio de Janeiro
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports its first mpox (Monkeypox) death, confirmed in Rio de Janeiro last week, as the state records 390 cases—the highest in the country. Nationwide, 1,023 infections have been reported, with 581 more under investigation as of November 12, 2026. São Paulo follows with 388 cases; other states include Ceará (61), Minas Gerais (45), Distrito Federal (41), Santa Catarina (24), Rondônia (20), Paraná (16), and Pernambuco (13); remaining states have fewer than 10. The predominant patient profile is men aged 30–39. Vaccination efforts by the Unified Health System (SUS) are expected to be reinforced, targeting high-risk groups: contacts of suspected or confirmed cases; people living with HIV with severe immunosuppression; and laboratory workers handling the virus. The report underscores ongoing mpox transmission across multiple states and Brazil’s first mortality from mpox.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、リオデジャネイロで国内初のMpox死亡例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで初のMpox死亡例が確認され、全国で1,023例（複数州に拡大）、390例が集中するリオデジャネイロ州など、重症度・拡大性の両面でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: HIV感染者など免疫抑制患者を含む高リスク群へのワクチン接種強化がSUSにより計画されている。国際的拡大の明確な記述はないが、国内複数州での継続的な感染拡大と初の死亡例という点で重大性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Milenge District Records Decline In Malaria Cases
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Milenge district, Zambia, declined from over 13,200 cases in the second quarter of 2026 to about 7,700 in the third quarter of 2026. District Health Director Chiluba Yamba attributed the drop to intensified prevention, including intermittent preventive treatment in pregnancy (monthly preventive antimalarial drugs during antenatal care) and continued distribution of insecticide-treated nets (ITNs). Preparations for a subsequent mass ITN distribution are underway, with health personnel and community volunteers undergoing training on net use and longevity. Trainers emphasized proper use to counter misuse, such as nets being used for fishing. Ongoing community education and engagement by health workers and volunteers aim to sustain malaria prevention across the district.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア:ミレンゲ郡でマラリア症例が減少
triage.triage_reason: マラリア症例は減少傾向にあり、異常性・深刻性・国際的拡大リスクは認められないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 症例数が減少し予防対策が奏功している良好な事例であり、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: prevenção à dengue em Descoberto - Jornal Panorama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Prevention in Descoberto - Panorama Newspaper
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, in Descoberto, the Municipal Health Secretariat’s Arboviruses Committee discussed dengue and other arboviruses in the context of climate change and the El Niño phenomenon. The meeting focused on forecasts of new dengue cases, prevention strategies, and strengthening control of Aedes aegypti to curb transmission. It emphasized enhancing health surveillance to prepare for potential case surges and to monitor climatic factors impacting mosquito proliferation. Community involvement is essential; residents were urged to remove standing water and keep environments clean to reduce breeding sites. The briefing did not provide case counts or laboratory-confirmed data. The initiative aims to anticipate responses, bolster surveillance, and ready the municipality for possible increases in dengue and arbovirus activity.

triage.headline_ja: デスコベルトにおけるデング熱予防対策 - パノラマ新聞
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例数や異常な増加の報告はなく、通常の予防啓発会議に関する内容であり、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体の予防会議報告であり、症例数・検査確認データは提供されていない。ブラジルのゴイアス州デスコベルトが舞台だが、具体的な感染拡大の兆候はないため対象国リストには該当するが、内容的にシグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Death Toll in DR Congo Reaches 5,568 - Health Institute
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains a major health burden in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The National Institute of Public Health (INSP) reported on 16 November 2026 that the outbreak has reached 11,376 confirmed infections and 5,568 deaths since it began in the country. INSP said that in the most recent 24 hours, 60 new cases and 36 deaths were recorded, underscoring sustained transmission. The figures reflect an ongoing outbreak within the DRC, with no regional breakdown or laboratory confirmation details provided in the excerpt. The report is attributed to INSP and carried by RIA Novosti from Moscow, illustrating continued international attention to the epidemic. No information on infection source or exported/imported cases is included in the item.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数5,568人に到達 - 保健研究所発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が11,376例・死亡5,568人（致死率約49%）に達し、直近24時間でも60新規感染・36死亡を記録するなど持続的な感染拡大が続いている。IHR基準2つ以上に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にMoscow/Russian Federationが含まれているが、これは報道元（RIA Novosti）の所在地であり、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。記事に地域別内訳や感染源・輸出入症例の情報はなし。累計症例数・死亡数が非常に大きく、過去のエボラ流行と比較しても深刻度が高い可能性があるため、詳細な経過（流行株、地理的拡大範囲、対応状況）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Број умрлих од еболе достигао 5.568
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola reached 5,568.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 5,568, with 11,376 cases reported by the National Institute of Public Health. In the last 24 hours, 60 new infections and 36 deaths were recorded. Jean Kaseya, director of the African Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, told Reuters the outbreak remains uncontrolled more than six months after it was declared, citing attacks on health workers, unpaid staff, and persistent resource shortages. The epidemic began in April. There is currently no licensed vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain spreading. The report underscores ongoing transmission and containment challenges.

triage.headline_ja: エボラによる死者数が5,568人に達した
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）による死者・感染者が増加を続け、6ヶ月以上制御不能な状態であり、ワクチン・治療法も存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による流行で、医療従事者への攻撃や資源不足により制御が困難な状況が継続している。アフリカCDC所長も制御不能と発言しており、国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana: surtos são registrados em 11 municípios de Minas Gerais em 2026; veja sintomas e como se prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human scabies: outbreaks recorded in 11 municipalities in Minas Gerais in 2026; see symptoms and how to prevent.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil, reported human scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) outbreaks across 11 municipalities in 2026: Alfenas, Andradas, Belo Horizonte, Campos Gerais, Coronel Xavier Chaves, Itapecerica, Joaquim Felício, Lagoa Santa, Lavras, Paraguaçu, and São Gonçalo do Pará. No statewide case total is available because scabies is not a notifiable disease. Transmission is mainly through direct, prolonged skin-to-skin contact; sharing contaminated clothing, towels, or bed linens can also spread it, though less commonly. Symptoms include intense itching (worse at night), small bumps or red elevations, irritation, and skin lesions such as sores or crusts, often on hands, wrists, arms, and torso. Prevention includes washing fabrics at hot temperatures, avoiding sharing personal items, cleaning environments, and sealing non-washable items in plastic for at least three days. Treatment exists under health professional guidance, and close contacts should be evaluated to interrupt transmission. Not related to hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: ヒト疥癬：2026年にミナスジェライス州の11自治体で発生が記録される；症状と予防法について
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は一般的に軽症で致死性が低く、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもないため、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は届出義務疾患ではなく、州全体の症例数データもない。衛生状態とは無関係な皮膚接触感染症であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: تطورات علاج السمنة وأوبئة إيبولا والحصبة 2026 في هذه المرحلة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Developments in obesity treatment and Ebola and measles outbreaks in 2026 at this stage.
article.articleSummary: Obesity therapies: Lilly disclosed Phase 2 data for an experimental obesity regimen combining Eloralintatide and Tirzepatide (full results not yet published) at ObesityWeek 2026. Novo Nordisk real-world data show patients taking the daily Wegovy achieving an average 6.2% weight loss over three months, signaling ongoing competition in oral obesity treatments. Outbreaks: Africa CDC says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled after six months, hampered by attacks on health workers, unpaid salaries, and resource shortages. In the United States, measles persists in Pennsylvania, with 1,542 cases across 46 counties and 305 hospitalizations; seven deaths this year occurred in an unvaccinated Montour County resident. The Wall Street Journal notes the US no longer meets measles elimination status due to ongoing transmission. Pharma policy: CVS Health suggests GLP-1 inhibitors priced under $350/month could enable insurer breakeven, though current prices remain high. FDA declined approval for Ivonisumab from Samat Therapeutics for lung cancer. In China, Pfizer and Innovent Biologics GLP-1s will be covered by national health insurance for type 2 diabetes from Jan 1, boosting competition in diabetes and obesity markets.

triage.headline_ja: 肥満治療の進展とエボラ・麻疹の流行、2026年現時点の状況
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が6か月間制御不能で、医療従事者への攻撃や資源不足が継続しており、WPRO基準の複数（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に該当し国際支援の必要性も示唆されている。
triage.notes: 記事は肥満治療薬の市場動向を中心とした総合記事で、エボラ（DRC）と麻疹（米国ペンシルベニア州）の流行状況も併記。対象国リストに含まれる発生地はDRCのみで、米国・中国は対象外（中国は糖尿病薬の保険適用の話で感染症発生ではない）。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya Pontianak: Warga Diimbau Cegah Nyamuk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya in Pontianak: Residents Urged to Prevent Mosquitoes.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya threat in Pontianak, Kalimantan Barat, Indonesia during the rainy season drives government and community actions. Mayor Edi Rusdi Kamtono calls for intensified mosquito breeding-site elimination (PSN) at the neighborhood level, heightened environmental cleanliness, and awareness. Standing water, water storage containers, and discarded items that collect rainwater are highlighted as potential breeding sites. Prevention relies on active community effort alongside government; if an outbreak is detected, actions will be coordinated with the provincial government and related agencies. The Pontianak Health Department will conduct field inspections to assess conditions and determine prevention and response steps. Residents are urged to protect themselves from bites with insect repellent or mosquito-control spray as needed. The aim is early containment of chikungunya through combined government-community action.

triage.headline_ja: ポンティアナックのチクングニア熱：住民に蚊対策を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 雨季における蚊媒介性のチクングニア熱リスクに対する予防的注意喚起であり、実際の集団発生報告はまだ確認されていないため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事は予防喚起の段階であり、実際の感染者数や重症度に関する情報は記載されていない。地方自治体（市・保健局）レベルでの対応であり、国際支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo sigue "fuera de control": autoridades sanitarias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains "out of control": health authorities.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control, according to Africa CDC officials. Six months after the emergency was declared, more than 80% of new infections are occurring outside the official surveillance lists. A substantial share of deaths is occurring in communities distant from medical centers, reflecting critical failures in surveillance and containment. Humanitarian organizations and agency leaders have issued an urgent appeal to international donors to accelerate the release of pledged funds. They warned that ongoing armed violence in the region and insufficient on-the-ground resources threaten to worsen the epidemiological crisis. The officials emphasized that the situation requires immediate and sustained international support to bolster frontline health systems and surveillance networks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、依然として「制御不能」：保健当局
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の制御不能な流行が継続しており、サーベイランス機能不全と国際支援の緊急要請があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要と判断。
triage.notes: 武力紛争地域での感染拡大と資金不足が指摘されており、サーベイランス体制の崩壊が懸念される。フルリスク評価にて詳細な感染者数・致死率等の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en la RDC: preocupación por magnitud del brote y la financiación de la respuesta - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Concern over the Magnitude of the Outbreak and the Funding for the Response - teleSUR
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain is the deadliest of the country’s 17 outbreaks. Africa CDC warns it could become a continental emergency if response actions are not strengthened. Six months after the official declaration, Ituri province remains a major transmission hub. As of November 13, the National Institute of Public Health in the DRC reports 11,254 cases and 5,505 deaths (case fatality 48.9%), with 1,538 in isolation and 3,054 recovered. The outbreak has claimed at least 74 health workers. Delays in international funding threaten containment, with officials urging quicker, sustained support. By contrast, Kenya contained the epidemic through risk management and surveillance, recording 9 confirmed cases and 2 deaths but avoiding escalation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱:流行の規模と対応資金への懸念 - teleSUR
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が17回の流行中最悪の致死率48.9%、11,254症例・5,505死亡、医療従事者74人死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、Africa CDCが大陸規模の緊急事態化を警告しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ケニアは9例・2死亡と記載されているが、流行の主体はDRCであり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Africa全体は大陸カテゴリであり対象国リストに非該当のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: مركز السيطرة على الأمراض الافريقي: إيبولا لا يزال خارج السيطرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC: Ebola remains out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control after six months since the May 15 declaration. Government data report over 11,200 infections and more than 5,500 deaths. More than 80% of new cases occur outside contact-tracing lists, and over 65% of deaths happen in communities outside health facilities, with the virus more transmissible in late stages. The outbreak is caused by a rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, the second-largest Ebola outbreak after West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis ( >28,600 cases, >11,000 deaths). International aid continues but often does not reach hot zones; shortages include trained staff, fuel-starved ambulances, and gaps in surveillance. Donor coordination remains problematic, with about $2.9 billion pledged and roughly $1.6 billion urged for release; some health workers have gone months without pay as payroll digitization proceeds.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ疾病対策センター：エボラ出血熱は依然として制御不能
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で11,200人超の感染・5,500人超の死亡を記録する大規模エボラ流行が制御不能な状況にあり、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルリスク評価に進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCでの流行のみを主題としておりAngolaへの言及はないため除外した。西アフリカ2014-2016年危機（>28,600例、>11,000死亡）に次ぐ史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行で、希少なBundibugyo株が原因。資金調達・人員不足等の管理上の課題も深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Keralam brings out India's first 'epidemic calendar' with monthly disease risks: How to get it
article.articleSummary: India's first epidemic calendar, released by Kerala's health department, details month-by-month infectious disease risks, symptoms, transmission modes and preventive measures for public awareness, surveillance, and advisories. As of 16 November 2026 in Kerala, November carries moderate-to-high risk due to intermittent rains and waterlogging, with dengue, leptospirosis, scrub typhus and diarrhoeal diseases highlighted as concerns. The calendar covers Nipah virus, Japanese Encephalitis, Hepatitis A and E, West Nile fever, Dengue fever, Chickenpox, Influenza, Scrub typhus, Diarrhoeal disease, Leptospirosis, and Amoebic meningoencephalitis. Access is via the Directorate of Health Services website; content is provided in Malayalam with disease names, preventive actions and warnings. Users can download, save to Google Drive, or print the calendar, which aims to aid early detection and preventive practices for residents and health officials.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州、月別疾病リスクを示すインド初の「流行病カレンダー」を発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はケララ州保健局による啓発ツール（疫病カレンダー）の発表に関するもので、具体的な感染症の発生・アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の感染症のアウトブレイクではなく、ケララ州保健局が公表した予防啓発用の月別疾病リスクカレンダーに関する報道。具体的な症例数や発生状況の記載はないため、シグナルとしては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Secretária descarta medidas emergenciais devido aumento de casos de covid e recomenda vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Secretary rules out emergency measures due to the rise in COVID-19 cases and recommends vaccination.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Cuiabá, Brazil: The municipal Health Secretary Deisi Bocalon reports an uptick in COVID-19-related consultations, but all cases are mild and no emergency measures are warranted as of Friday, November 13, 2026. Many patients with the disease have incomplete vaccination or have not updated their immunization since the pandemic, with some having only one or two doses. Officials emphasize vaccination as a key tool to reduce complications, hospitalizations, and deaths, and urge residents to visit Family Health Units (USFs) to assess and update their vaccine schedule per Ministério da Saúde guidelines. The remarks came during the handover of renovations at UPA Verdão, which received about R$1.6 million; improvements included roof repairs, leak fixes, interior upgrades, and lighting. Future investments will prioritize UPA Pedra 90, then Morada do Ouro, per the execution plan.

triage.headline_ja: 当局、COVID-19症例増加にもかかわらず緊急措置は見送り、ワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: 軽症例の増加のみで緊急対応は不要とされており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず、社会的関心も限定的なルーティン報道である。
triage.notes: 地方自治体担当者が軽症例の増加とワクチン未接種者の多さを指摘したルーティンな保健広報記事であり、緊急性・異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Drinking Water: West Africa's Quiet Emergency
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreaks span six West and Central African countries, with Nigeria reporting over 50,000 cases and 338 deaths since 1 January 2026, driven by flooding that contaminates water sources and damages sanitation. Safe drinking water remains scarce: only 24% of sub-Saharan people have safely managed water; over 400 million West and Central Africans lack safe water. In the Sahel, less than a third of rural residents have a resilient water service; Niger 2024 figures: 47% lacking basic drinking water, 84% lacking basic sanitation, 79% with no handwashing facility at home. Coastal pollution from illegal mining in Ghana threatens rivers; in Liberia, Monrovia’s Slipway residents rely on sachet water and untreated wells. Afrobarometer reports water as a top concern in Guinea and Benin (low public confidence). Calls for at least $440B/year in blended finance; priorities: protect catchments, maintain rural water points, cross-border cholera surveillance, fair tariffs.

triage.headline_ja: 飲料水:西アフリカの静かな緊急事態
triage.triage_reason: 西・中央アフリカ6カ国でコレラが流行し、ナイジェリアだけで5万人超の症例・338人の死亡が報告されており、国境を越えた拡大とIHR基準2項目該当が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は西・中央アフリカの水資源危機とコレラ流行の関連を扱っており、ナイジェリア（対象国外）の症例データが最も具体的。ガーナは沿岸汚染・違法採掘による水源汚染の文脈で言及されているが、記事冒頭の『6カ国でコレラ流行』に含まれる可能性が高いため暫定的に含めた。渡航・貿易制限や社会的関心度についての明確な記述は本文になく不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Morte confirmada e alta de casos; os números da mpox no Rio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed death and rising mpox cases in Rio
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro, mpox, reports Brazil's first mpox death in 2026, confirmed by SES-RJ on 13 November. By 13 November, 382 laboratory-confirmed infections had been recorded in the state, including 258 cases from 13 September to 13 November (about two-thirds of the annual total). The capital, Rio de Janeiro city, accounts for 71.2% of cases; at least 55 patients have been hospitalized. The deceased was a Rio resident with a preexisting immunosuppressive condition. Vaccination efforts include more than 2,000 doses allocated to Rio in early November, prioritizing people with HIV/AIDS and immunosuppressed individuals, and direct contacts of suspected or confirmed cases; the two-dose schedule has a 28-day interval. An additional 25,000 doses were acquired on 8 November to bolster stock. Transmission is via direct contact with lesions, mucous membranes, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects; symptoms include fever, headache, myalgia, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions, including genital/anal regions. Seek medical care and avoid close contact pending evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: リオでのmpox死亡確認と症例急増
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州で2026年初のmpox死亡例が確認され、直近2ヶ月で年間症例の約3分の2が発生するなど急増傾向にあり、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性に該当するためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 死亡例は免疫抑制基礎疾患を有する患者。HIV/AIDS患者や免疫抑制者を優先したワクチン接種（2回接種、28日間隔）が実施中。症例の71.2%がリオデジャネイロ市に集中している点も注目すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Paraná confirma 14 casos de mpox em 2026; saiba como se prevenir após Brasil registrar primeira morte pela doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná confirms 14 mpox cases in 2026; learn how to protect yourself after Brazil records its first death from the disease.
article.articleSummary: Paraná reports 14 mpox cases in 2026 as of November 16, with no deaths, while Brazil surpasses 1,000 total cases and records its first mpox death in Rio de Janeiro. National totals reach 1,055 cases in 2026 (up from 995 in 2025), with October accounting for 295 diagnoses and the first half of November for 245. Paraná’s cases are distributed: Curitiba 5, Londrina 3, Foz do Iguaçu 2, Araucária, Ivaiporã, Marialva, Maringá 1 each; two probable and eight suspected. No Paraná variant data; Rio de Janeiro reports Ib lineage in 43 of 62 patients studied. The Health Ministry has purchased 25,000 mpox vaccine doses (delivery in ~3 weeks); SUS offers vaccination to those 18+, two doses 28 days apart. Guidance: avoid contact with cases, do not share personal items, and seek care for skin lesions with fever or lymphadenopathy.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州、2026年のmpox症例14件を確認；ブラジルで初の死亡例を受け予防法を解説
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年にmpox症例が1,000例を超え初の死亡例が発生し、一部患者でClade Ib系統が検出されるなど、重症度・異常性の両面でIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内（パラナ州・リオデジャネイロ州）でのmpox症例増加と初の死亡例、Clade Ib系統の検出が報告されている。保健省はワクチン2.5万回分を購入し対応中。対象国リストにはブラジルのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Import of poultry meat and products from areas in India, UK and Japan suspended
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong’s Centre for Food Safety suspended imports of poultry meat and products (including poultry eggs) from areas with WOAH-reported outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza: India (Andhra Pradesh—Anantapur District), United Kingdom (Norfolk County; East Riding of Yorkshire District; Wyre District and nearby Lancaster, Fylde, and Preston Districts), and Japan (Chiba Prefecture). The action follows WOAH notifications of highly pathogenic H5N1 in India and the UK, and a Japan outbreak of highly pathogenic H5 avian influenza, with immediate effect to protect public health. Hong Kong has a protocol with India for poultry eggs but not meat; in the first nine months, HK imported about 680 tonnes of chilled/frozen poultry meat and 220,000 eggs from the UK, and about 1,030 tonnes of frozen poultry meat and 249.94 million eggs from Japan. The CFS will monitor developments and coordinate with authorities for further action.

triage.headline_ja: インド・英国・日本の一部地域からの家禽肉・製品の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザ(H5N1/H5)の家禽アウトブレイクに伴う貿易停止措置の記事であり、ヒトへの感染例は報告されていない。動物衛生イベントとして継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽における高病原性鳥インフルエンザ(H5N1/H5)アウトブレイクを受けた香港の輸入停止措置に関するもの。インド(アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州)、英国、日本が発生地域だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはインドのみ。ヒト感染例の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の直接的な深刻性は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarna humana em escolas de Varginha chegam a 55 registros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human scabies cases in Varginha schools reach 55
article.articleSummary: 55 human scabies cases in seven Varginha, Minas Gerais, schools as of November 13, 2026, per SEMUS. This follows an earlier count of 24 cases up to November 10, with an increase of 31 due to expanded case finding and evaluation of contacts. To curb transmission, the health secretary intensified integrated surveillance and school-based care, including pediatric medical evaluations of contacts with parental accompaniment, and on-site dispensing of medications by a pharmacist after prescription. Daily monitoring, epidemiological linkage investigations, family follow-up, school sanitation inspections, and guidance on cleaning environments and shared objects are ongoing. Scabies is caused by a parasitic mite transmitted mainly by prolonged direct skin contact; symptoms include intense itching and reddish skin lesions. Families are advised to seek health units, avoid self-medication, and treat close contacts simultaneously, with washing of clothes, towels, and bedding. Itching may persist 2-4 weeks post-treatment; new lesions require re-evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァルジーニャの学校における疥癬症例が55件に達する
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は致死性・重篤性の低い皮膚寄生虫症であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもなく、地域的な学校集団感染に留まるため、現時点でのピックアップは不要。
triage.notes: 地域保健当局（SEMUS）により学校単位での積極的サーベイランスと対応が行われており、国内の地方自治体レベルで管理可能な事案。

article.articleHeadline: Rotis made of expired atta: Man wins Rs 20,000 from store after stomach infection
article.articleSummary: Punjab Consumer Commission, Ludhiana, ruled on November 3, 2026, that a supermarket chain must compensate a Ludhiana resident after he fell ill with abdominal pain and a stomach infection from chapatis made with expired Whole Wheat Chakki Atta purchased from the chain. The complainant bought two 10 kg bags for Rs 682 on May 22; authorities found the atta expired on May 10 and the store did not remove it from the shelf. The Commission deemed the store deficient in service and engaging in unfair trade practice for selling expired, hazardous goods. It ordered the store to refund Rs 341 for one bag of expired atta per invoice, plus Rs 20,000 as composite costs, and pay interest at 8% per annum from the invoice date, within 30 days. The store did not appear; the matter proceeded ex parte. Takeaway: safety standards and consumer protection apply to hazardous goods.

triage.headline_ja: 期限切れの小麦粉で作ったロティ:男性が腹部感染症で店から2万ルピーの賠償を勝ち取る
triage.triage_reason: 単発の消費者トラブル・個人の食中毒事例であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や感染症アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は消費者裁判の判決に関する法律ニュースであり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。単一個人の食中毒事例。

article.articleHeadline: مركز مكافحة الأمراض الأفريقي يحذر من استمرار تفشي إيبولا خارج السيطرة في الكونغو - وكالة ستيب نيوز
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC warns that the Ebola outbreak remains out of control in the Congo - Step News Agency
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains out of control six months after its May 15 declaration, per Africa CDC. Since the declaration, government data report roughly 11,200 infections and 5,500 deaths. More than 80% of new cases occur outside contact tracing lists, and over 65% of deaths happen in communities outside health facilities; the virus is more contagious in late disease stages. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, described as rare, and is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (about 28,600 cases; 11,000 deaths). MSF warns aid has not reached hotspots, with shortages of trained staff, surveillance teams, and fuel for ambulances. Donors pledged about $2.9 billion, but coordination remains a problem; authorities are urged to release about $1.6 billion and to work with Kinshasa to avoid duplication. Some health workers have not received salaries for months; payroll is being digitized.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが制御不能な状態が続いていると警告 - ステップ・ニュース通信
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが宣言から6カ月経過しても制御不能であり、史上2番目の規模（感染11,200件、死亡5,500件）に達している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際支援の必要性も明確。
triage.notes: 記事はアラビア語媒体によるものだが、内容はAfrica CDCおよびMSFの発表に基づくDRCでのエボラ（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）アウトブレイクに関するもの。資金・人員不足、感染拡大の持続が報告されており、既知の大規模イベントとしてフルリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox avança no Rio, em São Paulo, no Ceará e no DF; veja quem pode tomar a vacina pelo SUS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox advances in Rio de Janeiro, in São Paulo, in Ceará and in the Federal District; see who can get the vaccine through the SUS.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Brazil reached 832 confirmed cases and one death as of November 6, 2026, with transmission focused in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Ceará, and the Federal District. Brazil purchased 25,000 doses via PAHO; delivery within three weeks is planned, and 3,650 doses have already been sent to nine states including Rio de Janeiro, Ceará, and the DF. SUS vaccination targets adults 18+ meeting official criteria, given as two doses 28 days apart. Because of limited supply, an intradermal 0.1 mL dose is recommended to extend reach for PrEP users, laboratory personnel, and people living with HIV/AIDS with CD4 counts below 200 (prioritizing under 100). Individuals with advanced immunosuppression receive 0.5 mL subcutaneous doses. Vaccination sites are Centros de Referência de Imunização, not Basic Health Units; schedules are set by states and municipalities. Transmission is mainly via contact with infected individuals; symptoms include skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, chills, and weakness.

triage.headline_ja: Mpoxがリオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ、セアラ、連邦直轄区で拡大；SUSでワクチン接種可能な対象者
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で832例・死亡1例と拡大傾向にあるが、既存のMpox流行への対応（ワクチン供給等）の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の新規性は認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 既知のMpox流行（Clade I/II混在の可能性あり）の継続拡大に関する報道。ワクチン接種体制の整備状況が中心で、新規性・異常性は低いが、HIV陽性者等ハイリスク層への感染拡大リスクは継続的に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Multiple Brain Abscesses in Immunocompetent Children Linked to
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus intermedius is a primary pathogen in pediatric brain abscesses, including among immunocompetent children. A 7-year-old boy in China presented with multiple brain abscesses and no prior health issues. A systematic PubMed review identified 42 additional pediatric cases of S. intermedius–associated brain abscesses described in English and French literature, with a male predominance. Importantly, these infections can occur without chronic illness or traditional predisposing factors. Clinicians should maintain vigilance for neurological symptoms in otherwise healthy children to enable rapid diagnosis, timely laboratory confirmation, and comprehensive treatment. The report, published in Frontiers in Pediatrics on 2026-11-16, underscores early recognition and management to improve prognosis in pediatric intracranial infections caused by S. intermedius.

triage.headline_ja: 免疫能正常な小児における複数脳膿瘍、Streptococcus intermediusとの関連
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告および文献レビューであり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。ヒト-ヒト感染性や流行性も認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は臨床症例報告・文献レビューであり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。中国の1症例は孤発例であり地域的な感染拡大の兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: Rio de Janeiro confirma a primeira morte por mpox registrada no Brasil em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro confirms the first mpox death recorded in Brazil in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro state confirms the first mpox death in Brazil in 2026. The victim resided in the capital; no further identity or clinical history was disclosed. MPXV infection causes skin and mucosal lesions with fever, headache and body pains. State Health Secretariat data through November 13 show a sharp transmission upsurge: 382 confirmed cases this year, including 124 from January 1–September 12 and 258 since mid-September. The positivity rate among notified cases rose from 23.6% to 49.5%. The city of Rio de Janeiro accounts for 71.2% of the state's infections; median patient age is 33.8 years; at least 55 hospitalizations have occurred. On November 8, the Ministry of Health ordered 25,000 new mpox vaccine doses, arriving within three weeks. In Rio, over 2,000 doses are available in two 28-day steps, targeted to priority groups: people living with HIV/AIDS with immunosuppression, lab workers handling the virus, and direct medium/high-risk contacts.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州、2026年ブラジル初のmpox死亡例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 2026年ブラジル国内初のmpox死亡例に加え、陽性率が23.6%→49.5%へ急上昇し症例数も急増（382例、入院55件）しており、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性の両方に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 死亡例の詳細な臨床経過や国際的な感染拡大の有無については情報不足。ワクチン追加調達（25,000回分）や優先接種対象（HIV感染者等）の設定から当局の積極的対応が確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया के बढ़ते प्रकोप से जमजुई में चिंता, 20 से अधिक लोग पीड़ित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern in Jamjui over increasing malaria outbreak; more than 20 people affected.
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreak in Jamjui village, Noamundi block of West Singhbhum district, has infected over 20 residents as of 16 November 2026. Tribal groups Adivasi Ho Samaj Yuva Mahasabha and National Adivasi Revival Association organized an awareness meeting to educate villagers on malaria symptoms, transmission, prevention, and prompt treatment. They urged residents to prevent standing water around homes, maintain cleanliness, use mosquito nets regularly, and seek immediate testing if fever arises. Sadar Hospital, Chaibasa medical team visited the village to issue treatment guidelines. The community requested provision of mosquito nets; administration assured distribution after receiving patient details. Villagers also complained of alleged rude treatment at the Jetia-based government health center when seeking care.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアの流行拡大によりジャムジュイ村で懸念、感染者20人超
triage.triage_reason: 局地的なマラリア流行（感染者20人超）だが、マラリアは当該地域の風土病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域住民への影響と医療対応の遅れへの不満があり、継続的な観察が必要。
triage.notes: マラリアはジャールカンド州の風土病地域で局地的流行。感染者数20人超で重症度・死亡者数は不明。蚊帳不足や医療機関での対応不備など地域的な公衆衛生課題が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: DENGUE: El Niño pode provocar alta de casos no Brasil em 2027, e especialistas recomendam vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: El Niño could trigger a surge in dengue cases in Brazil in 2027, and experts recommend vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Brazil faces a surge linked to El Niño-driven warmer temperatures and altered rainfall, with the Health Ministry forecasting a 20-40% rise in cases in 2027. As of October 31, 2026, Brazil reported 372,945 dengue cases and 368 deaths; 2025 showed 1,423,675 cases and 1,810 deaths. Experts urge vaccination now, noting protection develops gradually and vaccines do not eliminate mosquito control. In SUS, the only Dengue vaccine available is Qdenga (Takeda) for ages 10-14, two doses three months apart; immunity begins after the first dose and strengthens after the second. For others 4-60 years, private market access per label. The Butantan-DV vaccine remains suspended amid 42 severe adverse events, including two deaths, with Anvisa and Butantan reviewing data. LIRAa data indicate 49.2% of 3,732 municipalities at alert/risk; common breeding sites include plant pots and dishes (42.3%), water storage (26.1%), tires/waste (23%).

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：エルニーニョが2027年にブラジルで症例急増を引き起こす可能性、専門家はワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでは既に多数の死亡者・症例が報告されており、エルニーニョによる2027年の20-40%増加予測とワクチン安全性問題（Butantan-DVの重篤有害事象）が重なり、保健省の関心も高いためフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 本記事は2027年に向けた予測・注意喚起の性格が強く、現時点での急性かつ異常な新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。ただし既存の高い死亡者数・症例数とワクチン安全性問題（Butantan-DV）の併存から、今後の動向を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : baisse des cas positifs, mais les risques de
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: decline in positive cases, but the risks of.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases are down in several health zones of Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of 16 Nov 2026, but transmission remains high-risk due to insecurity, population movements, and community resistance. Bunia's ISTM Ebola Treatment Center reports seven positive cases being followed; Rwampara health zone has three; Niania in Mambasa territory has three; Mongwalu reports no confirmed cases, with four suspected under observation. In Mambasa health zone, 14 positives are currently recorded, down from about 20 in the prior three weeks. Authorities credit improved adherence to preventive measures, prompt case reporting, and community relay involvement for the slowdown. However, risks persist: new patients arriving from Bafwasende (Tshopo) and vandalism affecting facilities in Niania; resistance in mining areas PK 47 and PK 51; population movements from North Kivu toward Yedi (Djugu); insecurity limiting access to Damas, hampering field response. Officials urge continued prevention and collaboration to avoid a resurgence.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ出血熱：陽性症例は減少するも拡大リスクは依然存在
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、陽性症例数は減少傾向にあるものの、治安悪化・人口移動・コミュニティの抵抗により感染拡大・再燃リスクが継続しているため、既知の重大疾患としてフルRRAでの継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはマリ、チャド、ルワンダ、コスタリカ等も含まれるが、記事本文で言及されているのはコンゴ民主共和国イツリ州（ブニア、ランパラ、マンバサ、ジュグ、モングワロ等）およびチョポ州バファサンデからの患者流入のみであり、他国への実際の拡大は記載なし。既存の進行中アウトブレイクであるため「異常・予想外」は該当しないが、治安問題・人口移動・コミュニティ抵抗による再燃リスクは高く、継続的な外部支援の必要性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Sumedang meluncurkan dasbor untuk percepat penanganan TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sumedang Regency Government launches a dashboard to accelerate TB management.
article.articleSummary: Sumedang Regency, West Java, launched the Lawan TB digital dashboard to accelerate tuberculosis management, following 2,930 TB cases detected in 2026 through Nov 13 and thousands of patients needing follow-up. The system integrates suspected cases, confirmed TB, contact tracing, and treatment progress in real time via lawantb.sumedangkab.go.id. It displays district maps with color-coded risk and does not name individuals. Of the 2,930 cases identified in 2026, 2,723 started treatment; 4,436 records require follow-up (3,790 presumptive TB without diagnosis, 331 not started, 315 with unreported final outcomes). The dashboard lists 24,932 suspected TB, with 21,142 having diagnostic results. Treatment success stands at 82.8% for patients who began treatment between Nov 14, 2024 and Nov 13, 2025. Each patient is linked to at least 20 contacts for screening, and the tool tracks preventive therapy (TPT) and medication adherence via PMO. Officials urge use by all levels to reach zero TB by 2027.

triage.headline_ja: スメダン県政府、結核対策加速のためダッシュボードを開設
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策行政施策（デジタルダッシュボード導入）の報告であり、異常な公衆衛生事象や急性のアウトブレイクではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の地方風土病であり、本記事は行政の管理体制強化（デジタル化）に関する内容。感染症危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox cresce acima do esperado no Rio e já soma quase 400 casos em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox grows beyond expectations in Rio de Janeiro and already totals nearly 400 cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Mpox continues to grow in Rio de Janeiro. By November 11, 2026, the capital had 282 confirmed cases, up 196% from 2025, with October (136) as the peak month. Statewide cases reached 382 by November 13, with 258 diagnosed between Sep 13 and Nov 13, meaning two-thirds of annual confirmations occurred in two months. The capital accounts for 71.2% of cases; at least 55 patients have been hospitalized this year. Vaccination resumed November 6 but remains limited to 18+ adults living with HIV/AIDS and CD4 <200 cells/mm3; expansion depends on vaccine supply. The two-dose regimen is 28 days apart, available at five sites in Rio. Transmission mainly through direct contact with lesions or contaminated objects; symptoms include fever, headache, myalgias, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions that may blister. Sexual transmission is possible; condoms alone do not suffice. Guidance: avoid contact with lesions and shared items, and seek care for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでMpoxが予想を上回るペースで拡大、2026年の症例数は約400例に達する
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州でMpox症例が前年比196%増と急増し、入院例も55人に上るなど公衆衛生上の懸念が高まっており、ワクチン供給制約や性感染可能性から流行拡大リスクがあるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州における国内流行の報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の記載はない。ワクチン供給状況や今後の症例推移を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Sungai Pink di Karangasem Bali, DLH Ambil Sampel Air, Ini Dugaannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pink River Virus in Karangasem, Bali; DLH Takes Water Samples; Here’s the Suspected Cause.
article.articleSummary: Pink River Virus detected in the Bebayu River near Labasari, Abang, Karangasem, Bali, after residents reported a thick pink coloration on 15 November 2026. Police and the Karangasem Environmental Agency (DLH) responded on 16 November 2026, conducting site visits and water sampling. Preliminary field inquiries indicate the pink river runs beside a shrimp farming complex; the ponds had harvested in late October 2026. Investigators believe residual wastewater from the harvest activities was discharged into the Bebayu River, though it has not yet fully drained toward the sea. The report does not confirm laboratory results or any human infections as of publication. Authorities are examining the potential link between shrimp-pond effluent and the unusual coloration, with ongoing environmental monitoring to assess public health risks and ecological impact.

triage.headline_ja: バリ島カランガセムでピンク色の川が話題に、環境局が水サンプルを採取、その原因とは

triage.notes: 本事案は感染症ではなく環境汚染（養殖排水による水質変化）の疑いであり、人への感染症例は報告されていない。タイトルに'Virus'とあるが文脈上は比喩的表現（河川名）であり、病原体によるものではない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: India's Tamil Nadu intensifies surveillance following confirmation of bird flu
article.articleSummary: H5N1 bird flu confirmed in Tamil Nadu, India, with infections detected in poultry farms in Cuddalore district, about 210 km south of Chennai. Following laboratory-confirmed results, authorities launched full containment, culling all birds on the affected farm and within a one-kilometer radius. A three-month temporary ban on rearing broiler chickens within the affected zone has been imposed. Earlier, Chennai’s Vandalur Zoo was closed after bird infections were detected. Surveillance has been bolstered in Namakkal district, a major egg-producing hub. No human cases are reported in the article; the outbreak centers on avian influenza with potential human health implications. Measures reflect ongoing control actions for H5N1 as of 2026-11-16.

triage.headline_ja: インドのタミル・ナードゥ州、鳥インフルエンザ確認を受け監視体制を強化

triage.notes: 家禽養殖場でのH5N1確認に伴い、殺処分・移動制限・監視強化などの対応が取られているが、ヒト感染例は報告されていない。養鶏業従事者への曝露継続リスクは残るため、続報（ヒト感染の有無、拡大状況）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: खतरनाक डंक: डेंगू के 317 मरीज, चिकुनगुनिया और मलेरिया का भी प्रकोप, नवंबर के पहले 2 सप्ताह में मरीजों की बढ़ी संख्या | 317 dengue cases, outbreaks of chikungunya and malaria also reported; 49 new dengue cases detected in the first two weeks of November
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous bite: 317 Dengue cases, outbreaks of Chikungunya and Malaria also reported; the number of patients increased in the first two weeks of November.
article.articleSummary: As of November 16, 2026, Nagpur is witnessing rising vector-borne infections amid El Niño-driven low rainfall and higher humidity. Dengue leads the outbreak, with 317 dengue-positive cases from 2,601 suspected samples tested January–November; in the first two weeks of November, 49 new dengue cases were detected, most in Nehru Nagar (7), followed by Dhantoli and Hanuman Nagar (4 each). Chikungunya shows 20 positives among 521 suspected cases, and malaria records 32 positives in the same period. The city conducts ongoing fogging and insecticide spraying and house-to-house surveys with 100 breeding checkers and 1,200 ASHA workers, aided by 50 sanitation staff. In November, 23,863 houses were surveyed; 428 containers checked; 7,162 fever-households surveyed; 25 positive containers. Citizens are urged to take precautions and seek prompt medical care for fever-like symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な刺咬：デング熱317例、チクングニアとマラリアの流行も報告―11月前半で患者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: インド・ナグプールで季節性のデング熱・チクングニア・マラリアの増加が報告されているが、既知の媒介蚊感染症の季節的流行であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域の対応力（防疫活動）も機能しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 毎年繰り返される季節性の媒介蚊感染症（デング熱・チクングニア・マラリア）の増加であり、地方自治体による防除・サーベイランス体制も稼働中。重症度や死亡例についての言及はなく、特段の異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Tak źle z ebolą jeszcze nie było. Służby przyznają, że jest poza kontrolą. "To nasza porażka"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Things have never been this bad with Ebola. The authorities admit that it is out of control. "That's our failure."
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control as of 15 November 2026, the second-largest epidemic in history. Since 15 May, over 11,200 infections and about 5,500 deaths have been reported. The African CDC warns the epidemic is not contained, with more than 80% of new cases among people not on known contact lists, complicating transmission tracking. The response is hampered by armed attacks on health workers, shortages of equipment and funds, and months of unpaid salaries. Doctors Without Borders reports ambulances lacking fuel and some areas without functioning surveillance teams. International pledges around $2.9 billion from the United States, European Union, and World Bank have largely not reached the most affected regions. Transmission occurs via contact with blood and bodily fluids, with a case fatality near 50%; zoonotic spillover from fruit bats is the likely origin.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がこれほど深刻だったことはない。当局も制御不能と認める。『我々の失敗だ』
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが史上2番目の規模に達し、当局が「制御不能」と認めるなど、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確であるため。
triage.notes: 米国は資金拠出国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。致死率約50%、感染者の80%以上が既知接触者リスト外であり追跡困難、武装襲撃や資金不足により対応が著しく制約されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak update as of November 14
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo virus, BDBV) declared May 2026. By November 14, 2026, 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths (CFR 48.9%) had been reported. On November 14, 60 new confirmed cases were recorded: Ituri 28, North Kivu 25, Tshopo 5, Haut-Uélé 2 (−3.2% from prior day). Of these, 14 were community deaths (Ituri 6, North Kivu 8); 22 deaths occurred in Ebola Treatment Centers (ETCs): Ituri 12, North Kivu 8, Haut-Uélé 1, Tshopo 1, bringing the period total to 36. Ituri remains the epicenter with 69.1% of cumulative cases and 46.7% of new cases; North Kivu accounts for 41.7% of new cases and CFR 55.6%. No new health zones were affected in the last 24 hours. To date, 68 of 178 health zones (38.2%) across eight provinces have been affected: Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, South Kivu, Bas-Uélé, South Ubangi, North Ubangi.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク最新情報（11月14日時点）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で累計11,376例・死亡5,568例（致死率48.9%）に達する大規模エボラアウトブレイクが継続中であり、8州68保健地区に拡大しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月に宣言されたBDBV型エボラアウトブレイク。致死率が高く（48.9%、北キブでは55.6%）、8州・68保健地区に拡大継続中。既存の大規模アウトブレイクの継続報告であり、既にフルRRA対象となっている可能性が高いが、最新動向として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: quais os sintomas e como evitar doença que matou pessoa no Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: what are the symptoms and how to avoid the disease that killed someone in Rio de Janeiro
article.articleSummary: First mpox death this year in Rio de Janeiro as cases rise. By 13 November, Rio de Janeiro state had 382 confirmed mpox cases (258 since 13 September), with Rio de Janeiro city accounting for most state cases. Brazil reported 1,099 mpox cases as of 15 November; São Paulo (409) and Rio de Janeiro (395) led, with 617 suspected cases under investigation. Mpox incubation is 3–16 days (up to 21); fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgias, and fatigue accompany skin lesions appearing on the face, hands, feet, mouth, genitals, or anus, evolving to crusts. Diagnosis by molecular testing of lesion secretions or crusts; no specific treatment beyond supportive care. Transmission via close contact with lesions or contaminated objects; isolation until transmission ends. Vaccination doses rose from 20,000 to 25,000 with intradermal administration to expand coverage; vaccination is targeted at HIV/AIDS patients, PrEP users, and laboratory workers; mass vaccination not advised by WHO.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox:症状と、リオデジャネイロで死者を出した感染症の予防法
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でmpoxの症例が急増し今年初の死亡例が報告されており、WPRO基準の複数項目（異常性・重症度・継続曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はリオデジャネイロ州・サンパウロ州を中心としたブラジル国内のmpox症例急増と初の死亡例を報告。HIV/AIDS患者やPrEP利用者を対象にワクチン接種が拡大中だが、WHOは大規模接種を推奨していない。国際的拡大や渡航制限への言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Rio de Janeiro registra primeira morte por mpox no Brasil em 2026 em meio à alta de casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro records the first mpox death in Brazil in 2026 amid a surge in cases.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) death marks Brazil’s first mpox fatality in 2026, in Rio de Janeiro state. A Rio de Janeiro city resident with preexisting immunosuppression died on November 13, 2026. The state reports 382 mpox cases, with 258 diagnosed between September 13 and November 13, about two-thirds of the year’s total. The capital accounts for 71.2% of cases. Average age 33.8 years; at least 55 were hospitalized. In response, the Health Ministry allocated over 2,000 vaccine doses to Rio in early November; priority groups include people with HIV/AIDS and immunosuppression, lab workers handling MPXV, and those with medium/high-risk exposure; two doses, 28 days apart. On November 8, 25,000 additional doses were ordered. MPXV transmission is mainly by direct contact with fluids, mucous membranes, skin lesions, and contaminated objects. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and lesions, including genital/anal regions. Seek care promptly and avoid close contact until diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州、2026年ブラジル初のmpox死亡例を記録、症例急増の中で
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州でmpox症例が急増し初の死亡例が発生、ワクチン追加配備など公衆衛生対応が行われており、重症度・流行継続性の観点からフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 死亡例は免疫抑制の基礎疾患を有する患者。症例は9-11月に急増し、州保健当局がワクチン追加調達（25,000回分）を実施。国際的拡大の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak Still Surging out of Control 6 Months On
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), extending into parts of Uganda, remains out of control six months after it was declared, with cases also reported in Kenya and Nigeria in October 2026. The World Health Organization notes this is the most geographically widespread Ebola event on record and ongoing vaccine development is underway, though no licensed vaccine is yet broadly deployed. Health responders face attacks on workers and unpaid staff amid severe resource shortages, hindering surveillance, contact tracing, and patient care. Jean Kaseya, director-general of the Africa CDC, told Reuters the outbreak is still serious and not under control. The cross-border spread raises regional risk and underscores the need for sustained international support and secure supply chains to sustain the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、発生から6カ月経っても依然として制御不能な状況が続く
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ出血熱がウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大し、WHOが「史上最も地理的に広範なエボラ事例」と指摘するなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の懸念事例であるため。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの症例拡大が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる発生地はDRCである。

article.articleHeadline: From pet dogs to cats: Understanding the infections that can spread from animals to humans and how to prevent them
article.articleSummary: Dr Subramanian Swaminathan of Gleneagles Hospital, Chennai, explains that living with pets carries zoonotic infection risks, even when animals appear healthy. A prime example is Bartonella henselae, which causes cat-scratch disease and can infect humans when a scratch is contaminated with infected flea feces. Symptoms typically include fever and swollen lymph nodes, appearing a week or more after exposure. Transmission arises from bites, scratches, saliva, urine, feces, contaminated food or water, or contact with an infected animal’s surroundings; insects can also spread pathogens. Preventive measures are crucial for young children, older adults, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals. Recommendations: keep vaccinations and deworming up to date, use veterinarian-approved flea and tick control, dispose of waste safely, wash hands after handling pets, keep litter trays and feeding areas away from food prep, avoid allowing pets to lick wounds or the face, and supervise children. Published 16 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ペットの犬や猫から人への感染症：動物から人へ広がる感染症の理解と予防法
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の発生イベントやアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Joven de Barrancabermeja enfrenta dificultades para tratar filariasis linfática y busca apoyo para atención en México
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young man from Barrancabermeja faces difficulties in treating lymphatic filariasis and seeks support for treatment in Mexico.
article.articleSummary: Lymphatic filariasis in Barrancabermeja, Colombia, affects 17-year-old Keiner José Granados, who has lived with a severely swollen left leg for seven years after a mosquito bite around age 10. Diagnosed in 2023, he was prescribed diethylcarbamazine, but Colombia’s health insurer (EPS) did not provide the medication. The family imported the drug from India at a cost exceeding 18 million Colombian pesos. After a year of treatment, follow-up tests were not completed and lymphatic drainage therapies in Barrancabermeja were not authorized. To access care, a fundraiser is set for November 27, 2026, at Parque Camilo Torres in Barrancabermeja to raise 100 million pesos to travel to Mexico City, where Dr. Luis Montoya proposes an eight-hour daily regimen with an estimated 90–95% improvement; afterward, care would continue in Colombia with compression and bandaging.

triage.headline_ja: バランカベルメハの若者、リンパ性フィラリア症の治療に苦労し、メキシコでの治療支援を求める
triage.triage_reason: コロンビアの個人事例に関する人的関心記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常発生や拡大リスクは認められず、対象国（インド）は薬剤輸入元として言及されているのみで実際の発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はコロンビアの一個人患者の治療アクセス問題に関する人間関心記事であり、感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生危機を示すものではない。インドは治療薬の輸入元として言及されているのみで、発生地ではない。コロンビア・メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta que epidemia de ébola continua a alastrar na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola epidemic continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak declared six months ago in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, now with more than 11,200 cases and 5,500 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain drives the spread, while ongoing armed conflict hampers access to remote communities. Despite progress at initial epicenters, 400–500 new infections occur weekly, and the outbreak has expanded to 67 health zones across eight provinces. Children account for over a quarter of confirmed cases and about one-third of deaths, with around 70% of under-five cases fatal. Contact tracing remains below targets; two-thirds of deaths occur in communities, indicating late detection. Africa CDC notes that 80% of new infections are detected outside official surveillance, and about 65% of those infected die at home or in communities without access to a treatment center.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大し続けていると警告
triage.triage_reason: 6か月継続中のエボラ流行が11,200例超・死亡5,500人超に拡大し、武装紛争により対応が困難な状況が続いているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 武装紛争により接触者追跡や監視体制が不十分で、感染の8割が公式サーベイランス外で検出されている点が深刻。既にWHOが警告を発しており、国際的な注目・支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases in Agusan del Sur town hit 858; 5 dead
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Rosario, Agusan del Sur total 858 with five deaths since January, and 37 active cases as of 2026-11-16. The Municipal Health Office lists cumulative infections by barangay: Sta. Cruz 171, Bayugan 3 169, Cabantao 100, Poblacion 97, Novele 80, Tagbayagan 79, Libuac 67, Cabawan 43, Wasian 33, Maligaya 13, Marfil 6. Active cases are concentrated in Poblacion (11), Sta. Cruz (10), Bayugan 3 (6), Novele (4), Libuac (2), Wasian (2), Maligaya (1), Cabantao (1). The fatalities occurred in Novele (2), Sta. Cruz (1), Bayugan 3 (1), Cabantao (1). Residents are urged to intensify mosquito-control measures: destroy breeding sites, use insect repellents, wear long-sleeved clothing, and seek early medical care for fever, severe headache, or body pains. MHO advisories stress prompt action to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アグサン・デル・スール州の町でデング熱症例が858件に、死者5人
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンの一地方都市（ロサリオ町）における地域的なデング熱流行であり、季節的な蚊媒介感染症として通常範囲内と考えられるが、死亡例の発生と症例数の多さから経過観察を継続する。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は特定の一町（ロサリオ、アグサン・デル・スール州）における地元保健当局の症例報告。全国規模の異常発生を示す情報はないが、死亡例含む継続的な感染拡大のため監視継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia eboli wymyka się spod kontroli. Zmarło już ponad pięć tysięcy osób
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is getting out of control. More than five thousand people have already died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains out of control six months after it began, with over 11,200 cases and about 5,500 deaths since May 15. It ranks as the second-largest Ebola epidemic in history. African CDC notes that more than 80% of new infections involve people with unknown transmission sources, undermining contact tracing. Medical efforts are impeded by armed attacks on staff, shortages of equipment and funds, and months of unpaid salaries. Médecins Sans Frontières reports ambulances immobilized by fuel shortages and non-operational case-surveillance teams in parts of the region. International pledges totaling roughly $2.9 billion from the US, EU, and World Bank have largely not reached the hardest-hit areas. WHO explains Ebola virus transmission from fruit bats to humans via blood and bodily fluids, causing a severe hemorrhagic fever with a case fatality around 50%.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に。死者は既に5000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が制御不能な拡大を続け、致死率約50%・死者5500人超と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra primeira morte por mpox em 2026; vítima era do Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil reports first mpox death in 2026; the victim was from Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports the first mpox death in 2026; the victim was from Rio de Janeiro municipality, identity and circumstances not disclosed. Mpox typically causes skin lesions and mucosal lesions, with fever, headache, and muscle pains; transmission is mainly by close contact, including direct contact with lesions. By 2026, mpox cases in Brazil exceed 1,000, with Rio de Janeiro state leading with about 400 notifications, followed by São Paulo (over 380). Other states reporting cases include Ceará, Minas Gerais, the Distrito Federal, and Santa Catarina. In early November, Brazil ordered 25,000 mpox vaccine doses, using a two-dose schedule with a 28-day interval. Vaccination targets lab workers handling the virus, people living with HIV/AIDS in immunosuppression, and individuals with medium/high-risk exposure to suspected/confirmed mpox. Symptoms include skin lesions (genital, anal, oral regions), fever, headache, muscle pains, and swollen lymph nodes; seek care for suspicious lesions regardless of fever.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで2026年初のMpox死亡例を報告、犠牲者はリオデジャネイロ出身
