article.articleHeadline: COP31, ébola, robots asesinos, Gaza... las noticias del viernes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COP31, Ebola, killer robots, Gaza... Friday's news
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO reports over 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths, about one-third children. Initial epicenters are controlled, but transmission persists in rural areas; treatment centers run at roughly 50% capacity. The response faces security barriers, with more than 80 attacks on health workers in six months. Three treatments are in trials, plus two post-exposure prophylaxis options; vaccine candidates will enter trials in coming weeks. The outbreak has crossed borders: a first patient in Nigeria, a Swiss national who traveled via Uganda, has recovered; the infection source remains unclear, and exported cases in Kenya and Nigeria were contained. Separately, the UN urges a binding treaty to ban killer autonomous weapons. In Gaza, heavy rains threaten nearly one million displaced, with 400,000 at extreme risk; nine health facilities damaged; acute respiratory infections up by 33,000 versus last year; a nine-month-old death confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: COP31、エボラ、殺人ロボット、ガザ…金曜日のニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は6ヶ月で1万1千人以上の症例・5400人以上の死亡者を出し、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・スイスへの越境感染も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を主題とし、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・スイスへの輸出症例についても言及しているが、これらは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めていない。ガザの豪雨被害は別トピックであり本評価の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil confirma la primera muerte por viruela del mono del año y enciende alarmas por un brote de contagios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil confirms the first monkeypox death of the year and sparks alarm over an outbreak of infections.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports its first mpox (monkeypox) death of 2026 in Rio de Janeiro state as infections surge, with 258 of 382 confirmed cases since mid-September and at least 55 hospitalizations nationwide. The deceased is a ~40-year-old man with preexisting immunodeficiency, who died in intensive care. In response, the Health Ministry dispatched 2,000 vaccine doses to Rio de Janeiro to shield high-risk groups, including people living with HIV, and secured 25,000 additional doses through PAHO with the sole global producer. Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease spreading mainly through close skin-to-skin contact or contact with contaminated items, and presents with high fever, extreme fatigue, muscle pain, swollen lymph nodes, and rapidly evolving skin lesions that become pustules and crusts. Preventive measures include avoiding close contact, strict hand hygiene, home isolation if fever or rash appears, covering lesions, and seeking medical care.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、今年初のサル痘（エムポックス）死亡例を確認し、感染拡大への警戒感が高まる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でmpoxによる死亡例が確認され、感染者数が急増（382件中258件が9月中旬以降）、入院55件も発生しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態と判断される。
triage.notes: HIV陽性者など免疫不全者がハイリスク群とされ、保健省がリオデジャネイロへワクチン2000回分を緊急配布、PAHO経由で追加2.5万回分を確保するなど対応強化中。国際的拡大の明示的記述はないが、PAHOとの連携から地域的関心の高さがうかがえる。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz alerta para alta de casos graves de covid-19 em cinco estados e no DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz warns of a rise in severe COVID-19 cases in five states and the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe signals a localized rise in severe acute respiratory infections (SARI) linked to SARS-CoV-2 in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Bahia, and the Federal District during the 1–7 November 2026 epidemiological week. COVID-19 hospitalizations remain low despite the regional uptick; national SARI indicators continue to decline over 3- and 6-week horizons. Emphasis on surveillance, especially for older adults, young children, and high-risk individuals. In the four most recent epidemiological weeks, SARS-CoV-2 was identified in 11.5% of SRAG positives; rhinovirus accounted for 49%, RSV 8.9%, influenza A 4.3%, and influenza B 3.9%. Since 2026 began, Brazil logged 174,427 SRAG notifications, with 92,776 (≈53.2%) having a viral identification and 7,807 SRAG deaths. SARS-CoV-2 contributed 26.9% of SRAG deaths with lab-confirmed virus; rhinovirus 43.6%. Four capitals show SRAG activity at alert/risk/high-risk with rising trends; vaccination and prevention remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: Fiocruz、11月に5州および連邦直轄区で新型コロナウイルスの重症例増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19を含む呼吸器感染症の局地的な増加が報告されているが、入院率は低く全国的な指標は低下傾向にあるため、現時点では経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: Fiocruz(保健当局)によるサーベイランス報告であり、国家公衆衛生機関の定期的モニタリングの一環。COVID-19入院率は低く、全国的なSARI指標は低下傾向にあるため、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。高齢者・乳幼児・高リスク者への注意喚起にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Malang imbau warga perhatikan kebersihan lingkungan untuk cegah DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malang City Government urges residents to keep their surroundings clean to prevent dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Malang City, East Java, Indonesia reports about 500 dengue fever cases from January–October 2026, compared with 715 in 2025, prompting authorities to urge residents to intensify environmental cleanliness during the dry-to-rainy season transition. Health Office head Dr. Husnul Muarif notes dengue is driven by Aedes aegypti, so homes should eliminate standing water to prevent mosquito breeding. Preventive measures include keeping water storage containers tightly closed, regular cleaning, and, if dirty, emptying, scrubbing, and applying Abate larvicide. Residents should also remove trash that can collect rainwater. If breeding sites are minimized, dengue prevention is more effective. Residents are advised to adopt clean and healthy living habits and seek prompt medical care for dengue symptoms at local health facilities. Peak Aedes aegypti activity typically occurs February–March, so prevention should commence immediately.

triage.headline_ja: マラン市政府、デング熱予防のため住民に環境衛生への配慮を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・マランでの例年発生するデング熱に関する予防啓発記事であり、前年より症例数は減少傾向。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、通常の季節性公衆衛生対策の範囲内。
triage.notes: デング熱は東南アジアで季節的に毎年発生する風土病であり、本記事は前年比で症例数が減少していることを示す予防啓発情報。地方自治体レベルでの通常対応の範疇。

article.articleHeadline: Febre, tosse e manchas vermelhas: quando suspeitar de sarampo e procurar atendimento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever, cough, and red rash: when to suspect measles and seek care.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in Brazil rise to 65 by early November 2026, across São Paulo, Amazonas, Acre, and Rio de Janeiro, with 19 cases in the North Region (Amazonas 17, Acre 2). Classic progression starts with fever, cough, runny nose, and red eyes; after 3–5 days a red maculopapular rash typically begins on the face and spreads to the trunk and limbs. Suspect measles when fever and a rash coincide with at least one respiratory symptom or conjunctivitis, regardless of age or vaccination status; diagnosis relies on clinical picture, vaccination history, and appropriate tests. Complications can include otitis, diarrhea, pneumonia, and encephalitis, with infants and children under five at higher risk. Guidance: contact a health facility before visiting, stay home, avoid crowds and schools, and follow medical advice during evaluation. Public interest signals show rising searches in Acre and Rondônia toward late October 2026; Afya/Whitebook and Google Trends reflect increased attention on measles in these states.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱、咳、発疹:麻疹を疑うべき時と受診のタイミング
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル北部・南東部で麻疹症例が65例に増加し、複数州にまたがる継続的な感染拡大と合併症（脳炎・肺炎等）のリスクがあり、世間の関心（検索トレンド）も高まっているため、WPRO基準複数該当＋社会的関心ありでPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は患者向け啓発記事だが、65例への増加、複数州（サンパウロ・アマゾナス・アクレ・リオデジャネイロ）への拡大、脳炎等合併症の言及、検索トレンド上昇という社会的関心の高まりが確認されるため、続報を精査しフルリスク評価への移行を検討すべき。

article.articleHeadline: O que é mpox e como contrai a doença? Tudo que precisa saber após primeira morte no Brasil - Acorda Cidade - Portal de notícias de Feira de Santana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is mpox and how do you contract the disease? Everything you need to know after the first death in Brazil - Acorda Cidade - Feira de Santana News Portal.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, Brazil recorded its first mpox death of the year in Rio de Janeiro—a 40–49-year-old patient with an immunocompromising condition. Despite the crisis phase passing, mpox remains circulating, with new infections reported in February in Porto Alegre and São Paulo, indicating ongoing urban transmission. Two main lineages are circulating in Brazil: clade 2 (West Africa, typically milder) and clade 1 (originating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo), with the 1b sub-variant detected since 2025 linked to higher hospitalization and severe complications. Transmission occurs by direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, intimate or sexual contact, contaminated objects, and close-proximity droplets. Symptoms include facial-to-body skin lesions, fever, severe headache, myalgia, fatigue, chills, and lymphadenopathy; lesions crust and may scar. Diagnosis relies on RT-PCR or sequencing. Brazil reported about 2,170 mpox cases in 2024–2025, with the Southeast region accounting for most cases.

triage.headline_ja: mpoxとは何か、どのように感染するのか？ブラジルで今年初の死者が出た後に知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで免疫不全患者がmpoxで死亡し、より重症化しやすいクレード1bの流行と都市部での継続的な人ー人感染が報告されているため、フルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内でのmpox流行状況の解説記事であり、DRCやアンゴラは病原体の起源に関する言及のみで、現地での発生事例ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ISPA dan DBD Mengintai saat Musim Hujan, Dinkes Tasikmalaya Minta Warga Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acute Respiratory Infections (ARIs) and Dengue Fever Lurk During the Rainy Season, Tasikmalaya Health Office Urges Residents to Stay Vigilant
article.articleSummary: Acute Respiratory Infections (ISPA) and Dengue Fever (DBD) are highlighted by Tasikmalaya’s Health Office during the rainy-season transition. As the dry-to-wet season shifts (pancaroba), pockets of respiratory illness such as colds and fever rise, alongside ISPA. Dengue risk increases with standing water that serves as Aedes mosquito breeding sites. To counter these threats, authorities have issued preventive measures through healthcare facilities and a mayoral directive to ensure rapid response and prevention. The official also debunks the belief that rain itself makes people sick, noting that puddles—especially if contaminated and with open wounds—can lead to skin infections. No case or death counts are provided; emphasis is on vigilance, early care, and vector control during the transition from dry to rainy season in Tasikmalaya, Indonesia, as of 16 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季にISPA(急性呼吸器感染症)とDBD(デング熱)が潜む、タシクマラヤ保健局が住民に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の注意喚起に関する一般的な記事であり、具体的な症例数・死亡数の報告がなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 毎年の雨季における季節性感染症（デング熱・呼吸器感染症）への注意喚起記事で、具体的な症例数や死亡者数の報告はない。地方保健当局による予防的措置の案内が主な内容。

article.articleHeadline: مركز السيطرة على الأمراض الافريقي إيبولا لا يزال خارج السيطرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC: Ebola Remains Out of Control.
article.articleSummary: On 16 November 2026, Africa CDC warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control six months after it was declared on 15 May. Government data show over 11,200 cases and more than 5,500 deaths. Health-system challenges include deadly attacks on health workers, unpaid salaries, and resource shortages. The Africa CDC Director-General cautioned that the outbreak is still dangerous and uncontrolled. Notably, more than 80% of new cases are identified outside official contact lists, and over 65% of deaths occur in the community outside health facilities, with late-stage Ebola being more contagious. The statement underscores an urgent need to halt transmission to avoid the worst-case scenario.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC：エボラ出血熱は依然として制御不能
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）に加え、致死率の高いエボラが半年以上制御不能な状況が続いており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 死亡率約49%、新規症例の80%超が既知接触者リスト外、死亡の65%超が医療施設外で発生するなど、感染連鎖の追跡困難性が極めて高い状況。医療従事者への攻撃や資金不足も対応能力を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: ചിക്കൻ പോക്‌സ് ഭീതി. എം.ജി സർവ്വകലാശാല ഹോസ്റ്റലുകൾ അടച്ചിട്ടു. പ്രതിഷേധവുമായി അധ്യാപക സംഘടന. ഏതാനും വിദ്യാർത്ഥികൾക്ക് മാത്രമാണ് രോഗം ബാധിച്ചതെന്നിരിക്കെ, അവരെ ക്വാറന്റൈൻ ചെയ്യുന്നതിന് പകരം ഹോസ്റ്റലുകൾ പൂർണ്ണമായും അടച്ചിടുന്നത് സർവ്വകലാശാലയുടെ അക്കാദമിക പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങളെ താളംതെറ്റിക്കുമെന്നും അധ്യാപകർ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickenpox fear. MG University hostels closed. Teachers' associations protest. Although only a few students have been infected, instead of quarantining them, the hostels are being completely closed, which would disrupt the university's academic activities, say teachers.
article.articleSummary: Kottayam, Kerala — Mahatma Gandhi University closed its hostels for two weeks amid a chickenpox scare, a measure the Teachers’ Association says disrupts academics despite only a few infections. A few days earlier, two male students in the boys’ hostel tested positive for chickenpox, leading the university to extend the closure from one week to two and shift classes online. The blanket closure has left students, including those from other states, without accommodation, creating a housing crisis. After an initial week with no significant spread, ward officials reportedly advised reopening, but the order extending the closure to November 22 remains. Health department guidelines are reportedly absent, and no cleaning was carried out during the closure. Examinations scheduled for November 19 (three and five semester) and some PG exams in early December are now uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: 水痘流行の懸念。MG大学の寮が閉鎖。教員組合が抗議。感染した学生はごく少数であるにもかかわらず、隔離ではなく寮全体を閉鎖する措置が大学の学業活動に支障をきたすと教員らは述べている。
triage.triage_reason: 少数の学生に水痘（Varicella）の感染が確認されたのみで、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められず、ローカルな大学運営上の問題にとどまる。
triage.notes: 水痘は一般的に小児・若年成人に見られる軽症感染症であり、公衆衛生上の重大なリスクは低い。地元の大学運営・学生の抗議活動が主な論点であり、社会的関心はローカルなもの。

article.articleHeadline: Período chuvoso acende alerta para aumento dos casos de dengue em Lucas do Rio Verde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rainy season raises alarm over an increase in dengue cases in Lucas do Rio Verde.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, rainy-season conditions in Lucas do Rio Verde, Mato Grosso, Brazil, are raising dengue concerns. In the last 60 days, there have been more than 350 dengue notifications; for 2026 the municipality reports 1,896 suspected dengue cases, 430 confirmed, and two deaths. Aedes aegypti, which transmits dengue, Zika virus, and chikungunya, thrives in standing water, underscoring the need to eliminate breeding sites. Health authorities describe 2026 as atypical, with July rains contributing to the mosquito surge, and warn the trend may rise with ongoing rains. Two new vector-control measures were deployed in 2026 with state support: 317 ovitraps and 60 Larvicide Dissemination Stations (EDLs). Ovitraps help identify high-infestation areas; EDLs disseminate larvicide via female mosquitoes to prevent egg development. Public action—removing standing water—remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の到来によりルーカス・ド・リオ・ヴェルデでデング熱症例増加への警戒が高まる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一自治体における季節性デング熱流行であり、州の支援下で対策が進行中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、ルーチンの地域公衆衛生ニュースの域を出ない。
triage.notes: 当局は2026年を『非定型（atypical）』と表現しているが、死亡者数（2名）や症例規模は自治体レベルであり、州の支援（オビトラップ・EDL配備）で対応可能とされている。ブラジルで毎年繰り返されるデング熱流行パターンの一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Tropikal bölgelere gidenler, Dang Ateşi'yle karşı karşıya kaldı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Those traveling to tropical regions were faced with dengue fever
article.articleSummary: Three dengue fever cases were identified among travelers returning from dengue-endemic tropical regions—Indonesia, Maldives, and Burkina Faso—at Karadeniz Technical University Farabi Hospital. Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral infection common in tropical areas such as Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Singapore, and Western Pacific islands; transmission occurs via infected mosquitoes and not via person-to-person contact or respiration. Symptoms typically include abrupt high fever (up to 40°C), severe headache, retro-orbital pain, intense muscle, bone and joint pains, nausea, vomiting, and rash; a minority may progress to dengue hemorrhagic fever or dengue shock syndrome with organ failure. A further travel-associated case from Africa was reported last week. Prevention emphasizes vector protection during travel and vaccination against preventable diseases; guidance notes vaccines for influenza, pneumonia, RSV, and shingles if risk factors exist. Travelers to Burkina Faso, Nepal, India, or Indonesia should assess region-specific infection risks.

triage.headline_ja: 熱帯地域への渡航者がデング熱に直面
triage.triage_reason: トルコの病院における渡航関連デング熱3症例の一般的な注意喚起記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事はトルコの病院での渡航関連デング熱症例の報告であり、インドネシア・モルディブ・ブルキナファソからの帰国者に関するもの。対象国の中で発生地として言及されているのはインドネシアのみ（モルディブ・ブルキナファソは対象国リストに非該当）。タイ・フィリピン・ベトナム・シンガポール・ネパール・インドは流行地域の一般例示として言及されているのみで、具体的な発生事例ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Butantan cria centro para pesquisar tratamentos contra sequelas de chikungunya, dengue e zika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butantan Institute Creates Center to Research Treatments for the Sequelae of Chikungunya, Dengue, and Zika
article.articleSummary: Butantan Institute in São Paulo, Brazil, announces creation of the Center of Technology in Arboviruses (CeTA) to study long-lasting symptoms after infections by chikungunya, dengue, Zika, and yellow fever. The project will investigate persistent inflammatory, neurological, and joint manifestations to identify molecular targets for new therapies. Using artificial intelligence to mine research data for patterns explaining symptom persistence, the team will pinpoint molecules that could serve as therapeutic targets. Candidate treatments will be evaluated in three-dimensional human cell–based models, reducing reliance on animal testing. Leveraging existing infrastructure from a 2016 project, CeTA aims in five years to validate at least three molecular targets and advance two treatment biologics or vaccines to advanced preclinical testing. Funded by Fapesp, CeTA partners include the Ragon Institute (affiliated with MIT, Harvard, Mass General Brigham) and CNPEM in Campinas, São Paulo.

triage.headline_ja: ブタンタン研究所、チクングニア熱・デング熱・ジカ熱の後遺症治療を研究するセンターを設立
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は研究センター設立に関する発表であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究機関の新センター設立に関する科学・研究開発ニュースであり、感染症の発生・流行事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: casos graves voltam a subir no Brasil; veja onde estão em alta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Covid-19: Severe cases rise again in Brazil; see where they are on the rise.
article.articleSummary: Severe Covid-19 hospitalizations rise in Brazil per Fiocruz InfoGripe for 1–7 November 2026, though levels remain low. Increases are centered in Distrito Federal, Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná and Bahia, with Mato Grosso showing deceleration. The rise spans the Centro-Sul and Nordeste regions as Covid-19–related SRAG cases grow. SARS-CoV-2 positivity rose to 16.66% in the latest data, the highest since March 2025, with wider circulation across 18 states. Year-to-date SRAG with lab-confirmed viruses: RSV 38.3%, rhinovirus 33.7%, Influenza A 15.4%, Influenza B 5.5%, SARS-CoV-2 4%. In the four most recent weeks, rhinovirus accounted for 49% of positives, SARS-CoV-2 11.5%; SARS-CoV-2 represented 26.9% of virus-identified deaths (rhinovirus 43.6%). 2026 Covid-19 cases remain below 2025 levels. Vaccination remains important with updated recommendations for 6 months–5 years, pregnant women, adults 60+, immunocompromised individuals, and health workers; ensure doses are current.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルス感染症-19：ブラジルで重症例が再び増加、増加地域はどこか
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でCOVID-19重症入院例とSARS-CoV-2陽性率が上昇しているが、全体水準は低く、既知の季節性呼吸器感染症の動向報告であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは明示されていない。
triage.notes: 複数州でCOVID-19重症例とSARS-CoV-2陽性率の上昇が報告されているが、2026年の症例数は2025年水準を下回っており、既存の季節性呼吸器感染症サーベイランスの範囲内と判断される。続報での重症度・死亡率推移の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Cá 'zombie' xuất hiện trên sông Mekong ở Thái Lan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zombie fish appear on the Mekong River in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Zombie catfish with nodules, ulcers, and discolored fins were found in Thailand’s Mekong River, triggering concerns about heavy-metal pollution and seafood safety. Images circulated after 14 November showing Pla khae catfish caught along the Mekong in Loei and Nong Khai. Activist Aombun Thipsuna and local fishermen sent about 60 fish to Naresuan University; six exhibited severe nodules/ulcers, while 30–40 others showed early signs such as red fins/tails or small nodules. Thai monitoring data indicate Mekong metal concentrations rising since 2023; in August arsenic levels at Loei and Nong Khai were 3–4 times the standard 0.01 mg/L. Prior checks found digenean trematode parasites in similar lesions, but a direct causal link to pollution is unproven. An inter-agency meeting on 23 November will coordinate water quality monitoring, seafood testing, and consumer risk assessment.

triage.headline_ja: タイのメコン川に『ゾンビ』魚が出現
triage.triage_reason: ヒト感染症ではなく魚類の異常（重金属汚染・寄生虫疑い）であり、食品安全・環境リスクとして経過観察が必要だが、現時点でヒトへの健康影響は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 本事例は魚類の病変（重金属汚染・寄生虫疑い）に関するものであり、ヒト感染症としての確証はない。食品安全・環境モニタリングの観点から当局の対応（11/23会合）を注視すべき。ベトナムは発生地域に含まれるが記事の主題はタイのメコン川流域であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Hospital São José de Bicas restringe atendimentos a casos de urgência e emergência após alta de registros de Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospital São José de Bicas restricts services to urgent and emergency cases after a surge in Covid-19 case reports.
article.articleSummary: As of November 16, 2026, Hospital São José de Bicas in Bicas, Minas Gerais, Brazil, restricted admissions to urgent and emergency cases due to a surge in COVID-19 in the municipality, including severe clinical presentations. The measure aims to reorganize internal patient flow and safeguard patients and healthcare teams during the period of increased respiratory demand. The hospital urged residents to seek care only for urgent or emergency conditions and to avoid presenting with mild symptoms or routine ambulatory needs to prevent overload of the emergency department. It also called for continued basic preventive measures to curb transmission and protect vulnerable groups in the municipality.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・ビカス市のサンジョゼ病院、COVID-19症例急増を受け救急・緊急症例のみ受入制限
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地方自治体における季節的なCOVID-19症例増加に伴う病院運営上の措置であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限等のIHR基準に該当せず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 単一病院レベルの地域的な対応措置であり、COVID-19は既知の疾患であるため国際的な新規性・緊急性は低いと判断。続報があれば州・国レベルへの拡大状況を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: 日本千葉縣、英國及印度部分地區禽肉禽蛋因禽流感暫停進口本港
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong suspends imports of poultry meat and eggs from Chiba Prefecture, Japan, the United Kingdom and parts of India due to avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong’s Food Safety Centre suspended imports of poultry meat and poultry products, including eggs, from India’s Anantapur district in Andhra Pradesh; the United Kingdom (Norfolk: King’s Lynn & West Norfolk; East Riding of Yorkshire; Lancashire: Wyre, Lancaster, Fylde and Preston) and Chiba Prefecture, Japan due to notifications of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI). The centre cited OIE reports and said Hong Kong currently has an import mechanism only for eggs from India, and no poultry meat imports. Government data show the first nine months of 2026: Hong Kong imported no poultry eggs from India; from the UK about 680 tonnes of chilled/frozen poultry meat and ~220,000 eggs; from Japan about 1,030 tonnes of chilled poultry meat and ~249.94 million eggs. The centre has contacted authorities in India, the UK and Japan and will monitor OIE advisories and related updates.

triage.headline_ja: 日本・千葉県、英国、インド一部地域からの家禽肉・卵の輸入を香港が鳥インフルエンザのため一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における高病原性鳥インフルエンザ発生に伴う香港の輸入停止措置に関する内容であり、貿易制限基準には該当するが、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響については言及がなく情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はインドAndhra Pradesh州Anantapur地区、英国（Norfolk, Yorkshire, Lancashire）、日本千葉県での家禽HPAI発生を受けた香港の輸入停止措置について報じている。対象国リストに含まれるのはインドのみ（英国・日本はリスト外のため除外）。本件は家禽（動物衛生）における発生であり、ヒトへの感染報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana atinge bebês e profissionais e fecha berçários de creche em Cachoeira do Campo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human scabies hits babies and staff and closes daycare centers in Cachoeira do Campo
article.articleSummary: Six confirmed scabies cases, including two babies and four daycare staff, at Creche Municipal Arnaldo Bastos in Cachoeira do Campo, Ouro Preto district, Minas Gerais, Brazil. Cases identified in nurseries B0 and B1; the facility closed on Nov 12–13 with both nurseries to remain shut for seven days; other classes resume on Monday. Contacts in the workforce are being monitored but asymptomatic. Municipal Health Surveillance, guided by a Ministry of Health technical note, oversees sanitation measures to interrupt transmission. Health and Occupational Health sectors are supporting the center. Scabies is caused by a microscopic mite; main symptoms are intense itching (worse at night) and small red lesions. Transmission occurs via prolonged direct skin contact and through shared clothing or bedding. Treatment requires medical supervision; typically all close contacts are treated and fabrics washed in hot water.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬が乳児と職員に広がり、オウロ・プレトのカショエイラ・ド・カンポの保育園が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は局所的な保育施設内クラスターであり、重症度・国際的拡大リスクともに低く、通常の公衆衛生対応で管理されているためピックアップ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内の一地方自治体における保育施設内の疥癬クラスターで、地元保健当局が通常の対応（施設閉鎖・接触者モニタリング・治療）で管理しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : huit nouveaux patients déclarés guéris au centre de traitement - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: Eight new patients declared cured at the treatment center - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Eight patients, including two infants, were discharged from the Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) at the General Reference Hospital of Beni in North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, on 16 November 2026. The infants are 3 weeks and 2 months old and spent 15 and 16 days respectively at the ETC, benefiting from a treatment introduced by the National Biomedical Research Institute (INRB). With these discharges, the ETC in Beni has recorded a total of 136 recovered patients to date. Hospital officials and representatives of International Medical Corps (IMC) praised the families for timely treatment-seeking and ongoing support, noting that recovered patients are no longer contagious and can resume normal activities as they return home.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ流行：治療センターで新たに8人の患者が治癒と宣言
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱に関する進行中のアウトブレイク報告であり、重篤な疾患であること、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスク、国際支援（IMC）の関与が確認されるためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は回復患者の報告であり新規感染拡大の直接的証拠はないが、エボラは継続中のアウトブレイクであり既存のフルリスク評価対象として扱うべき。IMC（国際医療支援団体）の関与が示されており、国際支援が継続している状況。

article.articleHeadline: Balayına Giden Çiftlere Dang Ateşi Uyarısı: Maldivler Dönüşü Vakalar Görüldü
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Warning for Honeymooning Couples: Cases Reported Upon Returning from the Maldives.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever warning for honeymooners returning from the Maldives: Turkish experts report dengue diagnosed in couples returning from the tropical Maldives and in travelers from Indonesia. At KTÜ Farabi Hospital, Prof. Dr. Gürdal Yılmaz notes that dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and is not spread by touch or respiratory routes. While Turkey is not endemic, most cases appear after international travel. Typical symptoms include sudden high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle, bone and joint aches, nausea, vomiting, and a rash; a minority develop severe dengue with internal bleeding, hypotension, or organ dysfunction. Patients in these cases were discharged after treatment; doctors emphasize travel history to guide diagnosis. Preventive measures for tropical travel include long sleeves, repellents, and nets. The doctor also highlights seasonal detections of influenza viruses in Oct–Dec, ongoing COVID-19, and vaccination suggestions (flu, pneumonia, RSV; shingles for at-risk).

triage.headline_ja: 新婚旅行帰りの夫婦にデング熱警告：モルディブ旅行後に症例確認
triage.triage_reason: モルディブ・インドネシア旅行後にトルコで輸入デング熱症例が確認されたという一般的な渡航医学的注意喚起であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はトルコ国内での輸入症例報告であり、インドネシア・モルディブでの新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。モルディブは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 日本英國及印度部分地區爆H5N1禽流感 食安中心暫停相關地區禽肉禽蛋進口
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H5N1 avian influenza outbreaks in parts of Japan, the United Kingdom, and India; Centre for Food Safety suspends imports of poultry meat and eggs from affected areas.
article.articleSummary: HPAI H5N1 outbreaks have been reported in India (Andhra Pradesh, Anantapur district), the United Kingdom (Norfolk; East Riding of Yorkshire; Wyre district in Lancashire and nearby Lancaster, Fylde and Preston) and Japan (Chiba Prefecture). In response, Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety suspended imports of poultry meat and eggs from these affected areas to protect public health. The World Organisation for Animal Health and Japan's MAFF have issued alerts. Hong Kong currently has an egg-import mechanism with India but no poultry-meat mechanism; no Indian poultry eggs were imported in the first nine months of 2026. From the UK, Hong Kong imported about 680 tonnes of chilled/frozen poultry meat and about 220,000 eggs; from Japan, about 1,030 tonnes of chilled poultry meat and roughly 250 million eggs. The Centre has notified authorities in India, the UK and Japan and will monitor developments and adjust actions as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 日本・英国・インドの一部地域でH5N1鳥インフルエンザが発生、香港食物安全センターが該当地域からの家禽肉・卵の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: インド、英国、日本の複数地域でH5N1鳥インフルエンザの発生が報告され、香港が家禽製品の輸入を停止するなど貿易制限が実施されており、国際的拡大と貿易制限の2基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家禽における動物由来H5N1の発生であり、ヒト感染事例は報告されていない。日本・英国も発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。香港は輸入規制措置を実施した側であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Six mois après l'apparition d'Ebola en RDC, l'accès aux populations isolées reste un défi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six months after the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, access to isolated populations remains a challenge.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Bundibugyo ebolavirus–driven Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, access to isolated populations remains a major challenge. About 400–500 new cases weekly across 67 health zones in eight provinces; total cases exceed 11,000 with 5,400 deaths. Children account for more than a quarter of cases and about a third of deaths; among under-fives, seven in ten infected die. Contact tracing is below targets, and two-thirds of deaths occur in communities, indicating late detection. Yet progress includes transmission control in most early foci (Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Nizi, Rwampara, Butembo); Bunia cases halved, though transmission persists. Diagnostics expanded from 2 to over 20 labs; ~2,000 beds in 104 treatment/transit centers; nearly 3,000 recovered. Security remains a major barrier, with >80 attacks on health services; Cantine-Aloya attack caused 66 civilian deaths (including 3 health workers) and three health facilities were looted. UN and Africa CDC urge sustained funding through 2027 and safe access to reach remaining communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱発生から6か月、孤立した住民へのアクセスが依然として課題
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ大規模流行（11,000例超、死亡5,400人）が継続中で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、治安悪化による対応困難、国際支援の必要性が明確であり、IHR・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ルワンダは地理的近接による参考地域として記載されているが、記事本文では発生国としての言及はなくDRC国内の状況が主題のため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Controversial Capitol Doc Quits; Vaccine Injury Reimbursement? Cheese Outbreak Ends
article.articleSummary: Record-breaking U.S. measles surge strains clinicians as outbreaks intensify nationwide. In Africa, Congo’s Ebola outbreak—the deadliest in its history—remains uncontrolled six months after it began, with over 11,000 confirmed cases and a case fatality rate near 50%. Nigeria reports none of the 62 contacts linked to an Ebola case developed disease during 21-day monitoring. Closer to home, the United States faces increasing H5N1 bird flu activity in dairy cattle and poultry, a situation timed with the traditional flu season that could raise mutations and occasional human transmission. The FDA has declared an end to the E. coli outbreak tied to recalled Sierra Nevada Graziers raw milk cheeses.

triage.headline_ja: 物議を醸した連邦議会専属医師が辞任／ワクチン被害補償は？／チーズ由来の大腸菌アウトブレイクは終息
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが同国史上最悪規模（1万1000例超、致死率約50%）で6か月経っても制御できていないとの記述があり、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの複数基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本記事は複数の感染症トピック（米国の麻疹急増、DRCのエボラ、ナイジェリアの接触者追跡、米国のH5N1鳥インフルエンザ、チーズ由来大腸菌の終息）をまとめたダイジェスト記事。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみであり、ナイジェリア・米国は対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外した。DRCのエボラ関連情報は深刻かつ継続中であり、フルリスク評価（RRA）への移行が妥当と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Rio registra alta de mpox acima do esperado; veja como se prevenir | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio records mpox surge higher than expected; see how to protect yourself | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Mpox surge in Rio de Janeiro with the first confirmed death in Brazil is reported as the city records 297 mpox cases in 2026, including 205 confirmed from September to November (Rio's Epidemiological Observatory); the State of Rio has 396 cases in 2026. The death, announced on Friday the 13th, involved a patient with severely compromised immunity treated at the Evandro Chagas National Institute of Infectious Diseases. Mpox is caused by an Orthopoxvirus; symptoms resemble flu and include painful skin lesions that start red and evolve into blisters/crusts, lasting 2–4 weeks. Transmission is mainly via contact with lesions; intimate contact can also spread the virus. Prevention tips: avoid direct contact with lesions, do not share personal items, wash hands, and suspend intimate contact if symptoms appear. Vaccination is available for high-risk groups (e.g., people living with HIV, 18+, CD4 <200), with others to be added as doses arrive. Health posts are listed on the city map for locating clinics.

triage.headline_ja: リオ、予想を超えるMpoxの増加を記録；予防法を見る | リオデジャネイロ | O Dia
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内初のMpox関連死亡例が報告され、リオデジャネイロ市・州で予想以上の症例増加が確認されているため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はリオデジャネイロ市・州における2026年のMpox症例急増と国内初の死亡例（免疫不全患者）を報告。HIV陽性者等高リスク群へのワクチン接種体制についても言及があり、流行継続・管理体制の強化が今後の焦点となる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Spreads to 5 Countries, 5,500 Dead
article.articleSummary: DRC’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has killed 5,568 and infected 11,376 as of November 14, 2026, with cases in Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria and France. Declared May 15 and designated as a WHO public health emergency two days later, the outbreak has spread across eight Congolese provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Haut Uele, Tshopo, South Kivu, Bas Uele, South Ubangi and North Ubangi. The Bundibugyo virus, a rarer Ebola strain, has no approved vaccine or treatment, and the fatality rate is near 50%. Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths linked to Congo travel; France confirmed one imported case on June 24; recovered. Kenya has 9 cases and 2 deaths (all in Nairobi); Nigeria confirmed its first case Oct 20 in Abuja. Africa CDC warns up to 12 nations at risk; vaccination options include two Bundibugyo candidates and Ervebo for the Zaire strain. Violence and funding gaps complicate response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が5カ国に拡大、死者5,500人
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が致死率約50%、5カ国に拡散、WHOの公衆衛生緊急事態に指定されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの波及が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストには含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが発生源かつ主要被害国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai: Over 6,000 Severe Dog-Bite Cases Reported At 4 Major Hospitals In 7 Months; Rabies Treatment Access Raises Concern
article.articleSummary: April–October 2026 in Mumbai’s four major government medical colleges recorded 16,719 dog-bite cases, including 6,080 Category 3 exposures needing urgent post-exposure treatment. Sion Hospital led with 8,339 bites (2,080 Category 3), followed by KEM Hospital (4,984), JJ Hospital (2,274), and Nair Hospital (1,122). JJ Hospital had 1,924 Category 3 cases, about 85% of its total bites. A six-year-old girl from Thane died of rabies in December 2025 after a community dog bite, illustrating fatal risk even from minor injuries. Rabies immunoglobulin and vaccination are critical for Category 3 exposures per WHO criteria, but immunoglobulin is expensive and often unavailable, prompting referrals to medical colleges. Health advocates urge auditing stock to ensure eligible patients receive immunoglobulin amid concerns over access and shortages.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ:過去7ヶ月間で4つの主要病院に6,000件超の重度犬咬傷症例、狂犬病治療へのアクセスに懸念
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はインドの既知の風土病であり新規性・国際拡大リスクはないが、免疫グロブリン不足による治療アクセス問題と死亡例の発生は公衆衛生上の懸念として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染がなく動物媒介疾患であるため流行拡大のリスクは低いが、免疫グロブリンの供給不足という医療アクセス問題が焦点。小児の死亡例が報告されており、ローカルでの社会的関心は高いと推察されるが、国際的な緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Período chuvoso acende alerta para aumento dos casos de dengue em Lucas do Rio Verde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rainy season raises alarm over rising dengue cases in Lucas do Rio Verde.
article.articleSummary: Rising dengue risk in Lucas do Rio Verde as rainy season begins. In the last 60 days, more than 350 notifications; year-to-date: 1,896 suspected cases, 430 confirmed, and two deaths. Health surveillance supervisor Cláudia Engelmann notes 2026 has been atypical, with July rains fueling Aedes aegypti proliferation, the dengue vector also transmitting Zika virus and Chikungunya. Dengue spreads where standing water allows breeding; eliminating breeding sites remains critical. The municipality, with Mato Grosso state support, deployed two vector-control strategies in 2026: 317 ovitraps and 60 Larvicide Dissemination Stations (EDLs). Ovitraps help identify areas with higher infestation; EDLS use female mosquitoes to disseminate a larvicide that prevents egg development. Residents are urged to keep yards clean and remove water-holding containers to reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の到来でルーカス・ド・リオ・ヴェルデでデング熱患者増加への警戒が高まる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の地方都市におけるデング熱の季節的増加に関する報道であり、死亡例はあるものの、国際的拡大や渡航制限等のIHR基準には該当しない。例年の風土病的流行であり社会的関心の急激な高まりも確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・マトグロッソ州ルーカス・ド・リオ・ヴェルデの地域的なデング熱流行とベクター対策（オビトラップ、幼虫剤散布ステーション）に関する内容。ジカ熱・チクングニア熱は同じ媒介蚊として言及されているのみで、実際の症例報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak Still Uncontained After Six Months
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, transmission persists with 11,145 confirmed cases and 5,437 deaths (CDC as of Nov 10), nearly half of those infected. The outbreak spans eight of Congo's 26 provinces, concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu, and is active in 51 local health zones; it has crossed borders to Kenya (nine cases) and Nigeria (one), with Uganda previously reporting cases. Bundibugyo virus is rarer than Zaire; the Ervebo vaccine targets Zaire and lacks an approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, so response relies on surveillance, isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials. About 80% of new cases are found outside surveillance; one-third of deaths occur at home. Despite a mid-May declaration, early deaths (43) and rapid spread persisted; funding gaps and new hotspots hinder containment, while UNICEF reports 35% of deaths are children, and 21% of infections occur in children under five.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、6か月経っても制御できず
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのBundibugyo型エボラ出血熱が6か月間制御されず、11,145例・5,437死亡（致死率約49%）に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスはZaire型より稀で、承認済みワクチン（Ervebo）が効かないため対応が困難。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境例もあるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。資金不足と新規ホットスポットの出現により封じ込めが遅延している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'épidémie n'est toujours pas maîtrisée six mois après sa déclaration
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the outbreak is still not under control six months after it was declared.
article.articleSummary: Six months into an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, Africa CDC reports transmission remains out of control. Since the declaration on May 15, government data show over 11,200 cases and 5,500 deaths. More than 80% of new infections occur outside established contact lists, and over 65% of deaths happen in communities outside health facilities, highlighting late-stage contagiousness. Despite immense challenges, progress includes bringing vital services closer to affected communities. The response is led by the WHO with UN agencies, Africa CDC, regional bodies, and humanitarian partners coordinating access, logistics, protection and continuity of essential services. Transmission has slowed in initial epicenters, but about 400–500 new cases are reported weekly, with the outbreak spreading to 67 health zones across eight provinces. Progress remains fragile and must be sustained and expanded.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：発生宣言から6か月経ってもなお制御できていない
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが6か月経過しても制御できておらず、致死率・感染拡大範囲・コミュニティ内感染の割合から公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: WHO・Africa CDC・国連機関等が対応中。感染者11,200人超、死者5,500人超、8州67保健地域に拡大中で、週400-500件の新規症例報告が継続。極めて深刻な進行中アウトブレイクでありフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Has Killed More Than 5,000 People in the DRC, and the Church Is on the Front Line
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) declared in May has surpassed 10,600 confirmed cases and 5,200 deaths, the largest and most geographically widespread on record for the country, with eight provinces affected. As of 2026-11-16, Kenya reports 9 cases and 2 deaths; Nigeria 1 case evacuated to Switzerland. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment; a first vaccine trial began in Bunia in late October, with results expected in early 2027. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or body fluids of the sick or deceased, with incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms resemble flu, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, kidney and liver failure; case fatality about 50%. In Ituri’s Tchomia, health workers walked off the job in late October after four months of unpaid wages; five confirmed and 10 suspected patients remain at a treatment center. The Anglican Church of Congo leads prevention and safe burial efforts amid funding shortages.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱によりコンゴ民主共和国で5,000人以上が死亡、教会が最前線に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（1万件超・死者5,200人超、CFR約50%）が8州に拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの越境事例も発生。資金不足による医療従事者離脱など管理体制にも懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスでの症例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ワクチン未承認で治験中（結果は2027年初頭予定）、医療従事者の未払い賃金による離職など現場の管理体制悪化が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola na RDC: letalidade atinge 48,9% e vírus começa a se espalhar por outros países
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: fatality rate reaches 48.9% and the virus begins to spread to other countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains active and expanding six months after detection. The Bundibugyo strain has reached eight provinces and 67 health zones, with weekly incidence 400–500. Since May 15, more than 11,200 infections and 5,500 deaths, yielding a case-fatality rate of 48.9%. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya warns this could become the worst outbreak if containment fails. About 80% of new cases occur outside contact tracing; around 65% of deaths occur at home, limiting access to treatment centers. Children under five are especially vulnerable, accounting for >25% of cases and about one-third of deaths; 70% of under-5 deaths. Response hampered by fuel shortages, surveillance gaps, and frontline salary delays; 445 frontline infections and 74 deaths. Insecurity in Ituri and North Kivu, with >80 attacks on health facilities; Cantine-Aloya massacre (Nov 6) disrupted surveillance. Imported cases detected in Kenya and Nigeria signal cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱流行：致死率48.9%に達し、ウイルスが他国へ拡大開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率48.9%、11,200例超・5,500人超の死亡という大規模流行が継続し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入症例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。流行の主体はDRC（イトゥリ州含む8州）である。

article.articleHeadline: मोदी करेंगे कोविड-19 के दौरान उपचार एवं स्वास्थ... | UNI Varta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Modi to oversee treatment and health during COVID-19
article.articleSummary: On 16 November 2026, in Ajmer, Rajasthan, Prime Minister Narendra Modi will conduct a dialogue with three individuals who were affected by COVID-19 and recovered through medical facilities to review the health services, treatment arrangements, and recovery experiences provided during the pandemic. Ajmer district's Chief Medical and Health Officer, Dr. Jyotsna Ranga, stated that the participants—one from Jaipur II and two from Ajmer district—will share their experiences on Tuesday. The event aims to capture patient experiences and assess Rajasthan's public health response to COVID-19, highlighting frontline care and health-system resilience during the outbreak. These insights are intended to inform ongoing public health planning in Rajasthan.

triage.headline_ja: モディ首相、COVID-19期間中の治療と保健対応を視察へ
triage.triage_reason: 過去のパンデミック対応を振り返る政治的イベントであり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や新規感染拡大を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去のCOVID-19対応に関する回顧的な政治イベント（首相による患者との対話）を報じたものであり、新規の感染症発生・流行を示すものではない。対象国India自体は含まれるが、現行の感染症シグナルではないためverified_locationsも空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : La Croix-Rouge seule actrice sur le terrain à Bafwasende - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: The Red Cross is the only on-the-ground actor in Bafwasende - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of November 16, 2026, Ebola remains active in the Bafwasende territory of the Democratic Republic of Congo, 264 km east of Kisangani. The Red Cross is the sole on-the-ground responder, with volunteers conducting house-to-house, market, and public-area sensitization against Ebola. Hospitals in Bafwasende are reported emptied, and residents fear for their fate as humanitarian workers and other technical-financial partners have withdrawn amid persistent threats and even fatal accusations tied to the outbreak. Jean-Marie Aluka, president of the DRC Red Cross in Bafwasende, says he is receiving death threats; volunteers also face threats during outreach and funeral activities. Jeanne Magbolo, a Red Cross educator, notes hostility from groups opposing the response, risking the lives of those speaking about Ebola in the area. No case counts, laboratory confirmation, or infection source are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州でのエボラ出血熱：バフワセンデでは赤十字のみが現場で対応 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国バフワセンデでエボラ出血熱が継続しており、治安上の脅威により人道支援者が撤退し医療体制が崩壊している。IHR基準で複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 症例数・検査確認・感染源の情報は記事に記載なし。治安上の脅威により人道支援者が撤退しており、対応能力の著しい低下が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Com 80 casos de sarna humana, terceira creche é fechada por surto em Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 80 cases of human scabies, the third daycare center is closed due to an outbreak in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: At least 80 cases of human scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei infestation) have been reported in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, triggering closures and suspensions at daycare centers in Itaporã and Dourados. In Itaporã, Cmei Maria Rodrigues Dias recorded seven infections and remains closed; another creche in the city reported 27 cases (25 recovered, 2 in treatment) and reopened on November 16 after eight days with cleaning of facilities and textiles. In Dourados, Ceim Recanto Raízes has infected 24 children and 16 staff, prompting an indefinite class suspension since November 11; Ceim Beatriz de Barros Bumlai has four staff and two children diagnosed. By November 13, eight had recovered and 22 remained in treatment at Recanto Raízes. A district‑level meeting on November 16 aimed to update case data. Transmission is via prolonged skin contact; prevention includes hot washing (>55°C) and thorough cleaning of fabrics and environments.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬(ヒゼンダニ感染症)80例確認、マットグロッソ・ド・スル州で3つ目の保育所が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の保育施設における疥癬（Sarcoptes scabiei）の局地的な集団発生であり、重症度は低く（死亡・入院報告なし）、地域保健当局が洗浄・消毒等の通常対応で管理できている。国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクもなく、フルリスク評価に進む必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染する皮膚疾患だが、治療可能で致死性はなく、地元自治体レベルでの会議・清掃対応により管理されている。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Rio tem primeira morte confirmada por mpox no país; vacinação é retomada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio records its first mpox death in the country; vaccination resumes.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) death confirmed in Brazil—the first in the country—occurring in Rio de Janeiro city; victim details not disclosed. As of 13 November 2026, Rio de Janeiro State Health Secretariat reported 382 mpox infections in 2026, with 124 cases Jan 1–Sep 12 and 258 after; the capital accounts for 71.2% of cases. On 8 November, the Ministry of Health announced the purchase of 25,000 mpox vaccine doses, with delivery in about three weeks; Rio de Janeiro state reported more than 2,000 doses available. Vaccination resumed for adults 18+ living with HIV/AIDS with CD4 counts below 200 cells/mm³. The regimen is two doses 28 days apart, requiring official photo ID and a physician’s medical certificate. Five vaccination centers in Rio: CRIE INI/Fiocruz (Manguinhos); Super Centro Botafogo; Super Centro Zona Norte (Nova América, Del Castilho); Super Centro Campo Grande (ParkShopping CampoGrande); Centro Especial de Vacinação Doutor Álvaro Aguiar (Centro).

triage.headline_ja: リオで国内初のmpox死亡例確認、ワクチン接種再開
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内初のmpox死亡例が確認され、2026年にリオデジャネイロ州で382例の感染が報告されるなど増加傾向にあり、HIV感染者等の脆弱層への感染拡大懸念からワクチン接種が再開されている。
triage.notes: 死亡例はリオデジャネイロ市で発生。感染者の71.2%が州都に集中し、CD4値200未満のHIV/AIDS患者を対象にワクチン接種が再開されている点から、免疫不全層における重症化・流行継続リスクに注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: जहां हुई थी बैगा बच्चों की मौत...वहां फिर फैला मलेरिया! अलर्ट जैसे हालत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Where Baiga children died... malaria has spread again there! Alarming conditions.
article.articleSummary: Malaria resurges in Balaghat’s Baiga tribal belt, Madhya Pradesh, with Baiga children dying after a malaria outbreak and related illnesses. Authorities acknowledge 32 deaths, while MLA Sanjay Uikey claims up to 60, prompting political debate over survey timelines. Across the adivasi region, hundreds have fallen ill this season, with over 500 affected so far. This month, Bithli PHC reported ~90 patients; Son gudda PHC ~100 malaria cases, alongside fever, cold and cough, and rashes. Malaria is described as endemic in the zone; November’s cooler weather is linked to rising cases and weaker child immunity. Historically, this area accounted for about 57% of Madhya Pradesh’s malaria cases, but the share has fallen to 29%, triggering changes in surveillance and reduced facilities. Three PHCs serve remote villages; Son gudda had no doctor since 1997 until a post was recently filled. Politicians dispute death counts and survey timelines.

triage.headline_ja: バイガ族の子供たちが死亡した地域で再びマラリアが流行！警戒レベルの状況
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤプラデーシュ州バラガート地区のバイガ族地域でマラリアが再流行し、32〜60人の死亡と500人以上の罹患が報告されている。医療体制の脆弱性（医師不在PHC）と重症度の高さからWPRO基準に複数該当し、政治的論争も伴い社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: マラリアは当該地域の風土病として既知だが、死亡者数の政治的論争、医療インフラの不足（1997年以降医師不在のPHCなど）、季節的要因による患者急増が懸念される。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域の脆弱な医療体制への支援必要性についてはフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox no RJ: Secretaria de Saúde passa a divulgar casos diariamente após aumento de registros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox in Rio de Janeiro: Health Department begins daily reporting of cases after an increase in case reports
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, Rio de Janeiro State reports 395 confirmed mpox cases and one death, with Rio city accounting for 71.2% of infections. Due to rising cases, SES-RJ will update daily numbers of notified, confirmed, and discarded cases across 92 municipalities on Monitora RJ, with CIEVS support and weekly bulletins. By 16 November, cases rose from 211 to 382, reaching 395. Rio received 2,000 mpox vaccine doses, all allocated to Rio; new doses awaited to expand distribution. Vaccination targets priority groups, including people living with HIV/AIDS with greater immunosuppression, PrEP users, laboratory professionals, and contacts of suspected or confirmed cases; two-dose schedule with 28 days between doses. mpox (MPXV, Orthopoxvirus) is transmitted mainly by direct contact with lesions or contaminated objects; incubation 3–16 days (up to 21); most cases are mild to moderate, but immunocompromised at higher risk.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロのMpox：症例増加を受け保健局が毎日の症例報告を開始
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州でMpox症例が急増（211→395）し死亡例も発生しているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の明確な兆候は現時点でなく、ブラジル国内の地域的対応強化が中心のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。症例増加傾向とワクチン不足が継続している点は要注視。

article.articleHeadline: البرازيل تسجل أول وفاة بفيروس إمبوكس خلال 2026 والإصابات تتجاوز الألف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records its first death from the monkeypox virus in 2026, and cases exceed one thousand.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, Brazil records its first mpox (monkeypox) death this year in Rio de Janeiro, with confirmed cases surpassing 1,000. Fiocruz reports 1,009 cases since January, later updated to 1,055 by Health Ministry. Most infections are in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro; Rio de Janeiro state logged 258 cases between 13 September and 13 November, with about 70% of statewide cases in Rio city. The deceased is a 48-year-old man with a preexisting condition compromising immunity; 55 patients have been hospitalized. Authorities say the rise does not yet constitute an epidemiological outbreak. Mpox presents with fever, headache, muscle pain, and a rash with painful blisters that may ulcerate; transmission occurs mainly via close skin contact or contaminated items. Brazil has purchased 25,000 more vaccine doses and intensified tracing/testing for high-risk groups. WHO declared PHEIC in 2022 and 2024, ending the emergency in September 2025; surveillance continues.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで2026年初のエムポックス（サル痘）による死亡例を記録、感染者数は1000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年の感染者数が1000人を超え、国内初の死亡例が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性の両面でIHR基準2項目に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 当局は現時点で疫学的アウトブレイクには該当しないとしているが、死亡例の発生とワクチン追加調達など対応強化の動きがあり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya mengintai, warga Pontianak diminta waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya looms, Pontianak residents urged to stay vigilant.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, chikungunya warnings are issued in Pontianak, West Kalimantan, as Mayor Edi Rusdi Kamtono urges residents to heighten vigilance amid the rainy season. City authorities will investigate chikungunya causes and management and coordinate with the provincial government and health authorities if an outbreak is suspected. Community participation is essential to curb transmission by ensuring housing environments do not become mosquito breeding sites. Residents are urged to routinely clean surroundings, drain water storage containers, and eliminate standing water and puddles. With the rainy season, monitoring of water storage will be intensified to prevent stagnation. The Pontianak City Government will follow up on spread information with health departments to determine prevention measures. If increased cases or extraordinary events are detected, it will coordinate with West Kalimantan Province and related parties to reinforce response. Public is urged to maintain environmental cleanliness to reduce bites.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱が忍び寄る、ポンティアナック住民に警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 雨季に伴うチクングニア熱への予防的警戒を市長が呼びかけている段階で、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の情報は確認できない。今後の症例報告の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの確認情報がなく、市長による予防的注意喚起の段階。雨季に伴う蚊媒介感染症の季節的リスクとして経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Nova onda de covid-19? O que se sabe sobre número de casos da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New wave of COVID-19? What is known about the number of cases of the disease.
article.articleSummary: Early November 2026, COVID-19-related severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) cases rose in several Brazilian regions, though numbers remain low overall. In the four weeks ending 7 November, SARS-CoV-2 accounted for 11.5% of SARI hospitalizations and 26.9% of SARI deaths of viral origin, according to Fiocruz Infogripe. In five states plus the Federal District (Bahia, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná) severe COVID-19 cases gained momentum; four capitals—Boa Vista, João Pessoa, Porto Velho, Rio de Janeiro—show SARI risk or high risk. In Boa Vista, João Pessoa, and Porto Velho, the rise is mainly in children under 4; in Rio de Janeiro, cases are higher among adults over 65. Aracaju, Brasília, Cuiabá, Florianópolis are at alert level but without long-term growth. Fiocruz notes circulation continues and urges vaccination completion; annual vaccination for priority groups, boosters every six months for elderly and immunocompromised. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, masking (PFF2/N95).

triage.headline_ja: 新たなCOVID-19の波？感染者数について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でCOVID-19関連SARI症例が増加傾向にあるが、全体数は依然低く、新規変異株や異常事象の報告もないため、現時点では経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体（SARS-CoV-2）の季節的変動の範囲内と考えられ、重症度や死亡率の急増を示す明確な記述はない。継続的なサーベイランスデータの推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Pernambuco registra mais de 13 mil casos confirmados de dengue em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pernambuco records more than 13,000 confirmed dengue cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Pernambuco, Brazil: From Jan 4 to Nov 7, 2026, 13,480 confirmed dengue cases and over 54,000 notifications were reported. The Aedes aegypti mosquito, also vector for Zika and chikungunya, thrives in warm, humid conditions that promote breeding in any stagnant water. Prevention centers on identifying and eliminating larval habitats, including sealing water tanks and cisterns, cleaning gutters, discarding water-collecting containers, and protecting rain-related curbside items; weekly checks of yards, gardens, and outdoor areas are advised. Less obvious sites such as drains, plant-tray stands, and forgotten outdoor containers can harbor larvae. Experts warn that insecticides alone are insufficient; effective control requires eliminating breeding sites, surveillance, and, when instructed by health authorities, properly applied chemical measures. Local pest-control services operate in Recife and Olinda.

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブコ州、2026年のデング熱確定症例が13,000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルナンブコ州における季節性・地域流行性のデング熱に関する定例的な公衆衛生報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限等の要素は見られない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する既知の風土病であり、本記事は予防啓発を目的とした定例報道と考えられる。重症度や死亡者数についての具体的記載はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue SC: Saúde reforça combate ao mosquito Aedes aegypti com aplicação de inseticida nos prédios da SES
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue SC: Health reinforces the fight against the Aedes aegypti mosquito with insecticide application in SES buildings.
article.articleSummary: On 14 November 2026, in Florianópolis, Santa Catarina, Brazil, the state Health Secretariat (SES), via the Epidemiological Surveillance Directorate (DIVE), deployed intradomiciliary residual spraying (BRI) of insecticide in central SES buildings to combat Aedes aegypti, the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The spray creates a residual film on interior walls that remains active for up to four months, eradicating adults that contact treated surfaces. Over the past two years, BRI has been applied to 8,910 public and private buildings by state and municipal teams. The effort reinforces intensified prevention and vector control and seeks to encourage municipalities to adopt the technique, even weeks after application. SES also promotes participation in the National Dengue Mobilization Day on 28 November. Community measures include eliminating water-collecting containers and regularly inspecting possible breeding sites around homes.

triage.headline_ja: デングSC：州保健局がSES庁舎内で殺虫剤散布を強化し、ネッタイシマカ対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的ベクターコントロール活動に関する報道であり、異常な流行や症例急増を示す情報はなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は定例的な蚊媒介感染症予防活動（殺虫剤の残効性スプレー適用）の報告であり、症例数や流行状況についての具体的データは含まれていない。ブラジル国内の通常の公衆衛生対策として扱うべき内容。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: La guerre et Ebola aggravent une crise alimentaire qui menace 30 millions de personnes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: War and Ebola exacerbate a food crisis that threatens 30 million people.
article.articleSummary: In the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola has infected more than 11,000 people and caused about 5,400 deaths over six months, including many children. Initial foci in Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Nizi and Rwampara (Ituri) and Butembo (Nord-Kivu) have been brought under control, but transmission remains active in Bunia and across conflict-affected areas. Ongoing violence—more than 80 attacks on health services—hampers surveillance, treatment, and contact tracing, and population displacement complicates response. The Ebola outbreak sits atop a severe hunger crisis: 30.3 million Congolese could be in acute food insecurity from January to June 2027, up from 26.5 million in 2026, with over 4 million at emergency level. Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, and Ituri are hardest hit. Aid agencies urge urgent funding and unimpeded access; FAO emphasizes restoring seeds and tools before the 2027 planting season to prevent a lost harvest. The ADF’s violence adds to mortality and resilience challenges.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：紛争とエボラが悪化させる食糧危機、3000万人に脅威
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で感染者1万1000人超、死亡者5400人に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、紛争による対応阻害と深刻な食糧危機が重なる複合危機であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Barrick's Kibali reinforces health screenings after Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola cases in the surrounding community near Kibali, the joint Barrick-AngloGold Ashanti mine in the Democratic Republic of Congo, have prompted Barrick to temporarily demobilise non-essential personnel at the Kibali site. There have been two fatalities from the confirmed community cases. No employees or contractors have been identified as exposed; mining operations continue normally. As a precaution, Kibali has reinforced health screening and monitoring, strengthened emergency response arrangements, and offers confidential medical assessment and follow-up. The move underscores proactive public health measures amid an ongoing outbreak risk, with the surrounding community monitored for further cases. Kibali produced 203,000 oz of gold in Q3, at an all-in sustaining cost of $1,430/oz. The mine is 45% Barrick, 45% AngloGold Ashanti, 10% SOKIMO. The op-ed cited discusses Ebola’s potential regional economic disruption through quarantines, border closures, and site shutdowns.

triage.headline_ja: バリック社のキバリ鉱山、エボラ感染例発生を受け健康スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の地域感染例2件（死亡2件）が確認されており、深�and異常性の高い事象であるためIHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は鉱山企業の対応に焦点を当てており、公衆衛生当局からの公式な発表内容（感染経路、追加症例数、WHO対応状況等）は不明。続報で感染拡大状況やDRC保健省・WHOの対応を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Indian Institute of Science researchers find antibiotic combination to reverse TB drug resistance
article.articleSummary: TB caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis in India: IISc Bengaluru researchers identify an isoniazid–vancomycin combination that reverses isoniazid resistance in clinical isolates. In vitro testing on sputum-derived isolates from drug-resistant TB (with National Tuberculosis Institute, Bengaluru) showed >90% growth reduction across various resistance mechanisms, including MDR strains. Mechanism: isoniazid is a prodrug activated by bacterial enzymes; resistance blocks activation, while vancomycin alone cannot enter the cell wall; together, cell-wall disruption permits vancomycin entry and bacterial killing. In mice with MDR M. tuberculosis, 10 days of combination therapy reduced bacterial load about 10-fold in lungs and spleen and decreased granulomas; single-drug treatments were less effective. The approach is not yet clinically available; safety and efficacy must be evaluated in extensive studies and trials. Published in Microbiology Spectrum: Vancomycin rescues sensitivity to isoniazid in clinical isolates of drug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

triage.headline_ja: インド科学研究所の研究者、結核の薬剤耐性を逆転させる抗生物質の組み合わせを発見
triage.triage_reason: 研究成果に関する科学記事であり、実際の感染症発生・流行事例ではないため、公衆衛生緊急性やシグナルとしての該当性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Onde fazer teste de covid? Alta de casos em seis estados acende alerta; veja os sintomas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Where to get a COVID-19 test? Rise in cases in six states raises alarm; see the symptoms.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 activity resurges in Brazil, with Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin (Nov 12, 2026) documenting rising COVID-19–associated Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome in the Distrito Federal, Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, and Bahia during epidemiological week 1–7 November. Hospitalizations remain low nationally, and SRAG trends are downward, but the virus continues circulating. Testing remains accessible through the public SUS network (UBS units, UPAs), private laboratories, pharmacies with rapid antigen tests, and home self-tests, though availability varies by municipality and a negative self-test does not rule out infection. Key symptoms include fever, chills, cough, sore throat, runny nose, fatigue, headache, muscle aches, and loss of smell or taste; alarm signs such as shortness of breath, chest pain, or blue lips require urgent care. Early antiviral treatment with nirmatrelvir-ritonavir is recommended for high-risk individuals within five days of symptoms. Vaccination remains essential, with boosters advised for older adults (60+).

triage.headline_ja: どこでCOVID検査を受けるべきか？6州で症例増加、警戒強まる；症状を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル6州でCOVID関連SARIが増加しているが、入院率は低く全国的なSRAG傾向は下降中であり、既知の病原体による季節的な再流行と見られるため、フルRRAに進むほどの深刻性は確認されない。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体（COVID-19）による季節的な再流行であり、入院率低下・SRAG傾向下降という記事内容からWATCHと判定。公的医療情報・啓発記事の性格が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Vacinação de gestantes em Goiás reduz casos graves de vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination of pregnant women in Goiás reduces severe cases of the virus.
article.articleSummary: Vaccination of pregnant women against Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) in Goiás, Brazil, began in November 2025 and reached 85% coverage, above the 80% goal. A preliminary SES-GO study links maternal RSV vaccination to fewer severe SRAG cases, reduced ICU admissions, and less invasive ventilation among infants, especially those under six months. The analysis shows a 60.6% reduction in projected RSV-related SRAG cases in children under one year. ICU admission rates declined from 46.8% to 37.2% (under six months), 49.3% to 40.4% (under three months), and 43.0% to 32.9% (under one year). Invasive ventilation dropped from 19.2% to 8.9% (under one year); 21.1% to 12.6% (under three months); 20.7% to 9.1% (3–5 months); 13.5% to 6.4% (6–11 months). The composite ICU/ventilation/death indicator fell from 45.6% to 35.7% in under-1-year-olds. Results are preliminary; a full season and potential contributions from nirsevimabe in high-risk groups are noted. Premature infants began receiving nirsevimabe in February 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州での妊婦へのRSVワクチン接種、乳児の重症例を減少
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン接種プログラムの効果に関する肯定的な報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な感染拡大を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はRSVワクチン接種プログラムの成功事例を報告するものであり、疾病の発生や拡大を報じるものではないため、トリアージ対象外（DISMISS）と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra mais de 84 mil casos de tuberculose e doença ainda preocupa autoridades de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records more than 84,000 cases of tuberculosis, and the disease continues to worry health authorities.
article.articleSummary: Brazil recorded 84,368 new tuberculosis cases in 2025, per the March 2026 Epidemiological Bulletin from the Ministry of Health, a 2.1% drop from 2024, which had 6,376 deaths (up 5.8% from 2023). TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis and is primarily pulmonary but can affect other organs; transmission is airborne in crowded, poorly ventilated settings. In 2025, men represented 68.4% of new cases; 32.2% were aged 20–34; 65.7% occurred among Black and mixed-race individuals, highlighting social disparities. Vulnerable groups include the homeless (risk 54×) and incarcerated individuals (risk 24×). HIV coinfection accounted for 14% of new TB cases in 2025; other risk factors include diabetes, malnutrition, and immunosuppression. Symptoms include persistent cough, low-grade fever, night sweats, fatigue, and weight loss; care should be sought after three weeks of cough. BCG vaccination is free via SUS and mainly protects children from severe TB; treatment lasts at least six months and must be completed to prevent resistance.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、結核症例が8万4千件を超え、依然として保健当局の懸念材料に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの結核は既知の風土病であり、罹患数は前年比減少傾向。突発的・異常事態ではなく、国際的拡大リスクも低いため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 結核は慢性・既知の公衆衛生課題であり、統計報告記事のためルーチンサーベイランスの範疇。突発的アウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mesmo com vacinação acima da meta, sarampo mantém alerta no Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even with vaccination above the target, measles remains on alert in Amazonas.
article.articleSummary: Measles remains on alert in Amazonas, Brazil, despite 2026 vaccination coverage at 96.8% (above target). Twenty-four confirmed cases in 2026 are concentrated in the Alto Solimões region along the border with Peru and Colombia. Cross-border movement, lower border vaccination, migration, and limited access in remote Indigenous communities sustain transmission risk. The measles virus is airborne; one infected person can spread to up to 18 non-vaccinated people. Early symptoms include high fever, persistent cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and Koplik spots before a red rash; complications include pneumonia, encephalitis, otitis, and hearing loss; immunological amnesia is possible. About 87.5% of 2026 cases are in unvaccinated individuals. The Health Ministry allocated R$524,000 to Atalaia do Norte, Benjamin Constant, Tabatinga to bolster surveillance, vaccination, and border-area case finding, including vaccination in Alto Solimões for children from six months; SUS provides MMR, with two doses for 1–29 years and one dose for 30–59 years.

triage.headline_ja: 目標を上回るワクチン接種率でも、アマゾナス州では麻疹への警戒が続く
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン接種率が目標を上回るにもかかわらずブラジル・アマゾナス州（ペルー・コロンビア国境地域）で麻疹が継続発生しており、越境移動や先住民コミュニティへのアクセス制限により感染拡大リスクが持続している。保健省が資金投入し対応中であることから政治的関心も確認できる。
triage.notes: ペルー・コロンビアも発生地域として記載されているが、記事の主題はブラジル・アマゾナス州（Alto Solimões地域）の国境付近での麻疹流行であり、ペルー・コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジル保健省が国境3市（Atalaia do Norte, Benjamin Constant, Tabatinga）に予算配分し、サーベイランス・ワクチン接種強化を実施中。脳炎・難聴等の合併症リスクも報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hortolândia reforça combate ao Aedes após chuvas e calor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hortolândia steps up the fight against Aedes after rains and heat.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, Hortolândia intensifies its fight against Aedes aegypti with house-to-house UVZ inspections in Jardim Amanda, Jardim Rosolén, and Vila Real. October's ADL index 2.9 (medium) indicates continued infestation; UVZ notes 80% of breeding sites inside homes, urging entry from residents wearing badges. This year Dengue: 2,309 notified cases, 135 positives, no deaths; Chikungunya: 33 notified cases, none positive; Zika: no notified cases. Post-rain guidance: eliminate standing water. Dengue vaccination available at UBS centers 7:30–15:30; extended hours at Amanda II, Dom Bruno Gamberini, Rosolém, Santa Clara to 17:30, and Amanda I, Figueiras, Parque do Horto to 18:30. Call UVZ at (19) 3897-3312 or (19) 3897-5974 for route details.

triage.headline_ja: オルトランディア市、雨と暑さの後にネッタイシマカ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地方自治体における通常の季節的なデング熱・蚊媒介感染症対策活動の報告であり、死亡例なく症例数も特異な増加を示していないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルでの季節的なベクター対策活動の通常報道。死亡例なし、症例数も管理可能な範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Lutte contre le paludisme, au pays - Le Rotary soutient les efforts du PNLP et insiste sur la mobilisation des ressources domestiques !
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Fighting malaria at home — Rotary supports the PNLP's efforts and emphasizes mobilization of domestic resources!
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains the leading cause of morbidity, hospitalization, and mortality in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), disproportionately affecting children under five and pregnant women. The National Malaria Control Program (PNLP), led by Dr Baudouin Matela, organized a strategic workshop in Kinshasa from November 9–12, 2026 at Centre Saint-Pierre-Claver, Gombe, to validate the multisectoral National Malaria Control Framework for 2026–2030 and align financing, implementation, and monitoring. Rotary International, via its RHCC project, supports mobilization of domestic resources and sustainable funding, including a proposal to create a private foundation to unite stakeholders. In Kasaï Province, RHCC has already provided care for about 100,000 children through hundreds of community health sites. The initiative emphasizes reducing external dependence by strengthening domestic funding for a durable national multisectoral malaria response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:マラリア対策 ― ロータリーがPNLPの取り組みを支援し、国内資源の動員を強調
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア対策の戦略会議・資金動員に関する活動報告であり、新規の異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるGombe State（ナイジェリア）は記事主題と無関係（Gombeはキンシャサ市内のコミューン名と地名が重複したことによる誤マッチと推測）。記事はDRC国内のマラリア対策プログラム（PNLP）とロータリーの資金支援活動に関する内容であり、流行や異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana provoca surtos em 11 cidades de Minas Gerais e acende alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human scabies triggers outbreaks in 11 cities in Minas Gerais and raises alarm.
article.articleSummary: Human scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) outbreaks are being monitored in Minas Gerais, Brazil, with 11 municipalities reporting cases as of 16 November 2026, including Alfenas, Belo Horizonte, Lagoa Santa, Lavras, and Andradas. A regional survey released on 9 November identified about 500 infections across 16 municipalities in South Minas; these figures come from separate assessments and should not be summed. In Alfenas, local media reported more than 330 confirmed diagnoses, with surveillance classifying the outbreak as controlled. Scabies causes intense itching, especially at night, and skin lesions; transmission is mainly by direct prolonged skin-to-skin contact in households, schools, and daycares. Early identification and physician-guided treatment are essential to interrupt transmission; avoid self-medication. Regarding schools, identified cases do not automatically trigger class suspensions; measures are decided by health and education authorities based on local context.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州の11都市で疥癬の集団発生、警戒強まる
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重篤性が低く国際的拡大リスクも乏しいが、複数都市での集団発生が継続しており地域内監視対象として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 疥癬は軽症で死亡リスクが低く、既に一部地域では「制御下」と報告されている。学校閉鎖等の強い対策は取られておらず、国際的な公衆衛生緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil en alerta sanitaria tras confirmar su primera muerte por viruela del mono en 2026 - ABRIENDO BRECHA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil under a health alert after confirming its first death from monkeypox in 2026 - ABRIENDO BRECHA.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports its first mpox (monkeypox) death in 2026, in Rio de Janeiro state, as the outbreak accelerates there. The deceased is a man approximately 40 with preexisting immunodeficiency and was in intensive care. Across Brazil, 382 mpox cases have been recorded in 2026, with 258 infections diagnosed since mid-September, and at least 55 hospitalizations. To curb transmission, Brazil's Health Ministry activated a contingency plan, dispatching 2,000 vaccine doses to Rio de Janeiro to protect vulnerable groups including people living with HIV, and contracting 25,000 additional doses through OPS with the sole global manufacturer. Mpox spreads mainly via close contact, especially skin-to-skin and sexual contact with diagnosed individuals, and via contaminated items. Public health guidance urges avoiding close contact, rigorous hand hygiene, home isolation when fever, swollen lymph nodes, or rash appears, keeping lesions covered, and seeking prompt medical care.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、2026年初のサル痘（Mpox）死亡例確認後に衛生警戒態勢へ - ABRIENDO BRECHA
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州でMpoxによる初の死亡例が確認され、382症例・55件の入院を伴うアウトブレイクが加速しており、IHR基準の2項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 死亡者は基礎疾患（免疫不全）を有していた点に留意。ワクチン供給をOPS（汎米保健機構）経由で追加調達している点から国際支援の動きが見られる。性的接触を含むヒト-ヒト感染経路が明記されており、HIV陽性者など脆弱層への対応が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: Saúde estadual vai publicar atualizações diárias dos casos no RIO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Rio de Janeiro state health department will publish daily updates on cases in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro state health department will publish mpox case updates from 16 November 2026. As of 16 November, the state reports 395 confirmed mpox cases and one death, with the increase beginning in Epidemiological Week 37 (began 13 September 2026). The City of Rio accounts for 71.2% of total cases. Surveillance spans 92 municipalities via CIEVS, with weekly bulletins guiding control measures. A technical note was issued to municipalities, and 500 health professionals were trained on mpox diagnosis, clinical management, and prevention. The MoH provided 2,000 vaccine doses in early November, all allocated to Rio de Janeiro city; further doses will be distributed to municipalities based on epidemiological assessment and stock. Mpox is caused by MPXV Orthopoxvirus, transmitted mainly through close contact with infected lesions; symptoms include rash, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, myalgias, and fatigue. Vaccination prioritizes MoH-defined groups, especially people living with HIV, scheduled per municipality.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox：リオデジャネイロ州保健局が州内の症例を毎日更新して公表へ
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州でMpox確定395例・死亡1例と増加傾向が続いており、州保健局が毎日の症例更新とワクチン配布を実施するなど、公衆衛生上の懸念とWPRO基準の複数該当が確認されるため。
triage.notes: リオデジャネイロ州・市はブラジル国内の地域であり、ブラジルとして集約。HIV陽性者などハイリスク群へのワクチン接種が優先されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Sintomas de Covid-19 ou gripe: saiba identificar as diferenças
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 or flu symptoms: learn to identify the differences.
article.articleSummary: Influenza (flu) and COVID-19 produce overlapping respiratory symptoms—fever, cough, fatigue, and malaise—making clinical distinction unreliable; laboratory tests (rapid antigen or RT-PCR) are essential for accurate diagnosis. The flu is an acute influenza virus infection with abrupt onset, high fever, myalgia, sore throat, runny nose, and extreme exhaustion. COVID-19 can share these features but often includes loss of smell or taste and may involve multiple organs, with possible neurological, vascular, dermatological, and gastrointestinal symptoms, plus potential long-term post-acute effects. Vaccination remains the strongest protection against severe disease, hospitalizations, and deaths, with Brazil’s National Immunization Program prioritizing older adults, pregnant/postpartum women, the immunocompromised, healthcare workers, and those with chronic conditions. Early isolation, mask use in shared spaces, hand hygiene, and diagnostic testing are advised; medical follow-up is important. Antivirals may be used for high-risk infected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19とインフルエンザの症状：違いを見分ける方法
triage.triage_reason: 一般向けの健康啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
