article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : des journalistes informés sur le fonctionnement du Centre de traitement d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: Journalists briefed on how the Ebola Treatment Center operates - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, Democratic Republic of Congo—On 16 November 2026, journalists were given a guided tour of the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) in Kisangani, organized by FHI 360 to bolster awareness. Dr. Franck Botalema, the center’s physician, said media engagement is essential for informing the public and supporting government efforts to end the outbreak. The tour covered the CTE layout: two risk zones (high and low) and two patient categories (suspects and confirmed). Suspected cases move through the general pathway, while confirmed cases enter via a dedicated entrance. For recovered patients, bathing and dressing are handled by nurses of the same sex before discharge. The on-site morgue allows families to identify bodies through a glass before burial, after which Red Cross ambulances transport the remains to a government burial site about eight kilometers away; families may choose another site at their expense. Dignity in burial is emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:記者らがエボラ治療センターの運営について説明を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する記事で、治療センターの運営体制や政府・国際機関（FHI360、赤十字）の関与が示されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）を満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応（治療センターの広報活動）に関する内容であり、新規発生の報告ではないが、エボラは致死率が高く国際的関心が高い疾患であるため、継続監視・フルリスク評価の対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Malaria Cases Surge 48 Per Cent To 12,574, Chikungunya Drops 84 Pc Amid Testing Gaps
article.articleSummary: Malaria cases in Mumbai rose 48% in January–October 2026 to 12,574, up from 8,521 last year, while chikungunya infections fell 84% to 113 from 710, according to BMC RTI data. The decline raises questions about detection, as hospitals including V.N. Desai Hospital (Santacruz), Bhabha Hospital and Rajawadi Hospital reportedly lack ELISA testing and rapid-test kits are unavailable in some facilities. BMC says intensified mosquito-control and surveillance are underway, with fever surveys, blood sampling and breeding-site inspections. From Jan 1 to Sep 15, teams surveyed 5,94,269 homes (27,93,193 people) and collected 32,114 blood samples; 21,655 potential malaria-breeding sites were inspected, 3,367 positive for Anopheles; 661 tyres and 22,344 scrap items removed. Fogging covered 20,713 building premises and 3,21,716 slum structures (Sept 1–15).

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイのマラリア症例が48%急増し12,574件に、チクングニアは検査体制の不備の中で84%減少
triage.triage_reason: マラリア・チクングニアともにインド・ムンバイで毎年報告される風土病の季節統計であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められず、異常性も限定的。検査体制の不備は国内公衆衛生上の課題として言及されているが、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: BMC(ムンバイ市当局)が蚊対策・サーベイランスを強化中であり、地域保健当局内での対応は進行中。検査キット不足によるチクングニア症例の過小報告の可能性が指摘されているが、これは国内医療体制の課題であり国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : 17 patients, dont un nouveau-né pris en charge au CTE - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: 17 patients, including a newborn being treated at the CTE.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) treatment center in Kisangani, Democratic Republic of the Congo, reports 17 patients: 11 suspected and 6 confirmed. Among the confirmed, ages range from 10 days (newborn) to 48 years. Since the center opened in September, 256 patients have been admitted, including 74 laboratory-confirmed EVD cases; the current tally excludes patients admitted at the time of the visit. The facility now houses 56 beds (up from 24), with 22 allocated to suspected cases and 34 to confirmed ones. The CTE replaces a provisional MSF-built unit at Cinquantenaire hospital established after the Budibungyo Ebola outbreak declaration, driven by site constraints and non-compliance with standards. A media tour showcased patient-care zones and monitoring measures as part of the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニのエボラ出血熱：新生児を含む17人がCTEで治療中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニでエボラ出血熱の確定患者74名を含む256名が入院済みであり、重篤性・異常性・ヒト-ヒト感染リスクが高く、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 本事例は既知のエボラ流行（ブディブンギョ関連）の継続報告であり、CTE（エボラ治療センター）の病床増設やMSF関与が確認される。新生児例の存在は重症度・感染伝播リスクの観点からも注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: com quase 400 casos, Rio passa a atualizar diariamente os dados - Diário de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: with nearly 400 cases, Rio de Janeiro begins updating the data daily.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil, will update mpox data daily starting 16 November 2026. The state records 396 mpox (monkeypox) confirmed cases and 1 death in 2026, with 281 additional cases under investigation. Weekly notifications surged from 13 cases (week 13–19 Sep) to 206 (week 8–14 Nov), a 15‑fold increase. Authorities trained 500 health professionals and provide technical support to 92 municipalities for outbreak response. Symptoms include skin eruptions/lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, muscle pain, chills, and fatigue; people with HIV are at higher risk of severe disease. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected individuals, especially lesions. Vaccination priority includes laboratory workers handling viral samples, immunocompromised individuals, people living with HIV/AIDS, PrEP users, and those with high‑risk exposure. Historical context notes mpox originated from monkeys kept in Denmark (1958); first human case in 1970, DRC. Brazil’s 2022 outbreak had >10,500 infections and 14 deaths; in 2026 the country reports 1,099 cases and 1 death. The virus can infect animals; reservoirs likely small rodents.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox:症例数がほぼ400件に達し、リオデジャネイロ州がデータを毎日更新開始
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州でmpox症例が15倍に急増し、死亡例も発生、HIV感染者等への重症化リスクが指摘されており、当局が毎日のデータ更新・人員訓練等対応を強化しているためWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: DRCおよびデンマークは歴史的背景（mpoxの起源・最初のヒト症例）としての言及のみであり、現在の発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: com quase 400 casos, Rio passa a atualizar diariamente os dados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: with nearly 400 cases, Rio de Janeiro begins updating the data daily.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro state reports mpox (monkeypox) with 396 confirmed cases and 1 death in 2026, while 281 cases are under investigation. Daily case updates begin 16 November 2026. Weekly notifications rose 15-fold—from 13 cases in 13–19 September to 206 cases in 8–14 November. Health authorities trained 500 professionals and provide technical support to 92 municipalities for outbreak response. Symptoms include skin eruptions and lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, myalgia, chills, and fatigue; people living with HIV have higher risk of progression. Transmission is via contact with infected individuals, especially direct contact with lesions and mucous membranes. Vaccination is advised for priority groups: laboratory workers handling viral samples, immunocompromised individuals, people with HIV/AIDS, PrEP users, and high-risk direct contacts. The mpox name originated from monkeys in a Denmark lab; first human case was in 1970 in the DRC. Brazil’s 2022 outbreak caused 14 deaths and over 10,500 infections; in 2026 Brazil reports 1,099 cases and 1 death.

triage.headline_ja: エムポックス：リオデジャネイロで感染者数約400人、データを毎日更新へ
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州でエムポックス症例が週単位で15倍に急増し死亡例も発生、HIV陽性者のリスク上昇や多数の自治体への支援展開など、WPRO基準の複数該当とIHR基準の一部該当が認められるためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: DRCおよびデンマークは病名由来・初発症例の歴史的言及であり、現行発生地域ではないため除外。ブラジル全体でも2026年に1,099症例・死亡1例が報告されており、リオデジャネイロ州の急増が全国的傾向の一部である可能性に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Guarulhos registra sete casos de Mpox e reforça orientações sobre prevenção e sintomas - Click Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guarulhos reports seven Mpox cases and reinforces guidance on prevention and symptoms - Click Guarulhos
article.articleSummary: Mpox, caused by MPXV, is reported in Guarulhos, Brazil, with seven confirmed cases as of November 12; the state of São Paulo nears 400 confirmations. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, bodily secretions, sexual activity, and contaminated objects; close, prolonged contact with respiratory secretions can also spread the virus. While condom use helps prevent many STIs, it does not fully avert Mpox, and transmission can occur from lesions in unprotected areas. Key symptoms include fever, headache, body pains, chills, weakness, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions that may contain clear or yellow fluid, crust over, and appear on the face, hands, feet, mouth, genitals, and anal region. Incubation ranges from 3–16 days, up to 21 days; diagnosis is via laboratory testing of lesion samples. Seek care for lesions with fever or swollen nodes after exposure. High-risk groups include pregnant individuals, children, elderly, people living with HIV, transplant recipients, and cancer patients. Treatment is symptomatic with clinical follow-up; most recover in 2–4 weeks. Preventive measures include not sharing personal items, hand hygiene, laundering textiles, disinfecting surfaces, and isolating from symptom onset until lesions heal and new skin forms.

triage.headline_ja: グアルリョス市でMpox症例7件確認、予防・症状に関する注意喚起を強化 - Click Guarulhos
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で継続的にMpox症例が報告されており(州全体で約400例、グアルリョス市で7例)、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるが、重症例や死亡等の深刻な影響、異常な急増は確認されておらず、既存のサーベイランス体制下での経過観察情報と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は地域保健当局による予防・症状啓発を主目的とした報道であり、重症化や死亡例、医療逼迫等の深刻な公衆衛生インパクトの記載はない。既知のMpox流行の継続的なサーベイランス報告と見られ、フルリスク評価の緊急性は低いが、州全体での症例増加傾向は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dehradun News: इबोला संक्रमण रोकने को स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dehradun News: Health Department Alerts to Prevent Ebola Infection.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) alert in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India as cases rise in Africa. Health Department orders enhanced surveillance and infection-control measures in public and private hospitals, with directives to AIIMS Rishikesh and district CMOs. The Airport Health Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (AHI DSP) portal will provide traveler information; district surveillance will contact returnees from affected countries for 21 days of daily health checks, with any fever or suspicious symptoms triggering investigation and testing. Suspected Ebola presents with fever plus bleeding, red eyes, rashes, diarrhea, or vomiting blood; assess 21-day travel or contact history. Hospitals must ensure single-room isolation, PPE, N-95 masks, gloves. Suspected cases will be referred to AIIMS Rishikesh; the district Rapid Response Team will identify and monitor contacts. Public urged to avoid direct contact with blood or body fluids and to practice hand hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: デヘラドゥンニュース：エボラ感染防止のため保健局が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: 記事はアフリカでのエボラ症例増加を受けたインド・デヘラドゥン地域での予防的警戒態勢の発表であり、インド国内での実際の感染確認事例は報告されていない。発生国（アフリカのどの国か）も特定されておらず、現時点では続報を注視すべき段階。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ウッタラーカンド州デヘラドゥンにおける予防的サーベイランス強化の発表であり、エボラの実際の発生地は「アフリカ」とのみ記載され具体的な対象国リスト国は特定できない。インド国内でのエボラ感染例の報告はなく、渡航者監視・医療機関への指示が中心の内容。

article.articleHeadline: Quais os sintomas da Mpox e como é transmitida? Doença volta a preocupar em dois estados brasileiros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What are the symptoms of Mpox and how is it transmitted? The disease raises concerns again in two Brazilian states.
article.articleSummary: Mpox outbreaks rose in Brazil, driven by confirmed and probable cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. By November 15, 2026, Brazil had 1,099 confirmed or probable cases (São Paulo 409, Rio de Janeiro 395), with 257 cases in November alone—the month’s second-highest since 2022. The first mpox death of 2026 occurred in Rio de Janeiro state—a 48-year-old man with a preexisting immunosuppression. Mpox is caused by MPXV, an Orthopoxvirus zoonosis. Symptoms include skin lesions that can affect the face, hands, feet, mouth, genitals, or anus, along with fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, muscle aches, chills, and weakness; incubation is 3–16 days, up to 21. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with lesions, secretions, or contaminated objects, and via prolonged close respiratory contact. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with cases, hand hygiene, cleaning and disinfection, and not sharing personal items. Brazil’s vaccination program targets high-risk groups (people living with HIV/AIDS, especially with immunosuppression, PrEP users, lab workers); two doses are given 28 days apart; vaccination complements but does not replace prevention.

triage.headline_ja: Mpoxの症状と感染経路とは？ブラジルの2州で再び懸念高まる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年Mpox症例が1,099例（うち11月だけで257例、2022年以降月間2番目の高さ）に増加し、免疫不全を伴う初の死亡例も発生。HIV感染者など脆弱層への影響が懸念され、フルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: Mpoxは既知の疾患だが、ブラジル国内（サンパウロ州・リオデジャネイロ州）で症例数が急増し死亡例も発生。HIV陽性者など免疫不全者への影響とワクチン接種プログラムの拡充状況を含め、フルRRAでの詳細評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: المراكز الإفريقية: إيبولا لا يزال خارجاً عن السيطرة في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Centers: Ebola Remains Out of Control in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of November 16, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control six months after the May 15 declaration. Africa CDC reports roughly 11,200 infections and 5,500 deaths to date. Attacks on healthcare workers, nonpayment of salaries, and persistent resource shortages hinder response efforts. Jean Kasia, Africa CDC Director-General, warned that the outbreak remains dangerous and not contained. More than 80% of new cases are appearing outside established contact lists, and over 65% of deaths occur in community settings outside health facilities, signaling intensified late-stage transmission. Officials warn that failing to halt the outbreak now could result in the world's worst Ebola outbreak, with escalating transmission and severe outcomes in communities.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC：エボラ出血熱、コンゴで依然として制御不能
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が6ヶ月経っても制御不能であり、感染者数・死者数が多く、接触者リスト外の症例が80%超、コミュニティでの死亡が65%超と地域社会への拡大が顕著なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Africa CDCディレクター自身が『世界最悪のエボラ流行になりうる』と警告しており、医療従事者への攻撃や給与未払いなど対応能力の低下も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Foz terá mutirão contra a dengue com 38 caçambas na Região Leste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foz do Iguaçu will host a dengue-control drive with 38 dumpsters in the Eastern Region.
article.articleSummary: Foz do Iguaçu’s Eastern Region will host a dengue-control mutirão starting Monday, 16 November 2026, through 27 November 2026, as part of the Semana de Mobilização de Combate à Dengue. Coordinated by the Municipal Secretariat of Environment, the operation includes yard cleaning, sweeping, tree pruning, and removal of materials discarded in public spaces to reduce Aedes aegypti breeding sites. A total of 38 dumpsters will be placed at locations across Morumbi, Morumbi II, Portal da Foz, Portal, and other neighborhoods to facilitate disposal of old furniture, construction debris, and similar waste; residents can also submit requests via the e-Ouve app. Concentration of teams is at 8:30 a.m. at Praça 7 de Setembro (Morumbi). The effort supports national Dia D activities and aims to lower dengue, Zika, and chikungunya risks by eliminating standing-water sources.

triage.headline_ja: フォス・ド・イグアスの東部地域で、38台のダンプスターを使ったデング熱対策の一斉清掃活動が実施される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の予防を目的とした通常の地域清掃キャンペーンの告知であり、実際の症例発生や異常な流行を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体主導の予防的清掃活動（蚊の発生源除去）に関する告知記事であり、具体的な感染者数や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: अजनार नदी साफ करने उतरे 'बिट्टू तबाही' संक्रमण का शिकार, वीडियो शेयर कर बताया दर्द; बोले- अब स्वस्थ हूं
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Went to clean the Ajnar River, fell victim to the 'Bittu Tabahi' infection, shared a video explaining the pain; says, 'I am healthy now.'
article.articleSummary: Surendra Singh Chaudhary, known as Bittu Tabahi, of Biyavra in Rajgarh district, Madhya Pradesh, began cleaning the Ajnar River in January 2026. While repeatedly removing plastic bottles, bags and other debris from a polluted stretch, he developed a skin infection from contact with contaminated water and waste, causing itching, pain and skin lesions on his hands and feet. He recorded a video of his infected hands that circulated online, drawing praise for his cleanup work. Despite wearing protective gear, direct exposure to dirty water contributed to the infection, which he says began about five days prior to the article; he has since recovered and is reportedly healthy now. The piece underscores persistent river pollution and the broader public responsibility to keep waterways clean.

triage.headline_ja: アジナール川の清掃に取り組んだ『ビットゥ・タバヒ』が感染症に罹患、動画で苦痛を語る「今は健康です」
triage.triage_reason: 単一個人が汚染水との接触で皮膚感染症を発症し既に回復した事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 個人の環境活動家が汚染河川の清掃作業中に接触性皮膚感染症を発症した事例。病原体不明・単発事例であり、感染症のアウトブレイクやヒト-ヒト感染の懸念はない。既に回復済み。

article.articleHeadline: اتساع تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو.. هجمات مسلحة تفقد السلطات السيطرة على ألف مخالط
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Widening Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.. Armed attacks strip authorities of control over a thousand contacts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak intensifies in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with eastern provinces — notably North Kivu — facing disrupted case-tracing as armed attacks target hospitals and communities. More than 11,000 confirmed infections and over 5,400 deaths have been recorded since the outbreak began, with 400–500 new cases weekly. Over 1,000 contacts have been lost to follow-up after the Cantine-Aloya attack; WHO warns that violence and insecurity severely hinder surveillance, testing, isolation, and treatment. An attack on Cantine-Aloya killed 66 civilians, including 3 health workers, and damaged three health facilities (raided/ burned). WHO notes more than 80 attacks on health services since the outbreak began. Children comprise over a quarter of confirmed cases and about one-third of deaths; under-five mortality among the infected hovers around 70%. Ongoing insecurity threatens gains in containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行拡大…武装勢力の攻撃により当局が1000人の接触者の追跡を失う
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が拡大し、武装勢力の攻撃により接触者追跡・治療体制が崩壊しつつあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 北キブ州を中心に武装勢力による医療施設・医療従事者への攻撃（80件以上）が監視・追跡・治療を著しく阻害。5歳未満感染者の致死率は約70%と極めて高く、子どもが感染者の4分の1、死亡者の約3分の1を占める。国際的な支援と介入が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : le parlement des jeunes appelle la population à
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: the Youth Parliament calls on the population to.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Beni: The Youth Parliament of Beni continues an awareness campaign in Bunji health area neighborhoods, as of November 15, following several community deaths in recent weeks linked to delayed care. The group emphasizes that combating Ebola hinges on better public information about symptoms and the urgency of treatment in officially sanctioned health facilities. President Samuel Do Sekanabo warns that many deaths could be avoided with quicker access to competent centers, noting financial barriers and the use of facilities lacking proper infection prevention. The parliament urges residents to seek examination at authorized health facilities, avoid self-medication and rumors, and not delay care. Health professionals can determine whether a case is Ebola; when detected and managed promptly in appropriate centers, recovery chances are real. Adherence to prevention and care measures is crucial to curb the outbreak in the Beni region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（ベニ）：青年議会が住民に受診を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCベニ地域でエボラ関連の死亡例が続発しており、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念があるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるWestern AustraliaおよびCommonwealth of Australiaは記事内容と無関係なため除外。記事はDRCベニ地域（Bunji保健地区）での既知のエボラアウトブレイクに関する続報であり、医療アクセス遅延による死亡増加が懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox pode ser confundida com herpes; infectologista alerta para sinais da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox can be mistaken for herpes; an infectious-disease specialist warns about the signs of the disease.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (mpox) can resemble herpes, warns infectious-disease specialist Alessandro Pasqualotto. In Brazil, 1,055 laboratory-confirmed mpox cases in 2026 as of Nov 14, with 46 probable and 617 suspected, and one death in Rio de Janeiro. October saw 295 cases; by November 14 there were 257 new cases. Lesions may be localized, including the genital area, with fever, lymphadenopathy, headaches, myalgia, chills, and weakness. Diagnosis usually requires PCR testing to identify MPXV, though access is uneven across Brazil. Transmission is mainly through close sexual contact, but also via wounds, secretions, contaminated objects, or prolonged exposure to respiratory droplets. Most cases are mild to moderate and resolve in 2-4 weeks; severe disease occurs in immunocompromised individuals, including people with HIV. Prevention includes avoiding contact with suspected cases, not sharing personal items, cleaning and disinfecting clothing and surfaces, and practicing hand hygiene. Seek care if lesions accompany fever or lymphadenopathy or after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: Mpoxは単純ヘルペスと誤診される可能性；感染症専門医が病気の兆候について警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで継続しているMpox流行の症例数報告・啓発記事であり、新規の異常事態ではないが、死亡例や症例増加が継続しているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症専門医によるMpoxと単純ヘルペスの鑑別診断に関する啓発記事であり、2026年のブラジルにおける累計症例数（確定1,055例、死亡1例）の報告を含む。新規の緊急事態というより既存流行の継続状況報告に近く、フルRRAの優先度は高くないが、死亡例の発生や症例増加傾向から継続的な監視が望ましい。

Since mid-September, weekly notifications rose from 13 to 206 (8-14 November), about a 15-fold increase. Authorities trained 500 professionals and provide technical support to 92 municipalities to bolster response. Symptoms include skin eruptions/lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, myalgias, chills, and fatigue; HIV-positive individuals are at higher risk of progression. Transmission occurs through close contact, especially with skin lesions and mucous membranes. Vaccination is advised for priority groups defined by the Ministry of Health: laboratory workers handling samples, immunodeficient individuals, people living with HIV/AIDS (including PrEP users), and those with high-risk exposure. triage.headline_ja: Mpox：約400症例でリオデジャネイロがデータの日次更新を開始
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロでMpox症例が週次報告で15倍増加し396例・死亡1例を記録、HIV陽性者のリスク増加やワクチン優先接種対象の設定など公衆衛生上の対応強化が進んでおり、WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Três Rios confirma casos de malária e mpox no município | Três Rios | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Três Rios confirms malaria and mpox cases in the municipality | Três Rios | O Dia.
article.articleSummary: On 16 November 2026, the Municipal Health Department of Três Rios confirmed one imported malaria case and one mpox case within the municipality. The malaria case originated abroad; the patient contracted the infection outside Três Rios, and the municipality is not in Brazil’s Amazon region, the primary malaria-endemic area. Malaria is transmitted mainly by infected female Anopheles mosquitoes; it is not spread person-to-person through casual contact. Common symptoms include fever (often high), chills, tremors, headache, sweating, muscle pains, fatigue, nausea. Early diagnosis and treatment are essential. For mpox, the patient is in isolation and under health service guidance; no close contacts have been identified for monitoring. Mpox spreads primarily through direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects. Health authorities will continue surveillance and response measures for both cases.

triage.headline_ja: トレス・リオス市がマラリアとmpoxの症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: いずれも輸入症例が1件ずつで、地域拡大や濃厚接触者も確認されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Drug-Resistant Enterobacteriaceae in Livestock Foods Pose Escalating Global
article.articleSummary: Two-decade narrative review identifies livestock-derived foods—especially meat and milk—as major global reservoirs for extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL)–producing multidrug-resistant Enterobacteriaceae, chiefly Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and Salmonella. Contamination spans Asia, Africa, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, with high prevalence in dairy and various meats reflecting production practices and antibiotic use. In Bangladesh, ESBL E. coli is found in raw milk (≈59%), beef (≈57%), mutton (≈43%), chicken (≈30%), and buffalo milk (≈9%); ESBL K. pneumoniae appears in raw milk (20%) and poultry (≈49%). India shows milk E. coli contamination from 1.5% to 37.8% (pooled ≈9%). Pakistan reports beef E. coli at 60%, mutton 32%, chicken 47.6%, with K. pneumoniae in raw milk at 17%. China reports MDR Salmonella in chicken (81.1%) and pork (73.2%). Europe and North America exhibit regional variation with relatively lower retail contamination; surveillance links farm practices to food-safety risks across the globe.

triage.headline_ja: 家畜由来食品中の薬剤耐性腸内細菌科細菌が世界的な食品安全リスクを拡大
triage.triage_reason: 特定の急性アウトブレイクではなく、過去20年間の文献をまとめたナラティブレビュー論文の紹介記事であり、即時の公衆衛生対応を要するイベントではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の発生事象ではなく、家畜由来食品中のESBL産生多剤耐性腸内細菌科細菌に関する学術的レビューの紹介。急性アウトブレイクのシグナルではなく、AMR動向のモニタリング対象として参考情報に留まる。Bangladesh・Pakistanは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Seja racional e estratégico - enfrente o Aedes aegypti e mantenha doenças graves longe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be rational and strategic — face Aedes aegypti and keep serious diseases at bay.
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk in Brazil may rise with an intense El Niño, with up to 860,000 probable dengue cases projected for 2027. Warming in the Pacific and rainfall shifts can boost Aedes aegypti reproduction, making November prevention crucial before transmission peaks. Measures include eliminating breeding sites in yards and indoors, installing window screens, using repellents, sealing water tanks, and cleaning gutters, drains, and saucers. Remove standing water from bottles, tires, and other objects. Higher temperatures can shorten mosquito development to 5–7 days, faster than in cooler periods. Brazil recorded dengue notifications in 2024; El Niño contributed previously. Common dengue symptoms include high fever (39–40°C), headache, retro-orbital pain, nausea, weakness, joint pains, and a rash. Severe signs require urgent care. Vaccination targets 10–14-year-olds (two doses, 3 months apart); more than 3 million adolescents needed a second dose as of October 2026. Vaccination complements environmental controls and does not replace them.

triage.headline_ja: 合理的かつ戦略的に―ネッタイシマカに立ち向かい、重大な疾患を遠ざけよう
triage.triage_reason: 将来予測（2027年）に基づく一般的なデング熱予防啓発記事であり、現時点での異常な流行や緊急の公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発・予防に関する内容で、エルニーニョによる将来的なデング熱リスク増加を解説するもの。現在進行中の異常発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Salmonella: associação entre probióticos pode ampliar cobertura, aponta ensaio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Salmonella: Association Between Probiotics May Broaden Coverage, Trial Suggests.
article.articleSummary: Multi-strain probiotic combinations broaden Salmonella inhibition in broilers, per an in vitro assay by BioSyn under its Enhanced Integrity Program. Seven probiotic strains were tested against four Salmonella serovars (Mbandaka, Heidelberg, Minnesota, Anatum) and one E. coli isolate from broiler housing, loading surfaces, composting areas, and joints. No single strain inhibited all serovars strongly; combined results yielded high inhibition across pathogens. Of 35 strain–pathogen combos, 14 formed halos and nine showed high inhibition. Yeasts produced the largest halos but did not inhibit S. Heidelberg or E. coli; Lactobacillus acidophilus was active against all five pathogens, though with smaller halos. Halo size and spectrum did not always align. Practically, three-stage probiotic deployment is advised: early hatchery colonization, maintaining microbiota through processing, and rapid re-colonization after dysbiosis or antibiotics. A 2023 study reported resistance in S. Heidelberg and S. Minnesota to third-generation cephalosporins and fluoroquinolones in Brazilian broilers.

triage.headline_ja: サルモネラ菌：プロバイオティクスの組み合わせがカバー範囲を拡大する可能性、試験で示唆
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は家禽業界向けのプロバイオティクスによるサルモネラ抑制効果に関する実験室（in vitro）研究報告であり、ヒトの感染症発生事例ではないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのブロイラー飼育における家禽衛生管理・飼料添加物（プロバイオティクス）の実験研究であり、ヒト感染症の発生報告ではない。抗生物質耐性（S. Heidelberg, S. Minnesotaの第3世代セファロスポリン・フルオロキノロン耐性）への言及はあるが、具体的な発生事例ではなく研究背景情報にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Outbreak Spreads to Eight Provinces with 48.9% Fatality Rate
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has spread to eight provinces and 67 health zones, with weekly new cases ~400–500 and a national case‑fatality rate of 48.9% as of 16 November 2026. Since May 15 there have been 11,200 confirmed cases and 5,500 deaths. More than 80% of new infections occur outside epidemiological surveillance and contact tracing; 65% die at home or in communities before reaching treatment centers. Children comprise over a quarter of cases and about a third of deaths, with under‑five mortality around 70%. Systemic gaps include fuel shortages for ambulances, insufficient trained response teams, and a lack of surveillance specialists; 445 health workers infected, 74 dead. Ongoing conflict in Ituri and North Kivu hampers localization, with >80 attacks on health facilities. The November 6 Katinga-Aloya incident disrupted surveillance, severing contact with >1,000 tracked contacts and leaving three confirmed patients unaccounted. Imported cases have been reported in Kenya and Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、8州に拡大し致死率48.9%に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が8州・67保健ゾーンに拡大し、致死率48.9%、死者5,500人超、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境輸入例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入症例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。紛争地域(Ituri, North Kivu)での保健施設への攻撃(80件超)やコンタクトトレーシングの断絶（Katinga-Aloya事案）など、対応上の重大な障害が存在し、国際支援の必要性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: saiba como o vírus é transmitido e quais são os principais sintomas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: learn how the virus is transmitted and what the main symptoms are.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) transmission in Brazil involves direct contact with infected skin lesions, secretions, and contaminated objects, with additional risk from sexual and other close contact. Less commonly, respiratory droplets may spread during prolonged close contact; animal-to-human transmission is possible. In Pernambuco, 2026 has 13 confirmed mpox cases as of November 14. Across Brazil, 1,099 confirmed or probable cases have been reported in 21 states and the Federal District. Symptoms include fever, headache, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions on the face or hands; lesion counts vary, and immunocompromised individuals may have higher risk of complications. Vaccination is recommended for priority groups (immunodeficiencies, people living with HIV/AIDS, PrEP users, lab workers, and high-risk contacts) after clinical assessment; vaccination complements prevention. Mpox was first identified in 1958 in lab monkeys in Denmark; the first human case was in 1970 in DR Congo. The 2022 Brazil outbreak exceeded 10,500 cases and 14 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox：ウイルスの感染経路と主な症状について
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで既知のMpox流行が継続しており症例数が報告されているが、新規性・異常性は低く、啓発目的の記事で社会的関心の高まりも確認できないため、フルRRAには至らないが経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はMpoxの一般的な感染経路・症状に関する啓発記事であり、ブラジル・ペルナンブコ州の2026年症例数（13例）と全国累計（1,099例、21州）を報告。DRCやデンマークは疾患の歴史的起源に関する言及のみで、現在の発生地域ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Focus RDC : six mois de lutte contre l'épidémie d'Ebola Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC Focus: six months of fighting the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo reaches six months since the May 15 declaration, with Ituri province remaining the epicenter. As of November 15, 2026, the Bundibugyo strain has caused nearly 5,600 deaths nationwide, and Ituri accounts for about 70% of cumulative cases and roughly half of daily deaths. Since the September school term, at least 37 students have been infected, two of whom died; most cases appear linked to community transmission rather than school exposure, but schools now serve as critical surveillance points. At Fabia School in Bunia, handwashing, fever screening, and distancing are routine. Response remains centered on rapid case finding, isolation, contact tracing, and vaccination campaigns, with strong involvement of women in care and outreach. Insecurity in some areas complicates access, but health authorities remain cautious yet hopeful about preventing new transmission foci in the coming months.

triage.headline_ja: DRC注目：エボラ・ブンディブギョ型流行との闘い6か月
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が発生から6か月継続し、全国で約5600人が死亡、イツリ州が流行の中心となっており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 学校での感染例（37人、死亡2人）も報告されており、コミュニティ内感染が主体だが監視拠点としての学校の役割が強調されている。治安不安が対応の障害となっている点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: تحذير إفريقي من تفشي إيبولا بالكونغو.. آلاف الإصابات ومخاوف من كارثة عالمية - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African warning of an Ebola outbreak in Congo... thousands of cases and fears of a global catastrophe - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: DR Congo continues to battle an Ebola outbreak with 11,200+ confirmed cases and over 5,500 deaths since the outbreak began on May 15, six months ago. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention warns the outbreak remains out of control amid health, security, and logistical challenges, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus—the second-largest global outbreak after West Africa (2014–2016). More than 80% of new infections are in individuals not listed as contacts, and over 65% of deaths occur in communities outside health facilities, hindering surveillance and containment. Doctors Without Borders/MSF reports persistent resource shortages in the hardest-hit regions, including lack of trained staff, insufficient fuel for ambulances, and weak surveillance teams, despite donor pledges totaling about $2.9 billion and calls to release $1.6 billion. The government is digitizing payroll to address unpaid health workers.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ、コンゴでのエボラ流行を警告…数千人の感染者と世界的大惨事への懸念 - リビアニュース24
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は11,200例超・死者5,500人超と大規模化し、制御不能な状況が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのみが主題であり、Angolaへの波及は言及されていないため除外。発生開始から6ヶ月で感染者の80%超が非接触者であり、地域内拡散・サーベイランス困難が深刻化している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarna atinge três creches e chega a 108 casos em Mato Grosso do Sul - O melhor da informação!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of scabies hits three daycare centers and reaches 108 cases in Mato Grosso do Sul - The best information!
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of human scabies in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reaches 108 cases as of 16 November 2026, split between Dourados (74) and Itaporã (34). In Dourados, most cases are at CEIM Recanto Raízes (49), CEIM Beatriz de Barros Bumlai (15), and CEIM Professor Bertilo Binsfeld (10); Escola Municipal Franklin Luiz Azambuja has suspected cases and Recanto Raízes suspended classes. Authorities stress the outbreak did not originate in schools but was introduced there; the municipality is notifying Epidemiological Surveillance and deploying community health workers and Family Health Teams, with Tutelar Council involvement possible if families do not cooperate. In Itaporã, two creches are affected: Cmei Milton Milani will reopen; Cmei Maria Rodrigues Dias remains closed until 18 November, with seven cases. Transmission is via Sarcoptes scabiei mite through prolonged contact and contaminated fabrics; prevention includes hot-water washing (>55°C) and ironing; treatment aims to eliminate the mite and interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、マットグロッソ・ド・スルで疥癬のアウトブレイクが3つの保育施設に拡大、108例に達する
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度が低く、保育施設内での限定的な集団発生であり、地域の衛生当局が既に対応・管理しているため、国際的な公衆衛生リスクは低いと判断される。
triage.notes: 疥癬（ヒゼンダニによる接触感染）は一般的に軽症で、保育施設や家庭内での濃厚接触により拡大しやすいが、地域の疫学監視チームと家庭医療チームが既に介入しており、国家・国際的な関心や支援要請は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: OIF, violences en Afrique du Sud et Ebola en RDC : le point sur l'actualité [Africanews Today]
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: OIF, violence in South Africa and Ebola in the DRC: an update on current events [Africanews Today].
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak, Africa CDC reports over 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths as the virus continues to spread. South Africa faces deadly violence with at least 17 killed in shootings in Pretoria and Pietermaritzburg; investigations are ongoing. Ethiopia and Sudan accuse each other of backing armed groups across their frontier, heightening regional tensions. Francophonie postpones the next secretary-general election by one year amid Kinshasa–Kigali tensions and the Congo conflict. Cape Verde's José Maria Neves wins a second term with about 64% provisional, pledging focus on employment, health and education. Agenda highlights: Gambian presidential campaign opens Nov 16 ahead of the Dec 5 vote; Mozambique's Mondlane case starts Nov 17; ICJ to rule Nov 19 on Rohingya genocide; Pan-African Youth Forum in Addis Ababa (Nov 16–19); Marrakech Film Festival (Nov 20–28).

triage.headline_ja: OIF、南アフリカでの暴力、そしてコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱：アフリカのニュース最新情報 [Africanews Today]
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が発生から6か月で症例数11,000人超、死者5,400人超に達しており、重大な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事は複数のアフリカ関連ニュースをまとめたダイジェスト記事であり、エボラに関する言及はDRCの流行状況のみ。他地域（南アフリカ、エチオピア・スーダン、ルワンダ、ガンビア、モザンビーク、カーボベルデ、モロッコ）は政治・治安関連の別トピックでありエボラとは無関係のため verified_locations から除外した。症例数・死者数が非常に大きく、続報での詳細確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Four major Mumbai hospitals combined 16.7k dog bite cases in 7 months, 6,080 were Category 3
article.articleSummary: Dog bites in Mumbai: Four major city hospitals—JJ, KEM, Nair, and Sion—recorded 16,719 cases from April to October 2026, including 6,080 Category 3 (severe) bites. Immunoglobulin and anti-rabies vaccines (ARV) shortages drive referrals from suburban centers to larger hospitals; primary health centres are required to stock ARV, though stockouts have occurred historically. Anecdotes: a patient in Adarsh Nagar, Andheri, and a family in Oshiwara faced ARV unavailability at dispensaries before referral. An ICMR survey (last year) found only about 20.3% of 534 facilities across 15 states and 60 districts stocked ARV and rabies immunoglobulin in the public sector. BMC Executive Health Officer Dr Santosh Gaikwad says current dispensary stock is adequate; stock-outs are less frequent but can happen due to supplier disruptions, with authorities allowing local purchase.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイの主要4病院で7ヶ月間に犬咬傷16,700件、うちカテゴリー3は6,080件
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病予防ワクチン・免疫グロブリンの供給不足を示す継続的な公衆衛生課題だが、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではなく既知の構造的問題であるため、フルRRAには至らずWATCH対応とする。
triage.notes: 記事はムンバイ（インド）における犬咬傷件数と狂犬病予防薬の供給不足に関する内容。日本（Kyoto, Oshiwara表記あり）は地名の誤認識でBluedotが付与したものと考えられ、記事内容とは無関係（Oshiwaraはムンバイの地区名と推測される）。狂犬病自体の新規発生報告ではなく、医療供給体制の課題記事であるため新興感染症シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO "북한 결핵 확진자 중 약제내성 검사 비율 1.9%...세계 평균은 85%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Among confirmed tuberculosis cases in North Korea, the rate of drug susceptibility testing is 1.9%, while the world average is 85%.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports that in North Korea, among bacteriologically confirmed pulmonary tuberculosis cases last year, only 1.9% underwent rifampicin resistance testing (DST), far below the global average of 85%. North Korea is among 30 high-burden countries with DST below 50%, with Mozambique at 2.2% and the Democratic Republic of Congo at 30%; by contrast, 22 of the 30 high-burden countries achieve 80%+ DST. Rifampicin testing is crucial to selecting appropriate therapy, since rifampicin resistance necessitates second-line drugs. Globally, 8.4 million people were newly diagnosed with TB last year; 59% received WHO-recommended rapid diagnostics at first testing, and about 370,000 RR-TB cases were estimated, of which 155,333 (42%) were treated. Cure rates are ~90% for drug-susceptible TB vs ~70% for RR-TB. North Korea’s incidence estimates are under review and excluded from national maps, but NK remains among high-burden countries and contributed to over half of the global increase in TB preventive therapy among household contacts aged 5+.

triage.headline_ja: WHO「北朝鮮の結核確定患者のうち薬剤耐性検査実施率は1.9%…世界平均は85%」
triage.triage_reason: 北朝鮮における結核の薬剤感受性検査率の低さに関するWHOの統計報告であり、急性の発生・流行イベントではなく、対象国での具体的な発生事象でもないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は北朝鮮の結核診断能力（薬剤耐性検査率）に関するWHO報告。DRCやモザンビークは比較データとして言及されているのみで、当該国での発生イベントそのものではないため verified_locations には含めない。北朝鮮は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Rio de Janeiro soma 396 casos de mpox e confirma primeira morte no ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro reports 396 mpox cases and confirms the first death of the year.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Rio de Janeiro state: 396 confirmed cases in 2026, 297 in the capital, with Rio city ranking second nationally. The state reports its first mpox death of 2026: a man aged 40–49 with preexisting immunosuppression; death occurred in the second half of October after hospitalization at Fiocruz’s Instituto Nacional de Infectologia Evandro Chagas. Since mpox arrived in 2022, the accumulated case-fatality rate is 0.06%. In September–October, 74 cases were recorded in the state vs 10 in same period 2025; about 14% of cases required hospitalization. Testing free at UFRJ; appointments via WhatsApp (21) 96845-8188. Vaccination resumed in Rio on November 6, initially for adults with HIV/AIDS and CD4 <200; two-dose scheme, 28 days apart, outside the routine calendar. Five vaccination sites are listed in the city. Transmission mainly through contact with lesions, plus fluids, secretions, or contaminated items; close contact including sexual activity can spread mpox.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州でmpox症例396件、今年初の死亡例を確認
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準4項目(異常増加・重症度・持続曝露・流行しやすさ)に該当し、死亡例や入院例の増加など社会的関心も伴うため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 2022年以降継続流行中のmpoxだが、2025年同期比で症例数が大幅増加（74件 vs 10件）、初の死亡例確認、HIV陽性者への限定的ワクチン再開など、州レベルでの対応強化が進行中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose : plus d'un million de décès dans le monde en 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis: more than one million deaths worldwide in 2025.
article.articleSummary: Global tuberculosis deaths reached 1.13 million in 2025, a 35% decline over a decade but short of the 2015 targets. More than 10.0 million people developed TB that year, with over 80% of cases concentrated in 30 countries; India accounted for about a quarter of all cases, followed by Indonesia, the Philippines, China and Pakistan. Incidence declined only 14% since 2015, far from a 50% goal, with regional disparities: Europe −42%, Africa −30%, Eastern Mediterranean −6.6%, while the Americas saw a fifth consecutive year of rising incidence. TB remains the leading single-infectious-disease killer with 1.13 million deaths. Detection gaps persist: of 10.6 million ill in 2025, 8.4 million were diagnosed/reported, leaving about 2.2 million undiagnosed or unreported. For rifampicin-resistant TB, 42% of ~370,000 patients received treatment. International funding fell 14% to $940 million in 2025, though $6.6 billion was mobilized in low- and middle-income countries; a $22 billion annual need through 2027 remains unmet. WHO and UN urge expanded access, sustained financing, and new tools.

triage.headline_ja: 結核:2025年に世界で100万人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHOの年次结核统计レポートであり、新規かつ異常な発生事象ではなく、既知の慢性感染症に関する統計的報告のため、トリアージ対象のシグナルとはみなされない。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHOの世界結核年次報告書に基づく統計データの要約であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクイベントではない。資金不足や診断ギャップなど構造的課題への言及はあるが、緊急のリスク評価対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de mpox no Rio de Janeiro chegam a 396 no ano e estado confirma primeira morte de 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases in Rio de Janeiro reach 396 this year, and the state confirms its first death of 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, mpox (monkeypox) in Rio de Janeiro state has 396 confirmed cases, including the year's first death. The fatality occurred in late October; the patient was aged 40–49 with an immunosuppressive condition, hospitalized at Instituto Nacional de Infectologia Evandro Chagas (Fiocruz). Rio de Janeiro city accounts for 297 cases; vaccination resumed on 6 November for priority groups, now targeting people living with HIV/AIDS aged 18+, with CD4 counts below 200 cells/mm3. Citywide case fatality rate is 0.06%; statewide hospitalization rate stands at about 14%. Sept–Oct recorded 74 positives, up from 10 in 2025. Transmission concentrates among young men, often with recent sexual contact; infection spreads via direct contact with lesions, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects. Prevention emphasizes interrupting contact routes and hand hygiene; condoms alone are not enough. UFRJ offers free testing by online appointment via WhatsApp (21) 96845-8188; five vaccination hubs operate with varying hours.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州のエムポックス症例が今年396件に達し、2026年初の死亡例を確認
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州でエムポックス感染が前年比7倍に急増し、2026年初の死亡例が確認された。HIV陽性者など免疫不全層への感染拡大とワクチン接種再開など行政対応が進んでおり、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 死亡例はCD4<200の免疫抑制患者で発生。若年男性間の性的接触による感染が中心。ワクチン接種対象をHIV陽性者（CD4<200）に拡大するなど地域レベルでの対応が進行中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は記事上確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Surveillance Gaps in Indonesia Hinder Early Detection of Emerging Zoonotic
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's viral surveillance remains limited, resulting in substantial under-detection of zoonotic threats despite the country’s status as a global hotspot for viral emergence. The review notes SARS-CoV's multi-decade challenge and argues post-COVID-19 era still demands upgraded monitoring and heightened government and regional risk assessment. Ecological and demographic drivers—vast biodiversity including one of the planet’s largest bat populations, rapid population growth, deforestation, and land-use change—intensify wildlife-livestock-human interfaces, amplifying spillover risk, further shaped by cultural practices and climate-driven ecological shifts. Diagnostic gaps and incomplete visibility across ecosystems hinder timely detection. The study maps priority viral families in Indonesia, including Coronaviridae, Paramyxoviridae, Orthomyxoviridae (avian influenza), and others such as Flaviviridae, Filoviridae, Hantaviridae, Rhabdoviridae (lyssaviruses), Herpesviridae, Poxviridae (monkeypox), Reoviridae, and Hepeviridae (hepatitis E), with reservoir hosts. It outlines opportunities to strengthen surveillance to enable earlier detection of local spillovers, mitigating future pandemics from viral hotspots.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのサーベイランス格差が新興人獣共通ウイルスの早期検知を妨げる
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染症の発生事例ではなく、インドネシアにおけるサーベイランス体制の構造的課題を論じた総説記事であるため、直ちにRRAを要するシグナルではないが、将来のスピルオーバーリスクに関する継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の疾患アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、インドネシアの人獣共通感染症サーベイランス能力に関する学術的レビュー・総説である。具体的な症例数や発生状況は記載されていないため、将来的な関連報道の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Manila, Laguna regain bird flu-free status
article.articleSummary: Manila and Laguna in the Philippines have been declared free of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI), subtype H5N1, after laboratory tests yielded negative results. Manila recorded the first confirmed case in January 2023 in gamefowl chickens; Laguna reported 19 confirmed cases, mostly from backyard duck farms, with earlier 2022-2023 totals of 13 (San Pedro City and Victoria, Los Baños, Pangil) and six more in 2023 (Santa Cruz, Lumban). After detection, local authorities implemented depopulation, cleaning and disinfection, movement controls, and surveillance; stamping-out and biosecurity measures addressed the outbreak. The DA lists other free areas including Rizal, Ilocos Sur, Batangas, Capiz, Aurora, Ilocos Norte, Sultan Kudarat, Leyte, Cagayan, Camarines Norte, Camarines Sur, Bataan, Bulacan, Davao del Sur, South Cotabato, Cotabato and Quezon. The OIE notes status is achieved at least 28 days after stamping-out with no new cases. Status confirmed as of 16 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: マニラとラグナ、鳥インフルエンザ清浄地域の地位を回復
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの清浄化（終息）を報告する内容であり、新規発生や拡大の兆候はなく、動物（家禽）への影響のみでヒトへの感染報告もない。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox pode se manifestar com apenas uma bolha na pele, alerta infectologista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox can manifest with only a single blister on the skin, warns an infectious-disease specialist.
article.articleSummary: Brazil has 1,055 confirmed mpox cases through November 14, 2026, with 46 probable and 617 suspected, and one death in Rio de Janeiro. Mpox can begin with as few as a single skin blister, sometimes mistaken for herpes, highlighting the need for clinical evaluation. Typical symptoms include fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgias, chills, weakness, and skin lesions that may be localized or widespread, including the genital region. Diagnosis is usually confirmed by PCR testing of lesion material. Transmission occurs not only via intimate sexual contact but also through direct contact with lesions or secretions, contaminated objects, and prolonged exposure to respiratory droplets; precautions are advised until complete lesion healing. Most infections are mild to moderate with recovery in 2–4 weeks, though immunocompromised individuals face higher complication risks. Preventive measures: avoid contact with cases, don’t share personal items, wash hands, launder linens, disinfect surfaces, and isolate until healed.

triage.headline_ja: Mpoxは皮膚の水疱ひとつだけで発症することがあると感染症専門医が警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで既知のMpoxアウトブレイクが継続しており症例数（確定1,055例、死亡1例）が報告されているが、本記事は主に臨床的特徴に関する啓発記事であり新規の異常事態や国際的拡大の兆候は明確でない。
triage.notes: 記事はMpoxの臨床症状・感染経路に関する啓発情報が中心で、ブラジル国内の既存アウトブレイクの最新症例数（確定1,055、疑い617、死亡1）を報告している。新規の異常性や国際的懸念の明示的記述はなく、継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: IISc researchers combine antibiotics to tackle drug-resistant TB
article.articleSummary: Indian Institute of Science (IISc) researchers identify a strategy to restore isoniazid effectiveness against Mycobacterium tuberculosis, addressing drug-resistant TB. Testing on clinical isolates from patient sputum samples with drug-resistant TB, obtained via collaboration with the National Tuberculosis Institute, Bengaluru, showed that combining isoniazid with vancomycin substantially reduces bacterial growth, including MDR strains; most isolates achieved >90% growth reduction under combination therapy. Isoniazid is a prodrug activated by a bacterial enzyme; resistance mutations block activation, while vancomycin struggles to penetrate the M. tuberculosis cell wall. The combination appears to disrupt cell wall integrity, enabling vancomycin entry. In a mouse model infected with MDR M. tuberculosis, 10 days of combination therapy yielded about a 10-fold drop in bacterial load in lungs and spleen, and histology revealed fewer lung granulomas. The team plans to advance toward clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: IISc研究者、薬剤耐性結核対策のため抗生物質を併用
triage.triage_reason: 研究開発段階の基礎研究に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態やアウトブレイクの発生を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は薬剤耐性結核治療薬の併用療法に関する研究成果の報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではないため、感染症事象としてのトリアージ対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra primeira morte por mpox de 2026, no Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records first mpox death of 2026, in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports the first mpox death of 2026, in Rio de Janeiro, confirmed on November 13 and disclosed earlier this week. Mpox infections in Brazil exceed 1,000, with Rio de Janeiro leading at about 400, followed by São Paulo with over 380; Ceará, Minas Gerais, the Federal District and Santa Catarina also reported cases. The government has purchased 25,000 vaccine doses to reinforce the response. Vaccination targets include laboratory personnel handling the virus; people with HIV/AIDS and other immunosuppressed individuals; and direct contacts of suspected or confirmed mpox cases. Health authorities advise seeking care for suspicious lesions, especially genital, anal or oral regions, even without fever or enlarged lymph nodes. Preventive measures include avoiding direct contact with lesions and practicing safe sex; isolation of suspected/confirmed cases, hand hygiene, laundering contaminated items, and disinfecting surfaces. For animal reservoirs, avoid unprotected contact with wild animals and ensure meat is well cooked.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがリオデジャネイロで2026年初のエムポックス（サル痘）による死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 国内で1,000例を超える感染と初の死亡例が確認されており、重症度・感染持続性・感染拡大の可能性が高く、政府もワクチン購入等で対応を強化しているため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内（リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ等）でのエムポックス感染・死亡状況を報告しており、他対象国への言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Escabiose atinge 74 crianças em Dourados e fecha outra creche em Itaporã
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scabies affects 74 children in Dourados and closes another daycare center in Itaporã.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreak in Dourados and Itaporã, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil. In Dourados, 74 confirmed cases across three municipal early childhood centers: Recanto Raízes (Jardim Rasselen) 49; Beatriz de Barros Bumlai (BNH 4º Plano) 15; Professor Bertilo Binsfeld (Jardim Colibri) 10; one unit suspended due to new infections, while Franklin Luiz Azambuja has suspected cases awaiting confirmation. Health authorities convened school leaders to reinforce symptom recognition, hygiene, and reporting; teams will visit homes to monitor treatment. Officials say infections did not originate in schools but were introduced by already infected individuals. In Itaporã, two daycares closed; Milton Menani (about 300 children) reported 27 cases, eight-day closure, later reopened with two confirmed cases; Maria Rodrigues had seven cases (plus one staff) and remained closed for eight days. Cleaning campaigns are underway to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬が子供74人に感染し、ドウラードスとイタポランで保育園が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威となる重篤な感染症ではなく、局所的な保育施設内の感染拡大にとどまり、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに低い。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染するが重症度は低く、地域保健当局が通常の衛生対策・治療モニタリングで対応可能な事例。

article.articleHeadline: നെയ്യാറ്റിൻകര ടൗൺ പ്രദേശം കൊതുക് മയം ഉറക്കം നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ട് നാട്ടുകാർ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Neyyattinkara town area residents lose sleep due to itching.
article.articleSummary: Neyyattinkara town wards report severe mosquito nuisance as monsoon rains cause waterlogging, especially around the Neyyattinkara mini Civil Station area and Ezhakkulam in Aalummoodu ward. Stagnant water in streets and discharge areas has created abundant breeding sites, with residents blaming halted mosquito-control measures after sanitation work stopped. Residents fear dengue fever and chikungunya could spread, as fever cases are rising at the Neyyattinkara taluk hospital. They call for urgent fogging in the town and larvicidal treatment of waterlogged zones, along with timely waste clearance to curb vectors. The situation highlights gaps in vector control and sanitation, compelling local authorities to resume preventive actions to protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: ネイヤッティンカラ町地区で蚊の大量発生、住民がかゆみで眠れず
triage.triage_reason: 蚊の大量発生とデング熱・チクングニア熱の懸念が住民から挙がっているが、具体的な確定症例数や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示すデータが不足しており、局地的な衛生問題の域を出ていない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ケララ州ネイヤッティンカラの地域ニュースで、蚊の発生源と病原体媒介リスクへの懸念を伝える内容。デング熱・チクングニア熱の確定症例数の報告はなく、発熱症例増加との言及のみ。地域の衛生管理不備が流行の下地となっているため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго зарегистрировали более 11 300 случаев Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, more than 11,300 Ebola cases have been registered.
article.articleSummary: Since May 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo has registered more than 11,300 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with 5,568 deaths. The figures come from a bulletin of the National Institute of Public Health under the Ministry of Health of the country and were reported by TASS. The data indicate an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC. The article provides no details on symptoms, transmission chains, or laboratory confirmation methods beyond confirming cases, nor does it mention infection sources or any imported/exported cases. Public health authorities are monitoring the situation; the bulletin underscores the continued impact of the outbreak within the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者が11,300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%の大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 死亡者数5,568人・致死率約49%と非常に高く、感染経路や伝播チェーンの詳細は記事に記載がないため不明。続報での感染拡大状況と国際対応の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: صحيفة عمون : إيبولا في الكونغو .. هجمات مسلحة تعطل تتبع أكثر من ألف مخالط
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ammon News: Ebola in the Congo... Armed attacks disrupt contact tracing of more than a thousand contacts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is expanding in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the eastern provinces affected. Kantin-Aloya, North Kivu, was attacked, killing 66 civilians including 3 health workers and looting/burning 3 health facilities, disrupting contact tracing for more than 1,000 contacts. Since the outbreak began, confirmed cases exceed 11,000 and deaths surpass 5,400, with new infections ~400–500 weekly. Children account for over a quarter of confirmed cases and about a third of deaths; under-five case fatality near 70%. The World Health Organization warns that armed violence and insecurity impede outbreak response and access for medical teams, risking broader transmission in hard-to-reach or displaced communities. The health response remains challenged by security threats, limited tracing, and ongoing violence.

triage.headline_ja: アンモンニュース：コンゴでエボラ出血熱…武装攻撃により1000人以上の接触者追跡が妨害される
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（累計11,000例超、死者5,400人超）が武装勢力の攻撃により対応が妨げられており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 武装攻撃（北キブ州カンティン・アロヤ）により医療従事者3名を含む66人の民間人が死亡し、医療施設3か所が略奪・焼失。接触者追跡1,000人以上が中断され、治安悪化が感染拡大リスクを高めている。WHOも警鐘を鳴らしており、既存のエボラ大規模流行として継続的なモニタリングとリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : la prise en charge des patients au Centre de traitement d'Ebola est gratuite (Médecin traitant) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: Patient care at the Ebola Treatment Center is free of charge (Treating physician) - ACP
article.articleSummary: At the Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) in Kisangani, Northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, patient care is provided free of charge, as stated by treating physician Dr. Franck Botalema during a journalist-guided tour organized by FHI 360. No patient pays for consultations, treatment, or supplies used during hospitalization, including clothing provided. The holistic care covers both suspected and laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases. For post-hospitalization follow-up, patients who have recovered and those with negative test results and no persistent symptoms are allowed to return home. Patients who test negative but still require care for other conditions are referred to appropriate health facilities with a dedicated team ensuring continuity of care. Report dated November 16, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ：エボラ治療センターでの患者ケアは無料（主治医）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニでエボラ治療センターが稼働しており、実際にエボラ出血熱患者（疑い例・確定例）が治療を受けている状況が示されている。エボラはIHR基準・WPRO基準の両方で高リスク疾患であり、公衆衛生上の重大性とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性からフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は治療センターの無料ケア方針に焦点を当てているが、エボラ治療センターが運用中であることは現地でエボラ発生・対応が継続していることを示唆する。発生規模・死亡者数・感染拡大状況など詳細情報は記事に含まれておらず、フルRRAでの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Global Synthesis Details Foot-and-Mouth Disease Diversity and Heavy
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a highly contagious transboundary infection of cloven-hoofed livestock and wildlife. A global synthesis of 272 studies (1986–2025) shows FMD virus is an 8.4-kb positive-sense RNA Aphthovirus with seven immunologically distinct serotypes (O, A, C, Asia1, SAT1–SAT3) that lack cross-protection. Serotype C has not been detected since 2004 in Brazil and is presumed extinct; the others remain active with regionally distinct topotypes. In Southeast, Central, and East Asia serotype O dominates (Cathay, SEA, ME-SA), with Cathay linked to swine-adaptation via 3A deletions. In South Asia, O accounts for most outbreaks (India ~92%), while A and Asia1 are less common. Africa shows complex dynamics across East, North, West/Central, and Southern regions, with SAT2 prevalent in Southern Africa. South America has progressed toward elimination through vaccination and movement controls; confirmation of freedom remains challenging. Economic losses total 6.5–21B USD/year in endemic regions, plus ~1.5B USD in disease-free nations; Sub-Saharan Africa losses >2B, with implications for trade and vaccination programs, including potential outbreaks in high-income exporters like Australia.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫の多様性と重い経済的損失に関する世界的総括研究
