triage.notes: 記事は口蹄疫ウイルスの血清型・地域分布・経済損失に関するグローバルな総括レビューであり、特定の発生国における新規アウトブレイク報告ではないため、対象国の『実際の発生地域』としては特定できない。動物疾患であり人への感染報告もないため、EBSシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ceará sedia II Simpósio de Doenças Infecciosas e Inflamatórias | Portal Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceará hosts the Second Symposium on Infectious and Inflammatory Diseases | Fiocruz Portal
article.articleSummary: II Symposium on Infectious and Inflammatory Diseases will take place in Ceará, Brazil, from November 17–19, 2026. The free in-person event, organized by Fiocruz Ceará, IOC, Rede Translational Fio-Mucosa, TGHN LAC, and URCA, will run 8:30–17:00 Brasília time and gather researchers, health professionals, and students to share advances in infectious and inflammatory diseases. More than 20 speakers from Ceará, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Piauí and Espírito Santo will cover antimicrobial resistance, leishmaniasis, leprosy, fungal diseases, geohelminthiases elimination, RNA vaccines, and nanobodies for neglected diseases. The symposium aims to strengthen SUS and regional collaboration, bridging Southeast and Northeast institutions and supporting human resource development. Brazil reported 22,129 new Hansen’s disease cases in 2024, with the country ranking second globally after India. The program includes roundtables, short courses, posters, and closing remarks by Wilson Savino.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州で第2回感染症・炎症性疾患シンポジウム開催 | Fiocruzポータル
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学術シンポジウム開催の告知であり、新規の感染症発生やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・セアラ州で開催される学術イベントの告知。ハンセン病の国別症例数（ブラジル・インドの比較）に言及があるが、新規アウトブレイク報告ではないため対象国として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak still out of control six months on, Africa CDC warns
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak remains out of control six months after its 15 May declaration. The eastern DRC has recorded more than 11,200 infections and 5,500 deaths across eight provinces, driven by the Bundibugyo strain—the second-largest outbreak on record after 2014–2016. Originating in Ituri, the outbreak shows extensive community transmission, with about 80% of new cases not on contact lists and 65% of deaths in communities rather than hospitals. Cross-border spread has reached Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria; Uganda has brought the epidemic under control, Kenya discharged its final contact-tracing patient, and Nigeria reports improvement. Risks remain for Central African Republic and South Sudan, and Rwanda/Burundi could be affected if spread moves toward Goma and Bukavu. A Bundibugyo-specific vaccine is lacking, but the Tumaini trials and Ebo-Pep (obeldesivir) are in progress. About $2.9 billion in aid has been pledged, with $1.6 billion still needed; delivery is hampered by insecurity and payroll problems.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、発生から6カ月経っても制御不能とアフリカCDCが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,200人超の感染、5,500人超の死亡という大規模エボラ流行が制御不能な状態にあり、複数国への越境拡大も発生しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。中央アフリカ共和国、南スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジへのリスクも言及されているが対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: 中國疫情拉警報 中青年重症率高出近5倍 | 新變異株 PJ.2.1 | 封鎖消息 | 新冠後遺症
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's COVID-19 outbreak raises alarm | Severe illness rate among middle-aged and young people is nearly five times higher | New variant PJ.2.1 | Lockdown News | Long COVID
article.articleSummary: China faces a COVID-19 surge driven by the emergent variant PJ.2.1, with widespread southern transmission, notably Shenzhen, Guangdong. International agencies detected PJ.2.1 in wastewater in late October; domestic labs confirmed spread, but authorities reportedly blocked reporting. Severe illness among middle-aged and younger adults has risen nearly fivefold compared with prior waves, with a condition described as myalgic myelitis leading to paralysis highlighted by researchers. Shenzhen studies indicate post-COVID sequelae rose from ~30% to ~50%, prompting cancellation of further surveys due to alarmingly high figures. Summer infections left survivors with cardiopulmonary impairment; some require oxygen and experience recurrent hospitalizations. Outbreaks span Xinjiang, Northeast China, Yunnan, Guizhou, while Beijing and Shanghai wastewater signals trend upward and Guangdong, Sichuan, Chongqing remain high. Cold, fog, and pollution may worsen symptoms, compounding public health concerns.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の新型コロナ感染拡大が警鐘 | 中青年層の重症化率が約5倍に上昇 | 新変異株PJ.2.1 | 封鎖情報隠蔽 | コロナ後遺症
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1の出現と重症化率上昇が報じられているが、情報源が反体制系メディア（NTDTV）であり、当局による公式発表や第三者機関による検証が確認できないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 情報源が反体制系メディア（新唐人電視台）であり、中国当局による情報隠蔽を主張する内容を含むため、公式統計や独立した検証による裏付けが必要。排水サーベイランスでの検出報告など一部国際機関の関与が示唆されているが詳細不明。続報・公式発表の有無を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Logo : huit malades pris en charge malgré l'absence de nouveaux cas (médecin chef de zone) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Logo: eight patients treated despite no new cases (the zone's chief physician) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Eight patients with Ebola virus disease are being treated at the Ebola Treatment Center in Logo, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, from the Rimba health zone. Since October 4, no new cases have been reported in the Logo health zone, though the center currently cares for eight patients from Rimba. Among them, one has died; four are improving and could be discharged within the week; three have not yet shown satisfactory improvement. Health zone chief Dr. Josée Pirachel cautioned about rising infections in Rimba, attributing spread to persistent rumors and community resistance to control measures, including forcing some patients to seek treatment. Healthcare workers are among those affected. She urged the population to abandon rumors, report suspected cases promptly, and cooperate with response teams to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ログオでのエボラ出血熱：新規症例なしも8人の患者を治療中（ゾーン主任医師）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でエボラ出血熱の患者治療が継続中であり、死亡例や医療従事者への感染、住民の抵抗による感染拡大のリスクが報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngola（Lunda Norte Province含む）が挙げられているが、記事サマリーではDRCのイツリ州（Logo/Rimba保健ゾーン）のみが言及されており、Angolaは除外した。コミュニティの抵抗や噂によるアクセス困難、医療従事者感染が報告されており、継続的なモニタリングとリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura do Rio diz que casos de mpox cresceram acima do esperado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro City Hall says mpox cases rose above expectations
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) cases in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, rose above expectations, with 396 confirmed infections. The city recorded its first mpox death this year on 13 November; the patient was 40–49 years old and had a preexisting immunosuppressive condition contributing to severity. From September to October, 74 new cases were reported, compared with 10 in the same period in 2025. Vaccination resumed on 6 November, initially targeting HIV/AIDS patients 18+ with CD4 below 200 cells/mm³; expansion will occur as doses become available from the Ministry of Health. Brazil announced the purchase of 25,000 doses to bolster control. Mpox is a viral zoonosis caused by MPXV, formerly known as monkeypox. Transmission occurs via direct contact with skin or mucosal lesions, bodily fluids, respiratory secretions, or contaminated objects. Symptoms include fever, myalgia, headache, skin lesions that can blister, and lymphadenitis.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ市、mpox症例が予想を上回って増加と発表
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロでmpox症例が予想を上回って急増し、初の死亡例も確認された。IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性）を2つ以上満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 死亡例は免疫不全（HIV/AIDS関連）患者で発生。ワクチン接種はCD4低値のHIV患者を対象に再開、ブラジル政府が25,000回分を追加購入し対応中。国際的拡大の兆候については記事内に明確な記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Levantamento aponta risco de surto de dengue em Guaíra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Survey points to risk of dengue outbreak in Guaíra.
article.articleSummary: As of mid-November 2026, Guaíra, Brazil, faces dengue outbreak risk after a rapid survey (LIRAa) found a Residential Infestation Index of 6.6%. Of 1,323 inspected properties, 87 contained Aedes aegypti larvae, the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The 6.6% IIP places Guaíra in the Ministry of Health's 'outbreak risk' tier (<1% satisfactory; 1–3.9% alert; ≥4% indicates risk). This is the sole LIRAa for 2026; since July 2025, ovitraps monitor Aedes eggs across the area. In 2026, the municipality recorded 10 confirmed dengue cases. Warmer temperatures and rain ahead of summer could boost mosquito reproduction, underscoring the need to reduce breeding sites. Community participation is essential; actions include removing standing water, sealing tanks, cleaning gutters, checking plant pots, disposing of tires and rubbish, and following vector-control guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 調査によりガイラ市でデング熱アウトブレイクのリスクが指摘される
triage.triage_reason: 蚊幼虫指数に基づくリスク評価報告であり、2026年の確定症例数は10例と少なく、アウトブレイクや異常事態は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防的な蚊幼虫調査（LIRAa）結果の報告であり、実際の大規模アウトブレイク発生を示すものではない。継続的なベクター指数モニタリングが必要だが、現時点でのフルRRAは不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Maï-Ndombe : plus de 661.000 cas de paludisme enregistrés en 2025 - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maï-Ndombe: More than 661,000 malaria cases recorded in 2025 - ACP
article.articleSummary: Maï-Ndombe province in South-West Democratic Republic of Congo recorded 661,463 malaria cases and 1,290 deaths in 2025, a case fatality rate of 0.2%. Inongo announced during the launch of a mass insecticide-treated net distribution campaign. Children under five accounted for 52.5% of cases, highlighting vulnerability alongside pregnant women. The campaign provides 1,650,900 nets for 583,279 households across 14 health zones. The nets must be installed and used nightly by the entire family; misuse for fishing or garden protection will be sanctioned. Malaria remains the leading cause of consultations and deaths in local health facilities and a barrier to socio-economic development. The initiative, supported by the government and partners, aims to curb transmission through vector control in Maï-Ndombe.

triage.headline_ja: マイ＝ンドンベ州：2025年にマラリア症例が66万1000件以上記録 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるマラリアは既知の風土病であり、本記事は年間統計と防蚊キャンペーンの定例報告であって、異常な増加や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: マラリアはDRCの風土病であり、本記事は2025年の年間症例数（661,463件、死亡1,290件、致死率0.2%）と防虫蚊帳配布キャンペーンの開始を伝える定例的な公衆衛生報告。新規または異常な増加を示す情報はなく、既に政府・パートナーによる対策が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 avança em Aracruz e acende alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 advances in Aracruz and raises the alarm.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 activity rose in Aracruz, in the North of Espírito Santo, Brazil, prompting health authorities to monitor. From the start of 2026 through November 16, Aracruz recorded 432 COVID-19 notifications, with 78 confirmed cases and no deaths this year; hospital capacity remains stable, with no reported strain on the municipal health network. The rise is linked to an increasing test-positivity rate in the public-health system, though the article does not publish the current percentage or weekly comparisons, limiting assessment of outbreak magnitude. The city emphasizes continued vigilance, especially for older adults, pregnant people, immunocompromised individuals, and those with chronic diseases. Vaccination remains the primary protection against severe disease, hospitalizations, and deaths. In 2026, vaccines are offered to children 6 months–<5 years, pregnant people, and adults 60+, with additional priority groups. Vaccines are available at Aracruz UBS clinics; determine the need for dose updates at the reference unit.

triage.headline_ja: アラクルスでCOVID-19が増加し、警戒レベルが上昇
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の既知の季節的変動の範囲内であり、死亡者なし・医療逼迫なしと報告されているため、新規シグナルとしての異常性・緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。地元自治体レベルの定例的な警戒情報であり、死亡者ゼロ・医療体制安定と明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Mandima: 445 deaths reported out of 627 cumulative cases - ACP
article.articleSummary: Mandima health zone, Mambasa, Ituri Province, north-east Democratic Republic of the Congo, reports 627 cumulative Ebola virus disease cases and 445 deaths as of 16 November 2026, with 182 people alive. The case fatality rate is 70.9% (445/627). The figures underscore the severity of the outbreak and the major challenges in combating Ebola in Mandima. No further details are provided in the article about symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection source, or public health interventions. The epidemiological snapshot was dated Bunia, 16 November 2026, and consulted by CPA. The data illustrate a high mortality burden in this health zone, with seven out of ten recorded cases resulting in death.

triage.headline_ja: マンディマにおけるエボラ出血熱:累計627症例中445人死亡と報告 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州マンディマ保健ゾーンでエボラ出血熱の致死率が70.9%と極めて高く、公衆衛生上重大な影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率70.9%(445/627)という極めて高い数値が報告されているが、症状・検査確認・感染源・公衆衛生対応に関する詳細情報は記事に記載されていない。続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in the DRC: Response hampered by insecurity, WHO warns - ACP
article.articleSummary: WHO warns sustained Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the greatest challenge from rising insecurity, as response operations are disrupted and health workers attacked. Since the outbreak was declared six months ago, more than 11,000 people have been infected with Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo virus, and over 5,400 deaths have been reported. Transmission continues, with up to 500 new cases each week, and children account for more than one-third of deaths. Despite progress in hotspots, strengthening treatment centers, laboratory capacity, and healthcare worker training, the field has recorded more than 80 attacks on health services in six months, limiting access, surveillance, and treatment, and causing displacement. The WHO emphasizes sustained response using early case detection, patient care, contact tracing, and community engagement, alongside ongoing research into treatments and vaccines to save lives and interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱：治安悪化が対応を妨げているとWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで感染者11,000人超・死者5,400人超、週500例の新規感染が続く大規模エボラ流行であり、治安悪化により対応が阻害されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHOが治安悪化による対応阻害を警告する大規模エボラ流行（Bundibugyoウイルス株）。6ヶ月で11,000人超感染、5,400人超死亡、80件超の医療施設への攻撃が報告されており、フルRRAによる継続評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: Insecurity, distrust hinder Ebola response efforts
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) persists six months after declaration, with >11,200 confirmed cases and ~5,500 deaths. Declared May 15 in Ituri Province, the epidemic has spread to eight provinces and 67 health zones, with about 90% of cases in Ituri and North Kivu. Origin traced to Mongwalu, a mining town about 50 km north of Bunia. Resurgences have been reported in Fataki, Kilo, Drodro, and Mahagi (Ituri) and in Beni, Butembo, Oicha (North Kivu). Insecurity, public distrust, and difficult contact tracing hinder response; roughly 60 incidents targeting health workers or facilities have occurred in six months. Africa CDC notes 64% of deaths occur in the community, underscoring barriers to care and early detection. Uganda has also reported cases, though no new cases since July.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：治安悪化と不信感がエボラ対応活動を阻害
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は6ヶ月継続し、11,200例超・死者5,500人超、8州67保健地区に拡大、ウガンダにも波及しており、IHR基準4項目すべて該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例報告があるが7月以降新規例なしとのことで、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。治安悪化・医療従事者への攻撃（約60件）が対応を著しく阻害している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : plus de 450 cas et 82 décès de choléra enregistrés à
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: more than 450 cholera cases and 82 deaths recorded in.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak intensifies in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in North Kivu’s Masisi and Walikale territories, with secondary transmission in parts of South Kivu. Since the outbreak was officially declared on 19 September, the Katoyi health zone has recorded more than 450 cases and 82 deaths. Two additional cholera deaths were reported overnight Sunday–Monday, 16 November 2026, in Bitoyi and Kirambo health centers (Ufamandu II groupement, Masisi). The epidemic has spread to Kibua and Itebero in Walikale, and hundreds of cases are reported in Ziralo, South Kivu, including many displaced persons. Response is hindered by insecurity and logistical constraints; a 17-carton batch of IV fluids for severely dehydrated patients has been blocked for about two weeks roughly 40 km from the affected area amid clashes in Masisi. North Kivu’s Division of Health had not yet commented at publication.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：コレラ感染者450人以上、死者82人を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で高致死率（約18%）のコレラ流行が拡大し、南キブ州にも波及、紛争による人道支援物資の輸送妨害も発生しており、IHR基準2件以上・WPRO基準複数該当のためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にアルメニア（Aragatsotni Marz）が含まれているが、記事主題はDRC北キブ・南キブ州のコレラ流行であり、アルメニアは無関係のため除外した。紛争による医療物資輸送の妨害が被害拡大の要因となっている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis Care Delays Exceed Acceptable Limits Across Seven High-Burden
article.articleSummary: TB care delays across seven high-burden countries exceed the conventional 30-day threshold for timely TB management. Pooled mean patient delay is 24.65 days (95% CI 21.19–28.10) and treatment delay 8.96 days (95% CI 7.64–10.28). Bangladesh records the highest diagnosis delay at 93.50 days (95% CI 55.13–131.87); India shows the longest patient delay (129.33 days, 95% CI 26.32–232.35) and treatment delay (149.67 days, 95% CI 74.54–224.79). Across 79 studies (n=6,477,766 participants), the seven-country analysis excludes the Democratic Republic of Congo due to no eligible data and accounts for about 63% of global TB burden. Substantial heterogeneity and publication bias were detected; COVID-19 had heterogeneous impacts on delays across settings. The authors call policy action to reduce both patient and health-system delays to interrupt transmission, drawing on data from PUBMED/Scopus/Embase/Web of Science using a DerSimonian-Laird random-effects model.

triage.headline_ja: 7つの高負担国における結核ケアの遅延が許容限度を超える
triage.triage_reason: 急性の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、結核診療における遅延に関する学術的メタ解析（システマティックレビュー）であり、公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要するシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の急性アウトブレイクではなく、7つの高負担国（バングラデシュ、インド等）における患者遅延・治療遅延に関する79研究（参加者647万7766人）のメタ解析。DRCはデータ不足のため分析から除外されている。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。新興感染症イベントのシグナルではなく、研究論文の紹介記事のためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox avança no Rio, chega a 396 casos e registra primeira morte em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox advances in Rio de Janeiro, reaching 396 cases and reporting its first death in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, reached 396 confirmed cases and one death in 2026 as of 16 November. The state also logged 281 suspected cases under investigation, while Brazil overall has 1,099 confirmed cases and one death this year. To improve transparency and surveillance, the Rio de Janeiro State Health Secretariat began daily updates on suspected, confirmed, and discarded cases and expanded training for clinicians. About 500 health professionals were trained, with technical support to 92 municipalities to strengthen early case identification and transmission control. The fatal case involved a resident of the capital with preexisting immunosuppression. Mpox is caused by the MPXV (Orthopoxvirus) and typically presents with skin or mucosal lesions, fever, headache, muscle pain, lymphadenopathy, fatigue; transmission mainly via direct contact with lesions or secretions. Not all notifications are confirmed cases; investigations remain ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでMpoxが拡大、396例に達し2026年初の死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州でMpox感染が継続拡大し初の死亡例が発生、州保健当局が監視強化と臨床医研修を実施するなど行政的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 死亡例は免疫抑制状態の基礎疾患を有する患者であり、全体の致死率は低い。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報はなく、ブラジル国内での既知の継続的流行パターンとみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ribeirão Preto registra 14 mortes por tuberculose em 2026; veja sintomas e como fazer o teste rápido
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ribeirão Preto reports 14 deaths from tuberculosis in 2026; see symptoms and how to perform the rapid test.
article.articleSummary: Ribeirão Preto, Brazil reports 14 tuberculosis deaths from January 1 to November 6, 2026, with a 39% reduction from 23 deaths in the same period in 2025. In 2025, there were 235 new TB diagnoses (32.12 per 100,000 population), and since 2022 the city’s incidence has remained above 29 per 100,000. The disease more affects men (2025 incidence 45.7 per 100,000) than women (19.7), with most cases in adults aged 30–59. Transmission is respiratory, underscoring the importance of early diagnosis to prevent spread. Guidance: general population should seek care for a cough lasting three weeks or more; immunosuppressed individuals should seek evaluation for any cough; other signs include chest pain and fever. Diagnosis is via rapid molecular testing with results in up to 24 hours; positive cases proceed to Specialized Care Service for at least six months of treatment.

triage.headline_ja: リベイラン・プレト市、2026年の結核死亡者数14人を報告；症状と迅速検査の方法
triage.triage_reason: 結核死亡数は前年比39%減少しており、既知の風土病として通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核はブラジルの対象国リストに含まれないため（Brazilは3469034だが対象国リストにないため）verified_locationsは空配列とする。記事は地域の年次統計報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue pode atingir 1,7 milhão de brasileiros em 2027; veja como se proteger
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue could reach 1.7 million Brazilians in 2027; see how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-16, Brazil could record about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027, according to InfoDengue/Fiocruz, driven by heat and rain that favor Aedes aegypti breeding. Prevention combines vaccination where indicated with domestic vector-control to reduce risks. The Qdenga vaccine from Takeda is given in two doses, three months apart, for people aged 4–60 years, regardless of prior dengue infection, and helps reduce the risk of severe disease and hospitalizations. Alongside vaccination, regular removal of standing water is essential to interrupt the mosquito life cycle. Cleaning water-holding containers with water and neutral detergent, scrubbing to remove eggs, then keeping containers dry or protected from rain is recommended. Common water-collection sites include plant saucers, buckets, bottles, toys, drains, and gutters. Prevention relies on simple, frequent actions plus repellents and vaccination per health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、2027年にブラジルで170万人に達する可能性；予防法を見る
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで毎年流行する季節性デング熱に関する2027年の将来予測・予防啓発記事であり、異常事態や新規発生を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はInfoDengue/Fiocruzによる2027年の将来予測と予防ガイダンスであり、現時点での異常なアウトブレイクの報告ではない。デング熱はブラジルで季節性・常在性の疾患であり、定期的な公衆衛生広報の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Sorocaba confirma quarto caso de mpox em 2026 após investigação | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sorocaba confirms fourth mpox case in 2026 after investigation | TVS+
article.articleSummary: Sorocaba confirms the fourth mpox case in 2026 after investigating an October 2026 suspected case. The municipality has three imported mpox confirmations this year, with 16 cases ruled out and no deaths. The three February confirmations involved two men and one woman; the October case remains under investigation, with a victim treated for an arm injury and a suspect detained outside the hospital, also with a wound. In the surrounding region, Jundiaí registered its first mpox case of 2026 on March 9 (man, 30–39, symptoms began Feb 22; lab-confirmed); Jundiaí reported three cases in 2025 and five in 2024, while Várzea Paulista also reported one case this year. Mpox spreads via close contact and can involve contaminated materials or infected wildlife, especially rodents. Diagnosis relies on lesion swabs; isolation lasts 21 days or until lesions heal. Brazil authorized up to 20,000 vaccine doses from PAHO funds; a two-dose, 28-day apart schedule prioritizes people with HIV/AIDS and CD4 <100, among others, with post-exposure vaccination within 4 days (up to 14 days). Brazil tallies 665 mpox cases in 2026, down 94% from 2022.

triage.headline_ja: ソロカバ市、調査の結果2026年4例目のエムポックス感染を確認 | TVS+
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでエムポックスの散発例が継続しているが、死亡例なく、2022年比94%減少と既知の流行の範囲内であり、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域的な低レベル発生として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州ソロカバ及び周辺都市（Jundiaí、Várzea Paulista）での散発的なエムポックス症例を報告。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。HIV感染者へのワクチン優先接種方針に言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: RN tem oito casos registrados de mpox em 2026 - Tribuna do Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Norte has eight registered mpox cases in 2026 - Tribuna do Norte
article.articleSummary: Mpox totals in Brazil reach 1,099 cases as of 16 November 2026. Rio Grande do Norte reports eight cases (six confirmed, two probable), with all RN cases registered between weeks 7–16 and the last RN case in April. Nationwide, São Paulo has 409 cases and Rio de Janeiro 395. The first mpox death occurred in Rio de Janeiro city; Fiocruz says the patient was treated at the Instituto Nacional de Infectologia Evandro Chagas and died in October. Mpox is caused by the monkeypox virus (MPXV); symptoms include skin and mucosal lesions, fever, headache, and body aches. Prevention centers on avoiding direct contact with suspected cases, especially lesions. Lesions vary and can appear on the face, hands, feet, and genitals. Treatment relieves symptoms and prevents complications; seek care for suspected lesions, particularly genital, anal, or oral, even without fever or enlarged lymph nodes.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・ノルテ州、2026年にMpox症例8件を記録 - トリブーナ・ド・ノルテ紙
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで継続中のMpox流行に関する定期報告記事であり、新規性・異常性は低いが、死亡例の発生や継続的な症例報告があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルにおけるMpox流行の定期的な症例報告であり、全国で1,099例、リオデジャネイロ市で初の死亡例が報告されている。既知の継続的流行であり新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低いが、死亡例の発生を踏まえ動向を注視すべき。Chagas病への言及はタグ付けのみで本文には記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: O que se sabe sobre a primeira morte por mpox confirmada no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is known about the first mpox-related death confirmed in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: First mpox-related death confirmed in Brazil this year occurred in Rio de Janeiro's capital. Brazil reports 1,099 confirmed mpox infections and 617 suspected cases under investigation. São Paulo leads with 409 confirmed cases, followed by Rio de Janeiro state with 395; Rio's capital accounts for about 71% of its 382 infections through Nov 13. Ceará (61), Minas Gerais (45), and Distrito Federal (41) also reported cases. In Rio de Janeiro state, 382 infections are confirmed as of Nov 13, with 258 notified since Sep 13. Typical symptoms include vesicular rash evolving to crusts; incubation 3–16 days, up to 21. Transmission is by direct contact with lesions or contaminated objects. No specific treatment exists; care is supportive. Vaccination: on Nov 8, Health Ministry negotiated 25,000 doses with a single manufacturer; two-dose scheme (28 days apart), intradermal, for lab workers, people with HIV, and exposed contacts. 2022 saw 10.5k cases and 14 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで確認された初のMpox関連死亡例について判明していること
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年初のMpox関連死亡例が確認され、複数州（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ、セアラ等）で1,000例超の感染が継続的に報告されており、HIV陽性者など脆弱層への感染拡大とワクチン供給不足の懸念からIHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 2022年にも流行歴があるMpoxだが、今回は死亡例の発生とHIV陽性者等の脆弱層への感染、ワクチン供給量（25,000回分）の不足が新たな懸念点。国際的拡大リスクについては記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Gilead Expands Access to Investigational Obeldesivir for Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease Through Voluntary Licensing
article.articleSummary: Gilead expands access to its investigational antiviral obeldesivir for Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) through royalty-free voluntary licenses with Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Eva Pharma and Ferozsons Laboratories, covering 127 low- and lower-middle-income countries, including all African nations that have reported cases in the current Ebola BVD outbreak. The licenses authorize manufacturing and supply in the licensed territory pending supportive clinical data and regulatory approvals, with technology transfer already underway. Obeldesivir is being evaluated in the Ebola Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (EBO-PEP) Phase 3 field trial; it is not approved for PEP of filovirus disease anywhere. This effort complements Gilead's outbreak preparedness efforts, including compassionate-use remdesivir donations totaling more than 38,000 vials to the DRC, Uganda and Kenya. Remdesivir, while approved for COVID-19 in about 50 countries, has no established efficacy for Ebola BVD, 2026-11-16.

triage.headline_ja: ギリアド、エボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス病治療薬オベルデシビルへのアクセスをボランタリーライセンスにより拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダ・ケニアで報告が続くエボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス病の現行アウトブレイクに関する内容で、重篤な公衆衛生影響と複数国への拡大が確認されるためIHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はGileadによる治療薬アクセス拡大（企業対応）の発表であり新規感染拡大情報ではないが、背景にある現行エボラBVDアウトブレイク自体はDRC・ウガンダ・ケニアで継続中。対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当し、ウガンダ・ケニアはリスト外のためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Gilead signs licensing deals for Ebola drug obeldesivir By Investing.com
article.articleSummary: Gilead Sciences signed royalty-free licensing agreements for obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis for Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease. Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Eva Pharma and Ferozsons Laboratories will be authorized to manufacture and supply obeldesivir in 127 mainly low- and lower-middle-income countries, including all African countries with reported cases in the current outbreak, subject to clinical data and regulatory approvals. The licenses aim to support manufacturing readiness, technology transfer and supply planning while a Phase 3 randomized, placebo-controlled post-exposure prophylaxis trial coordinated by ALIMA and partners progresses. Additional manufacturers are under discussion. Obeldesivir has shown preclinical activity against filoviruses and is not approved for prevention anywhere. Gilead updated remdesivir licensing to cover filovirus disease; donations include over 2,000 vials to Kenya for investigational use and more than 38,000 vials as compassionate use to DRC, Uganda and Kenya. Remdesivir efficacy for Ebola BVD is unestablished and it is not approved for treatment or prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ギリアド、エボラ治療薬オベルデシビルのライセンス契約を締結（Investing.com）
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既存のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクに対する医薬品ライセンス供与・供給体制に関する商業ニュースであり、新規の症例増加や流行拡大を示す一次情報ではないが、進行中のアウトブレイク対応状況として継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクに対するギリアド社の医薬品ライセンス契約・供給体制に関する内容であり、具体的な症例数・発生地域の詳細は記載されていない。ウガンダ・ケニアも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: OIF, violence in South Africa and Ebola in the DRC: your news roundup [Africanews Today]
article.articleSummary: International Organisation of La Francophonie (OIF) postpones its Secretary-General election by one year amid tensions between Kinshasa and Kigali over the Democratic Republic of Congo conflict. In South Africa, deadly gun violence continues, with at least 17 people killed in two shootings in Pretoria and Pietermaritzburg, as authorities probe the circumstances. Tensions escalate between Ethiopia and Sudan, with both nations trading accusations of backing armed groups along the shared border. Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the virus persists, with Africa CDC reporting over 11,000 cases and about 5,400 deaths as health authorities press containment efforts. In Cape Verde, incumbent President José Maria Neves wins re-election with provisional results near 64%.

triage.headline_ja: OIF、南アフリカでの暴力、そしてコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱：本日のアフリカニュースまとめ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが6ヶ月継続し、Africa CDC報告で症例数11,000超、死亡者5,400人という極めて深刻な規模に達しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は複数トピックのニュースまとめだが、エボラに関する記述はDRCのアウトブレイクに限定される。症例数・死亡者数は非常に大きく、過去最大規模に近い可能性があり、続報での数値確認が必要。南アフリカ・スーダン・エチオピア・カーボベルデの話題はエボラとは無関係で、対象国リストにも該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Over 9,000 Hubei Foodborne Illness Cases Reported Watermelon Consumption
article.articleSummary: From 2013–2023, Hubei Province, China, recorded 9,662 watermelon-associated foodborne illness cases, comprising 48.22% of fruit-related illnesses (20,034) and about 4.3% of the province’s 227,099 total foodborne cases. Cases rose from 33 in 2013 to 2,641 in 2023. Geographic spread across all 17 prefectures shows Shiyan (1,318 cases, 13.64%) and Wuhan (1,267, 13.11%) as the top localities; Shennongjia forestry district had as few as 30. Demographically, peaks occur among children under six and adults over 40 (together 66.8%); farmers account for 40.3%. Clinically, virtually all patients had gastrointestinal symptoms (99.35%), with diarrhea (94.52%) and abdominal pain (53.08%). Exposure categories include cold watermelon (47.51%) and exclusive watermelon (32.55%). Etiological confirmation was limited (47/1,676; 2.80%), with norovirus documented in 22 cases. The study uses descriptive national surveillance data to guide targeted public health action.

triage.headline_ja: 湖北省で9,000件超の食品媒介疾患、スイカ摂取との関連が報告
triage.triage_reason: 2013〜2023年の過去10年間の湖北省における食品媒介疾患（スイカ関連）の記述疫学調査報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではなく、新規性・緊急性に乏しいため見送り。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去10年間（2013-2023）のサーベイランスデータに基づく記述的研究であり、ノロウイルスはわずか22例で病因確定率も低い（2.80%）。現在進行中の感染症危機ではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Rio de Janeiro atualiza diariamente dados de mpox após avanço de casos -- Política Distrital agora é PDNews, notícias sobre Política e Saúde do DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro updates mpox data daily after a surge in cases -- Política Distrital is now PDNews, news about Politics and Health in the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro state will update mpox epidemiological records daily from 16 November 2026, reporting 396 confirmed mpox cases and one death in 2026, with 281 cases under investigation. Weekly notifications surged 15-fold since September, rising from 13 to 206 between 8–14 November, signaling a continued outbreak growth since the Sept 13–19 epidemiological week. Authorities trained 500 health professionals to recognize and manage suspected mpox, and technical teams assist all 92 municipalities in surveillance and response. Nationally, Brazil records 1,099 confirmed cases and one death in 2026. Transmission occurs via close contact with infected individuals, especially direct contact with skin and mucosal lesions; symptoms include rash, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, myalgias, chills, and fatigue, with higher risk for people living with HIV. Vaccination is advised for priority groups in the public network: lab workers handling viral samples, immunocompromised individuals, people living with HIV/AIDS, PrEP users, and those with high-risk exposure. Background: mpox was identified in 1958 in captive monkeys in Denmark; first human case in 1970 in the DRC; probable rodent reservoirs; Brazil’s 2022 outbreak caused ~14 deaths and >10,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州、mpox症例急増を受け毎日データを更新 -- Política Distrital社は現在PDNewsとして、連邦直轄区の政治・保健ニュースを配信
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州でmpoxの週次報告数が9月以降15倍に急増し、396例・死亡1例が確認されるなど、異常な増加傾向と社会的関心の高まりが見られるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: DRCおよびデンマークはmpoxの歴史的背景（1958年デンマークで発見、1970年DRCで初のヒト症例）として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose: casos aumentam no ES, mas mortes diminuem
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis: Cases on the Rise in Espírito Santo, but Deaths Are Decreasing.
article.articleSummary: Global tuberculosis (TB) mortality reached about 1.13 million deaths in 2025, with roughly 10.6 million new cases and 2.2 million undiagnosed or unregistered, per the WHO Global TB Report 2026 released November 12. In Espírito Santo, Brazil, 1,916 TB cases and 113 deaths occurred in 2025, up from 1,882 cases and 146 deaths in 2024, while deaths declined. Americas TB incidence rose for a fifth consecutive year in 2025, 13% above 2015. Drug resistance is rising: about 370,000 people developed rifampicin-resistant TB in 2025, with only 42% treated. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis and spreads via airborne transmission, typically to the lungs but can affect other organs. Treatment is free through Brazil’s SUS and lasts at least six months; adherence is critical to prevent resistance. Early diagnosis reduces transmission; persistent cough warrants medical evaluation, ahead of National TB Day on November 17.

triage.headline_ja: 結核:エスピリトサント州で症例増加、死亡者数は減少
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の疾患で、エスピリトサント州では死亡者数は減少傾向にあり、WHO報告に基づく定例統計記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 世界結核デー（11月17日）前の啓発記事であり、ブラジル・エスピリトサント州の年次統計報告。薬剤耐性結核の増加は世界的課題だが本記事の主題は地域統計であり、緊急シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Pacientes relatam sintomas de casos suspeitos de Covid-19 em Amargosa e região | Criativa On Line
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients report symptoms of suspected COVID-19 cases in Amargosa and the surrounding region | Criativa On Line
article.articleSummary: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG)-associated with COVID-19 alerts reach Amargosa and surrounding Bahia region in Brazil, with local hospitals reporting patients with respiratory symptoms and suspected COVID-19 requiring admission, though cases described as non-severe and patients discharged. The Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin notes rising signals in six states. In Bahia, Sesab data show a 70% reduction in severe COVID-19 cases from January to October 2026 compared with the same period in 2025, with Fiocruz monitoring placing Bahia at a safe activity level. Despite the downtrend, the emergence of new cases underscores ongoing epidemiological surveillance, case follow-up, and prevention actions. Vaccination remains crucial, especially for older adults, people with comorbidities, and other vulnerable groups; continue vaccination, seek care for respiratory symptoms, and maintain SUS-based monitoring to protect the population and sustain gains against COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: アマルゴーザおよび周辺地域でCOVID-19疑い症例の症状が報告される | Criativa On Line
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の疾患で、症例は軽症とされ、地域の重症例は前年比70%減少しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルはBluedot対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。記事はルーティンのサーベイランス報告であり、COVID-19の季節的な動向を示すもので、特段のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Gilead signs generic licensing deals for experimental Ebola drug
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, Gilead signed royalty-free deals with Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Eva Pharma and Ferozsons Laboratories to manufacture obeldesivir, an experimental Ebola prevention drug. The agreements cover 127 low- and lower-middle-income countries and include all African countries reporting cases in Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak. Obeldesivir has shown activity against several Ebola-related viruses in preclinical studies but is not approved for any use. A late-stage trial is testing the drug in people at high risk after exposure, with the deals intended to line up manufacturing and supply before trial results and regulatory filings. Gilead is expanding remdesivir licenses to cover Ebola-related diseases if results are positive and regulators approve. The company has donated more than 38,000 remdesivir vials to DRC, Uganda and Kenya, including 2,000 recently to Kenya for investigational treatment and post-exposure prevention. Remdesivir is not approved to treat or prevent Ebola Bundibugyo disease, and its effectiveness is unestablished.

triage.headline_ja: ギリアド社、エボラ出血熱実験薬のジェネリック医薬品ライセンス契約を締結
triage.triage_reason: エボラ・ブンディブギョ型アウトブレイク（DRC等）に関連する国際的な医薬品供給体制構築の動きであり、IHR基準（深刻性・国際的拡大）を満たすため、既存アウトブレイクの進展として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ治療薬（obeldesivir、remdesivir）のライセンス契約・供給体制に関する内容であり、新規症例報告は含まれない。アウトブレイク自体はDRC、ウガンダ、ケニアで報告されているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tecpar reforça importância da vacinação para prevenção da raiva humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tecpar reinforces the importance of vaccination for the prevention of human rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination in Brazil: the Instituto de Tecnologia do Paraná (Tecpar) was selected in 2025 as the sole public laboratory supplying the human rabies vaccine for the Ministry of Health, via a technology-transfer partnership with Sinovac under the PDP. Rabies is lethal after symptoms but preventable with vaccination and rapid post-exposure prophylaxis; Brazil has only two reported human survivors. The vaccine, available through the SUS, can be given pre-exposure for high-risk professionals or immediately after exposure. Tecpar's move aims to strengthen SUS and reduce import dependence; the vaccine has been registered with China's NMPA, and Anvisa submission will assess quality, safety, efficacy, and Brazilian manufacturing conditions. Transmission occurs through saliva after animal bites, scratches, or mucosal contact; incubation averages ~45 days, with early nonspecific symptoms and later neurologic signs. Dogs and cats are main urban transmitters, but wildlife reservoirs like bats, foxes, saguis, keep transmission ongoing; vigilance remains.

triage.headline_ja: Tecpar、ヒト狂犬病予防のためのワクチン接種の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病ワクチンの国内製造・供給体制強化に関する一般的な公衆衛生広報記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおける狂犬病ワクチンの国内生産体制（Tecparと中国Sinovacの技術移転）に関する内容で、具体的な発生事例や症例数の報告はない。中国は技術提携先として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 流行継続で史上最悪恐れ　エボラ熱緊急宣言から半年
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear of the worst in history as the outbreak continues—six months since the Ebola emergency declaration.
article.articleSummary: Six months after WHO declared a public health emergency, Ebola virus disease continues in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Congolese Ministry of Health reports 11,376 laboratory-confirmed infections and 5,568 deaths. The outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, carries about a 50% case fatality rate, with roughly 70% mortality among children under five. The current outbreak ranks among the largest since the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which infected over 28,000 and killed more than 11,000. A joint WHO-CDC statement notes more than a quarter of cases are children. Ongoing fighting between government forces and armed groups hampers contact tracing, with officials indicating that more than 80% of recent infections were not traced to a known contact.

triage.headline_ja: 流行継続で史上最悪恐れ　エボラ熱緊急宣言から半年
triage.triage_reason: WHOが緊急事態を宣言してから半年が経過してもコンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続し、致死率約50%、死者5,568人に達する大規模アウトブレイクであり、紛争により接触者追跡も困難なため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC東部でのアウトブレイクのみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生については記載がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Del Val invita a vigilar para evitar otra posible crisis infecciosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Del Val urges vigilance to prevent another potential infectious outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, virologist Margarita del Val argues for vigilance and proactive surveillance to prevent outbreaks. She notes post-COVID shifts: faster international cooperation, stronger health systems, and a shift from reactive to anticipatory responses. In Spain, vector-borne risks include tiger mosquito spreading dengue with cases in the Balearic Islands, and West Nile virus circulating in parts of Andalusia since 2020 (no vaccine yet; control via larvicides). Monkeypox re-emerged in Spain in 2022 and surged again in 2024 due to a new variant; vaccines essential. Avian influenza remains mostly animal-to-human with limited human transmission. Hantavirus outbreaks linked to a Canary Islands cruise prompted international mobilization. The most dire threat is Ebola Bundibugyo in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with over 10,000 cases and export to France; five vaccines in development, with trials begun in 57 days. Lessons: readiness, vaccine development timelines under 100 days, and understanding 30 virus families.

triage.headline_ja: デル・バル氏、次なる感染症危機を防ぐための警戒を呼びかける
triage.triage_reason: 記事中でDRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行（1万例超）とフランスへの輸出例が言及されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）を複数満たすため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 本記事はスペインの研究者による一般的な感染症警戒を呼びかける意見記事であり、複数の疾病（デング熱、西ナイル熱、サル痘、鳥インフルエンザ、ハンタウイルス、エボラ）が併記されている。主たる懸念点はDRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行とフランスへの輸出例であり、スペイン・フランスは対象国リスト外のため除外した。記事本文が空欄のため詳細な数値の信頼性は未確認。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲疾控中心：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情仍未得到控制
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled, Africa CDC Director Kassaye said on November 15 in Ethiopia. The outbreak, first declared May 15 in DR Congo, has surpassed 11,000 cumulative cases and 5,400 deaths. It has spread to eight provinces and 67 health zones, with new weekly cases still about 400–500. If not brought under effective control, this wave could become the deadliest Ebola outbreak on record. The crisis is compared with the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic, which infected over 28,600 and killed more than 11,000. Emphasis is placed on deep community engagement and locally tailored response. A photograph shows health workers disinfecting in Ituri Province, highlighting ongoing containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は依然として制御されていない
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が11,000例・5,400人死亡と大規模化し、8州67保健区域に拡大、週400-500例の新規発生が続いており制御不能な状態。IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にEthiopia、Angolaが含まれるが、記事はDRCでのエボラ流行自体を主題としており、Ethiopiaはアフリカ CDC本部所在地としての言及に過ぎないため除外。致死率の高さと史上最悪級の規模となる可能性から緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Distrito Federal registra déficit na vacinação contra sarampo e alerta para risco de contágio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal District records a deficit in measles vaccination and warns of the risk of contagion.
article.articleSummary: Measles risk rises in Brazil’s Federal District, Brasília, as vaccination gaps persist: about 21% of 2-year-olds have not completed the measles-containing vaccine series, and 9.1% have not received the first dose. SES-DF targets 95% coverage for children up to two years. Adult uptake surpassed 51,000 doses in 2026. Brazil reported 65 measles cases in 2026, mainly in São Paulo; Amazonas near Colombia and Peru borders also have cases. The Federal District has no confirmed 2026 cases, but travel raises reintroduction risk. Vaccination is free in over 100 clinics. Schedule: first dose at 12 months; booster at 15 months via tetra-viral vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella, varicella); adolescents and adults up to 59 receive the triple viral vaccine. Infectious disease specialist José Urbaez warns one case can infect up to 18 people; symptoms include high fever, red rash, conjunctivitis, otitis, with pneumonia or death possible, especially in under-5s and older adults.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦直轄区（ブラジリア）麻疹ワクチン接種率に未達、感染リスクへの警戒を発令
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で麻疹症例が報告されており（主にサンパウロ、アマゾナス）、連邦直轄区でワクチン接種率の著しい不足が確認され、感染拡大の可能性と行政の対応強化が見られるためフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・連邦直轄区（ブラジリア）における麻疹ワクチン接種率の不足と感染リスクを主題としている。ペルー・コロンビアは国境付近のアマゾナス州の文脈で言及されているのみで、当該国での発生主題ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Gilead Expands Access to Investigational Obeldesivir for Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease Through Voluntary Licensing
article.articleSummary: Gilead expands access to investigational obeldesivir for Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) through royalty-free voluntary licenses with Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Eva Pharma and Ferozsons Laboratories, covering 127 primarily low- and lower-middle-income countries and all African nations that have reported Ebola BVD cases. The licenses aim to support potential future access as post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) while the EBO-PEP Phase 3, randomized, placebo-controlled field trial coordinated by ALIMA evaluates obeldesivir for high-risk contacts. In parallel, Gilead is updating remdesivir licensing to include filovirus disease to enable potential treatment access if PARTNERS results support use in Ebola BVD, subject to regulatory approvals. Gilead has donated more than 2,000 remdesivir vials for compassionate use in DRC, Uganda and Kenya. Obeldesivir remains investigational and unapproved for PEP or any indication.

triage.headline_ja: ギリアド、エボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス病治療薬オベルデシビルの自発的ライセンス供与によるアクセス拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョウ株）は重篤な疾患であり、DRC等でのコンパッショネートユース薬剤提供が継続している事実から、依然として現地で症例が発生していることが示唆される。重大性・異常性の観点からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は治療薬アクセス拡大（ライセンス供与）に関する製薬企業発のニュースであり、新規アウトブレイクの詳細（症例数・死亡者数等）は記載されていない。ただしDRC・ウガンダ・ケニアでのレムデシビル投与（コンパッショネートユース）の事実から、エボラ・ブンディブギョウ病が現地で継続していることが示唆される。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。続報で具体的な症例数・地域情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Multidisciplinary Care Resolves Severe Disseminated Tuberculosis and
article.articleSummary: Qinghai, China documents a single case of a 24-year-old pregnant woman at 30 weeks’ gestation with concurrent hematogenous disseminated tuberculosis, tuberculous meningitis, and active hepatitis B. Household exposure to pulmonary TB via her sister preceded two weeks of headaches, vomiting, and back pain. CSF Xpert detected Mycobacterium tuberculosis without rifampicin resistance; opening pressure >330 mm H2O; CSF showed abundant nucleated cells, elevated protein, low glucose, and reduced chloride. Chest CT revealed diffuse bilateral miliary nodules. HBV DNA was 1.94×10^8 IU/mL with triple-positive serology; TST and IGRA positive; HIV negative. In ICU, intracranial hypertension was managed by continuous lumbar cisternal CSF drainage, avoiding pregnancy-category C hyperosmolar agents. TB therapy began Oct 10 with isoniazid 0.6 g daily, rifampicin 0.45 g daily, ethambutol 0.75 g daily; pyrazinamide omitted due to GI intolerance. Co-infections included Mycoplasma pneumoniae IgM and Candida albicans, treated with azithromycin and nystatin. On Oct 15, deterioration prompted escalation of antimycobacterial therapy.

triage.headline_ja: 集学的治療により妊娠後期の重症播種性結核とB型肝炎が軽快した一例
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の臨床経過報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。個人の医学的管理事例にとどまる。
triage.notes: 単一患者の症例報告（家庭内曝露による結核感染、妊娠中のHBV重複感染等）であり、集団発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す内容ではないため対象国への該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Posso pegar mpox no corrimão do metrô? Infectologista esclarece dúvidas sobre a doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can I catch Mpox from the subway handrail? An infectious-disease specialist clarifies questions about Mpox.
article.articleSummary: In Brazil in 2026, São Paulo State leads mpox (monkeypox) cases with 398, while Rio de Janeiro State has 382 and reported the year's first mpox death in its capital. Transmission is mainly via direct contact with skin lesions; contaminated clothes or towels can also spread the virus. Common symptoms include fever, body aches, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions, with genital-area lesions possible. Infectious-disease specialist Álvaro Furtado (USP) notes that routine contact in gyms or on public transport is not a significant transmission route; the primary risk is intimate contact with someone infected. Diagnostic confirmation requires lab testing of lesion material, supported by a national network with facilities in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. Vaccine supply is constrained by a single global producer. HIV-positive individuals are prioritized due to higher risk of severe disease, followed by others at increased risk, to reduce severity and mortality.

triage.headline_ja: 地下鉄の手すりでMpoxに感染する？ 感染症専門医が疑問に回答
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でMpox症例（サンパウロ州398件、リオデジャネイロ州382件）と年内初の死亡例が報告されており、持続的なヒト-ヒト感染と公衆の関心の高まりが確認されるためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 記事は主に一般市民向けの感染経路に関するFAQ形式だが、サンパウロ州・リオデジャネイロ州における継続的な症例増加と死亡例の発生という実質的な疫学情報を含むため、既存のMpoxアウトブレイクの進展として経過観察・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يودي بحياة 5568 شخصا في الكونغو والإصابات تتجاوز 11 ألفا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has claimed the lives of 5,568 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with infections exceeding 11,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 11,376 cases and 5,568 deaths since it began in April 2026, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Kinshasa reported 60 new infections and 36 deaths in the last 24 hours. The outbreak remains out of control after more than six months, with challenges including attacks on health workers, delayed salaries, and resource shortages. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for this Bundibugyo strain. The figures reflect an ongoing, countrywide public health crisis as authorities continue to manage the outbreak. Significant emphasis is placed on the sustained transmission and the need for intensified response efforts. Keywords: Ebola, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Bundibugyo strain, Kinshasa, outbreak, public health challenges.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で死者5,568人、感染者11,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱流行（死者5,568人、感染者11,376人）が6か月以上制御不能な状態にあり、承認されたワクチン・治療法もなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株によるアウトブレイクであり、首都キンシャサでも感染拡大が確認されているため、国際的拡大や渡航制限の可能性について今後の続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết không còn theo mùa, chuyên gia cảnh báo nguy cơ mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is no longer seasonal; experts warn of new risks.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Vietnam is now year-round, with over 170,000 suspected cases and 21 deaths in 2026. Nationwide transmission persists, and Hanoi’s Thanh Nhàn Hospital reports 20 dengue patients admitted. Experts attribute the shift from seasonal peaks to continuous transmission to climate change, increased rainfall, and longer rainy seasons, making dengue a public health burden. Aedes mosquitoes can transmit the virus to eggs, allowing generations to persist, and traditional community surveillance (Breteau index) faces obstacles. Most hospitalizations involve children and the elderly, especially those with comorbidities or weakened immunity, including cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy or radiotherapy. A 47-year-old man from Bach Mai Ward, Hanoi, hospitalized with his third dengue episode, presented with high fever and headache, later developing hyponatremia (120 mmol/L) and mild anemia; paraneoplastic syndrome is suspected. In the 4–7 day window, risks include thrombocytopenia, liver enzyme elevation, and capillary leak; daily follow-up is essential, even after fever resolves.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱はもはや季節性ではない、専門家が新たなリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでデング熱が季節性を失い年間を通じて流行、17万件超の疑い例と21人の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: SFTSウイルスも疾患タグに含まれるが記事本文はデング熱に関する内容のみで言及なし。気候変動による蚊媒介感染症の伝播パターン変化が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en la RDC: UNICEF cifra en 1.737 los niños muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: UNICEF puts the number of dead children at 1,737.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, transmission continues and expands to new areas. As of 4 November, 2,959 children under 18 are confirmed infected and 1,737 have died. Children under 18 account for 28% of confirmed cases but 35% of deaths; under-fives are 14% of cases and 21% of deaths, with about 72% mortality among infected under five. Women and girls make up more than 53% of cases; among 15–17-year-olds, girls represent two-thirds of cases and 60% of deaths. More than 2,280 children have been orphaned or separated. Sixteen nurseries provide protection services. Access to services remains limited: births at affected North Kivu health centers fell ~18% (Jan–Sep); DTP third doses and measles first doses declined in several provinces. Nearly 7,500 schools with ~2.5 million pupils lack infection prevention measures, though 355,000+ have safe learning. The outbreak covers 67 health zones in eight provinces with active transmission in 51; the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC and second-largest globally. In 2026, 14.9 million people need humanitarian aid, including 8 million children. UNICEF urges sustained pediatric care, frontline worker protection, nursery support, family reunification, safe learning, and broader humanitarian action.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ユニセフが子どもの死者数1,737人と発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大・最悪のエボラ流行であり、8州67保健区域に拡大、死者多数（子ども1,737人）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はUNICEFによる人道的影響の報告が中心で、国際的拡大や渡航制限についての言及はないが、エボラの性質上ヒト-ヒト感染リスクが高く、既に過去最大規模に拡大している点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola claims 5,568 lives in Congo, with infections exceeding 11,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 5,568 deaths and 11,376 cases since the outbreak began in April 2026. In the latest 24 hours, 60 new cases and 36 deaths were reported. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible; no vaccine or licensed treatment exists. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya warns the outbreak remains out of control more than six months after it was first declared, citing attacks on healthcare workers, delays in staff salaries, and a shortage of resources. The Kinshasa-based daily report confirms ongoing transmission in the DRC as of 17 November 2026. Kinshasa-based report underscores ongoing transmission and a health system strained by attacks on workers and funding gaps.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が5,568人死亡、感染者11,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模に拡大しコントロール不能な状態にあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ワクチン・承認された治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行で、医療従事者への攻撃や資金不足により制御が困難な状況が継続している。6ヶ月以上流行が続いており、致死率も高い（約49%）。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: entenda a disparada de casos, primeiros sinais, transmissão, tratamento e prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Understand the surge in cases, early signs, transmission, treatment, and prevention.
article.articleSummary: First mpox death in Brazil in 2026 confirmed by the Rio de Janeiro State Health Secretariat. Nationwide mpox cases total 1,055, with Minas Gerais reporting 41 infections. Mpox is caused by MPXV, an Orthopoxvirus and zoonosis; most infections are mild to moderate. Transmission occurs via contact with infected people, especially direct contact with skin lesions and mucous membranes. Symptoms include rash and skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, muscle pains, chills, and fatigue. People living with HIV are at higher risk of clinical worsening. The report notes a surge in cases across Brazil and cites a video briefing by infectious disease specialist Melissa Valentini of Lab-to-Lab Hermes Pardini for further details.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox:症例急増の理解、初期症状、感染経路、治療、予防について
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年初のMpox死亡例が確認され、全国で症例が1,055件に急増しているため、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）に2つ以上該当すると判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州保健局が確認した2026年初のMpox死亡例および全国的な症例急増（1,055件、ミナスジェライス州41件）を報告。HIV陽性者は重症化リスクが高いとされる。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Two Decades of Surveillance Reveal Rising Dengue Burden Across China
article.articleSummary: Two decades of dengue surveillance in China show a shift from sporadic imported infections to a domestic public health threat. Reported cases rose from 40 (2005) to 24,278 (2024), with a cumulative 138,885 cases and 14 deaths across 31 divisions and the Xinjiang Corps. Age-standardized incidence climbed from 0.0036 to 1.6984 per 100,000, peaking at 4.1092 per 100,000 in 2014 (46,864 cases). Joinpoint analysis estimates an average annual percent change of 30.1%. Diagnoses rely on nucleic acid testing; 2008 revisions added IgG/IgM serology, while 2018 revisions recognized NS1 antigen and severe dengue definitions. Epidemics occurred in 2014, 2019, 2023, and 2024. A 2020–2022 decline tracked COVID-19 NPIs and border controls that reduced importation of foreign lineages, with resurgence in 2023. Geographic spread expanded from 31 districts in 2005 to 895 districts in 2024 across 28 divisions; Guangdong accounted for 11 of 14 deaths, and Yunnan showed across-demographic incidence increases.

triage.headline_ja: 中国における2十年間のサーベイランスが示すデング熱負荷の増加傾向
triage.triage_reason: 過去20年間のデング熱発生動向に関する疫学研究であり、現在進行中の急性アウトブレイクを示すものではないが、輸入例から国内定着への移行と急速な地理的拡大が示されており、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術的サーベイランス研究の要約であり、速報的な感染症イベントではない。過去のデータ（2005-2024年）に基づく傾向分析であり、即時のRRA対象というより継続監視対象と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: 'ไอกรน' โรคร้ายที่อาจทำให้เด็กอ่อนแอและเสี่ยงต่อชีวิต
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Whooping cough' is a dangerous disease that can weaken infants and put their lives at risk.
article.articleSummary: Pertussis (whooping cough), caused by Bordetella pertussis and spread via respiratory droplets, poses a high risk to infants and young children with immature immunity. Without timely treatment, it can cause severe complications such as pneumonia, seizures, or death. WHO data show rising global activity: more than 150,000 cases worldwide in 2023; the United States records over 15,000 annually, and Thailand has increasing cases, particularly among unvaccinated or under-vaccinated children. The disease progresses in three stages: catarrhal (cold-like symptoms for 1–2 weeks), paroxysmal (repeated coughing fits with a whoop, lasting 1–6 weeks and potentially causing vomiting or breathing difficulty), and convalescent (gradual recovery). On average, affected children cough around 112 days. Antibiotics are most effective within seven days of symptoms; severe cases may require hospitalization. Prevention relies on DTP vaccination at 2, 4, 6, and 18 months, plus boosters for adolescents and adults every 10 years.

triage.headline_ja: 「百日咳」は乳幼児を衰弱させ、命に関わる危険性のある病気
triage.triage_reason: 百日咳に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の突発的アウトブレイクや緊急事態を報じるものではない。タイでの増加傾向への言及はあるが具体的な症例数や地域情報が乏しく、既知の疾患で管理可能な範囲と考えられる。
triage.notes: 記事は百日咳の一般的な疾患解説・予防啓発が主眼であり、米国とタイの罹患者数増加傾向についてWHOデータを引用しているが、突発的な異常事態を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết không còn theo mùa, chuyên gia cảnh báo nguy cơ mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is no longer seasonal; experts warn of a new risk.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is year-round in Vietnam, with over 170,000 suspected cases and 21 deaths since January 2026. Transmission occurs monthly nationwide, linked to climate change and longer rainy seasons. In Hanoi, Thanh Nhàn Hospital treats 20 dengue patients; cases are down from earlier years but higher than last year, and severity may rise in people with underlying conditions. A 47-year-old man from Bạch Mai, Hanoi, was hospitalized for a third dengue episode, with headache and fever (38–39°C); labs showed mild anemia and severe hyponatremia (120), prompting evaluation for a malignancy. Professor Nguyen Van Kinh says dengue is now endemic in Vietnam; vector control remains challenging as Aedes mosquitoes persist via transovarial transmission. Health monitoring uses Breteau index; early management focuses on fever control and hydration, while days 4–7 require vigilance for complications such as thrombocytopenia, liver enzyme elevation, plasma leakage, and myocarditis risk. Children and the elderly need care.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱はもはや季節性ではない、専門家が新たなリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでデング熱が通年化し17万人超の疑い例・21人の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と疫学パターンの異常性（季節性の消失）という2つのIHR基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 疾患名にSFTS Virusが含まれているが記事サマリー・本文には一切言及がなく誤分類の可能性が高い。本イベントは専らデング熱（Dengue）に関する内容であり、ベトナム国内（ハノイ含む）での通年発生と重症化リスクに焦点を当てている。

article.articleHeadline: Two Plasmodium falciparum Gene Variants Modestly Associate With Severe
article.articleSummary: Plasmodium falciparum cbp1 and cbp2, genes encoding CX3CL1-binding proteins, show non-coding polymorphisms modestly linked to malaria severity in Thailand. In a cohort of 473 clinical isolates from patients with mild malaria, cerebral malaria, or severe malaria without cerebral complications, cbp1 379 C/T (intron near the splicing site) associated with cerebral malaria (odds ratio 1.99, 95% CI 1.03–3.85). cbp2 2306 A/T (3′ UTR) associated with severe malaria without cerebral complications (OR 6.67, 95% CI 1.28–34.73). Parasite density did not differ across cbp1/cbp2 genotypes. Genomic analysis found high conservation: cbp1 had nine SNPs (three coding synonymous), cbp2 had three non-coding SNPs and nine microsatellites, with no coding variants in cbp2. Illumina sequencing of 30 isolates guided broader genotyping by PCR-RFLP and Sanger on 473 samples. Authors call for functional studies to understand how these non-coding variants influence host–parasite interactions and disease severity.

triage.headline_ja: 2つのPlasmodium falciparum遺伝子変異がタイにおける重症マラリアと緩やかに関連
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は遺伝子多型と重症マラリアの関連性を調べた基礎研究であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な感染拡大を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の臨床検体（473例）を用いた遺伝学的研究報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではないため、地域検証対象外（研究対象地域としてタイが言及されているが、イベントとしてのトリアージ対象ではない）。

article.articleHeadline: 수억 달러 지원에도 에볼라 확산 못 막아...방역 현장은 인력·장비 부족 - 시사저널
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even with hundreds of millions of dollars in aid, the spread of Ebola couldn't be contained... The disease-control frontline is short of personnel and equipment - Sisa Journal
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Democratic Republic of Congo's second-largest Ebola outbreak, transmission remains uncontained despite hundreds of millions in aid. In Ituri, Haut-Uele and North Kivu provinces, frontline responders report severe shortages of personnel, medical supplies, and equipment, with some staff unpaid and ambulances running on fuel shortages. Healthcare workers treat suspected cases without adequate materials. MSF warns that despite large funding, many frontline teams lack gear and salaries, hampering containment. Surveillance gaps persist: despite resource allocations, several areas are neglected, and about two-thirds of Ebola deaths in the past month occurred outside treatment centers, delaying detection and isolation. Only 9% of MSF-treated patients were previously identified as contacts. Basic disinfection gear and PPE are scarce in Beni (North Kivu) and Haut-Uele, where 75% of facility infections occurred. Private clinics, pharmacies, and traditional healers remain largely outside response plans. Cases exceed 11,000; deaths exceed 5,000. Vaccines and therapies trials show progress, but urgent needs include transparent resource management and stronger on-the-ground staff support by the DRC government and UN.

triage.headline_ja: 数億ドルの支援にもかかわらずエボラ拡大を抑えられず…防疫現場は人員・装備不足 - シサジャーナル
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行が6か月経過しても制御できておらず、死者5000人超・症例1万1000人超に達し、国際的な拡大・支援必要性が高いため。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州・オートウエレ州はDRC国内の州であり、国レベルではDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。既知の継続的エボラ流行に関する続報で、資源不足・サーベイランスの欠陥が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: Brasil reforça vacinação após aumento de casos em 18 estados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: Brazil steps up vaccination after a surge in cases in 18 states
article.articleSummary: COVID-19: Brazil steps up vaccination after rising mild cases across 18 states. The Health Ministry will distribute over 1.4 million extra doses to ten states, led by São Paulo (>500,000), Rio de Janeiro (350,000), and Minas Gerais (290,000), with 150,000 for Rio de Janeiro capital. Vaccines are provided by SUS and not sold privately, aiming to reinforce stocks for priority groups under the National Vaccination Schedule. Target groups include children 6 months to under 5, pregnant women, and people 60+. Dosing: every six months for elderly and immunocompromised; once a year for chronically ill, health workers, Indigenous and quilombolas, ribeirinhos, homeless, incarcerated, long-term residents, postal workers, and puerperal women who did not vaccinate during gestation. Pregnant women: one dose per pregnancy. Unvaccinated children: three-dose series (4 weeks between first-second, 8 weeks to third). In 2026, 3,641 SRAG cases and 445 deaths, down ~70% from 2025. 22.9 million doses distributed; 7.6 million administered; Pfizer’s Comirnaty used by SUS. Fiocruz notes rising severe cases in Center-South and Bahia, though still low.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19：ブラジル、18州で症例増加を受けワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19軽症例の増加と予防接種強化の通常対応であり、重症度・国際的拡大の兆候は限定的だが、Center-South及びBahiaでの重症例増加傾向に注視が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年のSRAG症例・死亡数は2025年比約70%減少しており、全体として制御下にある。ただしCenter-SouthとBahiaでの重症例増加傾向は続報確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Tosse persistente merece atenção: conheça os sinais da tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Persistent cough warrants attention: learn the signs of tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Persistent cough lasting three weeks or more is the key warning sign of tuberculosis (TB), an airborne lung disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (the Koch bacillus) that can also cause afternoon fever, night sweats, and weight loss. In Brazil, TB is curable with treatment lasting at least six months and provided free by the Unified Health System (SUS); patients should complete therapy and not discontinue it. Diagnosis requires clinical evaluation plus laboratory tests and chest X-ray; tests include rapid molecular testing, sputum smear microscopy (bacilloscopy), and culture. Active pulmonary or laryngeal TB can release bacteria into the air when coughing, sneezing or talking, enabling transmission to close contacts; sharing cups or utensils is not a major transmission route. Prevention includes BCG vaccination in childhood, well-ventilated spaces, and cough etiquette. Health teams may screen contacts for latent infection and provide preventive treatment when indicated.

triage.headline_ja: 持続する咳には注意を：結核の兆候を知る

triage.notes: 本記事は結核の症状・診断・治療・予防に関する一般的な健康啓発情報であり、特定の発生状況や集団感染を報告するものではない。ブラジルのSUS（統一医療制度）における標準治療について触れているのみで、アウトブレイク情報ではないためverified_locationsも空とした。

article.articleHeadline: उत्तराखंड में इबोला को लेकर स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट, अस्पतालों को निगरानी और बचाव के पुख्ता इंतजाम करने के निर्देश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uttarakhand Health Department issues alert on Ebola, directs hospitals to strengthen surveillance and implement robust preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: On 16 November 2026, Uttarakhand’s Health Department issued an Ebola alert as cases rise in African countries, directing Dehradun hospitals to bolster surveillance, infection-control measures, and isolation capacity. Travelers returning from affected countries will be monitored for 21 days, with district surveillance units conducting daily health checks and traveler lists доступible on the Airport Health Integrated Disease Surveillance Program (IHIP) portal. Suspected cases require single-room isolation, PPE (N-95 masks, gloves), and rapid referral to AIIMS Rishikesh; a district Rapid Response Team will identify and monitor contacts. Key warning signs include fever with bleeding, red eyes, rash, diarrhea or vomiting blood, and recent travel to or contact with a case within 21 days. Emphasis on avoiding direct contact with blood/body fluids and frequent handwashing; all public and private hospitals must follow infection-control protocols.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタラーカンド州保健局がエボラ警戒を発令、病院に監視体制と予防対策の強化を指示

triage.notes: 記事はインド・ウッタラーカンド州における予防的な監視体制強化の指示であり、実際のエボラ症例はアフリカ諸国で報告されているとされるが具体的な国名は記載されていない。インド国内での感染確認情報はないため、対象国としての発生は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: 三种毒株同时流行 别把得过一次流感当"护身符" -泉州网|泉州晚报社 泉州新闻门户网站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three influenza strains circulating simultaneously; don't treat having had influenza once as a 'protective talisman'.
article.articleSummary: China’s influenza surveillance shows three strains co-circulating nationwide: A(H3N2), A(H1N1), and B/Victoria. Positive detections have risen in both southern and northern provinces; this season began early with multi-strain circulation, breaking the previous single-dominant pattern. In Quanzhou, Fujian, influenza activity is at a mid-season level and has not reached a peak. Children, especially infants and preschoolers, are most affected. A(H3N2) and B/Victoria are distinct strains, and infection with one does not confer protection against others. Typical symptoms include sudden high fever (up to 40°C), cough and fatigue; fever lasts 3–5 days and overall illness may take 1–2 weeks, with gastrointestinal symptoms more common in children with B. Antiviral treatment is most effective within 48 hours of onset; oseltamivir and baloxavir remain generally effective. Antibiotics do not treat influenza. Early vaccination (6 months and older) is recommended, along with routine preventive measures (hand hygiene, ventilation, masking, and avoiding crowded settings).

triage.headline_ja: 3つのインフルエンザ株が同時流行中、一度罹患したことを「お守り」にしてはいけない
triage.triage_reason: 中国における季節性インフルエンザ（A/H3N2、A/H1N1、B/Victoria）の複数株同時流行に関する公衆衛生啓発記事であり、典型的な季節性疾患の範囲内で重症化や国際的拡大の兆候は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの流行状況と予防啓発を目的とした一般向け医療情報記事であり、異常事態や緊急対応を要する内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 中国疫情拉警报 中青年重症率高出近5倍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's outbreak raises alarm as the severe illness rate among young and middle-aged adults is nearly five times higher.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in China is driven by a virulent emergent variant PJ.2.1 with widespread southern spread. Researchers report the severe-illness rate among young and middle-aged adults is nearly five times higher than in earlier waves, and post‑infection sequelae are common, with recurrent hospitalizations and escalating cardiovascular and pulmonary damage. In Shenzhen, wastewater surveillance detected PJ.2.1 in late October; international agencies had flagged the variant, but authorities reportedly suppressed reporting. Guangdong, Sichuan, and Chongqing show sustained transmission; Beijing and Shanghai wastewater data have risen, while Xinjiang, the Northeast, Yunnan, and Guizhou report ongoing activity amid cold, foggy weather. Long‑term sequelae among Shenzhen patients rose from about 30% to 50%. A 35-year-old patient in Yunnan illustrates enduring impairment, requiring oxygen and repeated hospitalizations following prior severe pneumonia.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で疫情拡大、警戒強まる－若年・中年層の重症化率が過去の約5倍に
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1による重症化率上昇・後遺症増加の報告があり、複数省での持続的な伝播と当局による報告抑制の疑いがあるためIHR基準を2つ以上満たすと判断されるが、単一の政治色の強いメディア報道であり裏付け情報が乏しい点に留意が必要。
triage.notes: 出典はaboluowang.com（海外華人系・反中共的傾向のあるメディア）であり、WHOや中国当局の公式発表による裏付けが現時点で確認できない。新変異株PJ.2.1や重症化率5倍などの主張は未検証であり、続報・公式情報源での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RJ passa a atualizar painel de casos de mpox diariamente | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RJ starts updating the mpox case dashboard daily | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleSummary: On 16 November 2026, Rio de Janeiro State Health Secretariat began daily updates to the Monitora RJ mpox dashboard, compiling notified, confirmed, and discarded cases across 92 municipalities. As of that date, the state had 396 confirmed mpox cases and one death, with Rio de Janeiro city accounting for 71.2% of confirmed cases in 2026. Growth accelerated since epidemiological week 37 (began 13 September). The dashboard is accessible at saude.rj.gov.br under Monitora RJ > Vigilância em Saúde > mpox. Monitoring is led by CIEVS and summarized in weekly bulletins. A mpox technical note was sent to municipal health secretariats, and 500 professionals were trained in diagnosis, management, and prevention. In early November, 2,000 vaccine doses were allotted to Rio, with distribution to other municipalities pending assessment and stock. Mpox is MPXV (Orthopoxvirus); transmission mainly via contact with lesions; symptoms include rash, lymphadenopathy, fever, fatigue. Prevention: avoid contact and seek care.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州、mpox症例ダッシュボードを毎日更新開始
triage.triage_reason: 既知のmpoxアウトブレイクに関する行政的なモニタリング体制強化の報告であり、新規異常事象ではないが、症例増加傾向と地域拡大が続いているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はリオデジャネイロ州における既存のmpox監視体制の強化（ダッシュボード日次更新、専門職研修、ワクチン配布）を報告しており、新規の異常発生シグナルではないが、症例数の増加傾向（第37週以降加速）と1名の死亡例があるため継続的な観察対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de covid-19 caem na Baixada Santista, apesar de alta no Estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases fall in Baixada Santista, despite a rise in the state.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases fall in Baixada Santista despite a state-wide rise in SRAG (COVID-19–related). Fiocruz data for the first seven days of November show six municipalities not following the statewide upsurge. Santos registered only 3 of this year’s 85 confirmed cases from September–November, with a peak of 23 in June and 14 in January and May. São Vicente has 19 cases this year (largest in January, 7); Mongaguá, 16; Guarujá, 56 (down from 190 in 2025); Itanhaém, 30; Cubatão, 84 through October (peak 29 in May). Praia Grande, Bertioga and Peruíbe did not report. Santos notes a 64.8% drop in cases January–October vs last year and hospitalizations down 78.3% (8 vs 37); one COVID-19 death this year (two in 2025). Vaccination remains available in the region, prioritized for young children and older adults, with age-based dosing schedules.
